text: Ang malain pa kay, halin mismo sa baba sang isa ka kongresista, nasiling pa sini nga:  “Bay-i lang sila dira, tutal mabakal ta man liwat ang ila boto!” Wala huya matuod!
english: Worse, from the mouth of a congressman, he said: “Leave them alone, since we can buy their votes again!” Shameless indeed!

text: Pero may sabat dira ang pila ka botante.
english: But some voters have an answer.

text: “Kon ginbaton namon ang imo kwarta ina tungod sa pagpati man nga matuman mo ang imo pangako, gali ginpalapaw mo lang kami.
english: “If we accepted your money because we believed that you would keep your promise, you would have let us down.

text:
May adlaw ka man, kay sa sunod nga eleksyon kag liwat mo kami tanyagan sang kuno bulig mo nga kwarta, ang kontra mo na ang amon botohon.”

Nga ginhimo matuod sang madamo sang nagligad nga eleksyon!
english:
You have a day, because in the next election and you offer us your money again, we will vote for your opponent.”

Which many did indeed in the last election!

text: Ang isa sa pinaka-manggaran dira sa NCR ginlutos gani sing daku sang ordinaryo lang niya nga kasumpong.
english: One of the richest men in the NCR was even severely defeated by his ordinary opponent.

text: Kag ang madamo pa sa ila sa iban nga lugar sa pungsod, lakip na ang gapa-cute lang nga wala naman sing mahimo kon yara na sa poder.
english: And many more of them in other parts of the country, including those who are just cute and can't do anything when they are in power.

text:
***

Nonetheless, bisan sa sining klase sang panan-aw sa pulitiko, ang desperado nga botante, nga minilyon ini sila, magarisgo gihapon sa paghatag sang pagsalig sa pangako sang pulitiko, labi na gid kon may panagupnop man sila nga basi matuman ini sang pulitiko.
english:
***

Nonetheless, even with this kind of political view, desperate voters, millions of them, will still risk giving confidence to the politician's promise, especially if they have a sense that the politician might keep it.

text: Katulad sa pangako sadto sang Marcos-Duterte tandem sadtong 2022 presidential election nga ipatuman nila ang PhP20 kada kilo nga bugas kon magdaug sila.
english: Similar to the promise of the Marcos-Duterte tandem during the 2022 presidential election that they will implement PhP20 per kilo of rice if they win.

text: Sadto, ang bili sang bugas galab-ot na sa PhP33 kada kilo.
english: In the past, the price of rice was as high as PhP33 per kilo.

text: Wala lang kita kaseguro kon bala ang PhP20 kada kilo nga bugas amo gid ang nagpadaug sa Marcos-Duterte tandem kag sang ila grupo.
english: We are not sure whether the PhP20 per kilo of rice really won the Marcos-Duterte tandem and their group.

text: Madamo man sa mga botante sadto nga luyag botohon ang mga kandidato nga gapasalig sang dugang nga sueldo kag ayuda sa ila pagpangabuhi, katulad sang duha (2) ka milyon nga mga mangunguma sa ila handom nga mapauswag man ang ila standard of living, lakip na ang nakapakita sing kaisug sa kawsa sang hustisya para sa mga pigos.
english: Many of the voters then wanted to vote for candidates who promised higher wages and livelihood assistance, such as the two (2) million farmers in their desire to improve their standard of living, including those who showed courage in the cause of justice for the oppressed.

text: Gapati gani ang isa ka political analyst nga ang pagdaug sang  Marcos-Duterte Unity Team natigayon lang paagi sa daku nga suporta sang mga kaugyon nila nga traditional families (dinastiya) gamit ang ila kwarta kag impluwensya.
english: One political analyst even believes that the victory of the Marcos-Duterte Unity Team was achieved only through the huge support of their fellow traditional families (dynasties) using their money and influence.

text:
***

Well, naghamdom gid man si PBBM nga ipatuman ang iya pangako nga PhP20 kada kilo nga bugas, tatlo ka tuig despues sang sining tuig lang, sang nakita niya ang sige pagtaas gihapon sang presyo sini.
english:
***

Well, PBBM is determined to implement its promise of PhP20 per kilo of rice, three years after this year, when it saw the price of rice continue to rise.

text: Sa ina nga tion, ang bili sang bugas nakasaka na halin sa farmgate pakadto sa mga retail store sing 80% tubtub 190%, sunu sa Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism.
english: During that time, the price of rice from the farmgate to retail stores has increased by 80% to 190%, according to the Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism.

text: Ironically, bisan pa sa pagsaka sang produksyon sang humay (unmilled rice) sang 1.53% sa 20.06 metriko tonelada (MT) halin sa tuig 2022.
english: Ironically, despite the rise in paddy (unmilled rice) production by 1.53% to 20.06 metric tons (MT) from the year 2022.

text: Na-tsunami ini seguro sang mas mabaskug nga mga kabangdanan agud magtaas pa ang bili sang bugas, katulad sang pagtaas man sang mga agricultural inputs kag ang iligal nga pag-kontrol sang mga rice cartel sang suplay sang bugas.
english: This is probably a tsunami of stronger factors to increase the price of rice, such as the increase in agricultural inputs and the illegal control of rice cartels over the supply of rice.

text: Sang sining ulihi lang, ang presyo sang bugas sa merkado nagalab-ot na kada kilo sa PhP49 (regular milled)  kag PhP54.68 (well-milled).
english: Until recently, the price of rice in the market reached PhP49 (regular milled) and PhP54.68 (well-milled) per kilo.

text: Ang procurement cost sang bugas sang NFA naglapaw man sa PhP20 kada kilo, agud planuhan na sini nga ipasaka sa PhP38 kada kilo agud malagas ang bili sang bugas sa open market kag agud indi gid matam-an pa sing pamierde ang NFA.
english: The procurement cost of rice of the NFA also exceeded PhP20 per kilo, so it plans to increase it to PhP38 per kilo to keep up with the price of rice in the open market and so that the NFA does not suffer more losses.

text: Naghatag gani ini sing lubos nga pangduha-duha sa mga economic experts kon mapatuman pa ang PhP20 kada kilo nga bugas.
english: This has even caused economic experts to doubt whether the PhP20 per kilo of rice will be implemented.

text: Sunu sa ila, indi “praktikal” gid man nga solusyon ang pagpanubo sang bili sang bugas sa PhP20 kada kilo sa kahimtangan karon sang aton Free Enterprise economy.
english: According to them, it is not a “practical” solution to reduce the price of rice to PhP20 per kilo in the current state of our Free Enterprise economy.

text: Meaning, ma-expect gid man kita sang pagbag-o bag-o sang presyo sang bugas tungod man sa pagbag-o bag-o sang mga prevailing factors.
english: Meaning, we can expect changes in the price of rice due to changes in prevailing factors.

text: Luas lang seguro kon may ideya ang gobyerno kon paano mapatuman ining PhP20 per kilo sing masulhay gihapon, labi na gid sa mga mangunguma nga ang padayon nga pagnubo sang bili sang bugas makahalit pa gid sa pagbaligya nila sang humay.
english: Unless the government has an idea how to implement the PhP20 per kilo easily, especially for farmers whose continued decline in rice prices will further damage their rice sales.

text: Sin-o ayhan ang makapasalig sina?
english: Who can guarantee that?

text: Si Speaker Martin Romualdez?
english: If Speaker Martin Romualdez?

text: Siling niya nga may mga insiyatibo kag mga kasuguan nga makapa-PERMANENTE pa gani sang bili sa bugas sa PhP20 kada kilo.
english: He said that there are initiatives and laws that can even PERMANENT rice price to PhP20 per kilo.

text: Para sa mga may low-income, syempre.
english: For low-income earners, of course.

text: Lakip diri segurado ang siyam (9) ka milyon nga yara sa poverty threshold kag minimum wage earners.
english: This includes certainly nine (9) million who are below the poverty threshold and minimum wage earners.

text: That’s a tall order, Mr.speaker!
english: That’s a tall order, Mr.speaker!

text: Tuod?
english: Facts?

text: Maayo kon matuod, Gasiling ugaling ang aton abyan nga si Pedro nga patup-a anay a!
english: Well, if it's true, but our friend Peter says, "Stop it!"

text: Bisan sa sulod lang sang anom ka bulan!
english: Even for just six months!

text: Samtang, may gina-proponer sanday Senador Panfilo Lacson kag Tito Sotto kon paano mabuligan ang pagpanubo sang bili sang bugas para sa publiko.
english: Meanwhile, Senators Panfilo Lacson and Tito Sotto have proposed how to help reduce the price of rice for the public.

text:
Ila suhestyon nga ibanan ang mga tikang (steps) nga nagakatabo sa pagpabili sang bugas halin sa farmgate tubtub sa retail stores kon diin daku ang kahilabtanan

sang mga rice traders.
english:
They suggest reducing the steps involved in the pricing of rice from farmgate to retail stores where there is a lot of involvement

of rice traders.

text: Kon matigayon ini, makapanubo kuno ini sing natural sang bili sang bugas sa publiko tubtub sa 20%.
english: If achieved, it is said to naturally reduce the cost of rice to the public by up to 20%.

text: Good luck sa ini nga hingyo ninyo nga basi mapatuman man!/PN
english: Good luck with this request that may be implemented!/PN

text: Nalutos ang Filipino tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa imbukada nga hampang sini sa Qatar Open kagab-i, Pebrero 9 (Manila time).
english: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala lost in his opening match at the Qatar Open last night, February 9 (Manila time).

text: Ang nagpierde sa iya amo ang Czech teen qualifier nga si Tereza Valentova sa skor nga 7-6, 6-1.
english: She was defeated by Czech teen qualifier Tereza Valentova 7-6, 6-1.

text: Ini na ang pangaduha nga tion nga nalutos sini si Eala matapos ang Japan Open round of 32 sang nagligad nga Oktubre.
english: This is the second time he has beaten Eala since the Japan Open round of 32 last October.

text: Magapahuway lang sang makadali ang 20-anyos nga Pinay player antes ang iya dugang nga hampang sa United Arab Emirates para sa Dubai Tennis Championships nga naka-schedule sa Pebrero 15 tubtub 21.
english: The 20-year-old Filipina will take a break before her next match in the United Arab Emirates for the Dubai Tennis Championships scheduled for February 15 to 21.

text: Kahapon sang ginkumpirma nga nagsaka na si Eala sa world no.
english: Yesterday when it was confirmed that Eala has risen to world no.

text: 40 sa WTA ranking matapos nga nakadangat sa singles quarterfinal kag doubles semifinal sa WTA 500 Abu Dhabi Open sa UAE sang nagligad nga semana.
english: 40 in the WTA ranking after reaching the singles quarterfinal and doubles semifinals at the WTA 500 Abu Dhabi Open in the UAE last week.

text: SADTONG 1935 naisipan ni Alan Mathison Turing, isa ka British physicist, ang isa ka “abstract computing machine”.
english: IN 1935 Alan Mathison Turing, a British physicist, conceived of an “abstract computing machine”.

text: May “limitless memory” ini kag scanner nga pwede mangin Electronic Brain.
english: It has “limitless memory” and a scanner that can become an Electronic Brain.

text:
Nagbunga ini sa pag-imbento na sang “programmable digital computer” sadtong 1940 tubtub natawo gid ang Electronic Brain sadtong 1956 sa isa ka workshop sa Dartmouth College, New Hampshire, U.S.A.

Nagpakita ini sang “intelligence” nga may ikasarang kasubong sang Human Intelligence, nga sang ulihi ginhingadlan na sa tawag nga Artificial Intelligence (AI).
english:
This led to the invention of the programmable digital computer in the 1940s until the birth of the Electronic Brain in 1956 in a workshop at Dartmouth College, New Hampshire, U.S.A.

It showed an “intelligence” with capabilities similar to Human Intelligence, which was later renamed Artificial Intelligence (AI).

text: Gin-“predict” na sadto ni Turing nga sa sige pag-uswag sang Electronic Brain mangin isa na ini ka “very good chess player”.
english: Turing predicted that the Electronic Brain would become a very good chess player.

text: Napamatud-an ini sadtong 1991 sang ginlutos sang IBM’s Deep Blue computer si Garry Kasparov, nga world champion sadto, sa isa ka six-game match sa score nga 3.5-2.5.
english: This was proven back in 1991 when IBM’s Deep Blue computer defeated Garry Kasparov, then world champion, in a six-game match by a score of 3.5-2.5.

text: Sadtong 2024, naalarma na gani si Stephen Hawking, nga isa ka world-renowned physicist kag cosmologist, sa padayon pa gid nga pag-uswag sang AI.
english: By 2024, even Stephen Hawking, a world-renowned physicist and cosmologist, will be alarmed by the continued development of AI.

text: Sa isa ka interbyu sa BBC, nagpaandam si Hawking nga ang padayon nga development sang AI “… could spell the end of the human race”.
english: In an interview with the BBC, Hawking warned that the continued development of AI “… could spell the end of the human race”.

text: Sunu sa iya nga, samtang nangin mapuslanon ang paggamit sang AI sa panugod, ang padayon nga pag-uswag sini mangin isa na ini ka “…machine that can become more intelligent than humans”.
english: He said that, while the use of AI was useful in the beginning, its continued development will make it a “…machine that can become more intelligent than humans”.

text: By then, siling pa niya, “AI would take off on its own, and re-design itself at an ever-increasing rate,” nga magpatuhaw sang isa ka sosyedad sang “intelligent machines” nga amo pa ang madikta sang ila luyag sa tawo nga nag-imbento sa ila.
english: By then, he said, “AI would take off on its own, and re-design itself at an ever-increasing rate,” creating a society of “intelligent machines” that would still dictate their wishes to the human who invented them.

text: Ma-“imagine” naton ang ining hitablo sa serye sang pelikula nga Terminator.
english: We can “imagine” this event in the Terminator movie series.

text: Napakita diri ang pagtuhaw sang “intelligent machines”, sa pagpamuno ni Skynet, nga nagapakig-away sa mga tawo sa isa ka “do-or-die combat” agud maghari sa katauhan.
english: It shows the emergence of “intelligent machines”, led by Skynet, who fight humans in a “do-or-die combat” to rule mankind.

text: Pero matabo bala ini sa aktwal nga sitwasyon?
english: But will this happen in the actual situation?

text: Sadtong 2023 pa lang, na-surpass na sang AI ang “human performance” sa madamo nga bagay.
english: As early as 2023, AI has surpassed “human performance” in many areas.

text: Although, ang AI mismo wala nagapanugyan, among others, sang paggamit sang “intelligence” sini sa pila ka areas sang “educational teaching”, tungod sa ethical, practical kag pedagogical concerns.
english: Although, AI itself does not recommend, among others, the use of its “intelligence” in some areas of “educational teaching”, due to ethical, practical and pedagogical concerns.

text: Kalakip diri ang areas sang personalized learning, automated assessment and grading, social and emotional learning, critical thinking development, cultural sensitivity, special education, ethical considerations involving data privacy, surveillance, kag potential bias in educational content and assessments, nga, agud indi ma-violate sang AI, kinahanglan gid ang human interaction and oversight.
english: These include the areas of personalized learning, automated assessment and grading, social and emotional learning, critical thinking development, cultural sensitivity, special education, ethical considerations involving data privacy, surveillance, and potential bias in educational content and assessments, which, in order not to be violated by AI, require human interaction and oversight.

text:
***

Sa karon, galab-ot na gani ang kinaalam sang AI sa “machine learning”,  “deep learning” kag “neural  networks”, nga maintiendihan lang sang mga propesyonal   sa “digital works”,  nga paagi sini makahimo ini, gamit ang natipon sini nga “vast data”,  sang  prediksyon ukon desisyon sa nagakalain-lain nga “human concerns”.
english:
***

Today, AI has reached the level of machine learning, deep learning and neural networks, which can only be understood by professionals in digital works, through which it can make, using its vast data, predictions or decisions on various human concerns.

text: Ensyano na ini sa “image recognition” kag “language translation” nga may ikasarang man sa paghangop (understand), paghibalo (learn) kag mag-apply sang intelligence sa madamo nga tasks nga mas “efficient” pa sa Human Intelligence.
english: It is skilled in image recognition and language translation with the ability to understand, learn and apply intelligence to many tasks that are more efficient than Human Intelligence.

text: Maka-operate na gani ang AI sing makinaugalingon (autonomous) sa madamo nga “task categories”.
english: AI can even operate autonomously in many task categories.

text: Ang iban pabor sa aton, katulad sang pagbulig sa paghimo sang desisyon sa areas sang finance, healthcare, kag security nga indi kinahanglan ang “human oversight”.
english: Others are in our favor, such as helping to make decisions in the areas of finance, healthcare, and security that do not require human oversight.

text: May potensyal man ini ugaling nga mangin mahaliton, katulad sang pagpatuman sang “automated processes” nga magaresulta sa “job displacement” kag “economic shifts”; “biases in training data” nga makaresulta sa “unfair outcomes”.
english: However, it also has the potential to be harmful, such as the implementation of automated processes that will result in job displacement and economic shifts; “biases in training data” that can result in “unfair outcomes”.

text: Ang “autonomous systems” sang AI magamit man sa “malicious purposes”, katulad sang “cyber attacks”.
english: AI's autonomous systems can also be used for malicious purposes, such as cyber attacks.

text: Lakip diri ang panghangkat sang “AI-generated images”, katulad sang “deepfakes”, “voice cloning”, kag iban pa nga “AI-created content”, nga makahalit sa tawo, reputasyon kag negosyo nga kon indi dayon ma-“fact check” kaluluoy gid lang ang bikima.
english: This includes the challenge of “AI-generated images”, such as “deepfakes”, “voice cloning”, and other “AI-created content”, which can damage people, reputation and businesses that if not immediately “fact checked” the victim will be miserable.

text: Kag diri ang aton daku nga problema sa kamot sang malisyoso kag ma-sindikato nga AI creators.
english: And here we have a big problem at the hands of malicious and syndicated AI creators.

text: Popular diri ang AI-generated nga mga fake news, fake commercials, kag fake statements nga ginaupdan sang nawong sang popular nga mga tawo.
english: Popular here are AI-generated fake news, fake commercials, and fake statements accompanied by the faces of popular people.

text: Lakip diri sa mga nabiktima ang political leaders, celebrities, professionals, print journalists, kag pati na gani ang mga broadcaster nga mas masaligan tungod, sa masami, naga-“fact check” dayon sang ila mga news reports direkta mismo halin sa ila sources.
english: Among the victims are political leaders, celebrities, professionals, print journalists, and even broadcasters who are more reliable because, often, they fact check their news reports directly from their sources.

text:
***

Ginakahadlukan na gani subong ang pila ka “powerful artificial intelligence models” nga naga-“exhibit” sang panghulag (behavior) nga naga-mimic sang ikasarang agud ma-“survive” ang ano man nga “prospect” agud kutlon ang ila “kabuhi”.
english:
***

Some powerful artificial intelligence models that exhibit behavior that mimics the ability to survive any prospect of taking their lives are now feared.

text: Katulad, por ejemplo, sa pagpatigayon sang “shutdown commands”.
english: For example, in the implementation of shutdown commands.

text: Kag ang ikasarang sang AI nga kobyahon ang iya kaugalingon saylo sa “hidden external server” agud sa ulihi matuman gihapon ang iya luyag.
english: And the AI’s ability to copy itself is transferred to a “hidden external server” to eventually still accomplish what it wants.

text: Makatulublag ini nga kamatuoran nga kinahanglan na matutukan ang pag-create sang “safe and ethical AI systems”.
english: This is a disturbing fact that needs to focus on creating “safe and ethical AI systems”.

text: Kinahanglan man ang kolaborasyon sang gobyerno, industries kag researchers sa pag-establisar sang bagay nga mga guidelines kag regulations, kag mga kasuguan agud ma-kontrol ang pag-create sang indi amo nga mga AI content, labi na ang pagpalapta (distribution) sini.
english: The collaboration of government, industry and researchers is also needed to establish appropriate guidelines and regulations, and laws to control the creation of such AI content, especially its distribution.

text: Basi kinahanglan na gani ang pagtukod kag paggamit sang mas mabaskug nga counter-AI models batok sa makahalalit nga potensyal sang “uncontrolled AI automation”./PN
english: Perhaps there is even a need to build and use stronger counter-AI models against the destructive potential of “uncontrolled AI automation”./PN

english:
Jho's cryptic post on X that read: “2026 — I choose my own happiness – without guilt, without explanation.”

text:

What keeps your heart strong and motivated through all the challenges?”

english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro, the government has already seen that this is possible because of the situation in the Middle East and this is the consequence.

text: Handa nga makigsapol ang mga senador sang Pilipinas sa embahada sang China may kaangtanan sa isyu sa West Philippine Sea (WPS), suno kay Senador Panfilo “Ping” Lacson.
english: Philippine senators are ready to meet with the Chinese embassy regarding the West Philippine Sea (WPS) issue, according to Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpahayag ni Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan nga bukas siya nga makig-istorya sa mga lideres sang Pilipinas agud mabuhinan ang tensyon sa tunga sang mga diplomatiko sang China kag mga opisyal sang Pilipinas.
english: This comes after Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan said he is open to talks with Philippine leaders to ease tensions between Chinese diplomats and Philippine officials.

text: Dugang pa ni Lacson, iya nga ipangabay kay Senate President Vicente Sotto III nga imbitarun ang mga Chinese diplomats sa isa ka diskusyon.
english: Lacson said he will ask Senate President Vicente Sotto III to invite the Chinese diplomats for a discussion.

text: Lakip sa amo nga pagsugilanon ang mga miyembro sang majority sa Senado, samtang mahimo man magpadala sang representante ang minority.
english: The meeting includes members of the Senate majority, while the minority can also send a representative.

text: Suno pa kay Lacson nga dapat man updon sa diyalogo sanday Senador Francis Pangilinan, Senador Risa Hontiveros, kag si Erwin Tulfo nga amo ang chairman sang Senate Committee on Foreign Relations.
english: Lacson said Senator Francis Pangilinan, Senator Risa Hontiveros, and Erwin Tulfo, chairman of the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, should also be included in the dialogue.

text: Paathag ni Lacson nga mas manami kun mag-atubangay ang duha ka partido sa Senado, sa embahada, ukon sa isa ka neutral nga lugar, agud propesyonal kag diplomatiko ang pag-istorya sang nasambit nga isyu.
english: Lacson explained that it is better if the two parties meet in the Senate, at the embassy, ​​or in a neutral place, so that the issue can be discussed professionally and diplomatically.

text: Ginbalibaran sang Iran ang gintanyag nga 15-point peace plan sang Estados Unidos sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga tensyon sang duha ka pungsod.
english: Iran has rejected a proposed 15-point peace plan by the United States amid ongoing tensions between the two countries.

text: Sa baylo, nag-isyu sang kaugalingon nga counterproposal ang Iran kadungan sang paglunsar sini sang dugang nga atake sa Israel kag Gulf Arab countries.
english: Instead, Iran issued its own counterproposal at the same time as it launched further attacks on Israel and Gulf Arab countries.

text: Duha ka officials halin sa Pakistan ang naglaragway sa 15-point U.S. proposal nga naga-address sa sanctions relief, rollback sa nuclear program sang Iran, kag limitasyon sa missiles kag reopening sang Strait of Hormuz.
english: Two officials from Pakistan described the 15-point U.S. proposal as addressing sanctions relief, a rollback of Iran’s nuclear program, and limits on missiles and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Sa gin-isyu naman nga plano sang Iran, luyag sini nga mauntat ang pagpamatay sa ila mga officials, siguraduhon nga wala na sang iban nga giyera nga ilunsar batok sa ila kag ang pagtugot sa Iran nga gamiton ang ila soberanya sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: In its plan, Iran wants to stop killing its officials, ensure that no other war is launched against them and allow Iran to exercise its sovereignty in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpabutyag ni President Donald Trump nga gusto sang Tehran nga makaangkon sang kasugtanan.
english: President Donald Trump has said that Tehran wants to reach an agreement.

text: Samtang, isa naman ka ministro halin sa Israel ang nagpahayag sang pagpangduha-duha sa amo nga tikang.
english: Meanwhile, another minister from Israel expressed doubts about the move.

text: Suno sa ministro nga ang plano sang US “matahum lamang sa papel,” apang ginpunto sini nga dako ang posibilidad nga indi ini pagbatunon sang Iran.
english: The minister said the US plan was “only beautiful on paper,” but pointed out that Iran is likely to reject it.

text: Apisar sa nagalala nga tension, ginpahayag sang Iran nga may ara sila sang misyon sa United Nations kun sa diin mahimo gihapon makaagi ang mga non-hostile vessels sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Despite the escalating tensions, Iran said it has a mission to the United Nations where non-hostile vessels can still pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Wala gid nakaluwas ang isa ka konsehal sang barangay matapos gintiro sang wala pa makilala nga tawo sa Brgy.
english: A barangay councilor was shot dead by an unidentified gunman in Brgy.

text: Riang, Peñarubia, Abra.
english: Riang, Peñarubia, Abra.

text: Ang biktima amo si Ryan Chavez, 42-anyos, ka naga-jogging sang gintiro ini sang lalaki nga sakay sa motorsiklo.
english: The victim was identified as Ryan Chavez, 42, who was jogging when he was shot by a man on a motorcycle.

text: Nagatalikod ang biktima sang gintiro ini kag nag-angkon sang madamo nga igo sang bala.
english: The victim was turning away when he was shot and sustained multiple gunshot wounds.

text: Madasig ini nga gindala sa ospital sang mga residente apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: He was rushed to the hospital by residents but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Padayon pa nga ginapangita ang suspek.
english: The suspect is still being sought.

text: May yara sang isa ka lalaki gikan sa Hungary ang nakakuha sang bag-o nga Guinness World Record sang nakabisita ini sa 7 ka pungsod samtang nagabisikleta kag sa sulod lamang sang 24 oras.
english: A man from Hungary has set a new Guinness World Record when he visited 7 countries while cycling and in just 24 hours.

text: Ang lalaki amo si David Kovari, kag suno sa iya antes niya ginlibot ang pila ka mga lugar, ginplano pa niya ang mga ruta nga iya pagaagyan sa sulod sang isa ka semana.
english: The man was David Kovari, and he said before touring some of the places, he even planned the routes he would take for a week.

text: Sa iya pagbyahe gamit ang bisikleta, nabisitahan niya ang pito ka mga lugar kag ini ang ginlakipan sang Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Austria, Hungary, Slovenia kag Croatia.
english: During his bicycle trip, he visited seven places and these included Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Austria, Hungary, Slovenia and Croatia.

text: Sa iya pagbyahe, ginasiguro man sini nga indi makaagi sa ma-traffic nga lugar agud nga indi ini siya ma-delay kag makaabot gilayon sa lugar nga iya gina-target.
english: During his trip, he also makes sure not to pass through traffic areas so that he will not be delayed and reach his target area immediately.

text: Wala man ini siya nagalabay sang mga matag-as nga dalan agud nga indi siya madasig nga makabatyag sang hapo.
english: He also does not take high roads so that he does not feel tired quickly.

text: Si Kovari ang ikaduha kag pinakabag-o nga nakaangkon sang Guinness record matapos nga nabisitahan sa sulod sang 24 oras ang mga pila ka mga lugar.
english: Kovari is the second and latest Guinness record holder after visiting several places in 24 hours.

text: Ang nauna nga naka-record amo ang German cyclist nga si Michael Moll nga nakabisita man sa anom ka mga pungsod.
english: The previous record holder was German cyclist Michael Moll who also visited six countries.

text: Naghagan-hagan na ang numero sang mga pasahero sa Parola Wharf subong nga hapon sang Huwebes Santo kun ikumpara ini kagina sang aga kun sa diin madamo ang mga nagatabok padulong sa Guimaras.
english: The number of passengers at Parola Wharf has decreased this afternoon on Holy Thursday compared to yesterday morning when there were many crossing to Guimaras.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Erlan Gatutoe, isa ka Engineer sang fiber boat, iya ginpahayag nga mas nakabawi na sila subong nga Semana Santa matapos ang pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong sa pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Erlan Gatutoe, an engineer of the fiber boat, said they have recovered more this Easter after the increase in fuel prices in the country.

text: Suno sa iya,ginabulubanta nga yara sa 2,000 tubtob 3,000 ang mga pasahero nga nagbyahe pakadto sa Guimaras subong lang nga adlaw kag possible pa nga magdamo sa Byernes Santo bangud sa pagahiwatun nga Pagtaltal sa Balaan Bukid.
english: He said an estimated 2,000 to 3,000 passengers traveled to Guimaras today and it is possible that the number will increase on Good Friday due to the upcoming Pagtaltal sa Balaan Bukid.

text: Madumduman nga apisar nga madamo ang mga sumalakay, ginapasiguro sa gihapon sang Coast Guard Station Iloilo nga ginasunod gid ang maximum capacity sang kada sakayang pandagat kun sa diin may ara man sang personnel nga gindeploy ang nasambit nga ahensya.
english: Despite the large number of attackers, the Coast Guard Station Iloilo still ensures that the maximum capacity of each vessel is followed where the agency has also deployed personnel.

text: Nabulsa sang Pinoy Olympian nga si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena ang bronze medal sa INIT Indoor Meeting Karlsruhe sa Germany.
english: Pinoy Olympian Ernest John “EJ” Obiena bagged the bronze medal at the INIT Indoor Meeting Karlsruhe in Germany.

text: Nakuha ni Obiena sa 5.70 meter-clearance sa isa lang ka attempt.
english: Obiena got to 5.70 meter-clearance in just one attempt.

text: Nanguna naman sa kumpetisyon si Sondre Guttormsen sang Norway nga naka-clear sang 5.84m samtang nagpangaduha si Cole Walsh sang United States nga may 5.78m.
english: Sondre Guttormsen of Norway topped the competition with a clear of 5.84m while Cole Walsh of the United States came second with 5.78m.

text: Isa ka adlaw antes sini nga kumpetisyon, nagkampyon si Obiena sa 12th Asian Indoor Athletics Championships sa China.
english: A day before this competition, Obiena won the 12th Asian Indoor Athletics Championships in China.

text: Espesyal ini nga kadalag-an para kay Obiena bangud ang amo nga gold medal amo na lang ang wala niya nakuha sa tanan nga major championships sa Asya.
english: This is a special victory for Obiena because the gold medal is the only one he has not won in all major championships in Asia.

text: Ginhandum kag gindumtan ini ni Obiena matapos nga nadag-an na ang mga kampyonato sa Asian Games, Southeast Asian Games, kag Asian Championships.
english: Obiena dreamed and hated it after already winning championships at the Asian Games, Southeast Asian Games, and Asian Championships.

text: Ginapuntariya subong sang Pinoy pole vaulter ang 5.90m agud nga maka-qualify sa World Athletics Indoor Championships sa Poland sa Marso.
english: The Filipino pole vaulter is now targeting 5.90m to qualify for the World Athletics Indoor Championships in Poland in March.

text: WALA naman makadumdum si Pedro sang akon kaadlawan.
english: PETER does not remember my birthday.

text: Pero salamat, kay wala naman ini nakapanghagad inom.
english: But thankfully, he didn't ask for a drink.

text: Ina bala ang nagapalingaso  gid, nga kon tawgon niya biti-biti, samtang gamantener lang ako sang isa ka botelya nga light beer.
english: That's what makes me so angry, when he calls me biti-biti, while I'm just holding a bottle of light beer.

text: Pero salamat man kay nadumduman niya ang kaadlawan sang aton bansagon nga kasimanwa, ang nagtaliwan na nga RTC Judge kag Senator Miriam Defensor.
english: But thank you also because he remembered the birthday of our famous fellow citizen, the late RTC Judge and Senator Miriam Defensor.

text: Tungod sini, nadumduman man niya ang akon kaadlawan sadtong Hunyo 15, nga kadungan sang kaadlawan ni Miriam.
english: Because of this, he also remembered my birthday on June 15, which coincided with Miriam's birthday.

text: “Tnx!
english: “Tnx!

text: Kit-anay na lang kita sa masunod ko nga kaadlawan!” siling ko na gid lang kay Pedro kag ginkadlawan siya.
english: See you on my next birthday!” I said to Peter and he laughed.

text: Nagnguri-nguri lang ang tarso.
english: The tarso just grumbled.

text:
***

Sa wala pa nakahibalo parti kay Miriam, natawo siya  sadtong Hunyo 15, 1945 sa La Paz, Iloilo City sa mga ginikanan nga sanday Benjamin Defensor, isa ka lokal nga hwes, kag Dempna Palma, isa ka college dean.
english:
***

For those who do not know about Miriam, she was born on June 15, 1945 in La Paz, Iloilo City to parents Benjamin Defensor, a local judge, and Dempna Palma, a college dean.

text: Nagtaliwan si Miriam sadtong Setyembre 29, 2016 bangod sang balatian nga stage 4 cancer.
english: Miriam passed away on September 29, 2016 due to stage 4 cancer.

text: Topnotch siya nga estudyante sa tanan nga ginsudlan niya nga mga buluthuan halin sa elemenarya tubtub sang nagtapos siya sang Political Science kag Law sa UP-Dilliman kag nag-abogada na.
english: He was a topnotch student in all the schools he attended from elementary school until he graduated from Political Science and Law at UP-Dilliman and became a lawyer.

text: Nagpasanyog pa gid ini sang kinaalam sa nagapanguna nga mga unibersidad sa gwa sang pungsod – sa Oxford, Harvard, Cambridge kag The Hague of International Law.
english: This has further promoted expertise in leading universities abroad – in Oxford, Harvard, Cambridge and The Hague of International Law.

text: Tungod sining mataas nga mga kinaalam nga naangkon niya nabotohan siya sadtong 2012 bilang isa ka judge sang International Criminal Court.
english: Because of these high qualifications, he was elected in 2012 as a judge of the International Criminal Court.

text: Wala niya ugaling ginbaton ina tungod sa amo nga tion na-diagnose na siya sang early stages of cancer.
english: However, he did not accept that because at that time he was diagnosed with early stages of cancer.

text: Samtang, ginkilala man siya bilang isa sang “100 Most Powerful Women in the World” kag “Lady Dragon of Asia” bilang maisug nga graftbuster.
english: Meanwhile, she was also recognized as one of the “100 Most Powerful Women in the World” and “Lady Dragon of Asia” as a brave graftbuster.

text: Nangin law professor, author, kag nag-serve sa tatlo gid ka sanga sang aton gobyerno – bilang RTC judge, Agrarian Reform Secretary kag Immigration Commissioner, kag tatlo ka beses nga nag-senador.
english: He became a law professor, an author, and served in three branches of our government – ​​as RTC judge, Agrarian Reform Secretary and Immigration Commissioner, and three times as a senator.

text: Nagdalagan siya sa pagka-presidente sadtong 1992 kag diutayan lang nagdaug batok kay anay Police Chief Fidel Ramos sa diutay gid lang nga abanse sang naulihi, nga nangin controversial pa.
english: He ran for president in 1992 and narrowly defeated former Police Chief Fidel Ramos by a narrow margin, which was still controversial.

text: In fact, madamo pa nga kadungganan ang nabaton ni Miriam halin sa aton gobyerno kag sa iban nga mga katapuanan lakip ang sa luas, nga indi na naton madumduman pa.
english: In fact, Miriam has received many other honors from our government and other agencies including abroad, which we cannot remember.

text:
Sa iya pagtaliwan, ginkilala pa gani siya sang madamo nga mga pamantalaan bilang “The Best President We Never Had!”

***

May diutay pa nga hitabo nga nadumduman naton angot kay Miriam.
english:
Upon his passing, he was even recognized by many newspapers as “The Best President We Never Had!”

***

There is another little incident that we remember about Miriam.

text: Sadtong mga estudyante pa kami sa kolehiyo.
english: It was when we were college students.

text: Editor-in-chief sadto si Miriam sang UP Iloilo paper kag ang nagtaliwan nga Iloilo City Councilor German Gonzales presidente naman sang Student Council sang amo man nga unibersidad.
english: Miriam was editor-in-chief of the UP Iloilo paper and the late Iloilo City Councilor German Gonzales was president of the Student Council of the same university.

text: Sa lain ako sadto nga kolehiyo nagatuon, ang The Linclon College, kag presidente sang Iloilo College Editors’ Guild.
english: I was studying at a different college, The Linclon College, and president of the Iloilo College Editors’ Guild.

text: Bantog sa UP Iloilo ang indi pag-intiendihanay ni Miriam kag ni German tungod sa mga isyu angot sa campus leadership, nga nahibal-an man naton tungod pirme ako nagaduaw sa UP Iloilo kay German angot sa madamo nga mga isyu nga may kaangtanan sa student movement sa panahon nga ato sang amat-amat sanyog na sang student power.
english: Miriam and German are famous in UP Iloilo for their misunderstanding over issues related to campus leadership, which we also know because I often visit UP Iloilo with German regarding many issues related to the student movement during that time when student power was gradually increasing.

text: Nabatyagan ko ugaling nga wala naluyagan ni Miriam ang pagkasuod ko kay German, nga ginpakita niya sa indi pag-attend sa mga miting namon nga mga student editors.
english: I felt, however, that Miriam did not like my closeness to German, which she showed by not attending our meetings as student editors.

text: Nagligad ang madamo pa nga tinuig nga wala gid ako makahigayon agud magkit-anay kami ni Miriam bisan sa tion sang pagpangampanya niya diri sa Iloilo sadto sa pagka-senador kag tubtub nangin senador na.
english: Many more years passed without me having the opportunity to meet Miriam even during her campaign here in Iloilo for senator and until she became senator.

text: Salamat kay sang ulihi nagkit-anay gid man kami.
english: Thankfully, we finally met.

text: Natabo ato sa isa ka college reunion sang The Lincoln College, kon diin nangin estudyante siya sa elementarya.
english: It happened at a college reunion of The Lincoln College, where he was an elementary school student.

text: Na-assign ako nga mag-introduce kay Miriam bilang inspirational speaker sa sina nga okasyon.
english: I was assigned to introduce Miriam as the inspirational speaker at that event.

text: Aba, todo dayaw ako sa iya naangkon nga mga kadungganan kag nakapangamusta gid man ako sa iya sa una nga kahigayunan.
english: Well, I was very impressed with his honors and I was able to say hello to him for the first time.

text:
***

Mas nangin malapit pa kami ni Miriam sang nag-upod ako sa campaign group niya sang nagdalagan siya sa pagka-presidente batok kay Ramos.
english:
***

Miriam and I became even closer when I joined her campaign group when she ran for president against Ramos.

text: Ginpangunahan ining campaign group ni Gng.
english: This campaign group was led by Mrs.

text: RUTH TIROL-JARANTILLA, nga maninay ko sa kasal.
english: RUTH TIROL-JARANTILLA, my mother-in-law.

text: Bless her soul!
english: Bless her soul!

text: Nagtaliwan si Maninay Ruth sadtong 2024 sa edad nga 87.
english: Aunt Ruth passed away in 2024 at the age of 87.

text: Bugal namon ni asawahon nga nangin maninay sa kasal si Maninay Ruth.
english: My wife and I are proud to have Maninay Ruth as a bridesmaid.

text: Isa siya ka topnotch civic leader kag philanthropist sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: He is a topnotch civic leader and philanthropist in Iloilo City.

text: Kag napadunggan bilang isa sang mga 10 Outstanding Ilonggos of Iloilo City.
english: And was honored as one of the 10 Outstanding Ilonggos of Iloilo City.

text: Nangin Area Director man siya sang Zonta Club Philippines kag nagpanguna pa sa pila pa ka mga katapuanan, lakip na ang pagka-Chairman sang isa ka rescue group sa panahon sang kalamidad diri sa siyudad.
english: He also became the Area Director of the Zonta Club Philippines and led several other members, including being the Chairman of a rescue group during disasters here in the city.

text: Sadto, Presidente man si Maninay Ruth kag General Manager sang Socorro Pharmaceutical Laboratories sa Quezon City, Socorro Drug Co.
english: Formerly, Maninay Ruth was also President and General Manager of Socorro Pharmaceutical Laboratories in Quezon City, Socorro Drug Co.

text: nga may sanga sa siyudad sang Iloilo, kag tag-iya man sang Seawind Resort Boracay sa Malay, Aklan.
english: with a branch in Iloilo City, and also owns Seawind Resort Boracay in Malay, Aklan.

text: Happy birthday, Miriam, kag God bless your soul, maninay!/PN
english: Happy birthday, Miriam, and God bless your soul, maninay!/PN

text: Nagsarurot na naman sa panibag-o nga record low ang baylo sang Philippine peso kontra sa US dollar kasunod sang nagasingki nga tensyon sa Middle East.
english: The Philippine peso has fallen to a new record low against the US dollar following escalating tensions in the Middle East.

text: Sandig sa Bankers Association of the Philippines, nagtakop ang trading kahapon nga P59.50 sa kada isa ka US dollar ang baylo sang Philippine currency.
english: According to the Bankers Association of the Philippines, the Philippine currency closed trading yesterday at P59.50 per US dollar.

text: Mas maluya pa ini nga balor ipaanggid sa nauna nga record low nga P59.46 nga na-rekord sang Enero 15.
english: This value is weaker compared to the previous record low of P59.46 recorded on January 15.

text: Antes ang pag-inaway sang US, Israel, kag Iran nga naglapta sa Middle East, naka-bangon-bangon sang gamay ang peso nga yara sa P57.51 as of Feb.
english: Before the conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran that spread to the Middle East, the peso rose slightly to P57.51 as of Feb.

text: Kun maluya ang baylo sang Philippine Peso, buot silingon, mas mahal ang pagbakal sang imported goods, lakip na ang langis bangud ini nga produkto ang gina-purchase paagi sa dolyar.
english: If the Philippine Peso is weak, it means that it is more expensive to buy imported goods, including oil because these products are purchased in dollars.

text: Magluwas diri, bangud man sang pagluya sang peso, may impact man ini sa utang sang Pilipinas, ilabi na nga one-third sang amo nga utang ang naghalin sa foreign creditors ukon mga manugpautang halin sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: In addition, due to the weakening of the peso, it also has an impact on the Philippine debt, especially that one-third of the debt comes from foreign creditors or lenders from abroad.

text: Una na nga ginsiling ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr nga indi sini luyag nga makalapaw ang peso sa 60 pesos sa kada isa ka dolyar, bangud kun magluya ang balor sang Peso, pat-od nga magatimbuok na naman ang balayran sa utang.
english: Earlier, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said he does not want the peso to exceed 60 pesos per dollar, because if the value of the peso weakens, the debt payments will surely increase again.

text: Nagpahayag si Palace Press Officer Usec.
english: Palace Press Officer Usec.

text: Claire Castro nga mas kahuluya ang gin-ubra ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga death threat kanday President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Marcos kag anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Claire Castro said Vice President Sara Duterte's death threat to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Marcos and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez is more shameful.

text: Ini matapos ang statement sang bise presidente nga indi na paghatagan sang atensyon kag pamatian si Castro bangud nga nagadala lang ini sang kahuluy-an sa Pilipinas.
english: This follows the vice president's statement that Castro should not be given attention and listened to because he only brings shame to the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Castro, madamo ang mga kahuluya nga gin-ubra ni Duterte kaangay sang pasumbag sini sa isa ka sheriff, indi pagsunod sa korte, kag pagamit sang ginpahayag peke nga Armed Forces Certificates agud tabunan ang iya confidential funds.
english: According to Castro, Duterte has committed many shameful acts such as punching a sheriff, disobeying the court, and using allegedly fake Armed Forces Certificates to cover up his confidential funds.

text: Madumduman nga pila na ka beses nga nagbaslanay sang ila sentimento ang duha ka opisyal.
english: The two officials have exchanged sentiments several times.

text: INDI MAPATIHAN sang madamo ang natabo sa Senate Impeachment Court sang nag-“convene” ini sadtong Hunyo 10.
english: MANY could not believe what happened at the Senate Impeachment Court when it convened on June 10.

text: Sa ina nga tion sang Hunyo 10, gintugtan ni Presiding Senator-judge Chiz Escudero ang privilege speech ni Senator-judge Bato dela Rosa, nga nag-“motion” pa nga i-“dismiss” ang Impeachment Complaint batok kay VP Sara Duterte.
english: Meanwhile, on June 10, Presiding Senator-judge Chiz Escudero allowed the privilege speech of Senator-judge Bato dela Rosa, who even moved to dismiss the Impeachment Complaint against VP Sara Duterte.

text: Contrary ini  sa opinyon ni anay RTC Judge kag Senator Miriam Defensor nga sa Impeachment Court indi tugot ang mag-“motion” katulad sang ginhimo ni Bato kundi ang magpabutyag lang sang “clarification” sa isyu angot sa “proceedings”.
english: This is contrary to the opinion of former RTC Judge and Senator Miriam Defensor that in the Impeachment Court it is not allowed to make a motion like Bato did but only to express a clarification on the issue of proceedings.

text: Isa pa, sworn-in na ini si Bato bilang “impeachment judge” nga dapat magdala sang “independent mind” agud matun-an kag mahusgaran sing maayo ang “impeachment case” ni VP Sara halin sa pagbayluhanay sang mga argumento sa tunga sang Prosecution kag Defense.
english: Furthermore, Bato is sworn-in as an impeachment judge who should bring an independent mind to study and judge VP Sara's impeachment case from the exchange of arguments between the Prosecution and Defense.

text: Pero naghimo gid si Bato sang “judgment” nga “not guilty” si VP Sara paagi sa iya “motion” nga i-“dismiss” ang Impeachment Complaint sang Kamara nga daw Defense Lawyer siya ni VP Sara.
english: But Bato made a judgment that VP Sara is not guilty through his motion to dismiss the Impeachment Complaint of the House of Representatives as if he were VP Sara's Defense Lawyer.

text: Tungod sini, dapat tani nag-“inhibit” na si Bato bilang “senator-judge” kay maathag nga “biased” na ang panghuna-huna sini.
english: Because of this, Bato should have inhibited himself as a senator-judge because it is clear that his thinking is biased.

text: Masadya, nga indi masadya, pa kay ginpabay-an lang ni Escudero si Bato sa iya “out of place” nga “motion” nga mahimo lang sa Plenary Session sang kabug-san sang Senado.
english: Fortunately, not happy, Escudero just left Bato in his “out of place” “motion” that can only be done in the Plenary Session of the entire Senate.

text: Siling ni Bato  nga pinulitika lang ang  akusasyon batok kay VP Sara, gali siya man lang ang gapamulitika.
english: Bato said that the accusations against VP Sara are political, but he is the only one who is doing politics.

text: Kag kabahin pa siya sang Impeachment Court!
english: And he's still part of the Impeachment Court!

text: Sa kahadlok seguro, sunu sa iban, sa anay mastermind sang mapintas nga “drug war” nga bisan suspetsado pa lang wala patawad nga ginapamatay.
english: Perhaps out of fear, according to some, of the former mastermind of the brutal “drug war” who even suspects are killed without mercy.

text: Gintudlo gid gani ini ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga amo gid ang mastermind.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte even pointed it out as the mastermind.

text: Gani nag-“propose” gid ni Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano nga ibalik (remand) sa Kamara  ang Articles of Impeachment agud ma-review kuno sang Kamara.
english: Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano proposed to remand the Articles of Impeachment to the House for review.

text: Nga sandig lang sa akusasyon ni Bato nga may “constitutional infirmity” ini, nga wala ebidensya kundi ang agsik lang sang iya laway nga maaslum!
english: Based on Bato's accusation that he has “constitutional infirmity”, with no evidence but the smell of his sour saliva!

text: Indi kita abogado, pero daw indi man ina ang pamaagi sang husgado (court), kundi ang maghimo sing panindugan sandig sa ebidensya kag masaligan nga testigo.
english: We are not lawyers, but that does not seem to be the way of the court, but to make a stand based on evidence and reliable witnesses.

text: Nahibal-an naton ini tungod sang aton malawig nga experyensya sa mga hitabo sa korte angot sa akon mga libel case (29 tanan) sang nagasulat pa ako sadto sang kolum sa lain nga pamantalaan.
english: We know this because of our long experience with court events regarding my libel cases (29 in all) when I was writing a column for a different newspaper.

text: Salamat kay na-“dismiss” ini tanan, nga nagpabalik-balik sa akon sa korte sa sulod sang mga apat ka tuig.
english: Thankfully it all got “dismissed,” which sent me back and forth to court for about four years.

text: Hambalon pa, pang-“harass” lang ang mga akusasyon nga ato sa akon.
english: In other words, the accusations against me are just harassment.

text: Nonetheless, ginbotohan gid pabor ining pag-“remand” sang Articles of Impeachment sang 18 ka “senator-judge”.
english: Nonetheless, the remand of the Articles of Impeachment was voted in favor by 18 senator-judges.

text: Apang wala malingkang nga ginpamatukan ini sang lima ka prinsipyado nga mga senador.
english: But five principled senators unwaveringly opposed it.

text: Sanday Koko Pimentel, Riza Hontiveros, Grace Poe, Nancy Binay kag Win Gatchalian.
english: Koko Pimentel, Riza Hontiveros, Grace Poe, Nancy Binay and Win Gatchalian.

text:
***

Insulto ining pagpabalik sang Articles of Impeachment sa kinaalam sang Kamara, labi na sa bahin sang House Prosecution Panel of 11 nga nagtuon gid sing maayo agud ma-presentar ang isa ka mabakod nga kaso batok kay VP Sara.
english:
***

This restoration of the Articles of Impeachment is an insult to the wisdom of the House, especially on the part of the House Prosecution Panel of 11 which studied hard to present a strong case against VP Sara.

text: Gani, indi katingalahan nga indi mabaton sang Kamara ining hingyo sang 18 ka mga senador tubtub makuha sini ang sabat sa ila mga pamangkot, labi na gid ang angot sa kon ngaa ginpabalik gid ini sang Senado samtang ang ginbasehan lang sang Senado ang pahayag ni Bato nga wala sing maathag nga rason kag ebidensya.
english: Therefore, it is not surprising that the House will not accept this request of the 18 senators until it gets answers to their questions, especially regarding why the Senate returned it while the Senate just based Bato's statement without clear reasons and evidence.

text:
***

Galungo-lungo gid si Pedro sa natabo nga ini sa pagbukas pa lang sang Impeachment Court.
english:
***

Pedro was shocked by what happened at the opening of the Impeachment Court.

text: Obvious kuno nga indi man gali  makapamensar sing “independent” ang  kalabanan nga mga senador, nga ginapamunuan pa sang Senate President.
english: It is obvious that most senators, led by the Senate President, cannot think independently.

text: Ti, ano ang maayo?
english: Well, what is good?

text: Tani, siling niya, ang “presiding impeachment judge” sa kaso batok sa Vice President dapat Chief Justice man sang Korte Suprema, kag indi lang ang Senate President.
english: Hopefully, he said, the “presiding impeachment judge” in the case against the Vice President should also be the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, and not just the Senate President.

text: Well, ang  aton 1987 Constitution gasiling nga Chief Justice gid lang ang maka-preside sa Impeachment Court batok sa Presidente, kag wala na sang iban luas sa iya.
english: Well, our 1987 Constitution says that only the Chief Justice can preside over the Impeachment Court against the President, and no one else but him.

text: Kon inang provision sang Konstitusyon indi lang “literal” kundi “substantive” man, kag wala sing “exception”, wala na sang iban nga interpretasyon dira bisan “obvious” pa nga “politically biased” ang Senate President bilang “presiding impeachment judge”, katulad sang suspetso sang madamo kay Escudero.
english: If that provision of the Constitution is not only “literal” but also “substantive”, and there is no “exception”, there is no other interpretation even if it is “obvious” that the Senate President as “presiding impeachment judge” is “politically biased”, as many suspect Escudero.

text: Bangod sina, kinahanglan gid matuod nga ma-“amend” inang “constitutional provision” sa impeachment sang mga dalagku nga “government officials” kun diin ang Chief Justice ang maga-preside man sa “impeachment case” sang Bise Presidente bangod “political personality” man siya katulad sang Presidente.
english: Therefore, it is necessary to amend the constitutional provision on the impeachment of senior government officials where the Chief Justice will also preside over the impeachment case of the Vice President because he is a political personality like the President.

text: Indi bala amo man ina ang ginapunto mo, Pedro?/PN
english: Isn't that what you're pointing at, Pedro?/PN

text: Sa pihak sang pahayag ni United States President Donald Trump nga may yara na sang negosasyon, nag-atake ang Iran sa Israel kag sa pila ka Gulf Arab states.
english: Despite US President Donald Trump's statement that negotiations have been held, Iran has attacked Israel and several Gulf Arab states.

text: Bangud sa amo nga atake, may damage kag injuries nga narekord sa Tel Aviv.
english: As a result of the attack, damage and injuries were recorded in Tel Aviv.

text: Liwat man nga nagwangwang ang mga air raid sirens sa Israel lakip na sa kapital sini.
english: Air raid sirens also sounded again in Israel, including in its capital.

text: Nakitaan man nga may mga buho na sa multistorey apartment building, apang indi pa klaro kun direkta ini nga igu ukon debris lang sang missile bangud sa pag-intercept sang Israel Air Defense.
english: Holes were also found in the multistorey apartment building, but it is not clear whether it was a direct hit or just debris from the missile due to interception by the Israel Air Defense.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon halin sa emergency medical service, may anum ka mga tawo nga nasamaran halin sa apat ka nagkalain-lain nga areas.
english: According to initial information from the emergency medical service, six people were injured from four different areas.

text: May mga na-trap man sa isa ka building sa Tel Aviv, kag may mga sibilyan man nga nakit-an sa shelter sa isa ka na-damage nga building.
english: Some were also trapped in a building in Tel Aviv, and civilians were also found in shelter in a damaged building.

text: Sa update naman sang Israeli military, naglunsar man sila sang atake sa Central Tehran.
english: In an update, the Israeli military also launched an attack on Central Tehran.

text: Ila ginpuntariya ang nagapanguna nga command centers lakip na ang mga pasilidad nga naangot sa Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ intelligence arm kag Iranian Intelligence Ministry.
english: They targeted key command centers including facilities linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ intelligence arm and Iranian Intelligence Ministry.

text: Masobra sa 50 ka dugang nga targets ang ginpang-igo sang gab-i lakip na ang ballistic missile storage kag launch sites.
english: More than 50 additional targets were hit overnight including ballistic missile storage and launch sites.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Trump nga naga-negosyar na ang US kag Iran, apang gintawag ini sang Tehran nga fake news kag gina-anunsyo lang sang US President agud ma-manipula ang oil kag financial market.#
english: Earlier, Trump said that the US and Iran were already negotiating, but Tehran called it fake news and the US President was just announcing it to manipulate the oil and financial markets.

text: May isa ka kuring sa New Zealand nga bantog sa ila nga mga kasilingan bangud sang tumalagsahon sini nga abilidad.
english: There is a cat in New Zealand who is famous in their neighborhood because of this extraordinary ability.

text: Kun naandan naton nga nagapang-takab ang kuring sang sud-an, si Leo naman ukon ang kuring nga ginbansagan nga si Leonardo da Pinchy ang nanamian gid nga manghakot sang hinalay sang ila mga tupad-balay.
english: If we are used to the dog picking up the food, Leo or the dog nicknamed Leonardo da Pinchy is very fond of picking up the hinalay of their neighbors.

text: Suno kay Helen North nga tag-iya sang kuring, ang paborito gid nga kuhaon sang iya hinuptanan amo ang hinalay nga mga underwear kag ang mga medyas.
english: According to cat owner Helen North, her pet's favorite things to pick up are dirty underwear and socks.

text: Pahayag sini, base lang sa iya naisip, 159 na ka mga bayo kag underwear ang nahakot sang iya kuring, kag kun kaisa, may dala man ini nga gardening gloves, sports bra, kalo, kag maski malahalon nga jersey nga may price tag pa.
english: She said that based on her count, 159 clothes and underwear have been picked up by her dog, and sometimes, she also brings gardening gloves, sports bras, hats, and even expensive jerseys with price tags.

text: Suno kay Helen, pinaka-aktibo si Leo kada Domingo kun sa diin madamo ang hinalay nga bayo sa ila palibot.
english: According to Helen, Leo is most active every Sunday when there are many clothes around them.

text: Agud mabalik ang mga gamit sa tag-iya, ginagamit naman ni Helen ang isa ka lokal nga WhatsApp group kag mga Facebook group sang ila kasilingan.
english: To get the items back to their owners, Helen uses a local WhatsApp group and neighborhood Facebook groups.

text: Didto niya ginapost ang mga litrato sang mga bagay nga ginadala ni Leo agud makita kag makuha sang tag-iya.
english: That’s where she posts photos of things Leo brings in for the owner to see and take.

text: Gindugang man sini nga wala man ginaguba ni Leo ang mga gamit, kundi ginabilin lang sa salog nga daw kaangay nga wala lang sang natabo.
english: He added that Leo does not destroy the items, but leaves them on the floor as if nothing had happened.

text: Dismayado ang isa ka indibidwal, matapos nga wala sila ginpahanugutan nga magbakal sang 10 ka litro nga gasolina sa isa ka gasoline station sa siudad.
english: An individual is disappointed, after they were not allowed to buy 10 liters of petrol at a petrol station in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rene Bordas, isa ka driver, iya ginpahayag nga mabakal tani sila sang gasolina bangud nga kinahanglan nila para sa ila generator sa rason nga brownout sa ila nga lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rene Bordas, a driver, said they were going to buy gasoline because they needed it for their generator due to the brownout in their area.

text: Suno kay Bordas, isa sila sa mga suki sang gasolinahan kun sa diin ginkakibot nya nga indi na pwede magbakal kun indi direkta nga igatughong sa isa ka salakyan.
english: According to Bordas, they are one of the customers of the gas station where he was surprised that it is not allowed to buy unless directly delivered to a vehicle.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini amo ang ginapatuman sang mga gasoline station sa bilog nga pungsod bangud sa pahanumdom sang Department of Energy nga mga salakyan lang ang ginapahanugutan nga tughungan sang mga produktong petrolyo agud malikawan ang hoarding kag masiguro nga patas ang pagbakal sang publiko.
english: It is known that this is being implemented by gasoline stations nationwide due to the reminder of the Department of Energy that only vehicles are allowed to be filled with petroleum products to avoid hoarding and ensure fair purchases by the public.

text: Gindugukan sang madamo nga mga pasahero ang Ceres Terminal sa Distrito sang Jaro, kagab-i, Abril 1.
english: Many passengers flocked to the Ceres Terminal in Jaro District, last night, April 1.

text: Ini bangud nga madamo ang nagapalauli sa ila tagsa ka mga ka probinsya subong nga Semana Santa.
english: This is because many are returning to their respective provinces this Easter Season.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMaj.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMaj.

text: Ryan Palaran, head sang Highway Patrol Group, iya ginpahayag nga ginapabaskog gid nila ang ila inspeksyon sa mga bus units agud masiguro ang seguridad sang mga pasahero.
english: Ryan Palaran, head of the Highway Patrol Group, said they are intensifying their inspection of bus units to ensure the safety of passengers.

text: Ginapatuman gid nila ang capacity limit nga 40 ka pasahero kada bus bilang kabahin sang safety measures.
english: They are strictly enforcing a capacity limit of 40 passengers per bus as part of safety measures.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga importante nga masunod ang amo nga regulasyon agud malikawan ang disgrasya kag masiguro ang proteksyon sang mga magapauli.
english: He said it is important to follow the regulations to avoid accidents and ensure the protection of those returning home.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang mga ini nga likawan ang overloading, bangod ini isa sa mga rason kun ngaa nagaluntad ang aksidente.
english: They also reminded to avoid overloading, as this is one of the reasons why accidents occur.

text: Gintawag ni Miss Universe co-owner Raul Rocha nga “delusional” si anay Ilocos Sur governor Chavit Singson, matapos nga nagbuya si Singson sang pahayag nga indi na si Rocha kag Anne Jakrajutatip ang nagapanag-iya sang Miss Universe Organization.
english: Miss Universe co-owner Raul Rocha called former Ilocos Sur governor Chavit Singson “delusional”, after Singson rejected the statement that Rocha and Anne Jakrajutatip no longer own the Miss Universe Organization.

text: Sa isa ka opisyal nga pahayag, ginpaathag sang Miss Universe Organization nga wala sang pagbag-o sa pagpanag-iya kag pagpamuno sang nasambit nga organization, kag ginakabig nga mga “sala” kag “pagpatalang” lamang nga impormasyon ang mga ginapalapta ni Singson.
english: In an official statement, the Miss Universe Organization explained that there is no change in the ownership and leadership of the organization, and considers the information spread by Singson to be “wrong” and “misleading”.

text: Dugang pa sang organisasyon nga indi nila pagpalampason ang sahi nga buluhaton, kag magapatigayon ang mga ini sang legal nga tikang agud mapangapinan ang ila pangalan kag reputasyon.
english: The organization added that they will not ignore such activities, and they will take legal action to protect their name and reputation.

text: Ginpanugyan man sang Miss Universe Organization ang publiko nga magsalig lamang sa ila opisyal nga mga pahayag kag plataporma para sa husto kag beripikado nga impormasyon.
english: The Miss Universe Organization also advised the public to rely only on their official statements and platform for accurate and verified information.

text: Gindugangan sang gobyerno sang P20 milyon ang reward para sa makatudlo sang nahamtangan sang pugante nga si Atong Ang, nga nagapangatubang sang patong-patong nga mga warrant may kaangtanan sa kaso sang ‘missing sabungero’.
english: The government has increased the reward by P20 million for information on the whereabouts of fugitive Atong Ang, who is facing multiple warrants in connection with the missing sabungero case.

text: Suno kay Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla, tinutuyo sang amo nga pagtaas sang reward nga mas madasig ang pagka-aresto kay Ang.
english: According to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla, the purpose of the increase in the reward is to speed up the arrest of Ang.

text: Ginpasiguro ni Remulla nga padayon ang imbestigasyon sa posible nga ginahamtangan ni Ang, matapos ang balita nga nagpalagyo ini padulong sa Cambodia — nga ginpanginwala naman sang gobyerno sang nasambit nga pungsod.
english: Remulla assured that investigations into Ang's possible whereabouts are ongoing, following reports that he fled to Cambodia — which the government of the country denied.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga ginpanginwala ni Ang ang mga akusasyon kag nagpasaka sang kaso batok sa whistleblower nga si Julie Patidongan, nga nag-akusa sa iya nga naga-organisa sang pagpatay sang amo nga mga manugbulang.
english: It can be recalled that Ang had earlier denied the allegations and filed a case against whistleblower Julie Patidongan, who accused her of organizing the killing of such healers.

text: Plano man sang gobyerno nga gamiton ang advanced surveillance technology, lakip na ang lidar, agud mapadasig ang pagsagap kay Ang kag sa iban pa nga high-profile fugitives.
english: The government also plans to use advanced surveillance technology, including lidar, to speed up the search for Ang and other high-profile fugitives.

text: Nangin bayolente ang protesta nga ginhimo sa Milan nga isa sa host cities sang 2026 Winter Olympic Games.
english: The protest held in Milan, one of the host cities of the 2026 Winter Olympic Games, turned violent.

text: Sa una pa lamang nga adlaw sang kumpetisyon, linibo na ka mga tawo ang nagmartsa sa dalanon sa northern Italy agud nga magprotesta batok sa hinampang kag sa iban pa nga serye sang mga isyu.
english: On the first day of the competition, thousands of people have marched through the streets of northern Italy to protest against the game and a series of other issues.

text: Sang ulihi, may yara na sang nagpalupok kag naghaboy sang bato sa mga pulis.
english: Later, someone opened fire and threw stones at the police.

text: Bangud sini, naggamit naman ang mga pulis sang tear gas kag water cannon.
english: As a result, the police used tear gas and water cannon.

text: Anum ka mga tawo ang gindakop sa amo nga protesta.
english: Six people were arrested during that protest.

text: Gintawag naman ni Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni nga mga kaaway sang Italya ang mga nag-protesta.
english: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called the protesters enemies of Italy.

text: Magluwas diri suno sa iya, may yara pa sang nagpang-lock sang railway cables agud nga indi makaandar ang mga tren.
english: Besides, he said, there are also those who locked the railway cables so that the trains could not run.

text: Sa tinaga naman ni Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini, mga “criminal” suno sa iya ang involved sa kumprontasyon sa Milan.
english: In the words of Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini, he said “criminals” were involved in the confrontation in Milan.

text: Matandaan nga antes sini, may mga Italian na nga nagprotesta batok sa presensya sang Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sa ila pungsod antes ang Olympics.
english: Earlier, Italians had protested against the presence of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in their country before the Olympics.

text: Kontrobersyal ang ICE bangud sa duha ka magkasunod nga shooting incidents nga involved ang federal immigration authorities sa Minneapolis.
english: ICE is controversial over two consecutive shooting incidents involving federal immigration authorities in Minneapolis.

text: Yara sila sa Italya agud magbulig sa paghatag sang security assistance sa Winter Games.
english: They were in Italy to help provide security assistance at the Winter Games.

text: Padayon nga ginabantayan sang mga public health expert sa Western Visayas ang kaso sang preterm birth ukon pagbata sang wala pa sa ti-on, isa ka isyu nga nagahatag kabudlayan sa madamo nga ginikanan kag mga healthcare providers.
english: Public health experts in Western Visayas continue to monitor the case of preterm birth, an issue that causes difficulties for many parents and healthcare providers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Joseph Aldric Gaspar, Neonatologist kag Chairman sang Neonatal Care Center, iya ginpahayag nga masami nga nagakatabo ang preterm birth kon magbata ang isa ka nanay antes mag-abot ang ika-37 nga semana sang iya pagkabusong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Joseph Aldric Gaspar, Neonatologist and Chairman of the Neonatal Care Center, said that preterm birth often occurs when a mother gives birth before the 37th week of pregnancy.

text: Ini nga kondisyon mahimo magresulta sa komplikasyon pareho sang budlay sa pagginhawa, pag-ubo, kag kabudlayan sa immune system sang bata.
english: This condition can result in complications such as difficulty breathing, coughing, and difficulties with the child’s immune system.

text: Suno kay Gaspar, isa ini ka seryoso nga isyu nga kinahanglan tutukan kon sa diin, kalabanan sa mga bata nga premature ang ginadala sa Neonatal Intensive Care Unit agud maatipan sang maayo.
english: According to Gaspar, this is a serious issue that needs to be addressed where, most of the premature children are taken to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit for proper care.

text: Ginpasiguro naman sang natungdan nga padayon ang ila programa sa maternal care kag prenatal education, agud malikawan ang mga kahimtangan nga mahimo magdala sang preterm labor, pareho sang high blood pressure, diabetes, kag infection.
english: She assured that they will continue their program in maternal care and prenatal education, to avoid conditions that can lead to preterm labor, such as high blood pressure, diabetes, and infection.

text: Ginapangabay man sang talatapan ang kooperasyon sang komunidad kag mga ginikanan sa regular nga prenatal check-up kag husto nga pagkaon kag pagpahuway sang mga nagabusong.
english: The office also urged the cooperation of the community and parents in regular prenatal check-ups and proper nutrition and rest for pregnant women.

text: Suportado ni 4th District Board Member Rolando Distura ang ordinansa nga ginaduso ni Senator Erwin Tulfo nga nagatuyo nga isulod sa basic education curriculum ang pagtudlo nahanungod sa West Philippine Sea (WPS).
english: 4th District Board Member Rolando Distura supports the ordinance proposed by Senator Erwin Tulfo that aims to include teaching about the West Philippine Sea (WPS) in the basic education curriculum.

text: Sa nahibaluan, si Distura ang principal sponsor sang “Iloilo Local Ordinance Anchored on Values Education of the West Philippine Sea” ukon (I LOVE WPS), nga napasar na sa probinsya sang Iloilo agud itudlo sa mga eskwelahan ang ihibalo nahanungod sa soberanya sang Pilipinas sa WPS.
english: Distura is the principal sponsor of the Iloilo Local Ordinance Anchored on Values ​​Education of the West Philippine Sea (I LOVE WPS), which has been passed in Iloilo province to teach schools the knowledge of Philippine sovereignty in WPS.

text: Gin-sponsoran man ini ni 3rd District Board Member Jason Gonzales nga amo ang chairman sang Committee on Education.
english: It was also sponsored by 3rd District Board Member Jason Gonzales who is the chairman of the Committee on Education.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay BM Distura, iya ginpahayag nga nalipay gid siya sa ginaduso nga ordinansa ni Senator Tulfo nga pagtudlo sa mga estudyante sa public schools nahanungod sa WPS, nga kaangay man sa tinutuyo sang ordinansa nga iya ginpangunahan sa probinsya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, BM Distura said he is pleased with Senator Tulfo's proposed ordinance to teach students in public schools about WPS, which is similar to the purpose of the ordinance he led in the province.

text: Dugang pa ni Distura, magamay pa lamang ang kaalam sang kabataan may kaangtanan sa WPS kag madamo ang nagalapta nga sala nga impormasyon sa social media.
english: Distura added that children's knowledge regarding WPS is still small and there is a lot of misinformation spreading on social media.

text: Gani, dako ini nga bulig sa pagpabakod sang soberanya sang Pilipinas paagi sa pagpasiguro nga ang mga Pilipino, labi na ang kabataan, may husto nga ihibalo parte sa sini nga isyu.
english: Therefore, it is a great help in strengthening the sovereignty of the Philippines by ensuring that Filipinos, especially children, have the right knowledge about this issue.

text: Nagapati man si Distura sa diplomasiya kag wala sini ginakabig nga kaaway ang China, apang suno sa iya, ang tuyo lamang amo ang pagpangapin sang teritoryo sang Pilipinas kag pagsiguro nga may husto nga ihibalo ang mga kabataan sa amo nga diskusyon.
english: Distura also believes in diplomacy and does not consider China an enemy, but he said the only goal is to defend the territory of the Philippines and ensure that children have the right knowledge of the discussion.

text: Sa karon, nagpasalig si Distura nga masuguran na sa sini nga school year ang pagtudlo sang amo nga leksyon sa kada eskwelahan sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Distura assured that the lesson will be taught in every school in Iloilo province this school year.

text: Ginpahanumdom sang isa ka doctor ang pagpabilin sang proper hygiene agud nga malikawan ang pag-angkon sang arikis kag paglaton sini sa iban nga mga tawo ilabi na sa mga kaupod sa balay.
english: A doctor reminded the public to maintain proper hygiene to avoid getting measles and spreading it to other people especially housemates.

text: Ang arikis ang ginadala sang Sarcoptes scabiei var hominis nga sarang makatinir sa lawas sang tawo sa malawig nga tion.
english: Scabies is carried by Sarcoptes scabiei var hominis which can stay in the human body for a long time.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rema Joy Cejar, Fellow sa Philippine Dermatological Society kag head sang Western Visayas Medical Center-Dermatology Section, iya ginpahayag nga nagalaton ang kagaw paagi sa close contact sa iban nga mga tawo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rema Joy Cejar, Fellow of the Philippine Dermatological Society and head of the Western Visayas Medical Center-Dermatology Section, said the virus is transmitted through close contact with other people.

text: Mahimo man ini maglaton kun naga-share sang ulunan, bedsheets, habol kag iban pa nga mga gamit sang infected nga tawo.
english: It can also be spread by sharing pillows, bedsheets, blankets and other items with an infected person.

text: Ini ang rason suno kay Cejar nga dapat masami gid nga magpaninlo kun may infected person na sa panimalay, kag dapat man nga mag-isolate ukon indi na mag-impon sa iban nga mga tawo agud indi magsaylo ang kagaw.
english: This is why, Cejar said, it is necessary to clean up often when there is an infected person in the house, and also to isolate or not mix with other people to prevent the spread of the disease.

text:
Pahayag ni Cejar, indi madala ang arikis sa simple lang nga pagpanghabon, gani nga may lista sang recommended lotion ukon bulong nga ginahatag ang doctor agud mapatay ang kagaw kag mauntat ang pagpalangatol ilabi na kun gab-i.

Ginpanumdom man sang doctor nga likawan nga maggamit sang dagom ukon magsunog sa infected area sang lawas kun may arikis bangud mahimo ini magtuga sang lain na naman nga problema.
english:
Cejar said arikis cannot be treated with simple soap, so there is a list of recommended lotion or medicine that the doctor gives to kill the germ and stop itching especially at night.

The doctor also reminded the public to avoid using needles or burning the infected area of ​​the body if there is a rash because it can cause other problems.

text:
Ginahuring-huring subong nga magabalik subong nga tuig 2026 ang bantog nga sitcom movie sang dekada 90 nga “Home Along Da Riles”

Sang Disyembre 28, nag-upload sa social media ang aktor kag direktor nga si Boy 2 Quizon sang isa ka teaser nga kaangay nga may nagapa-abot nga pelikula nga “Home Along Da Riles Da Reunion.”

Ginpakita man ang title sang proyekto kag ang pangalan ni Quizon bilang direktor sang pelikula kag ginsundan sang mensahe nga “The legacy continues in 2026.”

Nahibaluan nga una nga ginpaguwa sang tuig 1992 ang pelikula kag nangin isa sa pinakapopular nga programa sa telebisyon sa sulod sang 17 ka tuig.
english:
It is now rumored that the famous 90s sitcom movie “Home Along Da Riles” will return in 2026

On December 28, actor and director Boy 2 Quizon uploaded a teaser on social media that looks like there is an upcoming movie “Home Along Da Riles Da Reunion.”

The title of the project and Quizon’s name as the film’s director were also displayed followed by the message “The legacy continues in 2026.”

The film was first released in 1992 and became one of the most popular television programs for 17 years.

text: Ginapangunahan man ini sang Comedy King nga si Dolphy Quizon.
english: It is also hosted by Comedy King Dolphy Quizon.

text: Halos nabatok gid ang lawas sang tatlo ka tuig nga bata nga babaye nga na-trap sa sulod sang nasunog nga balay sa Cabubugan, Guimbal, Iloilo subong nga hapon, Marso 11, 2026.
english: The body of a three-year-old girl trapped inside a burned house in Cabubugan, Guimbal, Iloilo this afternoon, March 11, 2026, was almost burned.

text: Ginpahayag nga tulog ang bata sang ginlamon sang kalayo ang ila nga balay.
english: The child was reportedly asleep when the fire engulfed their house.

text: Suno sa mga residente, gintinguhaan pa nila nga salbaron ang bata apang bangud sa tuman ka dako na sang kalayo, wala na nila makuha ang biktima.
english: According to residents, they tried to save the child but because of the fire, they could not get the victim.

text: Sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo, nagtambong sa isa ka meeting ang iloy sang bata.
english: According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo, the mother of the child attended a meeting.

text: Ginaimbestigaran pa ang ginhalinan sang kalayo.
english: The cause of the fire is still under investigation.

text: Magapain ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sang P2 billion pamaagi sa DTI-Small Business Corporation para sa “OFW Negosyo Fund”.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will allocate P2 billion through the DTI-Small Business Corporation for the “OFW Business Fund”.

text: Ini nga programa sang DTI ang isa ka pautang para sa mga Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga magapauli sa Pilipinas bangud sa epekto sang krisis sa iban nga pungsod, ilabi na sa gyera karun sa Middle East.
english: The DTI program is a loan for Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) who will return to the Philippines due to the impact of the crisis in other countries, especially the current war in the Middle East.
