text: Humalin Marso 12, 2026, sarang nga makautang ang mga OFW sang kapin P30,000 tubtub P20 million nga may isa ka tuig nga grace period kag flexible nga mga terms, lakip na ang loan repayment hasta lima ka tuig kag wala sang collateral sa pautang hasta P5 million.
english: Starting March 12, 2026, OFWs can borrow more than P30,000 to P20 million with a one-year grace period and flexible terms, including loan repayment of up to five years and no collateral for loans up to P5 million.

text: Suno kay DTI Secretary Cristina Roque, ang amo nga pondo ang magahatag sang pamaagi sa mga OFW nga handa nga mag-negosyo sa pungsod, ilabi na subong nga panahon sang krisis.
english: According to DTI Secretary Cristina Roque, the fund will provide a way for OFWs who are willing to do business in the country, especially during this time of crisis.

text: Sa mga maga-avail, sarang mag-apply online sa DTI-SBCorp Money App ukon sa sbcorp.gov.ph, kag sa mga Negosyo Centers sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: Those who will avail can apply online at the DTI-SBCorp Money App or at sbcorp.gov.ph, and at Business Centers nationwide.

text: Gin-inagurahan na kahapon nga adlaw, Abril uno ang ika-siyam kag ikanapulo nga Iloilo City Action and Resilience (ICARE) Center sa Bankers Village IV, Jaro, kag Taal, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: The ninth and tenth Iloilo City Action and Resilience (ICARE) Centers were inaugurated yesterday, April 1, at Bankers Village IV, Jaro, and Taal, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ini agud nga magabulig sa mas madasig kag mas epektibo nga pagresponde sa emerhensya kag kalamidad sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: This is to help in the faster and more effective response to emergencies and disasters in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, Spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang pasilidad nga nahamtang sa Bankers Village IV pwede na nga magamit sang City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), Iloilo City Police Station 3 kag Bureau of Fire Protection.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, she said the facility located in Bankers Village IV can now be used by the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), Iloilo City Police Station 3 and Bureau of Fire Protection.

text: Samtang ang sa Taal Molo, Iloilo City naman ang ginkay-o na sang maayo kag pwede na nga magamit sang Molo Police Station sa pagserbisyo man sa mga pumuluyo sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: Meanwhile, the one in Taal Molo, Iloilo City has been repaired and can be used by the Molo Police Station to serve the residents of the said area.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga mga bag-o nga center ang magadugang sa mga existing ICARE Centers sa So-oc, Ungka, Calumpang, Balantang, Tanza-Esperanza, Nabitasan, ICC Gaisano, kag Megaworld, nga nagapakita sang kooperasyon sang city government kag mga partner agencies sa paghatag sang mas safe nga Iloilo City.
english: These new centers will add to the existing ICARE Centers in So-oc, Ungka, Calumpang, Balantang, Tanza-Esperanza, Nabitasan, ICC Gaisano, and Megaworld, showing the cooperation of the city government and partner agencies in providing a safer Iloilo City.

text: Suno pa kay Gorzal nga indi na mabudlayan ang pumuluyo sa lugar bangud nga napalapit na sa mga ini ang pasilidad nga magabulig sa ila sa pag-preparar, pag-mitigate, kag pagresponde sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: Gorzal said the residents in the area will no longer have difficulties because they have access to facilities that will help them prepare, mitigate, and respond in times of emergency.

text: Ginpanindugan ni United States President Donald Trump nga may negosasyon subong kaupod sa Iran kaangot sa gyera sa Middle East.
english: US President Donald Trump has insisted that there are current negotiations with Iran over the war in the Middle East.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Trump apisar gintawag sang Iran nga “fake news” ang iya ginapangwakal kag nagapanginwala nga may yara sila sang gina-istoryahan.
english: Trump made the remarks despite Iran calling his claims “fake news” and denying that they had any talks.

text: “No negotiations have been held with the US, and fakenews is used to manipulate the financial and oil markets and escape the quagmire in which the US and Israel are trapped,” suno anay kay Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf sa social media.
english: “No negotiations have been held with the US, and fakenews is used to manipulate the financial and oil markets and escape the quagmire in which the US and Israel are trapped,” Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf once said on social media.

text: Suno naman sa US leader, naga-istorya ang iya nga administrasyon sa husto nga mga tawo sa Tehran, kag luyag gid sang amo nga mga tawo nga makalab-ot sila sa kasugtanan.
english: The US leader said his administration is talking to the right people in Tehran, and those people really want to reach an agreement.

text: “We’re talking to the right leaders, and they want to make a deal so badly,” pahayag sini.
english: “We’re talking to the right leaders, and they want to make a deal so badly,” stated sini.

text: Pahayag pa ni Trump, involved gani mismo sanday Vice President JD Vance kag Secretary of State Marco Rubio sa diskusyon.
english: Trump said Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio were even involved in the discussion.

text: Gindugang man sang presidente nga nagpasugot ang Iran nga indi na sila mag-angkon ukon maghimo sang nuclear weapon.
english: The president also added that Iran has agreed not to acquire or develop nuclear weapons.

text: Bangud sa ila atake sa Iran suno kay Trump, may yara na sang pagbag-o sa rehimen.
english: Because of their attack on Iran, Trump said, there has been a change in the regime.

text: “We can say this is regime change,” pahayag sini sa Oval Office.
english: “We can say this is regime change,” he said in the Oval Office.

text:
Dugang niya: “We’ve won this war.”

Una na nga ginpahayag ni Trump nga indi na sini pagdayunon ang iya pamahog nga bombahan ang power plants sang Tehran bangud may mga negosasyon na sila nga ginahikot agud matapos ang gyera nga nag-umpisa sang Pebrero 28, 2026.#
english:
He added: “We’ve won this war.”

Earlier, Trump said he would not continue his threat to bomb Tehran's power plants because they were already in negotiations to end the war that began on February 28, 2026.#

text: Ang kada tawo, may pinasahi gid nga kinaiya sa nawong man ukon sa diin nga parte sang lawas.
english: Everyone has a unique characteristic, whether it's on the face or in some part of the body.

text: Halimbawa diri amo ang Japanese internet celebrity nga si @Jonouchich1 nga may yara sang malaba nga sulang nga amo ang rason nga nakilala siya sa social media.
english: An example of this is Japanese internet celebrity @Jonouchich1 who has a long beard which is why he became known on social media.

text: Siya ang masami nga ginasuyaan bangod sa iya sulang nga daw makasarang magbuno kag ginakumpara sa mga anime characters nga may malaba kag taliwis nga sulang ukon babalo.
english: He is often teased for his stabbing beard and is compared to anime characters with long, twisted beards or widows.

text: Apang ini ang gingamit niya agud maka-attract sang atensyon.
english: But he used it to attract attention.

text: Madamo sa mga fans niya ang naghambal nga magpa X-ray siya nga iya man gintuman.
english: Many of his fans told him to get an X-ray which he did.

text: Suno sa mga doktor wala pa sila nakakita sang tawo nga may babalo kaangay sang iya apang ginalantaw nga posible ini may kaangtanan sa genes.
english: Doctors say they have never seen a person with a widow like hers but it is believed that it may be related to genes.

text: Apang ginapatihan naman ni Jonouchich nga bangod mahilig siya mag-inom sang gatas, posible nga ang tanan nga calcium nagkadto lang sa iya babalo apang wala naman ginbaton sang mga doktor ang ini nga rason.
english: However, Jonouchich believes that because he likes to drink milk, it is possible that all the calcium went to his grandmother but doctors did not accept this reason.

text: Sa subong, apisar nga ginasuyaan ang iya sulang kag kun kaisa gina-reject pa sang mga babaye, ginakabig naman niya ini nga asset.
english: Now, although his sulang is despised and sometimes rejected by women, he considers it an asset.

text: INDI gid kamo magpati kay vlogger/influencer nga si Euleen Castro, nga ga-“enjoy” tawgon ang kaugalingon nga Yobab (Baboy, kon baliskaron), sa iya “food review” batok sa Coffee Break.
english: DO NOT believe vlogger/influencer Euleen Castro, who “enjoys” calling herself Yobab (Pig, in reverse), in her “food review” against Coffee Break.

text: Sa “street language”, kon tawgon ka nga “baboy”, buot silingon sina nga sobra-sobra ang imo pagkatambok (obese), nga gina-admitir niya sa pagpakita kon ano siya katambok sa iya larawan sa internet.
english: In street language, if you are called a “pig”, it means that you are obese, which he admits to show how fat he is in his picture on the internet.

text: Peke ining panugdaon ni Yobab batok sa Coffee Break tungod “unfair” kaayo ini.
english: Yobab's suggestion against Coffee Break is fake because it is very unfair.

text: Gakritikar lang nga wala man lang sang suhestyon kon paano makoreheran ang na-ekperensyahan niya nga diperensya.
english: He just criticized that there were no suggestions on how to correct the difference he experienced.

text: Nga gagwa nga “biased”.
english: That comes out as “biased”.

text: Wala gid kuno sing “masarap” sa ginhanda nga pagkaon sini kag matab-ang ang sabor sang kape dira, samtang gapamuyayaw sa atubangan mismo sang gina-udakan niya.
english: He said there was nothing “delicious” about the food he prepared and the taste of the coffee was bitter, while he was smiling right in front of the one he was drinking.

text: Grasya ang ginaatubang mo, Yobab, basi gabaan ka!
english: You're facing grace, Yobab, maybe you'll be destroyed!

text: Aba, sa minilyon nga nalipay sa pagkaon dira sa Coffee Break sa sulod na sang sobra 20 ka tuig, siya pa lang ang nakasiling sina!
english: Why, of the millions who have enjoyed eating at Coffee Break for over 20 years, he is the only one who can say that!

text: Amo man ina pirme ang menu nga ginahanda sang café nga ini.
english: That is also always the menu that this café prepares.

text: Nagtilaw gani si mayor kag bise mayor, kag pila ka taga-media pagkatapos sinang panugdaon ni Yobab, kag wala man sila reklamo.
english: The mayor and vice mayor, and some members of the media, tried after Yobab's suggestion, and they had no complaints.

text: Gindayaw pa gani nila.
english: They even praised him.

text: Ti, si Yobab gihapon ang patihan ta?
english: Well, are we still to believe Yobab?

text: Porque sobra tatlo ka milyon ang iya followers?
english: Because he has more than three million followers?

text: Indi na!
english: Unable!

text: Pila na gani nga followers niya ang nag-unfollow sang iya vlog kay daw tinonto man lang ang iya ginhimo.
english: Some of his followers have even unfollowed his vlog because it seems like a joke.

text: Gin-apinan pa gani ini sang isa ka bulay-og man nga vlogger.
english: It was even defended by a fellow vlogger.

text: Siling niya wala kuno gabinutig si Yobab kay “universal”, ukon magkapareho, man ang panimpla sang tawo.
english: He said Yobab was not lying because human taste is “universal”.

text: So, tungod indi kauyon si Yobab sang timpla sang Coffee Break, dapat likawan man ini sang mga “potential” pa nga mga kostumer?
english: So, since Yobab doesn't like the taste of Coffee Break, should potential customers avoid it?

text: Hoy, indi, a!
english: Hey, no!

text: Peke ina ya ang panimpla ni Yobab!
english: Yobab's seasoning is fake!

text: Pang-sabotahe gani ini sa iban nga cafe kag restawran sa Iloilo kag sa imahe sang siyudad sang Iloilo sa pagkilala sang UNESCO sini bilang Creative City of Gastronomy, ang “Science and Art of Good Eating”.
english: This is sabotaging other cafes and restaurants in Iloilo and the image of Iloilo City in its UNESCO recognition as the Creative City of Gastronomy, the “Science and Art of Good Eating”.

text: Tutok na kita sa kuno “universal” nga panimpla sang tawo.
english: Let's focus on the supposedly “universal” taste of man.

text: Sunu kanday Jason Meyers, nga associate professor of Biology and Neuroscience, kag Maura Tumulty, professor of Philosophy, indi “universal” ang panimpla sang tawo —  sweet, bitter, sour, umami, kag salty – tungod indi magkapareho ang “degree of perceptive sensation” sang kada tawo.
english: According to Jason Meyers, associate professor of Biology and Neuroscience, and Maura Tumulty, professor of Philosophy, human taste — sweet, bitter, sour, umami, and salty — is not “universal” because each person has different degrees of perceptive sensation.

text: Indi gani tupong ang mga tudlo naton, indi bala?
english: Our fingers are not even parallel, are they?

text: Ina bangod kay bisan may “basic” nga panimpla ang tawo sa ila “physiological make-up”, ma-impluwensyahan pa ini sang iban nga “function” sang lawas, katulad sang aton pagpanimaho (sense of smell), kag sang ila experyensya (behavioral adaptation) sa palibut.
english: That's because even if a person has a basic taste in their physiological make-up, it can be influenced by other body functions, such as our sense of smell, and their behavioral adaptation to the environment.

text: Sunu gani sa AI, ang mga tawo nga may “obesity” maka- experyensya sang “reduced sensitivity to certain tastes”, labi na sa matam-is kag maasin nga panimpla ukon panabor.
english: According to AI, people with obesity experience reduced sensitivity to certain tastes, especially sweet and salty.

text: Bangod sini, ining “diminished sensitivity” makatulod sa ila pagkakinahanglan sang dugang nga katam-is kag mas maasin nga panabor agud matumbasan ang pareho nga panabor sang kadam-an nga indi obese.
english: Because of this, this “diminished sensitivity” can drive their need for more sweetness and a saltier taste to offset the same taste of the non-obese majority.

text: Amo ina seguro kon ngaa wala nanamitan si Yobab sang pagkaon nga natilawan niya kag kon ngaa matab-ang ang panimpla niya sa kape kay ang ginahanda sang Coffee Break pagkadam-an nga panabor sang publiko.
english: That's probably why Yobab didn't like the food he tasted and why he tasted the coffee because what Coffee Break prepares is mostly for the public.

text: In other words, “exception” ka ya Yobab, gani indi na pagdalahiga pa ang iban sa imo panimpla.
english: In other words, you are an “exception” Yobab, so don't include others in your taste.

text: Apang kon problema ini ni Yobab, “advice” naton sa iya nga gamitan niya ang iya ginakaon sang condiments katulad sang dugang nga asin ukon toyo sa pagkaon, kag dugang nga kalamay sa iya kape.
english: But if this is Yobab's problem, we advise him to use condiments such as more salt or soy sauce in his food, and more sugar in his coffee.

text: Nga wala niya ugaling ginhimo, kag ginbasol lang ang Coffee Break samtang ang diperensya yara gali sa iya kaugalingon.
english: Which he however did not, and simply blamed the Coffee Break when the difference was actually his own.

text: Sus, a!/PN
english: Up, a!/PN

text: Nagpositibo sa drug test ang duha ka taxi drivers sa ginpatigayon nga Oplan Harabas sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) 6 kag Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) 6 sa Dumangas Port kahapon nga adlaw, Miyerkules, Abril, 1.
english: Two taxi drivers tested positive for drugs in the Oplan Harabas conducted by the Land Transportation Office (LTO) 6 and Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) 6 at Dumangas Port yesterday, Wednesday, April 1.

text: Ini ang nagdugang sa walo ka drivers nga una na nga nagpositibo sa drug test sa mga terminals nga una na nga ginbisita sang PDEA kag LTO kun sa diin, lima diri ang tricycle drivers, duha ang taxi drivers kag isa ka driver sang Public Utility Jeepney kag ini sila ang napaidalom na sa confimatory test.
english: This is in addition to the eight drivers who previously tested positive for drugs in the terminals that were previously visited by the PDEA and LTO where, five of them are tricycle drivers, two are taxi drivers and one driver of Public Utility Jeepney and they have already undergone confirmatory test.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Regional Director sang LTO 6, iya ginpahayag nga humalin sang Lunes Santo, Marso 30, 2026 may ara na sang 1,422 ka mga specimen ang ginpaidalom sa drug test halin sa mga terminals sa probinsya sang Antique, Sara, Roxas, kag Guimaras.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Regional Director of LTO 6, said that as of Monday, March 30, 2026, 1,422 specimens have been subjected to drug tests from terminals in the provinces of Antique, Sara, Roxas, and Guimaras.

text: Ini nga numero ang naglapaw na sa target sang opisina apang magapadayon pa bangud may mga alkalde nga naga-request sa ila opisina nga magpatigayon sang drug test sa mga drivers.
english: This number has already exceeded the target of the office but will continue because there are mayors who request their office to conduct drug tests on drivers.

text: Nagapangabay man ang opisina sang Land Transportation Region 6 sa Association of Taxi Operators in Panay nga dapat nga maghimo sila sang nagakigo nga tikang batok sa illegal nga paggamit sang droga para sa ila mga drivers agud nga matapna na ini.
english: The office of Land Transportation Region 6 also urged the Association of Taxi Operators in Panay to take appropriate measures against illegal drug use for their drivers so that it can be stopped.

text: Apat ang patay kag duha ang pilason sa bungguanay sang wing van truck kag motorsiklo sa Sitio Maaslom, Barangay Busay, Cebu City.
english: Four people were killed and two others injured in a collision between a wing van truck and a motorcycle in Sitio Maaslom, Barangay Busay, Cebu City.

text: Ang motorsiklo may yara sang tatlo ka sakay samtang ang wing van may tatlo man ka sakay.
english: The motorcycle had three occupants while the wing van also had three occupants.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, pataklad ang motorsiklo sang nadulaan sang kontrol ang nagapadulhog nga wing van kag nagkadto sa piyak nga lane kag didto na nagbunggo sa motorsiklo.
english: According to the investigation, the motorcycle was going uphill when the wing van lost control and went to the other lane and collided with the motorcycle.

text: Patay ang tanan nga sakay sang motorsiklo samtang gindeklarar man nga dead on arrival ang driver sang wing van.
english: All the occupants of the motorcycle were killed while the driver of the wing van was declared dead on arrival.

text: Kritikal naman ang kondisyon sang duha pa ka sakay sang wing van.
english: Two other passengers of the wing van are in critical condition.

text: Nagapadayon naman ang imbestigasyon sa amo nga aksidente.
english: The investigation into the accident is ongoing.

text: SAMTANG ginabaisan pa kon san-o gid hiwaton ang Impeachment Trial  sa kaso ni  VP Sara Duterte, may mga haka-haka na kon ano gid ang mangin kapalaran sini sa Senate Impeachment Court nga pangunahan sang Chief Justice sang Supreme Court bilang presiding judge upod ang kabug-usan sang 24 ka mga senador.
english: WHILE the impeachment trial of VP Sara Duterte is still being debated, there are speculations about its fate in the Senate Impeachment Court headed by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court as presiding judge along with a total of 24 senators.

text: Ma-convict ukon ma-acquit bala ini?
english: Will it be convicted or acquitted?

text: Kag, sa ano nga klase sang panindugan sang mga senador nga malab-ut nila ang ila verdict, conviction man ukon acquittal?
english: And, in what kind of position do the senators reach their verdict, whether conviction or acquittal?

text: Madepende bala ini sa merito gid sang mga ebidensya kag mga testigo.
english: Whether it will depend entirely on the merits of the evidence and witnesses.

text: Ukon sa partisan politics kag  selfish interests sang mga senador?
english: Or to the partisan politics and selfish interests of the senators?

text:
***

By the way, indi pa mahibal-an kon san-o gid hiwaton ang Impeachment Trial.
english:
***

By the way, it is not yet known when the Impeachment Trial will be held.

text: Kuno sang nagligad pa nga Hunyo 2.
english: It was supposedly last June 2.

text: Sa Hunyo 11 naman kuno.
english: It's supposed to be on June 11th.

text: Por diyos por santo, “San-o gid?” napamangkot gani sang naaburido na nga ML Partylist Rep.
english: For god’s sake, “When exactly?” even asked the already worried ML Partylist Rep.

text: Leila de Lima.
english: Leila de Lima.

text:
***

Gin-impeach si VP Sara sang 240 sang 306 nga myembro sang Kamara sadtong Pebrero 5, 2025.
english:
***

VP Sara was impeached by 240 of the 306 members of the House of Representatives on February 5, 2025.

text: Ang aton 1987 Constitution ga-require lang sang one-third (1/3), ukon 102, nga boto agud ma-impeach sang Kamara ang isa ka opisyal sang gobyerno nga ginapangunahan dira sang Presidente kag Bise Presidente.
english: Our 1987 Constitution requires only one-third (1/3), or 102, votes for the House to impeach a government official headed by the President and Vice President.

text: Agud awayon ini sa boto sang mga botante, ginkampanyahan gid sang maki-Duterte nga i-boycott ang pagboto sa mga pro-impeachment nga mga kongresista sadtong 2025 midterm elections.
english: To fight it in the vote of the voters, the pro-Duterte campaigned to boycott the vote for pro-impeachment congressmen during the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Unfortunately, daku gid nga majority sang mga pro-impeachment ang nagdalaug sangsa mga anti-impeachment, nga gapakita sang ila pagsugot sa Impeachment Trial.
english: Unfortunately, a very large majority of the pro-impeachment candidates won over the anti-impeachment candidates, which shows their support for the Impeachment Trial.

text: Gin-describe ining pagdaug sang mga pro-impeachment ni Manila 3rd Ditrict Rep.
english: This was described as the victory of the pro-impeachments of Manila 3rd District Rep.

text: Joel Chua nga isa ka “swashbuckling election victory”.
english: Joel Chua called it a “swashbuckling election victory”.

text: Si Chua ang nanguna sa pagduso sang mga akusasyon batok kay VP Sara sa Quad Committee on Corruption and Accountability, nga, tungod sini, galaum siya nga sakdagon gid sing lubos sang Senado ang panumbungon sang 11 ka myembro sang House Prosecution Panel.
english: Chua took the lead in pushing the charges against VP Sara to the Quad Committee on Corruption and Accountability, which, because of this, he hoped the Senate would fully support the indictment of the 11 members of the House Prosecution Panel.

text: Ugaling lang kay daw lain ang resulta sang botohay para sa 12 ka mga kandidato sa pagka-senador sang 2025 midterm elections, nga amo ang mahusgar sang kapalaran sang  kaso ni VP Sara upod sa 12 nga nabilin pa sa Senado.
english: However, the results of the vote for the 12 senatorial candidates in the 2025 midterm elections will be different, which will judge the fate of VP Sara's case along with the 12 remaining in the Senate.

text: Nagpakita sang pwersa diri ang mga anti-impeachment sa sinang eleksyon sa pagdaug sang lima ka maki-Duterte nga mga kandidato – sanday Go, Bato kag Marcoleta sang Duterte10 kag ang duha nga laban-laban maki-Duterte bisan indi kaupod sa Duterte10.
english: The anti-impeachment forces showed strength here in that election by winning five pro-Duterte candidates – Go, Bato and Marcoleta of Duterte10 and the two who are mostly pro-Duterte even though they are not with Duterte10.

text: Ining duha amo sanday Senator-elect Villar nga nagdoble-kabe sa Alyansa ni PBBM kag sa Duterte10, kag ang kuno independent candidate nga si reelectionist Senator Imee Marcos nga sa hulag kag mga deklarasyon maki-Duterte gid.
english: These two are Senator-elect Villar who double-headed the Alliance of PBBM and Duterte10, and the supposedly independent candidate reelectionist Senator Imee Marcos who in actions and declarations is very pro-Duterte.

text: May panghulag man gani kontra impeachment halin sa mga (daw lang) maki-Alyansa man nga mga senador nga ang termino tubtub pa 2028, katulad ni Senator Nancy Binay kag ni Senator Jinggoy Estrada.
english: There is even a movement against impeachment from (apparently) pro-Alliance senators whose terms are until 2028, such as Senator Nancy Binay and Senator Jinggoy Estrada.

text: Yara man dira si Senator Robin Padilla.
english: Senator Robin Padilla was also there.

text: In fact, kon husto ang aton pagpati, isa na gid lang ang kulang agud maka-9 ka boto sila agud ma-frustrate ang manug-convict nga 2/3, ukon 16, nga boto.
english: In fact, if our assumption is correct, they are only missing one vote to get 9 votes to frustrate the convict with 2/3, or 16, votes.

text: Whatever, dapat hiwaton gid sang Senado ang Impeachment Trial, bisan na lang sa pag-respeto sa daku nga boto sang Kamara sa pag-impeach kay VP Sara – 240 sang 306 nga myembro sang Kamara.
english: Whatever, the Senate should hold the Impeachment Trial, even in respect of the overwhelming vote of the House to impeach VP Sara – 240 of the 306 members of the House.

text: Kag, syempre agud man mapatihan ang reputasyon sang Senado nga independent-minded ini.
english: And, of course also to lend credence to the Senate’s reputation for being independent-minded.

text:
***

Pero, maboto gid ayhan ang mga senador sandig sa merito sang mga ebidensya kag mga testigo sa ila desisyon sa Impeachment Trial?
english:
***

But, will the senators really vote on the merits of the evidence and witnesses in their decision on the Impeachment Trial?

text: Base sa resulta sang 2025 midterm election para senador nga naghatag sang dugang nga pwersa sa kontra impeachment, basi indi na nila mahimo ina.
english: Based on the results of the 2025 midterm election for senator that gave more force to the anti-impeachment, they may not be able to do that.

text: In other words, posible nga ang desisyon sang mga senador may lamod na sang survival politics kag maboto na lang ang kada isa sunu sa ila selfish interest.
english: In other words, it is possible that the decision of the senators is already tainted with survival politics and each will vote according to their selfish interest.

text: Nonetheless, bisan ano pa ang boto sang aton mga senador, segurado nga pabudlayon gid sang House Prosecution si VP Sara sa pagsabat sang panumbungon nila sa iya sa Impeachment Trial.
english: Nonetheless, no matter what our senators vote, the House Prosecution will surely make it very difficult for VP Sara to answer the charges against him in the Impeachment Trial.

text: Kag basi mag-retreat na lang si VP Sara sa tunga-tunga sini katulad sang natabo kay anay Presidente Estrada, kag mag-hope na lang for the best.
english: And maybe VP Sara will just retreat in the middle of it like what happened to former President Estrada, and just hope for the best.

text: Ukon atubangon gid niya ang Impeachment Trial sa iya pagpati kag sang iya legal team nga malutsan pa niya ang mga akusasyon batok sa iya./PN
english: Or will he face the Impeachment Trial in the belief that he and his legal team will be able to overcome the charges against him./PN

text: Temporaryo nga ginpauntat ang Game 2 sa Dinagyang Cup 2026 matapos ang tensyon nga natabo sa tunga sang hampang sa Mandurriao kag Iloilo City Proper.
english: Game 2 of the Dinagyang Cup 2026 was temporarily suspended after tensions between the matches in Mandurriao and Iloilo City Proper.

text: Ginpatigayon ang match sa La Paz kagab-i, Pebrero 5.
english: The match was played in La Paz last night, February 5.

text: Nag-ugat ang tensyon sa desisyon sang referee nga i-technical foul ang coach sang Mandurriao.
english: The tension stemmed from the referee's decision to give the Mandurriao coach a technical foul.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Rudiver Jungco, Sr., Executive Assistant for Youth and Sports sang Iloilo City Government nga yara man mismo nagalantaw sa amo nga match, iya ginpahayag nga sa pamuno pa lang sang hampang, nagareklamo na ang coach sang Mandurriao sa kada tion nga indi ini kumbinsido sa kada call sang game official.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Rudiver Jungco, Sr., Executive Assistant for Youth and Sports of the Iloilo City Government who was also watching the match, said that at the beginning of the game, the coach of Mandurriao complained every time he was not convinced of every call of the game official.

text: Pila ka beses ini natabo nga ginlaragway ni Jungco nga indi maayo nga gesture.
english: This happened several times which Jungco described as a bad gesture.

text: Suno kay Jungco, sang gin-technical foul na ini, didto kag naghana ini nga mag-walkout apang wala man dalayon naka-walkout bangud yara man gihapon ini sa sulod sang court.
english: According to Jungco, when he was given a technical foul, he tried to walk out but did not immediately walk out because he was still inside the court.

text: May players ang Mandurriao nga nagtinir suno kay Jungco kag wala man nag-upod sa coach.
english: Jungco said Mandurriao had players who stayed and did not accompany the coach.

text: Pahayag pa sini, gindesisyunan na lang nga indi pagpadayunon ang hampang ilabi na bangud tensyonado sa gihapon kag madamo ang nagalantaw.
english: He said it was decided not to continue the game especially since it was still tense and many people were watching.

text: Suno kay Jungco, ipatawag sini ang magtimbang nga bahin kag desisyunan kun san-o sila maga-resume sa Game 2.
english: Jungco said he will summon both sides and decide when they will resume Game 2.

text: Ginalantaw man kun ano ang sanctions nga mahimo idagdag sa coach sang Mandurriao.
english: The sanctions that can be imposed on the Mandurriao coach are also being considered.

text:
OFFICIAL STATEMENT SANG TEAM MANDURRIAO

Sa official statement sang Team Mandurriao nga gin-post sa Facebook, nagpangayo ini sang pasensya sa natabo nga insidente nga nagresulta sa pag-postpone sang hampang.
english:
OFFICIAL STATEMENT OF TEAM MANDURRIAO

In an official statement posted on Facebook, Team Mandurriao apologized for the incident that resulted in the postponement of the match.

text: Ginpaathag sang team nga nagapati sila sa respeto, sportsmanship kag patas nga kumpetisyon.
english: The team made it clear that they believe in respect, sportsmanship and fair competition.

text: Apang pahayag nila, sa nauna pa lang nga minutos sang hampang, madamo na nga tumalan-aw ang naka-obserba sang inconsistency sa mga pag-officiate.
english: However, they said, in the first minutes of the game, many spectators observed inconsistencies in the officiating.

text: Ginplastar nila nga pila ka beses ini natabo apang ginpalampuwas lang sa ngalan sang hampang.
english: They laid out that this happened several times but was just overlooked in the name of the game.

text: May isa ka punto nga nagreklamo ang ila coach suno sa team para sa safety sang player kag sa integridad sang hampang ilabi na bangud wala gid sang may gintawag nga call ang referee.
english: At one point, their coach complained, according to the team, for player safety and the integrity of the game, especially since the referee never called anything.

text: Didto sila kag nagreklamo ang coach, apang nakibot sila suno sa ila sang gindeklarar nga “thrown out” na ang ila coach bisan nga wala pa sang technical ukon formal warning.
english: They were there and the coach complained, but they were surprised when their coach was declared “thrown out” even though there was no technical or formal warning.

text: Kun may nahambal man nga indi maayo suno sa team, ginapangayuan nila ini sang pasensya bangud halin man ini sa responsilidad kag pag-ulikid bilang coach nga luyag nga proteksyunan ang iya player sa court.
english: If there is anything wrong with the team, they apologize because it is also out of responsibility and concern as a coach who wants to protect his player on the court.

text:
Nangayo sila sang pasensya sa league organizers kag referees kag nagpanawagan sang patas nga desisyon kasunod sang hitabo sang nagligad nga gab-i.

LEARNING EXPERIENCE PARA SA TANAN

Hugot naman nga ginabaton sang coach sang Team Mandurriao nga si Coach Jay Dan Delos Santos ang nangin sanction sa iya.
english:
They apologized to the league organizers and referees and called for a fair decision following the previous night’s incident.

LEARNING EXPERIENCE FOR ALL

Team Mandurriao coach Jay Dan Delos Santos strongly accepts the sanction.

text: Suno sa iya, gin-suspend siya kag indi mahimo maka-coach sa iya team kun mag-resume na ang Game 2.
english: He said he was suspended and will not be able to coach his team when Game 2 resumes.

text: Ginplastar man sini kun ano ang nakabutang sa statement sang ila team kag ginpaathag liwat ang inconsistencies nga nakit-an sa pag-officiate.
english: He also laid out what was in the statement of their team and explained the inconsistencies found in the officiating.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, gin-ako niya ang iya nangin kapaltahan ilabi na sa iya gesture.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, he admitted his mistakes especially in his gesture.

text: Pahayag sini, nabaton na sini kun ano man ang desisyon, madamo siya sang natun-an, kag tion na agud nga maka-move on sa amo nga hitabo.
english: He said he has accepted whatever the decision was, he learned a lot, and it's time to move on from the incident.

text: “At the end of the day, baton ko man nga out na ko sa playing court kay bal-an ko man nga may kapaltahan ko ah,” pahayag sini.
english: "At the end of the day, I accept that I'm out of the playing court because I know I have a flaw," he said.

text: “Damo ta na-learn sa amo ni nga butang.
english: “We’ve learned a lot from this.

text: Indi lang ako ang may natun-an kundi for sure ang mga naga-officiate man.
english: Not only did I learn but for sure those who officiated as well.

text: Learning experience ni sa aton tanan.
english: This is a learning experience for all of us.

text: Sa liwat, gapangayo ako sang pasensya.
english: Again, I apologize.

text: Salamat, kag mag-move on na ta,” dugang sini.
english: Thank you, and let’s move on,” it added.

text: Gin-imbitahan ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. invited

text: ang grand winner sang “America’s Got Talent” Season 20 nga si Jessica Sanchez nga mag-perform saAssociation of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Leaders’ Summit nga pagahiwaton sa Pilipinas sa masunod nga tuig.
english: the grand winner of “America’s Got Talent” Season 20 Jessica Sanchez to perform at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Leaders’ Summit to be held in the Philippines next year.

text: Suno kay President Marcos kag First Lady Liza Marcos nga ang Prime minister sang Singapore ang isa ka fan ni Jessica kag gina-abangan gid sini ang Filipino-American singer.
english: President Marcos and First Lady Liza Marcos said the Prime Minister of Singapore is a fan of Jessica and is looking forward to the Filipino-American singer.

text: Nagpasalamat naman si Jessica kag suno sa iya nga excited na ini nga magkanta para sa mga lider sang nagkalain-lain nga mga pungsod ilabi na nga igarepresenta sini ang Pilipnas.
english: Jessica thanked and said she is excited to sing for the leaders of different countries especially that she will represent the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga magapaguwa ini sang album sa una nga quarter sa masunod nga tuig kag kabahin sa iya mga kanta amo ang tagalog kag collaborations sang mga Pilipino nga artista.
english: He also said that he will release an album in the first quarter of next year and some of his songs are Tagalog and collaborations with Filipino artists.

text: Yari subong sa Pilipinas si Jessica para sa New Year’s Countdown Celebration sa Pasay City antes ini magabalik sa US.
english: Jessica is currently in the Philippines for the New Year's Countdown Celebration in Pasay City before returning to the US.

text: Isa ka man-og ang nakit-an nga nagtupad sa isa ka manok sa sulod sang kurungan sini sa Calasiao, Pangasinan.
english: A snake was found next to a chicken inside its cage in Calasiao, Pangasinan.

text: Suno kay Zaldy Posadas Tamayo, nakita na lang niya ang man-og kasunod sang pagbaha sa ila nga lugar.
english: According to Zaldy Posadas Tamayo, he only saw the snake after the flooding in their area.

text: Nagpaandam naman ang mga eksperto nga indi pagsakiton ang mga man-og, sa baylo, i-report gilayon sa otoridad para nga ma-rescue.
english: Experts warned against hurting the snakes, instead, report them immediately to the authorities for rescue.

text: Nasamaran ang isa ka overseas Filipino worker (OFW) kasunod sang missile attack sa Arad, Israel sang tinalikdan nga Marso 21.
english: An overseas Filipino worker (OFW) was injured following a missile attack in Arad, Israel last March 21.

text: Suno sa Philippine Embassy sa Israel, gilayon nga gindala ang 30-anyos nga biktima sa Soroka Medical Center agud nga hatagan sang nagakaigu nga pagbulong.
english: According to the Philippine Embassy in Israel, the 30-year-old victim was immediately brought to the Soroka Medical Center for proper treatment.

text: Padayun man nga naga-monitor ang embahada sa nasambit nga pungsod agud nga mahatagan sang bulig ang iban pa nga mga apektado nga mga Pilipino sa nagapadayun nga tension sa Middle East.
english: The embassy in the country is also continuing to monitor to provide assistance to other Filipinos affected by the ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

text: Matandaan nga wala na-intercept sang air defense sang Israel ang duha ka ballistic missiles sang weekend rason nga may mga nasamaran.
english: Israeli air defense failed to intercept two ballistic missiles over the weekend, causing injuries.

text: Isa sa missile strikes sang Iran ang nag-igo sa isa ka multi-story apartment block sa syudad sang Arad.
english: One of Iran’s missile strikes hit a multi-story apartment block in the city of Arad.

text: Kabahin ini sang balos sang Iran matapos nga gin-atake sila sang US kag Israel sang Pebrero 28 nga amo ang nagpatay kay anay Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei kag iban pa nga senior officials.
english: It was part of Iran's retaliation after the US and Israel launched attacks on them on February 28 that killed former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and other senior officials.

text: Gintawag sang isa ka research group nga hapaw ang mga solusyon nga ginatanyag sang gobyerno sa tunga sang ginalantaw pagtimbuok sang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo bangud sang epekto sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: A research group has called the solutions offered by the government superficial amid the expected rise in petroleum product prices due to the impact of the war in the Middle East.

text: Ini kasunod sang mga panugyan halin sa gobyerno nga magkinot sa gatong, indi magkadto sa indi importante nga mga destinasyon, pahat-pahaton lang ang price hike, magpangita sang mga gas station nga may discount, kag may naga-suhestyon man sang pagpatuman sang four-day workweek kag online classes.
english: This follows advice from the government to save fuel, avoid non-essential destinations, spread the price hike, look for gas stations with discounts, and some suggest the implementation of a four-day workweek and online classes.

text: Kagab-i, Marso 6, ginmandu naman ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: Last night, March 6, President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.

text: four-day work week arrangement para sa mga ahensya nga yara sa idalom sang Executive Department umpisa sa Lunes, Marso 9.
english: four-day work week arrangement for agencies under the Executive Department starting Monday, March 9.

text: Paagi ini suno sa presidente agud nga ma-enforce ang energy conservation measures.
english: The president said this is a way to enforce energy conservation measures.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay IBON Foundation Executive Director Jose Enrique “Sonny” Africa, iya ginpahayag nga bisan ihambal pa sang Department of Energy (DOE) nga gradual ukon hagan-haganon lang ang price hike, indi sini makakas ang tuman kabug-at nga palas-anon para sa mga Pilipino.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, IBON Foundation Executive Director Jose Enrique “Sonny” Africa said that even if the Department of Energy (DOE) says that the price hike is gradual, it will not remove the heavy burden for Filipinos.

text: Pahayag sini, ang tanan nga solusyon sang gobyerno wala naga-ako sang ila responsibilidad.
english: He said all government solutions do not accept their responsibility.

text:
MGA REKOMENDASYON

Ginapanugyan naman sang research group ang pagkakas sang Value Added Tax (VAT) kag sang excise taxes sa fuel prices.
english:
RECOMMENDATIONS

The research group also recommends the abolition of Value Added Tax (VAT) and excise taxes on fuel prices.

text: Suno kay Africa, kun kakason ini nga duha ka buwis sa oil prices, mapanubo ang presyo sang gasolina sang tubtub sa P16-17; mapanubo ang presyo sang diesel sang tubtub P13; kag mapanubo ang presyo sang kerosene sang tubtub P8.
english: According to Africa, if these two taxes on oil prices are removed, the price of gasoline will be reduced by up to P16-17; reduce the price of diesel by up to P13; and reduce the price of kerosene by up to P8.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin suno sa iya, kun magpadayon ang price hikes, ang gobyerno lamang ang maka-benepisyo bangud makaganar ini sang dugang nga P1.3 billion kada bulan sa VAT revenues halin lamang sa gasolina kag diesel.
english: On the other hand, he said, if the price hikes continue, only the government will benefit because it will earn an additional P1.3 billion per month in VAT revenues from gasoline and diesel alone.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa ginatos ka bilyones ka pesos nga nakuha na sang gobyerno halin sa VAT kag excise taxes sa existing oil prices.
english: This is in addition to the hundreds of billions of pesos that the government has already collected from VAT and excise taxes on existing oil prices.

text: Ginduso man sang IBON Foundation nga ihanda na ang subsidiya nga ihatag sa mga driver sang pampubliko nga salakyan agud nga barato gihapon ang pamasahe kag may kita gihapon ang mga driver.
english: The IBON Foundation also proposed to prepare the subsidy to be given to the drivers of public transportation so that the fare is still cheap and the drivers still have income.

text: Magluwas diri suno sa iya, dapat nga may ayuda man para sa mga mangunguma kag mga manugpangisda.
english: Besides, he said, there should also be assistance for farmers and fishermen.

text: Sa tunga sang ginalantaw nga pagsaka sang inflation, ginapanugyan man sini ang paghatag sang subsidiya sa mga pigado.
english: Amid the expected rise in inflation, he also suggested providing subsidies to the poor.

text: Una naman nga ginsiling sang DOE nga makabulig sa paghagan-hagan sang fuel prices ang ginaduso nga paghatag sang Kongreso kay Marcos sang temporaryo nga awtoridad agud nga kakason ang excise taxes sa petroleum products.#
english: Earlier, the DOE said the proposed grant of Congress to Marcos temporary authority to remove excise taxes on petroleum products will help ease fuel prices.

text: Hugot nga ginbaton sang coach sang Team Mandurriao ang nangin sanction sa iya matapos ang tensyon nga natabo sa hampang batok sa Iloilo City Proper sa Dinagyang Cup 2026.
english: The coach of Team Mandurriao firmly accepted the sanction against him after the tension that occurred in the match against Iloilo City Proper in the Dinagyang Cup 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Coach Jay Dan Delos Santos, iya ginpahayag nga gin-suspend siya kag indi mahimo maka-coach sa iya team kun mag-resume na ang Game 2.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Coach Jay Dan Delos Santos said he has been suspended and will not be able to coach his team when Game 2 resumes.

text: Pahayag sini, nabaton na sini kun ano man ang desisyon, madamo siya sang natun-an, kag tion na agud nga maka-move on sa amo nga hitabo.
english: He said he has accepted whatever the decision was, he learned a lot, and it's time to move on from the incident.

text: Kun balikan, temporaryo nga ginpauntat ang hampang kagab-i bangud sa natabo nga tensyon nga nag-ugat sa desisyon sang referee nga i-technical foul si Delos Santos.
english: The match was temporarily suspended last night due to tensions that led to the referee's decision to technically foul Delos Santos.

text: Una naman nga napakig-angutan sang Bombo Radyo si Mr. Rudiver Jungco, Sr., Executive Assistant for Youth and Sports sang Iloilo City Government nga yara man mismo nagalantaw sa amo nga match.
english: Bombo Radyo first contacted Mr. Rudiver Jungco, Sr., Executive Assistant for Youth and Sports of the Iloilo City Government who was also watching the match.

text: Iya ginpahayag nga sa pamuno pa lang sang hampang, nagareklamo na ang coach sang Mandurriao sa kada tion nga indi ini kumbinsido sa kada call sang game official.
english: He said that at the beginning of the game, the coach of Mandurriao complained every time he was not convinced of every call of the game official.

text: Pila ka beses ini natabo nga ginlaragway ni Jungco nga indi maayo nga gesture.
english: This happened several times which Jungco described as a bad gesture.

text: Suno kay Jungco, sang gin-technical foul na ang coach sang Mandurriao, didto kag naghana ini nga mag-walkout apang wala man dalayon naka-walkout bangud yara man gihapon ini sa sulod sang court.
english: According to Jungco, when the Mandurriao coach was technically fouled, he tried to walk out but did not immediately walk out because he was still inside the court.

text: Pahayag pa sini, gindesisyunan na lang nga indi pagpadayunon ang hampang ilabi na bangud tensyonado sa gihapon ang venue kag madamo pa ang nagalantaw.
english: He said it was decided not to continue the game especially since the venue is still tense and there are still many people watching.

text: Suno naman kay Delos Santos, may may mga “inconsistent” nga mga tawag sang mga game official, apang pila ka beses nila ini nga ginpabayaan lang kag ginpadayon ang game.
english: According to Delos Santos, there were some “inconsistent” calls from the game officials, but they ignored them several times and continued the game.

text: Pahayag pa sini, sang nakabunggo na ang ulo sang iya player kag wala gid sang call nga ginhimo ang referee, didto na kag nag-alsa siya bangud sa iya pag-ulikid sa safety sang iya player.
english: He said that when his player's head was hit and the referee did not make a call, he stood up because he was concerned about the safety of his player.

text: Sa statement sang ila team, nakibot sila suno sa ila sang gindeklarar nga “thrown out” na si Coach Delos Santos bisan nga wala pa sang technical ukon formal warning.
english: In a statement, their team said they were shocked when Coach Delos Santos was declared “thrown out” even though there was no technical or formal warning.

text: Kun may nahambal man nga indi maayo suno sa team, ginapangayuan nila ini sang pasensya bangud halin man ini sa responsilidad kag pag-ulikid bilang coach nga luyag nga proteksyunan ang iya player sa court.
english: If there is anything wrong with the team, they apologize because it is also out of responsibility and concern as a coach who wants to protect his player on the court.

text: Sa interview subong nga gab-i, ginsulit ni Delos Santos ang iya pagpangayo sang pasensya sa alkalde, kay Jungco, sa league organizers, kag referees sa kun ano man ang iya nangin gesture nga indi maayo.
english: In an interview tonight, Delos Santos reiterated his apology to the mayor, Jungco, the league organizers, and referees for whatever gesture he made that was not good.

text: “At the end of the day, baton ko man nga out na ko sa playing court kay bal-an ko man nga may kapaltahan ko ah,” pahayag sini.
english: "At the end of the day, I accept that I'm out of the playing court because I know I have a flaw," he said.

text: “Damo ta na-learn sa amo ni nga butang.
english: “We’ve learned a lot from this.

text: Indi lang ako ang may natun-an kundi for sure ang mga naga-officiate man.
english: Not only did I learn but for sure those who officiated as well.

text: Learning experience ni sa aton tanan.
english: This is a learning experience for all of us.

text: Sa liwat, gapangayo ako sang pasensya.
english: Again, I apologize.

text: Salamat, kag mag-move on na ta,” dugang sini.
english: Thank you, and let’s move on,” it added.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga wala sang pustaanay nga involved sa ila pag-representar sang Mandurriao — baliskad sa nagaguwa nga reports nga may nakataya nga kuwarta para sa hampang.
english: He also clarified that there was no betting involved in their representation of Mandurriao — contrary to reports that money was at stake for the game.

text: Natalana pa nga ipaguwa ang schedule kun san-o maga-resume ang Game 2.#
english: The schedule for when Game 2 will resume is yet to be released.#

text: Isa ka proactive move sang Department of Energy ang temporaryo nga pagsuspende sang Wholesale Electricity Spot Market agud malikawan ang tuman nga pagsaka sa presyo sang kuryente sa Pilipinas.
english: A proactive move of the Department of Energy is the temporary suspension of the Wholesale Electricity Spot Market to avoid the sharp increase in electricity prices in the Philippines.

text: Ini matapos nga nagdeklarar ang nga magapatuman sila sang dugang nga P2 tubtob P4 per kilowatt hour sa bulan sang Abril.
english: This is after the company declared that they will implement an additional P2 to P4 per kilowatt hour in April.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raphael Dorilag, Manager sang Energy Sourcing Department sang More Electric and Power Corporation, iya ginpahayag nga subong nga may krisis sa langis, posible gid nga may ara sang magamay nga pagtaas sa rate sang kuryente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raphael Dorilag, Manager of the Energy Sourcing Department of More Electric and Power Corporation, said that now that there is an oil crisis, it is possible that there will be a slight increase in the rate of electricity.

text: Ini bangud nga nagaumpisa na nga mabatyagan ang tuman ka-init nga panahon sa bilog nga pungsod kun sa diin nagataas man ang demand sang publiko.
english: This is because the hot weather is beginning to be felt across the country where the demand of the public is also increasing.

text: Dugang pa niya, posible nga pagagamitun sang MORE power ang ila Diesel Power plants kun pagakulangun ang ila nga suplay, apang wala ini gina-engganyo sang gobyerno bangud sa kulang nga suplay sang diesel sa Pilipinas.
english: He added that it is possible that MORE will use their diesel power plants if their supply is short, but the government does not encourage it due to the shortage of diesel supply in the Philippines.

text: Wala na nakasalbar ang isa ka hiker matapos nahulog sa pil-as sa Tarao Cliff sa Palawan.
english: A hiker was unable to survive after falling from a cliff at Tarao Cliff in Palawan.

text: Ang biktima amo si Mark Louie Torrente, residente sang Puerto Princesa City sa amo nga probinsya.
english: The victim was identified as Mark Louie Torrente, resident of Puerto Princesa City in the province.

text: Suno sa mga otoridad, ginbawian sang kabuhi ang biktima bangud sa dako nga mga pilas nga naangkon sini.
english: According to authorities, the victim died due to serious injuries sustained.

text: Ginpahayag sang mga katapo sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Puerto Princesa nga nangin mabudlay ang pagrekober sa lawas sang biktima bangud sa mabudlay nga alagyan.
english: Members of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Puerto Princesa said it was difficult to recover the victim's body due to the difficult road.

text: Ginahibalo pa kun paano nahulog ang amo nga lalaki.
english: It is still unknown how the man fell.

text: Nasapwan nga wala na sang kabuhi ang isa ka lalaki sa Rayong, Thailand bangud sa adlaw-adlaw nga pag-inom sang beer sa sulod sang masobra isa ka bulan.
english: A man in Rayong, Thailand was found dead after drinking beer daily for more than a month.

text: Sang damlag lang, ginrespondehan sang mga rescue workers halin sa Siam Rayong Foundation ang isa ka balay sa Ban Chang district sang Rayong agud buligan ang isa ka lalaki nga ginpahayag nga nagsuprir sang seizure kag nalipong.
english: Recently, rescue workers from the Siam Rayong Foundation responded to a house in the Ban Chang district of Rayong to help a man who allegedly suffered a seizure and fainted.

text: Sa malain nga palad, antes pa man sila nag-abot, napatay na ang pasyente.
english: Unfortunately, before they arrived, the patient died.

text: Siya ginkilala nga si Thaweesak Namwongsa, 44-anyos, kag amay sang 16-anyos nga solterito.
english: He was identified as Thaweesak Namwongsa, 44, and father of a 16-year-old boy.

text: Suno sa anak sang biktima, wala na gid sang iban nga ginakaon ukon ginainom ang iya amay sa sulod na sang masobra isa ka bulan.
english: According to the victim's son, his father has not eaten or drunk anything else for more than a month.

text: Nakit-an sa iya kwarto ang masobra 100 ka botelya sang beer.
english: More than 100 bottles of beer were found in his room.

text: Ginapatihan nga ang pagbulagay nila sang iya asawa ang reason kun ngaa nagpinahubog na lang ini adlaw-adlaw.
english: It is believed that the separation from his wife was the reason why he became drunk every day.

text: Hugot nga ginpanginwala sang Malacañang ang mga huring-huring nga may colon cancer si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., matapos ang iya sakit nga diverticulitis.
english: Malacañang has strongly denied rumors that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has colon cancer, after he suffered from diverticulitis.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pahayag ni anay presidential spokesperson Harry Roque nga nagagamit si Marcos sang colostomy bag tungod sa colon-related surgery.
english: This follows the statement of former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque that Marcos is using a colostomy bag due to colon-related surgery.

text: Ginpanginwala sang palasyo ang pahayag kag gintawag nga ‘peke’ ang laragway nga ginpakigbahin ni Roque sa iya social media.
english: The palace denied the statement and called the picture Roque shared on his social media ‘fake’.

text: Ginhinyo ni Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro ang publiko nga indi magpati ukon magpalapnag sang fake news, bangud posible ini makaguba sa Presidente kag sa ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro urged the public not to believe or spread fake news, as it could damage the President and the Philippine economy.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang Malacañang ang pahayag ni Bise Presidente Sara Duterte nga target sang administrasyon ang iban nga senador, kag ginakabig ini nga isa man ka sala nga istorya.
english: Malacañang also denied Vice President Sara Duterte's statement that the administration targeted other senators, and considered it a false story.

text: Suno kay Castro, indi ini ang una nga kahigayunan nga nagpalapta si Duterte sang sala nga impormasyon parte sa gobyerno.
english: According to Castro, this is not the first time that Duterte has spread false information about the government.

text: SADTONG presidential election sang 2022, nakita na ang pagbaskug sang boto sang mga kabataan batok sa mga political dynasties kag celebrities nga, sunu sa sining mga kabataan, “wala makasolbar sang mga problema” sang pungsod.
english: DURING the presidential election of 2022, the vote of children against political dynasties and celebrities who, according to these children, “have not solved the problems” of the country has been seen.

text: Ginpakita pa gani ini sang mga Gen Z generation (gaedad 18-28) kag mga Millennial (gaedad 29-44) sa paghatag sang ila boto sa kay anay VP Leni Robredo bisan pa nga nalutos ini sa kabug-usan batok kay Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Gen Z generation (aged 18-28) and Millennials (aged 29-44) even showed this by giving their votes to former VP Leni Robredo despite her defeat overall against Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ginpalabi nila si VP Leni sa ginpakita sini nga pagka-sinsero, pagkabunayag (honest), kag pagka-resourceful sa serbisyo bisan practically wala ini matagaan sing significante nga rolyo sa administrasyon ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte (2016-2022).
english: They praised VP Leni for her sincerity, honesty, and resourcefulness in service even though she was practically not given a significant role in the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte (2016-2022).

text: Sa ila pag-encuentro ni Marcos Jr.
english: During their encounter with Marcos Jr.

text: sadtong 2022 presidential election, sunu sa AI research, 60% gid sang gaedad 18-24 ang nagboto kay Robredo; mga 55% naman ang halin sa edad nga 25-34; kag natigayon pa ang 50% sang boto sang nagaedad 35-44.
english: in the 2022 presidential election, according to AI research, 60% of those aged 18-24 voted for Robredo; about 55% are from the age group of 25-34; and still achieved 50% of the vote of those aged 35-44.

text: Ugaling, sa kabug-usan, ginlutos siya ni Marcos Jr.
english: However, overall, he was defeated by Marcos Jr.

text: sing daku halin sa boto sang mga gaedad 45 pataas.
english: largely from the vote of those aged 45 and over.

text: Sunu sa AI research, bangod ato sa matam-is nga “campaign messaging”, nga naglakip sang pangako nga PhP20 kada kilo nga bugas, kag sang pwersa sang “political legacy”, ukon personal nga liderato, sang mga political leaders nga may suporta pa sang mga traditional families (dynasties).
english: According to AI research, this is due to the sweet campaign messaging, which included the promise of PhP20 per kilo of rice, and the force of political legacy, or personal leadership, of political leaders who still have the support of traditional families (dynasties).

text: Sa indi na katingalahan nga hitabo, sang nagligad nga 2025 midterm elections nagpakita pa gid sing pagbaskug ang boto sang mga kabataan batok sa mga kandidato halin sa political dynasties kag celebrities.
english: In a less surprising development, the recent 2025 midterm elections showed further strength in the youth vote against candidates from political dynasties and celebrities.

text: Nag-resulta ini sa pagkalutos sang madamo sa ila sa lokal man kag nasyonal nga pwesto.
english: This resulted in the defeat of many of them in both local and national positions.

text: Lakip diri nalutos ang halos katunga gid sang 12 ka mga kandidato sang Alyansa ni PBBM, samtang naghatag man sang kadalag-an sa mga kasumpong nga mga kandidato.
english: This included defeating almost half of the 12 candidates of the PBBM Alliance, while also giving victory to the opposing candidates.

text: Sa isa ka interbyu, si Senior Research Fellow at Ateneo Policy Center Michael Henry Ll.
english: In an interview, Senior Research Fellow at Ateneo Policy Center Michael Henry Ll.

text: Yusingco nagtugda nga sa 2025 midterm elections nakita dira ang pagbaskug pa gid sang boto sang mga kabataan kag ang pagsikway na nila sang madamo nga mga kandidato halin sa political dynasties kag celebrities nga “wala (ukon indi) makahatag kasolbaran sa mga problema sang pungsod”.
english: Yusingco suggested that the 2025 midterm elections will see the strengthening of the youth vote and the rejection of many candidates from political dynasties and celebrities who “do not (or will not) provide solutions to the country's problems”.

text: Ang political scientist kag retired University of the Philippines professor Clarita A. Carlos nag-welcome man sang dugang nga partipasyon sang mga kabataan sa 2025 nga eleksyon.
english: Political scientist and retired University of the Philippines professor Clarita A. Carlos also welcomed increased participation of children in the 2025 elections.

text: “The signs are good that we are reaching political maturity little by little.
english: “The signs are good that we are reaching political maturity little by little.

text: Voters are becoming more educated and discerning in choosing their leaders.
english: Voters are becoming more educated and discerning in choosing their leaders.

text: And that’s all good,” siling niya.
english: And that’s all good,” he said.

text: Ma-imagine ko, dugang niya, nga indi na nila maagwanta ang “corruption kag “ineptitude” sang madamo nga mga lideres naton sa pungsod.
english: I can imagine, he added, that they can no longer tolerate the “corruption and “ineptitude” of many of our leaders in the country.

text: “Naniniwala ako,” siling naman ni Comelec chairman George Erwin Garcia, “that the votes of the youth matters talaga.
english: “I believe,” said Comelec chairman George Erwin Garcia, “that the votes of the youth really matter.

text:
Yung pagdagsa nilang sobrang dami… Yung boses nila, gusto talaga nilang iparinig.”

(I truly believe that the votes of the youth really matter.
english:
Their crowds are so big... Their voices, they really want to be heard.”

(I truly believe that the votes of the youth really matter.

text:
Their overwhelming turnout… Their voices, they genuinely wanted to be heard).”

Sunu sa data sang Comelec, sobra sa 6 sa 10 registered voters ang na-belong sa Millennial kag Gen Z generations sa sinang 2025 nga eleksyon.
english:
Their overwhelming turnout… Their voices, they genuinely wanted to be heard).”

According to Comelec data, more than 6 out of 10 registered voters belong to the Millennial and Gen Z generations in the 2025 elections.

text: Base sa ini nga Comelec data, ang mga Millennial kag Gen Z voters make up sang 60.5 percent, ukon 41,412,361 sang kabilogan nga 68,431,965 sang registered voters para sa 2025 midterm polls.
english: Based on this Comelec data, Millennial and Gen Z voters make up 60.5 percent, or 41,412,361 of the total 68,431,965 of registered voters for the 2025 midterm polls.

text: Tungod sini, galaum kita nga ining pagbaskug sang pagsikway sang mga kabataan sang mga kandidato halin sa political dynasties kag celebrities, makapabag-o man sang mga istratehiya, sugod subong, sa pag-serbisyo sang aton mga opisyales sa gobyerno padulong sa mas mabungahon nga mga kasuguan kag inisyatibo sa panghimanwa./PN
english: Therefore, we hope that this strengthening of the rejection of the children of candidates from political dynasties and celebrities, will also change the strategies, from now on, in the service of our government officials towards more fruitful laws and citizenship initiatives./PN

text: Nagdesisyon ang pila ka mga transport cooperative sa syudad sang Iloilo nga indi anay magbiyahe buwas nga adlaw sang Byernes Santo tubtob sa Sabado bangod sa padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong.
english: Some transport cooperatives in Iloilo City have decided not to operate tomorrow Good Friday until Saturday due to the continuous rise in fuel prices.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo Parcon, Chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sa mga drivers ang nabudlayan bangud nga ila man gina-ekspektar nga mangin magamay lamang ang pasahero.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said many of the drivers are having difficulty because they expect the number of passengers to be small.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagahulat sang subsidiya halin sa gobyerno ang ila nga mga myembro apang sang gin-check na nila ang ila bank account wala sa gihapon nag-abot ang ginalauman nila halin sa gobyerno nga assistance.
english: He also said that their members are waiting for subsidies from the government but when they checked their bank accounts, they still did not receive the assistance they expected from the government.

text: Bangud sini, nagnubo man ang numero sang mga nagabiyahe nga salakyan bangud nga indi man sa gihapon makabalik ang ila gasto bangud sa kamahal sang gatong.
english: As a result, the number of vehicles traveling has also decreased because they are still unable to recover their expenses due to the high price of fuel.

text: Dugang pa sini nga naglab-ot na lamang sa 30% ang operational nga units nga nagabyahe sa ila kooperatiba, samtang ang iban nga driver ang nagdesisyon nga indi anay magbiyahe bangud sa mabudlay nga sitwasyon.
english: He added that only 30% of the operational units are traveling in their cooperative, while other drivers have decided not to travel due to the difficult situation.

text: Magabalik naman ang ila nga operasyon sa Domingo Abril 5 bangud ila ginalauman nga madamo sa sang mga pasahero nga magabalik sa ila tagsa ka mga trabaho
english: They will resume operations on Sunday, April 5 as they expect many of the passengers to return to their respective jobs

text: Dako ang pagpasalamat nga nabatyagan sang aktor nga si Tom Rodriguez matapos ini magdaog bilang Best Supporting Actor sa 2025 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF).
english: Actor Tom Rodriguez is very grateful after he won Best Supporting Actor at the 2025 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF).

text: Sa iya Instagram, gin-share sini ang pila ka mga litrato niya halin sa awarding ceremony nga ginhiwat sang Sabado.
english: Taking to her Instagram, she shared some photos of herself from the awarding ceremony held on Saturday.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Tom ang iya pagpasalamat sa iya team nga nangin iya ‘safety net’ sa sulod sang madugay nga panahon.
english: Tom also expressed his gratitude to his team for being his ‘safety net’ for so long.

text: Nadag-an ni Tom ang Best Supporting Actor tungod sa iya papel sa pelikula nga Unmarry, nga ginbidahan nanday Angelica Panganiban kag Zanjoe Marudo.
english: Tom won Best Supporting Actor for his role in the film Unmarry, starring Angelica Panganiban and Zanjoe Marudo.

text: Ginhalad ni Tom ang iya award sa iya asawa nga si Cecilia kag anak nga si Korben.
english: Tom dedicated his award to his wife Cecilia and son Korben.

text: SA ATON karon pagbalik sa sining kolum halin sa pagpahuway sa tion sang 2025 midterm elections, luyag ta anay tamyawon ang pila ka kasimanwa naton nga mga Ilonggo nga nagapuyo karon sa Kingdom of Norway.
english: As we return to this column from a break during the 2025 midterm elections, we would like to greet some of our fellow Ilonggos who are now living in the Kingdom of Norway.

text: Mga katapo ini sila sang Hiligaynon Assn.
english: They are members of the Hiligaynon Assn.

text: Norway nga magaselebrar sang ila 15th Anniversary sa palaabuton nga Mayo 24, 2025 via Mrs. Luz Therese Gaje-Bergersen, nga upod naton sa alumni sang (National) YMCA Rizal  Youth Leadership Training Institute.
english: Norway will celebrate their 15th Anniversary on May 24, 2025 via Mrs. Luz Therese Gaje-Bergersen, who is with us alumni of the (National) YMCA Rizal Youth Leadership Training Institute.

text: Associate editor ini si Luz sang Roots & Wings Magazine nga ginabalhag monthly sa Europe, kon diin naga-contribute man ako sa pagsulat sadto sa una nga mga tinuig sang pag-retire ko sa pagka-editor sang isa ka local daily diri sa Siyudad sang  Iloilo.
english: Luz is the associate editor of Roots & Wings Magazine which is published monthly in Europe, where I also contributed to writing in the early years of my retirement as editor of a local daily here in Iloilo City.

text: Ang editor-in-chief sining magasin amo si Rachel Gaje-Hansen nga utod man ni Luz.
english: The editor-in-chief of this magazine is Rachel Gaje-Hansen who is also Luz’s sister.

text: Mabuhay kamo dira tanan!
english: Long live you all!

text:
***

Notwithstanding sang aton concern sa family planning angot sa overpopulation kag sang mga dala pa sini nga mga problema sa malinong kag masulhay nga pagpangabuhi naton, indi man matulon sang aton konsyensya nga pabay-an naton ang problema sang pagbun-ag sang aton mga kababayehan.
english:
***

Notwithstanding our concern about family planning regarding overpopulation and the problems it brings to our peaceful and comfortable life, our conscience cannot swallow that we should neglect the problem of giving birth to our women.

text: Labi pa gid kay mga Kristohanon kita nga gahatag sing  lubos nga pagpalangga sa mga kabataan.
english: Especially since we are Christians who give full love to children.

text:
Siling  gani ni Kristo (Matthew 19:14): ”Indi ninyo pagpunggi nga makapalapit ang mga kabataan sa akon kay ang Kaharian sang Langit para sa kasubong nila (nga mga inosente).”

Sa karon, daku nga concern naton ang Climate Change nga nagadala sang sige paglala sang panahon (extreme weather) tungod sa kakulang nga pagpanikasog (indi bala?) sang aton mga lideres nga mapahagan-hagan ini.
english:
Christ said (Matthew 19:14): "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these (who are innocent)."

Today, we are very concerned about Climate Change which is bringing extreme weather due to the lack of efforts (right?) of our leaders to mitigate it.

text: Ining extreme weather gadala sang mas malala nga mga bagyo, pagbinaha, mamatay nga mga balatian katulad sang Dengue nga nagaigu sang aton  mga kabataan, panghalit sa aton produksyon sang pagkaon sa kaumhan, kag sang makatalagam na nga Global Warming.
english: This extreme weather brings more severe typhoons, flooding, deadly diseases such as Dengue that affect our children, damage to our food production in the countryside, and the already dangerous Global Warming.

text: Sunu sa weather authorities ang 2024 pakadto sa 2025 ang may pinakainit nga panahon halin sadtong Industrial Revolution.
english: According to weather authorities, 2024 to 2025 will be the hottest period since the Industrial Revolution.

text: Nagalab-ut ini kag galampas pa sa dangerous level nga heat index nga 42 degrees Celsius diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: It is reaching and exceeding the dangerous level of heat index of 42 degrees Celsius here in Iloilo City.

text:
Ang Dumangas gani gin-report nga nakabatyag sang init lab-ut sa heat index nga 46%C.

Naalarma na gani ang mga health authorities: “The danger and risk  against extreme heat is widespread,” sunu sa ila.
english:
Dumangas was reported to experience heat up to a heat index of 46%C.

Health authorities are already alarmed: “The danger and risk against extreme heat is widespread,” they said.

text: Luwas pa, of course, sa risgo sa mga nagabusong nga ginadala sang extreme weather, sa kabug-usan.
english: Besides, of course, the risk to pregnant women posed by extreme weather, in general.

text: Gin-link nila ini  sa “higher risks of complications, maternal hospitalizations, and severe maternal morbidity.
english: They linked it to “higher risks of complications, maternal hospitalizations, and severe maternal morbidity.

text:
It’s also associated with an increased risk of adverse outcomes such as stillbirth and preterm birth, which can have lasting health effects on the baby.“

Ang miscarriage sang ginabusong globally kag sa Filipinas man, sunu sa AI research, nagakatabo sa 10-20% sang pregnant women.
english:
It’s also associated with an increased risk of adverse outcomes such as stillbirth and preterm birth, which can have lasting health effects on the baby.“

Ang miscarriage sang ginabusong globally kag sa Filipinas man, sunu sa AI research, nagakatabo sa 10-20% sang pregnant women.

text: Nagakatabo ini sa sulod sang una nga 12 ka semana (first trimester) sang pregnancy.
english: It occurs during the first 12 weeks (first trimester) of pregnancy.

text: Tungod sini, for the love of our children, mas kinahanglan pa naton ang malapad nga access sa prenatal care kag better healthcare services, nga tani matagaan sing prioridad sang bag-o naton nga mga opisyales sa gobyerno./PN
english: Therefore, for the love of our children, we need more access to prenatal care and better healthcare services, which should be given priority by our new government officials./PN

text: Ginpaidalom na sa state of calamity ang banwa sang New Lucena, Iloilo bangud sa nagalala nga epekto sang krisis sa gatong.
english: The town of New Lucena, Iloilo has been placed under a state of calamity due to the worsening impact of the fuel crisis.

text: Base sa deklarasyon, nagbilin sang dako nga problema ang padayon nga pagtaas sang presyo sa gatong sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: According to the declaration, the continuous increase in fuel prices in the said town has left a big problem.

text: Apektado ang mga drivers kag mga pasahero bangud sa pagtaas sang pamasahe kag limitado man ang pagbyahe .
english: Drivers and passengers are affected by the increase in fares and limited travel.

text: Nagapangatubang man sa karon sa pagpanghangkat ang mga lokal nga negosyo bangud sa pagtaas sang operational costs.
english: Local businesses are also facing challenges due to rising operational costs.

text: Bunga sini nagtaas man ang presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: As a result, the price of goods also increased.

text: Base sa rekomendasyon sang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (MDRRMC), gin-aprubahan sang Sangguniang Bayan ang deklarasyon agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga solusyon ang sitwasyon.
english: Based on the recommendation of the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (MDRRMC), the Sangguniang Bayan approved the declaration to provide an appropriate solution to the situation.

text: Sa idalom sang deklarasyon, mahimo magamit ang MDRRM Fund para mangin madali ang paghatag sang ayuda kag makapatigayon sang tikang ang LGU agud mapahagan-hagan ang epekto sang krisis sa mga apektado nga sektor.
english: Under the declaration, the MDRRM Fund can be used to facilitate the distribution of assistance and enable the LGU to take steps to mitigate the impact of the crisis on the affected sectors.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas sa New Lucena, una na nga ginpaidalom sa state of calamity ang banwa sang Ajuy.
english: Besides New Lucena, Ajuy town was also placed under a state of calamity.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Meanwhile, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: nga kon ipaidalom man sa state of calamity ang bug-os nga probinsya, may nakahanda na nga pondo nga nagalab-ot sa 82 million pesos para buligan ang mga apektado nga sektor.
english: that if the entire province is placed under a state of calamity, there is already a fund of 82 million pesos to help the affected sectors.

text: Nagsaka na sa walo ang kumpirmado nga napatay matapos nagtibusok sa Colombia ang military transport plane nga may sakay nga 125 ka mga tawo.
english: The confirmed death toll has risen to eight after a military transport plane carrying 125 people crashed in Colombia.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Colombian defense minister Pedro Anulfo Sanchez ang amo nga trahedya nga naga-involve sang Lockheed Martin Hercules-C-130 plane.
english: Colombian defense minister Pedro Anulfo Sanchez confirmed the tragedy involving a Lockheed Martin Hercules-C-130 plane.

text: Sa 125 nga sakay sang aircraft, masobra sa 80 ang na-rescue kag subong ginabulong sa ospital.
english: Of the 125 on board the aircraft, more than 80 were rescued and are now being treated in hospital.

text: Missing pa ang iban nga mga pasahero as of press time.
english: Other passengers are still missing as of press time.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa kabug-usan nga sakay, 114 ang mga pasahero, kag 11 ang crew.
english: Of the total number of passengers, 11 were crew members.

text: May nagagwa nga mga report nga mga soldado ang sakay sang amo nga eroplano sang natabo ang trahedya.
english: There are reports that soldiers were on board the plane when the tragedy occurred.

text:
“At this moment we do not know details of the crash,” suno kay Carlos Fernando Silva, ang commander sang Colombia air force, “except that the plane had a problem and went down about two kilometres from the airport.”

Sa post naman ni President Gustavo Petro sa X, nagpahayag ini nga “this horrendous accident … should not have happened”.
english:
“At this moment we do not know details of the crash,” said Carlos Fernando Silva, the commander of the Colombian air force, “except that the plane had a problem and went down about two kilometers from the airport.”

In a post on X, President Gustavo Petro said that “this horrendous accident ... should not have happened”.

text: Ginbasol man sini ang “bureaucratic problems” nga amo ang nagapugong sa modernisasyon sa equipment sang armed forces kag ila nga mga aircraft.
english: He also blamed “bureaucratic problems” that are preventing the modernization of the equipment of the armed forces and their aircraft.

text: “I will allow no further delays, the lives of our young people are at stake,” dugang sini sa iya nga post.
english: “I will allow no further delays, the lives of our young people are at stake,” he added in his post.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, matandaan nga may Bolivian Air Force C-130 Hercules man nga nagaunod sang banknotes ang nagtibusok sa west sang Colombia nga nagpatay sang 20 ka mga tawo.#
english: Last month, a Bolivian Air Force C-130 Hercules carrying banknotes crashed in western Colombia, killing 20 people.

text: Hugot nga nagapati ang isa ka human rights lawyer nga mismo ang mga opisyal sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas ang dapat magatindog agud pangapinan ang soberanya sang pungsod, ilabi na sa agawan sang teritoryo sa West Philippine Sea (WPS).
english: A human rights lawyer firmly believes that Philippine government officials themselves should stand up to defend the country's sovereignty, especially in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) territorial dispute.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jobert Pahilga, isa ka human rights lawyer, iya ginpahayag nga talawit kag daw pagsurrender ang ginabuhat sang pila ka senador sa pagpangapin sa China batok sa pag-claim sang Pilipinas sa WPS.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jobert Pahilga, a human rights lawyer, said the actions of some senators in defending China against the Philippines' claim to the WPS are shallow and surrender-like.

text: Ginpunto ni Pahilga ang mga kaangay pag-apin nga pahayag ni Senator Rodante Marcoleta batok sa Chinese embassy, nga nagpakamalaot sang pila ka lideres sang pungsod, lakip na si Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson Commodore Jay Tarriela.
english: Pahilga pointed to similar defensive statements by Senator Rodante Marcoleta against the Chinese embassy, ​​who criticized some of the country's leaders, including Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson Commodore Jay Tarriela.

text: Dugang pa sini, makaalarma ang pagbais ni Marcoleta sa iya kaupdanan sa Senado nahanungod sa agawan sang teritoryo sa WPS, nga kaangay nagapabor sa China, bisan pa nga siya mismo ang isa sa mga lideres sang pungsod nga dapat nagasuporta sa kinamatarong sang Pilipinas sa iya teritoryo.
