english: He added that Marcoleta's argument with his colleagues in the Senate about the territorial grab in the WPS, which seems to favor China, even though he himself is one of the country's leaders who should support the Philippines' right to its territory, is alarming.

text: Paathag ni Pahilga nga sala gid ang mga pahayag ni Marcoleta kag indi ini ang buluhaton sang isa ka matuod nga Pilipino.
english: Pahilga explained that Marcoleta's statements are wrong and not the work of a true Filipino.

text: Liwat nga nagpanugyan ang Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO) sa publiko nga likawan ang tuman nga exposure sa init.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO) once again advised the public to avoid excessive exposure to heat.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong nga nagalab-ot sa 42-degree Celsius ang init, dako ang risgo nga mag-angkon sang heat related illness.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, she said that with the current temperature reaching 42-degrees Celsius, there is a high risk of heat related illness.

text: Lakip na diri ang heat exhaustion kag heat stroke.
english: This includes heat exhaustion and heat stroke.

text: Suno kay Quiñon, mahimo maka-eksperyensya sang amo nga balatian bangod sa tuman ka paang nga tyempo, dehydration ukon kakulangan sang tubig, sobra-sobra nga exercise, kag madugay nga direct exposure sa adlaw.
english: According to Quiñon, the disease can be experienced due to extremely hot weather, dehydration or lack of water, excessive exercise, and prolonged direct exposure to the sun.

text: Mataas naman ang risgo sa mga infants ukon mga lapsag, mga nagatrabaho sa initan, may high blood, kag diabetes.
english: Infants, those who work in the heat, those with high blood pressure, and diabetes are at high risk.

text: Dugang sini nga mag-inom gid sang madamo nga tubig kag likawan ang pag-inom sang hot tea, kape, soft drinks, kag makahulubog nga ilimnon bangud ini ang nagadugang sang dehydration.
english: He added that drink plenty of water and avoid drinking hot tea, coffee, soft drinks, and alcoholic beverages as they increase dehydration.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga magsuksok sang mga light colors nga panapton agud nga indi madali nga mainitan ang kalawasan.
english: He also said to wear light colored clothes so that the body does not get hot easily.

text: Ginsentensyahan ang isa ka lalaki sa Shanghai, China sang kapin tatlo ka tuig nga pagkabilanggo matapos napamatud-an nga sulit-sulit niya nga ginbutangan sang ginatawag nga “truth serum” ang ilimnon sang iya kaupod sa opisina agud mahibaluan ang mga plano sini sa trabaho.
english: A man in Shanghai, China has been sentenced to more than three years in prison after he was found guilty of repeatedly putting a so-called “truth serum” in his office colleague’s drink to find out about her work plans.

text:
Ang akusado nga ginkilala sa apelyido nga Li napamatud-an nga may sala nga “inducing drug use through deception.”

Nabakal ni Li ang “truth serum” sa isa ka business trip kun sa diin ginsiling sang nagbaligya nga bisan pila lang ka patak sini, bastante na agud mapasugid ang isa ka tawo sang ila tinago ukon mga sikreto.
english:
The defendant identified by the surname Li was found guilty of “inducing drug use through deception.”

Li bought the “truth serum” on a business trip where the seller said that even a few drops of it are enough to tell someone their secrets.

text: Posible ayhan ina?
english: Is that possible?

text: Syempre, para mahibaluan, gin-try man ni Li!
english: Of course, to find out, Li tried it too!

text: Gingamit niya ini batok sa iya kaupod nga si Wang agud hibaluon ang mga plano sini sa trabaho.
english: He used it against his colleague Wang to find out about her work plans.

text: Una niya ini ginhimo sang Agosto 2022, samtang nagkadto sila sa dinner sang iya mga kaupdanan.
english: He first did so in August 2022, as they went to dinner with his colleagues.

text: Ginpatakan niya ang ilimnon ni Wang sang serum.
english: He spiked Wang’s drink with a serum.

text: Naka-eksperyensya si Wang sang pagkahilo kag kalain sang pamatyag, pero wala gihapon nakuha ni Li ang impormasyon nga ginapangita niya.
english: Wang experienced dizziness and nausea, but Li still couldn’t get the information he was looking for.

text: Ini ang rason nga ginhimo niya ini liwat sang Oktubre kag Nobyembre 2022 kag naglain liwat ang pamatyag ni Wang.
english: This caused him to do it again in October and November 2022 and Wang felt bad again.

text: Diri na nagsugod nga magduda si Wang, bangud iya nakit-an nga nga kada upod niya si Li magkaon sa gwa, dira lang siya nagamasakit.
english: This is where Wang began to get suspicious, because he noticed that every time he ate out with Li, he got sick.

text: Nagdesisyon siya nga magpa-check sang dugo kag ihi.
english: He decided to get a blood and urine test.

text: Base sa resulta sang laboratory test, nagpositibo siya sa clonazepam kag xylazine nga makit-an man sa pampakalma nga apektado ang central nervous system.
english: Based on the results of the laboratory test, he tested positive for clonazepam and xylazine, which are also found in sedatives that affect the central nervous system.

text: Gamit ang nasambit nga ebidensya, nagpasaka si Wang sang reklamo sa pulis.
english: Using the evidence, Wang filed a complaint with the police.

text: Ginsalakay sang mga otoridad ang balay ni Li kag nadakpan didto ang “truth serum” nga may sulod man sang amo nga mga droga.
english: The authorities raided Li's house and seized the “truth serum” that also contained the drugs.

text: Dira na kag nag-ako si Li sa iya nga sala.
english: That's when Li admitted his guilt.

text: Sang ulihi, ginsentensyahan sang Shanghai District People’s Court si Li sang tatlo ka tuig kag tatlo ka bulan nga pagkabilanggo kag multa nga 10,000 yuan.
english: Later, the Shanghai District People’s Court sentenced Li to three years and three months in prison and a fine of 10,000 yuan.

text: Bisan wala gindetalye kung ano ang eksakto nga work plan ni Wang, madamo ang nag-espekular online kon ano kadaku sang plano nga ini kag ano gid nga sikreto ang gusto sini mahibaluan kun ngaa nasarangan sini maghimo sang krimen.
english: Although Wang's exact work plan was not detailed, many speculated online about the size of the plan and what secret he wanted to know why he was able to commit the crime.

english: According to the authorities, the rape of the suspect took place from 2021 to 2024 in Marikina City.

english: Philadelphia 76ers Forward Paul George was given a 25-game suspension for violating the National Basketball Association's anti-drug program.

text: Base sa naggwa nga impormasyon, gin-ako sini nga may gin-gamit siya nga substance kag maathag nga paglapas ini sa NBA rules.
english: Based on the information that came out, he admitted that he used a substance and it was a clear violation of NBA rules.

english: According to George, he used the substance for his mental health condition.

text: Wala naman gintuad kun ano ang iya gin-gamit nga substance.
english: He did not confess what substance he used.

english: As a result, up to $11.7M or ₱688.7M will be deducted from his salary before he can return to the game on March 25.

text: Posible suno sa Department of Energy (DOE) nga magalab-ot sang masobra 80 pesos kada litro ang presyo sang diesel kun magapadayon ang gyera sa Middle East kag kun indi pahat-pahat ang pagpatuman sang price hikes.
english: According to the Department of Energy (DOE), it is possible that the price of diesel will reach more than 80 pesos per liter if the war in the Middle East continues and if the implementation of price hikes is not phased.

text: Ang nasambit nga posibilidad ginpresentar ni DOE Oil Management Bureau Director Rino Abad sa hearing kahapon nga adlaw sang Senate Committee on Foreign Relations.
english: The possibility was presented by DOE Oil Management Bureau Director Rino Abad during yesterday's hearing of the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations.

text: Dugang pa ni Abad nga mas malala ang natabo nga gyera sa tunga subong sang United States kag Iran kumpara sa natabo sang nagligad sa Russia kag Ukraine nga mas naka-apekto sa presyo sang krudo sa world market.
english: Abad added that the war between the United States and Iran is worse than the one in the past between Russia and Ukraine, which has affected the price of crude oil in the world market.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Abad nga kun magpadayon pa ini may posibildad nga magalab-ot sa 90 pesos ang presyo sang kada litro sang diesel kag gasolina ilabi na kun indi pag-amat-amaton sa pagdugang ang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: Abad also said that if this continues, there is a possibility that the price of diesel and gasoline will reach 90 pesos per liter especially if the price of petroleum products is not gradually increased.

text: Nasapwan nga patay ang duha ka ginapahayag nga mga miyembro sang LGBTQIA+ sa Quezon City.
english: Two alleged LGBTQIA+ members were found dead in Quezon City.

english: According to the witness, he saw the man again looking restless.

text: Sang ginpangita sang testigo ang mga biktima, didto na niya nakit-an ang mga duguon nga lawas sang mga ini.
english: When the witness searched for the victims, he found their bloody bodies.

english: The investigation and search for the suspect is ongoing.

text: Nangin maragtason ang ginhiwat nga 51st Metro Manila Film Festival kahapon sang gab-i, sa ginpatigayon nga Gabi ng Parangal sa Makati.
english: The 51st Metro Manila Film Festival held last night became historic, with the Gabi ng Parangal held in Makati.

text: Ini matapos nga nakuha sang pelikula nga “I’mPerfect” ang Best Picture award, samtang ginpasidunggan si Krystel Go bilang “Best Actress” sa iya papel sa pelikula nga nagasentro sa istorya sang mga young adults nga may Down syndrome.
english: This comes after the film “I’mPerfect” won the Best Picture award, while Krystel Go was honored as “Best Actress” for her role in the film that focuses on the story of young adults with Down syndrome.

text: Nakuha naman sang comedian nga si Vice Ganda ang iya labing-una nga pasidungog sa MMFF sang iya nakuha ang “Best Actor award” para sa “Call Me Mother” sini nga pelikula.
english: Comedian Vice Ganda won his first award at the MMFF when he won the “Best Actor award” for his film “Call Me Mother”.

text: Nangin madinalag-un naman nga ginpasidunggan si Tom Rodriguez bilang Best Supporting Actor para sa pelikula nga “Unmarry”, si Odette Khan bilang Best Supporting Actress para sa “Bar Boys: After School” nga pelikula, kag si Lucas Andalio bilang Best Child Performer para sa “Call Me Mother”.
english: Tom Rodriguez was awarded Best Supporting Actor for “Unmarry”, Odette Khan was awarded Best Supporting Actress for “Bar Boys: After School”, and Lucas Andalio was awarded Best Child Performer for “Call Me Mother”.

text: Gindala naman pauli nanday Jeffrey Jeturian ang Best Director para sa pelikula nga “Unmarry”, nga ginhingadlan man nga 2nd Best Picture, samtang ang Manila’s Finest kag Call Me Mother ang ginpasidunggan bilang 3rd Best Picture.
english: Jeffrey Jeturian took home Best Director for “Unmarry”, which was also named 2nd Best Picture, while Manila’s Finest and Call Me Mother were honored as 3rd Best Picture.

text: Nagtakop na ang kampanya sang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa singles sa Abu Dhabi Open.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala's singles campaign at the Abu Dhabi Open has come to an end.

text: Ginlutos siya sang world no.
english: He was defeated by world no.

text: 11 nga Russian player nga si Ekaterina Alexandrova, 6-3, 6-3, sa ila nga quarterfinal match.
english: 11 Russian player Ekaterina Alexandrova, 6-3, 6-3, in their quarterfinal match.

text: Antes sini, ginlutos anay sang 20-anyos nga Pinay sanday Zeynap Sönmez sang Turkey, 6-4, 6-3, kag Aliaksandra Sasnovich sang Belarus, 2-6, 6-4, 7-6(5) sa nauna nga duha ka mga round.
english: Earlier, the 20-year-old Filipina defeated Zeynap Sönmez of Turkey, 6-4, 6-3, and Aliaksandra Sasnovich of Belarus, 2-6, 6-4, 7-6(5) in the previous two rounds.

english: It was an impressive opening to the year for Eala who made it to the semis of the ASB Classic and the first round in the main draw of this year’s Australian Open.

text: KON wala nagsala ang aton pagpamati sa interbyu sa radyo kay Uswag Ilonggo Partylist Representative Jojo Ang, ini ang nakuha naton nga pahayag niya.
english: IF we misunderstood the radio interview with Uswag Ilonggo Partylist Representative Jojo Ang, this is what we got from him.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga ang ginaplano niya nga mga proyekto kag mga programa, kon magdaug naman ang iya partido sa 2025 election, amo ang paghatag gihapon sang iya bug-os nga ikasarang sa pagbulig pasanyog pa gid sang kauswagan … sa bug-os nga isla sang Panay!
english: He said that his planned projects and programs, if his party wins the 2025 election, is to give his full ability to help further promote development ... in the entire island of Panay!

text: Sang Panay lang?
english: Only in Panay?

text: Wala gani niya ma-mensyonar ang Guimaras, nga, sa karon, amo na gid lang, upod sa Panay provinces, ang sakop sang Western Visayas, tungod wala na ang Negros Occidental kay kabahin na ini sang Negros lsland Region.
english: He did not even mention Guimaras, which, at present, is the only one, along with the Panay provinces, that is part of Western Visayas, because Negros Occidental is no longer part of the Negros lsland Region.

text: Hulat anay, daw indi man amo na gid lang ini nga mga lugar ang dapat serbisyohan sang Uswag Ilonggo.
english: Wait, it seems that these are not the only areas that Uswag Ilonggo should serve.

text: Indi man Ilonggo gid lang ining mga pumuluyo tungod gapuyo sila sa magkaingud nga mga probinsya sang Iloilo, Antique, Aklan, Capiz, kag Guimaras.
english: These people are not just Ilonggos because they live in the neighboring provinces of Iloilo, Antique, Aklan, Capiz, and Guimaras.

text: Sa matuod, ang mga Ilonggo indi lang Ilonggo tungod nagapuyo sila diri sa Western Visayas kundi tungod sa ila gid ethnicity, ukon pagkapinasahe sa iban nga grupo sang katauhan sa ila ginamat-an nga mga bagay regadless kung diin man sila nagapuyo sa Filipinas ukon sa luwas man sang aton pungsod.
english: In fact, Ilonggos are not only Ilonggos because they live here in Western Visayas but because of their ethnicity, or being different from other groups of people in the things they learn regardless of where they live in the Philippines or abroad.

text: Ining ila shared attributes galakip sang ila pagpati/pagtuo (beliefs), gindak-an nga practices (tradisyon), kag pag-share sang lenggwahe nga mahangpan man sang tanan in common, bisan indi gid man lubos pareho gid ang paggamit nila tanan sang mga tinaga sa paghambal kag pagsulat.
english: These shared attributes include their beliefs, upbringing practices (traditions), and sharing a language that everyone can understand in common, even if they don't use the same words in speech and writing.

text: Diri ginahambal ang Hiligaynon, ang lenggwahe sang kadam-an, labi na gid sa Iloilo kag Negros Occidental, lakip na sa Capiz.
english: Hiligaynon, the language of the majority, is spoken here, especially in Iloilo and Negros Occidental, including Capiz.

text: Ang iban nga mga lenggwahe galakip sang Kinaray-a sa Antique kag pila ka banwa sa Iloilo katulad sang Guimbal kag Nueva Valencia sa Guimaras (kon diin natawo kag nagpuyo ang akon Lola Felen), kag ang Akeanon sa Aklan.
english: Other languages ​​include Kinaray-a in Antique and some towns in Iloilo such as Guimbal and Nueva Valencia in Guimaras (where my grandmother Felen was born and lived), and Akeanon in Aklan.

text: In fact, makit-an man ang mga Ilonggo nga nagadominar sa Cotabato, South Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, kag pila ka bahin sang Saranggani sa Mindanao.
english: In fact, Ilonggos are also found dominating Cotabato, South Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, and parts of Saranggani in Mindanao.

text:
***

Well, indi lang ini ang kapaslawan – ang makilala ang mga Ilonggo bilang sakop lang sang nagainingod nga mga probinsya sa Western Visayas.
english:
***

Well, this is not the only failure – to recognize the Ilonggos as only members of the neighboring provinces in Western Visayas.

text: Kag, tungod man sa sina nga pagpati, indi na matagaan sang bulig ang mga Ilonggo sa gwa sang Western Visayas.
english: And, because of that belief, Ilonggos outside Western Visayas will no longer be able to receive assistance.

text: Fortunately, sadtong pagduaw sang delegado sang Liga ng mga Barangay sa South Cotabato sadtong Pebrero 20, 2025 sa Iloilo, ginpat-ud gid ni Iloilo Gov.
english: Fortunately, during the visit of the delegate of the League of Barangays in South Cotabato on February 20, 2025 to Iloilo, Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: kay Rep.
english: to Rep.

text: Ang nga ini sila mga Ilonggo man.
english: They are also Ilonggos.

text: Kag ugaling nakamarasmas siya nga nagsiling nga “malapit sa iya tagipusuon” ang mga Ilonggo bisan dira pa sila nagapuyo sa South Cotabato.
english: And yet he was able to say that “close to his heart” are the Ilonggos even though they live in South Cotabato.

text: Nangako pa gani siya sa pagsuporta kag pagbulig sa ila.
english: He even promised to support and help them.

text: Indi man lang gani sa Rehiyon 6, kundi pati man sa Rehiyon 12, kag syempre pa sa iban pa nga mga Ilonggo sa iban nga lugar, labi na gid ang luyag mangayo gid sang bulig sang Uswag Ilonggo Partylist.
english: Not only in Region 6, but also in Region 12, and of course to other Ilonggos in other places, especially those who want to ask for the help of the Uswag Ilonggo Partylist.

text: Ang Region 12 gasakop sang Soccsksargen (South Cotabato, Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, Sarangani kag ang highly urbanized city nga General Santos).
english: Region 12 covers Soccsksargen (South Cotabato, Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, Sarangani and the highly urbanized city of General Santos).

text: Ang regional center sini amo ang Koronadal sa South Cotabato.
english: Its regional center is Koronadal in South Cotabato.

text:
***

Nonetheless, gapasalamat kita sa kay Rep.
english:
***

Nonetheless, we are grateful to Rep.

text: Ang, upod sa nabuligan na, sa nabulig sini nga mga proyekto kag programa sa ila.
english: The, along with the already helped, the helped these projects and programs to them.

text: Katulad sang pagpatigayon sang Uswag Ilonggo Partylist nga mahatagan sang sobra PhP30 ka Million nga financial assistance ang 13,500 ka residente sang Iloilo City kag 2nd District sang Iloilo Province sadtong Agosto 21-22, 2024 didto sa Iloilo Sports Complex, paagi sa Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa idalom sang Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) kag sang Ayuda para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP).
english: For example, the Uswag Ilonggo Partylist will provide more than PhP30 million in financial assistance to 13,500 residents of Iloilo City and 2nd District of Iloilo Province on August 21-22, 2024 at the Iloilo Sports Complex, through the Department of Social Development and Welfare (DSWD) under the Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) and the Assistance for the Poor Program (AKAP).

text: Subong man ang pagbulig sa sobra 1,000 ka libo nga market vendors sa siyudad sang Iloilo nga gintagaan sang PhP15,000 kada isa para sa ila sustainable livelihood sadtong Disyembre 5, 2024.
english: Also, the assistance to more than 1,000,000 market vendors in Iloilo City who were given PhP15,000 each for their sustainable livelihood on December 5, 2024.

text: Kag ang 7,000 ka mga estudyante sa Himamaylan, Negros Occidental, Binalbagan, kag Hinigaran nga nakabaton sa kay Rep.
english: And the 7,000 students in Himamaylan, Negros Occidental, Binalbagan, and Hinigaran who received Rep.

text: Ang sang educational financial assistance sadtong Setyembre 27, 2024.
english: The of educational financial assistance on September 27, 2024.

text: Ang 600 ka Uswag scholars sang Roxas City natagaan man sang PhP10,000 kada isa para sa ila edukasyon.
english: The 600 Uswag scholars of Roxas City were also given PhP10,000 each for their education.

text: Nagbaton man sang PhP10,000 kada isa ang 1,114 ka student beneficiaries sa idalom sang One-Barangay-One-Scholar Program sang Antique sadtong Agosto 2, 2024.
english: The 1,114 student beneficiaries under the One-Barangay-One-Scholar Program of Antique also received PhP10,000 each on August 2, 2024.

text: Nagpatigayon man ang Uswag Ilonggo sa pagtukod sang PhP400M Guimaras Arena and Convention Center kag sang lima (5) ka mga school building nga nagabalor sang PhP78.750 Million sa kada munisipyo sang Guimaras sadtong Agosto 30, 2024.
english: Uswag Ilonggo also facilitated the construction of the PhP400M Guimaras Arena and Convention Center and five (5) school buildings worth PhP78.750 Million in each municipality of Guimaras on August 30, 2024.

text: Nagtambong pa gani si Rep.Ang sa groundbreaking sang Convention Center.
english: Rep. Ang even attended the groundbreaking of the Convention Center.

text: Sa Aklan, ang Uswag Ilonggo naghatag man sang PhP10,000 sa na-enrol nga mga estudyante sa private kag public school.
english: In Aklan, Uswag Ilonggo also gave PhP10,000 to enrolled students in private and public schools.

text:
***

Ang Uswag Ilonggo five-point agenda amo ang masunod: “The well-being of every Ilonggo family comes first; proper healthcare for the poor; consistent programs on infrastructure and tourism; progress in agriculture and aquaculture (fishing); and uphold more scholarships for the youth.”/PN
english:

The Uswag Ilonggo five-point agenda is as follows: “The well-being of every Ilonggo family comes first; proper healthcare for the poor; consistent programs on infrastructure and tourism; progress in agriculture and aquaculture (fishing); and uphold more scholarships for the youth.”/PN

text: Wala ginpalampas ni Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano ang mga nagatawag sa ila nga pro-China ukon mga Tsinador.
english: Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano did not ignore those who call them pro-China or Chinese.

text: Partikular sini nga namunuhan ang pahayag sang political analyst kag anay Cabinet Secretary nga si Ronald Llamas batok sa mga ginapahayag “pro-China” nga senador nga wala nagpirma sa resolusyon sang Senado nga nagakundena sa mga pahayag sang Chinese Embassy.
english: He particularly led the statement of political analyst and former Cabinet Secretary Ronald Llamas against the alleged “pro-China” senators who did not sign the Senate resolution condemning the statements of the Chinese Embassy.

text: Sabat naman ni Cayetano, palareho lang nga nagapanindugan ang mga senador nga iya sang mga Pilipino ang West Philippine Sea, apang kun wala sila nagpirma, wala man ini nagakahulugan nga nagadampig na sila sa Beijing.
english: Cayetano said the senators are both insisting that the West Philippine Sea belongs to the Filipinos, but if they do not sign, it does not mean that they are on the side of Beijing.

text: “Pareho stand natin.
english: “We have the same stand.

text: Atin to, eh.
english: There's this, eh.

text: Yung approach natin ang iba… Pareho nating mahal ang Pilipinas,” suno kay Cayetano.
english: Our approach to others... We both love the Philippines,” Cayetano said.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa column ni Llamas, ginpahayag sini nga ginatawag sang mga Pilipino nga “Tsinador” ang siyam ka mga senador nga nagpamalibad sa pagpirma sa resolusyon nga ginpirmahan sang 15 sa ila kaupdanan.
english: In his column, Llamas said that Filipinos call the nine senators who refused to sign the resolution signed by 15 of their colleagues “Tsinador”.

text: Ini nga resolusyon nagapanawagan sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga maghimo sang mabakod nga diplomatic action batok sa Chinese embassy sa Manila.
english: This resolution calls on the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to take strong diplomatic action against the Chinese embassy in Manila.

text: Nagakondena man ini nga resolution sa mga pagpang-atake sang embahada sa government officials lakip na sa mga senador kag kongresista nga nagadepensa lamang sa posisyon sang Pilipinas sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The resolution also condemns the embassy's attacks on government officials including senators and congressmen who are only defending the Philippines' position in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Kahapon, Pebrero 9, dalayon nga napasar sa upper chamber ang amo nga resolusyon.#
english: Yesterday, February 9, the resolution was immediately passed in the upper chamber.

text: Nagasumpakilay ang pahayag sang Iran kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika kun may yara na gid man sang negosasyon nga untatan na ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: Iran and the United States have conflicting statements about whether there will be negotiations to end the war in the Middle East.

text: Kun si United States President Donald Trump ang pahambalon, may maayo na sila nga istoryahanay.
english: If you ask US President Donald Trump, they have a good conversation.

text: Bangud sang amo nga negosasyon suno kay Trump, ginpakamaayo sini nga ipaiway na ang iya ginhatag nga 48-oras nga ultimatum sa Iran kag indi sini pagdayunon ang pagbomba sa mga power plants sang amo nga pungsod.
english: Because of the negotiations, Trump said he agreed to suspend his 48-hour ultimatum to Iran and not to continue bombing that country's power plants.

text: Suno pa kay Trump, gin-postpone man sini ang iya plano nga atakehon ang energy grid sang Iran sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw.
english: Trump said he also postponed his plan to attack Iran's energy grid for five days.

text: Ginpahayag man sini sa atubang sang media nga ang iya special envoy nga si Steve Witkoff ang naka-istorya na sa mataas nga Iranian official sang Domingo sang gab-i kag magapadayon ini tubtub sa Lunes.
english: He also said before the media that his special envoy, Steve Witkoff, had spoken with the senior Iranian official on Sunday night and would continue until Monday.

text: “We have had very, very strong talks.
english: “We have had very, very strong talks.

text: We’ll see where they lead.
english: We’ll see where they lead.

text: We have major points of agreement, I would say, almost all points of agreement,” pahayag sini samtang yara pa sa Florida.
english: We have major points of agreement, I would say, almost all points of agreement,” he said while still in Florida.

text: Sa Memphis, Tennessee, nagpahayag man ini nga madugay na naga-negosyar ang US sa Iran.
english: In Memphis, Tennessee, he also said the US has been negotiating with Iran for a long time.

text: Wala sini ginpangalanan kun sin-o nga Iranian official ang gin-istorya sang US, apang suno sa iya, respetado ini nga tawo kag isa ka lider.
english: He did not name which Iranian official the US spoke to, but said he was a respected man and a leader.

text: “We’re dealing with some people that I find to be very reasonable, very solid.
english: “We’re dealing with some people that I find to be very reasonable, very solid.

text: The people within know who they are.
english: The people within know who they are.

text: They’re very respected, and maybe one of them will be exactly what we’re looking for,” suno kay Trump.
english: They’re very respected, and maybe one of them will be exactly what we’re looking for,” according to Trump.

text: FAKE NEWS?
english: FAKE NEWS?

text: Gintawag naman sang Iran nga “fake news” ang ginapanghambal ni Trump.
english: Iran called Trump's claims "fake news".

text: Suno kay Iran parliament speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, wala sang anuman nga negosasyon nga natabo.
english: According to Iran parliament speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, no negotiations took place.

text: Ginahimo lang ang fake news suno sa iya agud nga ma-manipula ang financial kag oil markets.
english: He said fake news is being created to manipulate the financial and oil markets.

text:
“No negotiations have been held with the US, and fake news is used to manipulate the financial and oil markets and escape the quagmire in which the US and Israel are trapped,” post sini sa X.

Ginpanindugan sini nga nga magatimalos ang Tehran sa mga nag-atake sa ila.
english:
“No negotiations have been held with the US, and fake news is used to manipulate the financial and oil markets and escape the quagmire in which the US and Israel are trapped,” it posted on X.

He insisted that that Tehran would take revenge on those who attacked them.

text: Pahayag pa sini, nagatindog sila sang malig-on bilang suporta sa ila nga Supreme Leader kag sa mga pumuluyo sang ila nasyon tubtub nga malab-ot nila ang ila nga tinutuyo.
english: He said they stand firm in support of their Supreme Leader and the people of their country until they achieve their goal.

text: “Iranian people demand complete and remorseful punishment of the aggressors.
english: “Iranian people demand complete and remorseful punishment of the aggressors.

text: All Iranian officials stand firmly behind their supreme leader and people until this goal is achieved,” dugang sang opisyal.
english: All Iranian officials stand firmly behind their supreme leader and people until this goal is achieved,” the official added.

text: Nagpaandam man ang elite Revolutionary Guards sang Iran nga magapadayon sila sa pagbomba sa US targets.
english: Iran's elite Revolutionary Guards have also warned that they will continue bombing US targets.

text: Gintawag nila ang mga tinaga ni Trump nga “psychological operations”.
english: They called Trump’s words “psychological operations”.

text: Domingo sang aga oras diri sa Pilipinas sang nagpaandam si Trump nga may 48 ka oras lamang ang Iran agud nga buksan ang Strait of Hormuz, bangud kun indi, bombahan nila ang mga power plant sang amo nga pungsod.
english: On Sunday morning, Trump warned that Iran has only 48 hours to open the Strait of Hormuz, otherwise they will bomb the country's power plants.

text: Wala nagpalingkang ang Iran kag nagbalos man sa paandam nga dalayon nila nga siraduhan ang Strait of Hormuz kun tandugon ang ila nga power plants.
english: Iran did not hesitate and responded with a warning that it would immediately close the Strait of Hormuz if its power plants were touched.

text: Nagpaandam man ang Tehran nga iguon nila ang mga imprastraktura sang mga kaalyado sang US sa Middle East pananglitan dayunon ni Trump ang iya paandam.
english: Tehran has also warned that it will strike the infrastructure of US allies in the Middle East if Trump follows through on his warning.

english: Wala napunggan sang baha ang kasal sang magkahagugma nga sanday Jade Rick Verdillo kag Jamaica Aguilar sa Barasoain Church sa Bulacan subong nga adlaw.

text: Congratulations!
english: Congratulations!
