text: Nagapabilin nga wala pa nakapasa sang accomplishment report sa Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office ang pila ka mga banwa sa Iloilo may kaangtanan sa pagpangbakuna sa mga ido.
english: Some towns in Iloilo have not yet submitted their accomplishment reports to the Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office regarding the vaccination of dogs.

text: Ini amo ang banwa sang Igbaras, Leganes, Miag-ao, San Enrique, kag San Dionisio.
english: These are the towns of Igbaras, Leganes, Miag-ao, San Enrique, and San Dionisio.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Darel Tabuada, Veterinarian sa Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office, iya ginpahayag nga yara na 29.71% sang mga ido sa probinsya ang nabakunahan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Darel Tabuada, Veterinarian at the Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office, said that 29.71% of the dogs in the province have been vaccinated.

text: Sa nasambit nga porsyento, nakasaad diri nga sa kabug-usan nga 367,907 ka mga ido, yara sa 109,310 ang nabakunahan na.
english: Sa nasambit nga porsyento, nakasaad diri nga sa kabug-usan nga 367,907 ka mga ido, yara sa 109,310 ang nabakunahan na.

text: Suno kay Tabuada, tubtob sa Abril 30, 2025 na lang ang mass dog vaccination sang Provincial Government.
english: According to Tabuada, the mass dog vaccination of the Provincial Government is until April 30, 2025.

text: Target man sang lokal nga panguluhan nga malab-ot ang 70% sang dog population sa probinsya ang mabakunahan.
english: The local government also targets to vaccinate 70% of the dog population in the province.

text: Sa subong, ang mga banwa sang Banate, New Lucena, Cabatuan, Concepcion, kag Tubungan pa lang ang nakalab-ot sang 70-porsyento nga nabakunahan nga mga ido.
english: So far, only the towns of Banate, New Lucena, Cabatuan, Concepcion, and Tubungan have reached 70-percent vaccinated dogs.

text: Duha ka tawo ang patay matapos nagbunggo ang naghugpa nga eroplano sa isa ka fire truck sa LaGuardia airport sa New York.
english: Two people were killed after a landing plane crashed into a fire truck at LaGuardia airport in New York.

text: Ang involved ng eroplano amo ang Air Canada Express Flight 8646 nga gina-operate sang Jazz Aviation.
english: The involved plane is Air Canada Express Flight 8646 operated by Jazz Aviation.

text: Halin sa Montreal, Canada ang eroplano.
english: The flight was from Montreal, Canada.

text: Ang eroplano ginapatihan nga nagadalagan sa kadasigon nga 24 tubtob 30 mph sang nagbunggo ini sa fire truck.
english: The plane is believed to have been traveling between 24 and 30 mph when it struck the fire truck.

text: Ang mga napatay amo ang pilot kag co-pilot sang aircraft.
english: The deceased were the pilot and co-pilot of the aircraft.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad sa amo nga insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Nahibaluan nga may sakay ang amo nga eroplano nga 72 ka mga pasahero kun sa diin may iban sa ila ang nag-angkon sang injuries.
english: The plane was carrying 72 passengers, some of whom sustained injuries.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. announced

text: ang pagpatuman sang four-day work week sa pila ka mga opisina sang executive department umpisa sa Lunes, Marso 9.
english: the implementation of a four-day work week in some executive department offices starting Monday, March 9.

text:
”Para naman sa bahagi ng pamahalaan: Simula sa Lunes, ika-9 ng Marso, pansamantala nating ipapatupad ang four-day work week sa ilang tanggapan ng ehekutibo,” kabahin sang video message sang presidente nga gin-release subong nga gab-i.

Ini nga tikang ang kasunod sang iya panawagan nga magkinot sa energy resources bangud sa gyera sa Middle East nga nag-apekto sa Pilipinas ilabi na sa presyo sang fuel products.
english:
"As for the government: Starting Monday, March 9, we will temporarily implement the four-day work week in their executive offices," part of the president's video message released tonight.

The move follows his call to save energy resources due to the war in the Middle East that has affected the Philippines especially the price of fuel products.

text: Suno sa presidente, wala nalakip sa four-day work week arrangement ang mga ahensya nga involved sa nagapanguna ukon emergency services.
english: According to the president, the four-day work week arrangement does not include agencies involved in frontline or emergency services.

text: Ginmanduan man ang mga ahensya nga magtipid kag magbuhin sang tubtob 20% sa konsumo sang kuryente kag petrolyo.
english: Agencies have also been directed to save and reduce up to 20% in electricity and petroleum consumption.

text: Temporaryo man nga ginadumilian ang mga biyahe kag mga aktibidad sang gobyerno nga indi kinahanglanon pareho sang study tour, team-building activities, kag mga meeting nga mahimo man himuon online.
english: Non-essential government travel and activities such as study tours, team-building activities, and meetings that can also be conducted online are also temporarily prohibited.

text:
SWELDUHANAY SA IDALOM SANG 4-DAY WORKWEEK ARRANGEMENT

Ginpaathag sang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) nga mangin intact sa gihapon ang sweldo kag benepisyo para sa mga trabahador pananglitan nga sundon sang kumpaniya ang proposed four-day workweek.
english:
SALARY UNDER 4-DAY WORKWEEK ARRANGEMENT

The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) explained that salaries and benefits for workers will remain intact if the company follows the proposed four-day workweek.

text: Isa ini ka flexible arrangement nga amo ang ginalantaw nga makabulig sa employees kag mga negosyo sa tunga sang pagtimbuok sang energy costs.
english: This is a flexible arrangement that is expected to help employees and businesses amid rising energy costs.

text: Suno kay DOLE Bureau of Working Conditions Director Alvin B. Curada, sa idalom sini nga arrangement, makumpleto sang employees ang standard 40-hour workweek sa apat ka adlaw sa baylo nga lima ka adlaw.
english: According to DOLE Bureau of Working Conditions Director Alvin B. Curada, under this arrangement, employees will be able to complete the standard 40-hour workweek in four days instead of five.

text: Sa pihak sini, wala sang ibuhin sa daily pay.
english: However, there is no deduction from the daily pay.

text: Sa sini nga compressed workweek setup, mas malawig nga oras ang trabaho sang empleyado kada adlaw agud nga malab-ot ang gina-require nga weekly hours.
english: In this compressed workweek setup, the employee works longer hours each day in order to meet the required weekly hours.

text: Ang dugang nga oras sa sini nga schedule ang indi man makonsiderar nga overtime basta nga nakasulod ini sa nakasugtan nga 40-hour workweek.
english: Additional hours in this schedule will not be considered overtime as long as they are included in the agreed 40-hour workweek.

text: Isa ka babaye sa China ang nakaluwas matapos ginbuno sang 22 beses sa dughan sa bulig sang iya silicone breast implants!
english: A woman in China survived after being stabbed 22 times in the chest with the help of her silicone breast implants!

text: Ang insidente natabo sa isa ka shopping mall sa South Eastern China.
english: The incident happened in a shopping mall in South Eastern China.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, ginpilit sang suspek ang 30-anyos nga biktima nga magsulod sa iya salakyan sa parking area kag gintayaan niya ini sang kutsilyo kag ginpilit nga magmaneho pakadto sa isa ka lugar.
english: According to the investigation, the suspect forced the 30-year-old victim into his car in the parking area and he threatened her with a knife and forced her to drive to a certain location.

text: Samtang yara sa biyahe, ginpilit siya sang suspek nga mangita sang kwarta agud ipadala sa iya kag ihatag sa suspek.
english: While on the trip, the suspect forced her to find money to send to him and give it to the suspect.

text: Ini man ang nangin kahigayunan para sa babaye nga makapangayo sang bulig.
english: This was also an opportunity for the woman to ask for help.

text: Sa bulig sang boyfriend, ginpa-trace sini ang GPS location sang biktima sa bulig sang mga pulis.
english: With the help of her boyfriend, she traced the victim's GPS location with the help of the police.

text: Apang pag-abot sang mga pulis, hinali lang ginbuno sang suspek sa dughan ang biktima bag-o sini ginbuno man ang kaugalingon nga kabangdanan sang kamatayon sang suspek.
english: However, when the police arrived, the suspect suddenly stabbed the victim in the chest before stabbing himself causing the suspect's death.

text: Sa maayo nga palad, nakaluwas ang biktima kag suno sa mga doktor, isa ka igo sang buno lang ang naangkon niya sa iya nga baga.
english: Fortunately, the victim survived and according to doctors, he sustained only one gunshot wound to his lung.

text: Suno sang biktima, sang amo nga tion, nagapaidalom siya sa breast augmentation surgery kag ginsagang sang silicone implant ang buno nga nakapatay kuntani sa iya.
english: According to the victim, at the time, she was undergoing breast augmentation surgery and the silicone implant blocked the stab that would have killed her.

text: ISA SA mga bumalasa naton, nga Ilonggo man gani, ang luyag gid mahibal-an kag maathagan ang pila ka bagay sa aton pagsulat sa Hiligaynon diri sa aton kolum.
english: ONE of our readers, who is also an Ilonggo, wants to know and clarify some things in our writing in Hiligaynon here in our column.

text: Siling ko ugaling nga basi indi ako ang dapat niya tun-an sang pagsulat sa Hiligaynon – ang standard, ukon “King’s language”, sang mga Ilonggo, sa kabug-usan kung diin man sila karon nagapuyo sa pungsod kag sa diin pa nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: I said, however, that perhaps I should not learn to write in Hiligaynon – the standard, or “King’s language”, of Ilonggos, in general wherever they now live in the country and elsewhere in the world.

text: Pero okey lang kuno sa iya, kay kon ginasaligan kuno ako sang akon publisher sa pagsulat sa Hiligaynon, wala kuno siya sang rason agud indi man niya ako masaligan sa iya ginapangabay sa akon.
english: But he said it was okay, because if my publisher trusted me to write in Hiligaynon, he had no reason not to trust me with what he asked me to do.

text: Well, kon amo ina, mabuligan ko siya sa iya ginapangabay paagi man sa sining kolum.
english: Well, if that's the case, I can help him with his request through this column.

text:
***

Ginsaligan ako sang naulihi ko nga publisher agud magsulat kag mag-editor na gani sa tri-weekly niya nga pamantalaan nga ginabalhag sa Hiligaynon.
english:
***

My last publisher entrusted me to write and even edit his tri-weekly newspaper published in Hiligaynon.

text: Tungod ina seguro sa duha ka rason.
english: That's probably for two reasons.

text:
Tumandok ako sang Iloilo nga, upod sa Bacolod City kag Negros Occidental, diri namat-an ang Hiligaynon bilang standard na nga lenggwahe, para sa mga Ilonggo, sa kabug-usan, sa pagpasanyog man sini sang mga brilliant nga mga manunulat kag Hiligaynon scholars,

Isa pa ka rason amo nga editor man ako sa ina nga tion sang isa pa niya ka pamantalaan nga ginabalhag naman sa English.
english:
I am a native of Iloilo where, along with Bacolod City and Negros Occidental, Hiligaynon was learned as a standard language, for Ilonggos, in general, to promote it by brilliant writers and Hiligaynon scholars,

Another reason was that I was also the editor at the time of another of his newspapers, which was also published in English.

text:
***

Luyag sang gapangabay sing bulig sa aton nga paathagan ko siya sa kung ano ang pagsulat sa pila ka tinaga sa standard Hiligaynon gamit ang mga Filipino alphabet nga “o” kag “u”, ang “i” kag “e”, kag ang kahulugan sang “kon” kag “kung” (ukon “kun”), kag pila pa ka bagay nga “confusing” para sa iya.
english:
***

The person asking for our help wants me to explain to him what it means to write some words in standard Hiligaynon using the Filipino alphabets “o” and “u”, the “i” and “e”, and the meaning of “kon” and “kung” (or “kun”), and some other things that are “confusing” for him.

text: Ang ining mga alpabeto sa Filipino Alphabet, nga gamit man sa Hiligaynon, masulat ini sunu sa match-up sang tonog (sound) sa naandan naton nga paghambal (spoken usage) kag sang pagsulat sa standard Hiligaynon.
english: These alphabets in the Filipino Alphabet, which is also used in Hiligaynon, are written according to the match-up of the sound in our spoken usage and the writing in standard Hiligaynon.

text: In other words, sunod in sa pagsulundan, kung sa Filipino pa: “Kung ano’ng bigkas siyang baybay.” (Spell as pronounced).
english: In other words, it follows the rule, if in Filipino: “Whatever the pronunciation of the baybay.” (Spell as pronounced).

text: Mahumok naton nga ginamitlang diri ang “o” kasubong sa Spanish kag English alphabet nga nadak-an man naton bilang kolonya sang Espanya kag Estados Unidos sa madugay nga panahon.
english: We pronounce the “o” softly here as in the Spanish and English alphabets that we also grew up as colonies of Spain and the United States for a long time.

text: Ang pagmitlang (pronounce) sini halin sa daku nga pagbukas sang bibig nga ang dila nagapabilin sa normal nga position, katulad sang “bag-o” kag “bagyo”.
english: Its pronunciation is from a wide opening of the mouth with the tongue remaining in a normal position, such as “new” and “typhoon”.

text: Ang “u” naman, mamitlang naton katulad sa matig-a nga “o” sa English alphabet sa tinaga nga “go” ukon “booo!”, nga kasubong man sa pagmitlang, sa Hiligaynon.
english: The “u” is pronounced like the hard “o” in the English alphabet in the word “go” or “booo!”, which is similar in pronunciation, in Hiligaynon.

text: sang tinaga nga “daku” (big) kag “pitu” (seven), nga ang pagmitlang paagi sa pagtakop sang bibig nga ang dila ginatulak ukon ginapunggan pasulod.
english: of the words “big” and “seven” (seven), which are pronounced by closing the lips with the tongue pushed or held inward.

text: Ang pagsulat sa “i” naman halin sa pagmitlang sing matig-a nga English “e” sa “bee” sa pagbukas diutay sang bibig nga ang dila ginapunggan sa paggwa, kasubong sang “ihi” (urine) kag “pari” (priest).
english: The writing of “i” comes from pronouncing a hard English “e” in “bee” with a slight opening of the mouth with the tongue prevented from coming out, such as “urine” and “priest”.

text: Ang “e” naman makuha sa pagmitlang katulad sa English “be” nga mahimo sa pagbukas sing diutay sang bibig nga ang dila sa normal nga position, katulad sang “grabe” “serious” kag “yabe” (key).
english: The “e” is pronounced like the English “be” which can be done by opening the mouth slightly with the tongue in a normal position, like “grabe” “serious” and “key” (key).

text:
***

Ano naman ang kahulugan sang “kon” kag “kung” (gamit ang k kag dipthong “ung”) ukon “kun”?
english:
***

What about “if” and “if” (using k and the diphthong “ung”) or “if” mean?

text: Ang “kon” nagakahulugan sang “if” sa English gamit sa pagpahayag sang pangduha-duha ukon conditional nga sitwasyon.
english: “If” means “if” in English used to express a doubtful or conditional situation.

text: Ma-usar man ini sa opposite sini nga tinaga nga “when” sa pagpahayag sang kaseguruhan (certainty) nga ang hitabo matabo.
english: It can also be used in the opposite of the word “when” to express certainty that the event will occur.

text: Ang “kung” (ukon “kun”) nagakahulugan sang “where” (at what place or situation).
english: “if” (or “if”) means “where” (at what place or situation).

text: May kahulugan man ini nga “wherein” ukon “in which”, nga galakip sang isa ka bagay sa isa ka hitabo ukon sitwasyon, ukon paano natigayon ukon matigayon ang isa ka bagay (how), ukon ano ang natabo ukon matabo (what).
english: It also means “wherein” or “in which”, which includes something in an event or situation, or how something is achieved or will be achieved (how), or what happened or will happen (what).

text: Okey man ang paggamit sang mga contraction, katulad sang “syudad” nga mahapos mitlangon sa lugar sang “siyudad” kag bisan ang paggamit sang dipthong katulad sang Spanish “ie” sa “gobierno” sa lugar sang “gobyerno”.
english: It is also okay to use contractions, such as “city” which is easy to pronounce in place of “city” and even to use a diphthong such as the Spanish “ie” in “gobierno” instead of “gobier”.

text: Indi pa settled ang paggamit sang “sang” kag “sing”.
english: The use of “sang” and “sing” is not yet settled.

text: Personally, mas mahapos ko mitlangon kag isulat ang “sing” una sa isa ka adjective, katulad sang “sing hilway nga panugdaon” kag “kasubong sing katahum ni Inday”.
english: Personally, I find it easier to pronounce and write “sing” before an adjective, such as “of free suggestion” and “as beautiful as Inday”.

text: Ang “sang” ginagamit ko sing masami sa mga noun, katulad sang “sang mansanas” kag “sang tawo”.
english: I use “of” often with nouns, such as “of apple” and “of man”.

text:
***

Indi ta man dapat malipatan nga ang aton karon nga ginagamit nga Makabagong Alpabetong Pilipino (MAP)  may 28 na ka alpabeto, kung diin ang 20 ka alpabeto sang Abakada, nga lakip ang “ng”, nadugangan na sang 7 basic Latin alphabets nga c, f, j, q, v, x, z nga yara man sa English, kag sang “ñ” halin sa Spanish.
english:
***

We must not forget that our current Modern Philippine Alphabet (MAP) has 28 alphabets, where the 20 alphabets of the alphabet, including “ng”, have been supplemented by 7 basic Latin alphabets c, f, j, q, v, x, z which are also in English, and Spanish from “ñ”.

text: Obvously, ang 28 ka alpabeto sang MAP nagahatag ini sang mas hilway (flexibility) nga paggamit sang mga foreign words sa Filipino language, lakip sa mga lokal nga lenggwahe, katulad sang Hiligaynon.
english: Obvously, the 28 alphabets of MAP give more flexibility in the use of foreign words in the Filipino language, including local languages, such as Hiligaynon.

text: Wala man sing problema ang pagsulat gamit ang Chavacano nga pulong sang kadam-an sa Zamboanga, nga isa ka Spanish derived creole.
english: There is also no problem writing in the Chavacano language of the majority in Zamboanga, which is a Spanish derived creole.

text: Pwede na gani ang indi na paggamit sang na-“indigenized” nga mga equivalent sang English kag Spanish kag iban pa nga foreign words.
english: It is even possible to stop using the “indigenized” equivalents of English and Spanish and other foreign words.

text: Katulad sang Spanish “cocina” sa Filipino, ukon Hilgaynon, version nga “kusina” kag  “zapatos” sa “sapatos”.
english: Similar to the Spanish “cocina” in Filipino, or Hilgaynon, version “kusina” and “zapatos” in “shoes”.

text: Kag katulad man sang paggamit sang taglish nga “ma-late ako”./PN
english: And also the use of taglish “I'll be late”./PN

text: Liwat nga maga-updanay sanday Lebron James, Stephen Curry kag Kevin Durant bilang team sa isa ka intense line-up para sa NBA All-Star Game.
english: Lebron James, Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant will once again team up in an intense line-up for the NBA All-Star Game.

text: Ang bag-o nga estilo sang All-Star Game ang pagatungaon sa tatlo ka koponan, duwa sini ang ginalakipan sang mga player nga mga Amerikano kag ang isa naman ang ginalakipan sang mga international players.
english: The new-style All-Star Game will be divided into three teams, two of which will feature American players and the other will feature international players.

text: Maga-kontrahanay ang tatlo ka koponan sa isa ka round-robin nga min-tournament kag ang duwa nga nagapanguna nga koponan ang magaatubangay sa final game.
english: The three teams will face each other in a round-robin min-tournament and the top two teams will face each other in the final game.

text: Sanday James, Curry kag Durant nga tatlo ka haligi sang koponan sang USA nga nakakuha na sang gold medal sa 2024 Olympics sa Paris ang updan nanday Jaylen Brown sang Boston, Jalen Brunson sang New York Knicks, kag Kawhi Leonard sang Los Angeles Clippers.
english: James, Curry and Durant three pillars of the USA team that has already won a gold medal at the 2024 Olympics in Paris will be joined by Jaylen Brown of Boston, Jalen Brunson of the New York Knicks, and Kawhi Leonard of the Los Angeles Clippers.

text: Ang magakumpleto sang lineup nga ginatawag nga “USA Stripes” sanday Donovan Mitchell sang Cleveland kag Norman Powell sang Miami.
english: Completing the lineup dubbed “USA Stripes” will be Cleveland’s Donovan Mitchell and Miami’s Norman Powell.

text: Ang isa pa ka koponan sang USA Stars ang pagalakipan nanday Cade Cunningham sang Detroit, Anthony Edwards sang Minnesota, kag Chet Holmgren sang Oklahoma City.
english: Another USA Stars team will include Detroit’s Cade Cunningham, Minnesota’s Anthony Edwards, and Oklahoma City’s Chet Holmgren.

text: Upod man sa roster sanday Devin Booker sang Phoenix Suns, Tyrese Maxey sang Philadelphia, kag Jalen Duren sang Detroit.
english: Also on the roster are Devin Booker of the Phoenix Suns, Tyrese Maxey of Philadelphia, and Jalen Duren of Detroit.

text: Samtang pagapangunahan naman ang ”World” team ni Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sang Oklahoma City nga sa karon ang NBA Most Valuable player, upod man si Luka Dončić sang Los Angeles Lakers kag Victor Wembanyama sang San Antonio Spurs, pati man si Nikola Jokic sang Denver.
english: Meanwhile, the World team will be led by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander of Oklahoma City, who is currently the NBA Most Valuable Player, along with Luka Dončić of the Los Angeles Lakers and Victor Wembanyama of the San Antonio Spurs, as well as Nikola Jokic of Denver.

text: Pagahiwaton ang NBA All Star Game sa Los Angeles sa Pebrero 15.
english: The NBA All Star Game will be held in Los Angeles on February 15.

text: Ginpakakas na ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang mga “unnecessary graphics” kaangay sang “Uswag Ilonggo”, Rise Iloilo kag iban pa nga sticker sa mga service vehicle sang Iloilo City Government.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas has removed the “unnecessary graphics” such as “Uswag Ilonggo”, Rise Iloilo and other stickers on the service vehicles of the Iloilo City Government.

text: Ini ang kaangot sa Anti-Epal Drive ukon ang ginpagwa sang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Memorandum 2026-006 nga nagamandu sa tanan nga government offices nga sigurohon nga wala sang pangalan, litrato, logo, initials, color motif, slogan kag iban pa nga identifying symbol sang public official sa mga proyekto kag kagamitan nga ginpondohan sang gobyerno.
english: This is in connection with the Anti-Epal Drive or the issued by the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Memorandum 2026-006 which directs all government offices to ensure that there are no names, photos, logos, initials, color motifs, slogans and other identifying symbols of public officials used in government projects and equipment.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagpanaug sang Office Order ang City Administrator sang Pebrero 5 sa tanan nga offices nga ginhatagan sang service vehicle nga kakson na ang mga sticker kag slogan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said the City Administrator issued an Office Order on February 5 to all offices that were given service vehicles to remove the stickers and slogans.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, target nga maubos na ini ka pangkakas subong nga semana.
english: According to Fantilaga, it is targeted to be sold out this week.

text: Madumdoman nga una man nga ginpangkakas ang mga litrato kag slogan sang alkalde sa Atipan Center sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: It can be recalled that the mayor's photos and slogans were also removed from the Atipan Center of Iloilo City Hall.

text: Patay ang 32 ka tawo samtang 160 ang nasamaran matapos nga nag-atake ang isa ka suicide bomber sa isa ka Shiite mosque sa Islamabad, Pakistan samtang nagahiwat sang Friday prayers.
english: At least 32 people were killed and 160 injured after a suicide bomber attacked a Shiite mosque in Islamabad, Pakistan during Friday prayers.

text: Ginpangunahan sang grupo nga ISIS ang pag-atake, kag nadakpan na ang ginpahayag nga mastermind, kaupod ang apat (4) ka suspek nga nagbulig sa preparasyon sang pagpang-atake.
english: The group ISIS led the attack, and the alleged mastermind has been arrested, along with four (4) suspects who helped in the preparation of the attack.

text: Ini ang isa sa brutal nga pag-atake sa Pakistan humalin pa sang Enero 2023, kag nagapakita nga padayon nga may peligro sa terorismo sa amo nga pungsod.
english: This is one of the most brutal attacks in Pakistan since January 2023, and shows that there continues to be a threat of terrorism in that country.

text: Nagtambong ang linibo ka mga tawo sa funeral prayers sa idalom sang hugot nga seguridad, samtang gin-kondena sang gobyerno sang Pakistan, US, kag Afghanistan ang insidente bilang krimen batok sa katawhan ukon cime against humanity.
english: Thousands of people attended the funeral prayers under tight security, while the governments of Pakistan, the US, and Afghanistan condemned the incident as a crime against humanity or cime against humanity.

text:
GINAPILIT gid ni Pedro nga sabton ko ang iya pamangkot sadtong Paskwa pa, apang wala ko ini ginsabat, kag nagsiling lang nga “Secret!”

Indi  tungod indi ko ato masabat dayon.
english:
PETER INSISTED that I answer his question back at Christmas, but I didn't, and just said “Secret!”

Not because I can't answer it right away.

text: Nagpangalag-ag ako kay daw indi man magpati seguro si Pedro sa isabat ko sa iya.
english: I hesitated because Peter probably wouldn't believe my answer.

text: Sang sini lang, naisip ko, ugaling, nga ang indi ko pagsabat sa iya pamangkot basi makapalain pa kag updan sini ang pagpati sang malisyoso nga iban.
english: Recently, I thought, however, that not answering his question might make it worse and lead to the belief of malicious others.

text: So, sabton ko na lang ini.
english: So, I’ll just answer this.

text: Kag sabton ko ini paagi sa ining kolum ko kay basi magpati man siya tungod ipabutyag ko ini sa publiko.
english: And I will answer it through this column because he might believe it because I will express it to the public.

text: Man mabudlay magbinutig sa publiko.
english: Man it's hard to lie in public.

text:
Ang pamangkot ni Pedro amo ini: “Kamusta ang remedyo mo sa mga pulitiko sang Paskwa?”

Well, ang Paskwa panahon sang “Pure Giving” nga wala gapaabot sing bwelta nga kabalaslan.
english:
Peter’s question was: “What is your remedy for the Christmas politicians?”

Well, Christmas is a time of “Pure Giving” that does not expect anything in return.

text: So, wala man sing malisya dira kon tanyagan ka kag batunon ini nga indi ka man ma-obligar sang bwelta nga pabor, nga basi makabutang sa alang-alang ang kredibilidad sang aton tindug sa Free Press.
english: So, there is no malice in it if you are offered and accept it without being obliged to return the favor, which might jeopardize the credibility of our position in the Free Press.

text: Ugaling kay laban-laban patihan gid sang tawo nga ma-obligar ang journalist magbalik pabor sa pulitiko bisan pa pamaskwa lang ina, kag basi indi amo ang hingyuon sini nga indi mabalibaran.
english: However, most people believe that the journalist will be obliged to return in favor of the politician even if it's just Christmas, and maybe that's not what he asks for that can't be refused.

text: Unfair ina nga suspetso sa amon nga mga journalist nga gahakos sang misyon nga ugyunan kag indi i-kompromiso ang kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo kag pangapinan sila batok sa pagpang-abuso, labi na gid kon gamit ang poder sang sungayan nga pulitiko kag kasosyo nga power brokers.
english: That suspicion is unfair to us journalists who embrace the mission to agree and not compromise the rights of the people and defend them against abuse, especially when using the power of horny politicians and partner power brokers.

text: Well, ang matuod lang, Pedro, kag ini ang matuod sa sabat ko sa imo pamangkot: “Ni isa ka timoy ukon isa ka putos nga regalo wala gid ako nabaton nga pamaskwa sang nagligad nga Paskwa.
english: Well, the truth is, Peter, and this is the truth in my answer to your question: “I didn't receive a penny or a package of gifts for Christmas last Christmas.

text: In fact, kon may nabaton ako isa gid lang ka Christmas greeting kag halin pa sa text sang isa, kag isa gid lang, ka pulitiko.” Fortunately, wala man kita sang problema sa pulitiko nga ini kay halos wala kita masaway sa iya panghimanwa.
english: In fact, if I received anything, it was only one Christmas greeting and it was from a text from one, and only one, politician.” Fortunately, we have no problem with this politician because we are almost never criticized for his citizenship.

text: Kon ngaa, ina seguro kay indi na kinahanglan pangayuan nila ako sing pabor, kag sabton lang kon ano man ang isyu nga igu sila.
english: Why, that's probably because they don't have to ask me for a favor, and just answer whatever issue they have.

text: Nga daan ginpat-ud ko na sa publiko nga hilway ang akon mga panugdaon diri sa akon kolum nga “Hilway nga Panugdaon”.
english: I have already made it public that my suggestions are free here in my “Free Suggestion” column.

text: Okey man gani ina sa akon, kay daw hwes ako nga ginahadlukan sang mga may kaso nga palapitan agud hingyuan sang pabor kay basi makapalain pa ina sang ila kaso, kag mapabilin pa ang hwes nga “fair and just” sa iya desisyon.
english: That's okay with me, because I'm like a judge that people with cases are afraid to approach to ask for favors because it might make their case worse, and the judge will remain “fair and just” in his decision.

text: Indi bala, Pete?
english: Right, Pete?

text:
***

Sa nagligad nga edisyon sang aton kolum, napahayag naton diri nga pwede mangin madinalag-on ang isa ka pungsod kon hungdon sini ang away batok sa Climate Change, nga ginpakita naman sang pila sa ila.
english:
***

In the previous edition of our column, we stated here that a country can be successful if it takes up the fight against Climate Change, which some of them have shown.

text: Ang problema lang ugaling kay ang global nga epekto sang GHG emission sang mga Carbon Positive nga mga pungsod galab-ut pa sa ila, katulad sang mas mabaskog nga mga bagyo,  intense heat, rising sea level, kag intensive kag erratic heavy rainfall nga, in the interim, nagatuga man sang severe drought.
english: The problem is that the global impact of GHG emissions from Carbon Positive countries extends beyond them, such as stronger typhoons, intense heat, rising sea levels, and intensive and erratic heavy rainfall that, in the interim, also cause severe drought.

text: Sa mga Carbon Positive nga mga pungsod, nagapanguna diri ang Communist China kag ang United States.
english: Among the Carbon Positive countries, Communist China and the United States lead the way.

text: Sadtong 2020 nga data sang US EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) nagapanguna ang China tubtub 12% sang global GHG emission.
english: In 2020 data from the US EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), China accounted for up to 12% of global GHG emissions.

text: Gasunod ang US nga may mga 6%.
english: The US follows with about 6%.

text: Sadtong 2023, sunu man sa US EPA, ang China, United States, India, ang EU 27, Russia kag Brazil ang world’s largest GHG emitters.
english: By 2023, according to the US EPA, China, the United States, India, the EU 27, Russia and Brazil will be the world’s largest GHG emitters.

text: Together, sakop nila ang 49.8% sang global population kag 63.2% sang global gross domestic product.
english: Together, they account for 49.8% of the global population and 63.2% of the global gross domestic product.

text: Unfortunately, kabangdanan man sila sang 64.2% sang global fossil fuel consumption kag 62.7% nga global GHG emissions.
english: Unfortunately, they are also responsible for 64.2% of global fossil fuel consumption and 62.7% of global GHG emissions.

text: Ang masubo pa kay ang pila sa ila wala luyag magsunod sa mga ginatalana nga reduction standards sang GHG emissions.
english: Unfortunately, some of them do not want to follow the set reduction standards of GHG emissions.

text: Ang isa naggwa na gani kag ang pila pa nagapalabtik nga manuggwa man sa Paris Agreement.
english: One has already left and several others are preparing to leave the Paris Agreement.

text: Bisan pa, sunu kay Bård Harstad, isa kay professor sa political economy sa Stanford Graduate School of Business, nga indi man kinahanglan himuon nila ina kay ang Paris Agreement gahatag man sang kasubong nga option sa ila.
english: However, according to Bård Harstad, a professor of political economy at the Stanford Graduate School of Business, they do not have to do that because the Paris Agreement gives them a similar option.

text: Fortunately, ang kalabanan gaugyon sa Paris Agreement.
english: Fortunately, most agree with the Paris Agreement.

text: Sa Uropa, nagahugpong ang 27 ka katapo sang European Union agud ipatuman ang EU National Energyang and Climate Program (2021-2030) agud punggan ang global temperature nga indi magtaas pa sang 1.5oC.
english: In Europe, the 27 members of the European Union are coming together to implement the EU National Energy and Climate Program (2021-2030) to keep global temperatures from rising beyond 1.5ºC.

text: Ginatan-aw pa gani nila ang dugang nga mga stratehiya batok sa Climate Change tubtub malab-ut ang Zero Carbon status sa 2050.
english: They are even looking at additional strategies against Climate Change until achieving Zero Carbon status by 2050.

text: Target nila ang as follows: 40% reduction sang GHG emission tubtub 2030 ikumparar sa 1990; 32% nga consumption sang renewable energy; 32.5% improvement sa energy efficiency; kag 15% electricity interconnection sa 2030.
english: They target the following: 40% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to 1990; 32% renewable energy consumption; 32.5% improvement in energy efficiency; and 15% electricity interconnection by 2030.

text: Angot diri, ang tanan nga myembro gina-requirer nga mag-submit sang ila draft National and Climate Plan (NECP) sadtong Dec.
english: In this regard, all members are required to submit their draft National and Climate Plan (NECP) by Dec.

text:
(Warning:Sensitive content)

Arestado sang mga otoridad ang isa ka babaye sa Thailand matapos nga sekreto nga ginkuhaan sang laragway kag video ang pagpakighilawas niya sa mga monghe, agud makakwarta.
english:
(Warning:Sensitive content)

Authorities in Thailand have arrested a woman after she secretly took pictures and videos of her having sex with monks, in order to make money.

text: Ang suspek amo si “Ms. Golf” nga nagapang-blackmail sa mga monghe nga naka-sex niya, gamit ang ila nga mga video sang ila akto.
english: The suspect is “Ms. Golf” who blackmails the monks who had sex with her, using their videos of their act.

text: Suno sa pulis, posible nga nakakwarta ang babaye sang tubtob sa 385 milyong baht sa nakaligad nga tatlo ka tuig paagi sa pag- blackmail sa mga monghe.
english: Police said the woman may have earned up to 385 million baht in the past three years by blackmailing monks.

text: Ginpahayag nga siyam ka mga monghe ang iya naka-sex.
english: She reportedly had sex with nine monks.

text: Nakit-an sa balay ni Ms. Golf ang masobra sa 80,000 nga mga pictures kag videos nga gin-gamit niya agud pahugon ang mga monghe.
english: Found in the house of Ms. Golf the more than 80,000 pictures and videos he used to intimidate the monks.

text: Ang monghe isa ka lalaki nga miyembro sang relihiyoso nga grupo nga nagapangabuhi sang simple, disiplinado, kag may mga panata nga indi magpangasawa ukon magpakighilawas,kag magsunod sa mga mando sang ila nga komunidad ukon relihiyon.
english: A monk is a male member of a religious group who lives a simple, disciplined life, and has vows not to marry or have sex, and to follow the orders of his community or religion.

text: Hatagan sang pagtamod sang Iloilo City Health Office (CHO) ang mga barangay nga may reports sang kaso sang dengue sa Iloilo City.
english: The Iloilo City Health Office (CHO) will give attention to the barangays that have reports of dengue cases in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Ann Diaz head sang City Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang mga may kaso sang dengue ang patigayonan sang misting operations.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Ann Diaz head of the City Health Office, she said that those with dengue cases will be subjected to misting operations.

text: Suno kay Diaz, tinutuyo sang tikang nga mapahagan-hagan ang kaso sang dengue sa mga target nga mga barangay.
english: According to Diaz, the move aims to reduce dengue cases in the target barangays.

text: Target man sang talatapan nga hatagan sang prayoridad ang mga barangay nga yara sa malapit sa boarder sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: The office also targets to give priority to barangays near the border of Iloilo province.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa data sang CHO, may 26 ka barangay ang may pinakamadamo nga kaso sang dengue sa Iloilo City.
english: According to CHO data, 26 barangays have the highest number of dengue cases in Iloilo City.

text: Sa subong, yara sa 149 ang kaso sang dengue, kon sa diin, 112 ang kumpirmado, 37 ang na man probable kag 1 ang napatay.
english: As of now, there are 149 dengue cases, of which 112 are confirmed, 37 are probable and 1 has died.

text: Nalangkag si Coach Tim Cone nga maka-upod na liwat si Kai Sotto sa mga hampang sang Gilas Pilipinas.
english: Coach Tim Cone is excited to have Kai Sotto back in Gilas Pilipinas games.

text: Ini matapos masobra isa ka tuig nga nagpahuway bangud sa injury partikular ang torn ACL (anterior cruciate ligament).
english: This comes after more than a year of rest due to an injury particularly a torn ACL (anterior cruciate ligament).

text: Magatipon liwat ang Gilas sa tunga-tunga subong nga bulan samtang ginapreparahan ang duha ka hampang diri sa Pilipinas sa 2027 FIBA Asian Qualifiers batok sa New Zealand sa Pebrero 26, kag batok sa Australia sa Marso 1.
english: The Gilas will reconvene in the middle of this month as they prepare for two games here in the Philippines in the 2027 FIBA ​​Asian Qualifiers against New Zealand on February 26, and against Australia on March 1.

text: Isa ka semana ang nagligad, nagbalik na si Sotto sa iya team nga Koshigaya Alphas sa Japan B.League 2025-26 season.
english: A week later, Sotto has returned to his team Koshigaya Alphas in the Japan B.League 2025-26 season.

text: Siya man ang latest Filipino import nga nakasulod sa 1,000-point club sa B.League.
english: He is also the latest Filipino import to join the 1,000-point club in the B.League.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa Asian Qualifiers, nakaangkon ang Pilipinas sang back-to-back wins batok sa Guam kag tinguhaan nga mapabilin ini nga streak sa pag-atubang sa mas agresibo kag mas mataas nga mga kasumpong nga Tall Blacks kag Boomers.
english: It is known that in the Asian Qualifiers, the Philippines had back-to-back wins against Guam and will try to maintain this streak against more aggressive and taller opponents Tall Blacks and Boomers.

text: Ginpamatud-an sang 49-anyos nga security guard nga wala sang edad kun ang paglab-ot sa handom ang pagaistoryahan.
english: The 49-year-old security guard proved that there is no age when it comes to achieving dreams.

text: Ini amo si Julian Avila, security guard sa University of Caloocan City (UCC).
english: This is Julian Avila, security guard at the University of Caloocan City (UCC).

text: Sang damlag lang, nakatapos si Avila sang degree program nga Bachelor of Public Administration sa amo nga unibersidad kun sa diin siya naga-duty.
english: Recently, Avila graduated from the Bachelor of Public Administration degree program at the same university where he is on duty.

text: Suno sa Facebook post sang UCC, sa sulod sang malawig nga tuig, nangin pamilyar nga nawong si Avila nga hipuson lang kag nagabantay sa palibot.
english: According to the UCC Facebook post, over the long years, Avila became a familiar face who was quiet and watched the surroundings.

text: Apang sa likod sini amo ang iya handom nga makatapos sa kolehiyo.
english: But behind that was her desire to finish college.

text: Sa bulig sang LGU- Caloocan, kag sa idalom sang isa ka programa nga nagahatag sang oportunidad sa mga empleyado sang gobyerno nga makaeskwela samtang nagatrabaho, liwat nga nabuhi ang iya paglaum.
english: With the help of LGU- Caloocan, and under a program that gives government employees the opportunity to study while working, his hopes were revived.

text: Sa idalom sang Bachelor of Public Administration-Evening Classes for Government Employees (BPA-ECGE), nagpadayon siya sa iya nga serbisyo sa adlaw bilang guwardiya, kag sa gabi bilang estudyante.
english: Under the Bachelor of Public Administration-Evening Classes for Government Employees (BPA-ECGE), he continued his service during the day as a security guard, and at night as a student.

text: Tubtob nga natapos niya ini.
english: Until he finished it.

text: Tuman naman ang iya pagpasalamat sa Board of Regents nga ginapamunuan ni Chairman, Hon. Mayor Dale Gonzalo R. Malapitan, nga nangin instrumento agud matuman ang iya handom.
english: He expressed his gratitude to the Board of Regents headed by Chairman, Hon. Mayor Dale Gonzalo R. Malapitan, who became an instrument to realize his dream.

text: KINAHANGLAN ta pa athagon diri ang malip-ut ta nga sabat sa mga doomsayer sang nagligad nga edisyon sang aton kolum.
english: We must clarify here our brief response to the doomsayers of the previous edition of our column.

text: Ginapilit nila ang pagpapati sa publiko nga indi conclusive ang pamahog sang GHG emission kag, kon matabo gid man, wala na kita sing mahimo.
english: They force the public to believe that the threat of GHG emission is not conclusive and, if it does occur, there is nothing we can do.

text: Well, kon indi conclusive ang pamahog sang GHG emission, ngaa gintukod gid ang Paris Agreement nga nagalimite sang GHG emission sa kalibutan?
english: Well, if the threat of GHG emission is not conclusive, why was the Paris Agreement limiting the world’s GHG emission established at all?

text: Katapo diri ang mga 196 ka pungsod.
english: It includes some 196 countries.

text: Gina-obligar sini ang tanan nga himulatan gid masunod ang panugyan sang mga siyentipiko nga malimitahan ang paggamit sang fossil fuel sa 45% sang subong nila nga paggamit.
english: It obliges everyone to follow the advice of scientists to limit the use of fossil fuels to 45% of their current use.

text: Ina agud man malimitahan sa 1.5o degrees Centigrade ang pagtaas sang global temperature tubtub 2030 kung san-o pwede na mapanubo ini sa masunod nga tinuig.
english: This is to limit the rise in global temperature to 1.5o degrees Centigrade until 2030 when it can be reduced next year.

text:
***

Kon matabo – ang sige-sige nga paglala sang Climate Change, sa hangop ta sa mga doomsayer – wala na kita kuno mahimo dira.
english:
***

If it happens – the ever-worsening of Climate Change, as we understand the doomsayers – there is nothing we can do about it.

text: Tuod?
english: Facts?

text: Well, pakot-pakot lang ini nga wala ebidensya, kag sala nga generalization.
english: Well, this is just a rumor without evidence, and a wrong generalization.

text: Ang matuod may mga daku gid kita nga mahimo.
english: The truth is we have great things to do.

text: Nahibal-an na sang aton mga siyentipiko ang mga kabangdanan, kag ginatudlo nila dira ang tatlo ka mayor nga rason.
english: Our scientists already know the causes, and they point to three main reasons.

text: Una gid ang sobra –sobra nga paggamit sang fossil fuel sa pagkabuhi sang mga pungsod, nga ang pagsunog sini nagaboga sang greenhouse gas (GHG) nga ang pagpabilin sa atmospera nagapainit sang kalibutan.
english: First of all, the excessive use of fossil fuels in the lives of countries, the burning of which emits greenhouse gases (GHG) that remain in the atmosphere warms the world.

text: Madugang ta pa diri gani ang pag-manufacture, gamit ang fossil fuel, sang mga bagay nga mabudlay kag siniglo madunot (non-biogdegrable) kag makahalalit sa environmental kag human health.
english: We can add to this the manufacture, using fossil fuels, of things that are difficult and non-biodegradable and harmful to environmental and human health.

text: Ikatatlo, ang pakawala (heedless) nga pagpanapas sang kakahuyan sa kabukiran nga daku nga natural Carbon Sink.
english: Third, heedless deforestation in the mountains is a large natural carbon sink.

text: Ang kakahuyan nagasuyop sang Carbon Dioxide.
english: Forests absorb Carbon Dioxide.

text: Ginagamit sang kahoy ini bilang “pagkaon”, samtang nagapagwa bwelta sang oxygen, nga ginaginhawa sang tawo kag kasapatan sa padayon nila nga pagkabuhi.
english: The tree uses it as “food”, while releasing oxygen, which humans and animals breathe in their continued existence.

text:
***

Nahibal-an naman sang aton mga syentipiko ang solusyon dira.
english:
***

Our scientists know the solution.

text: Sa nasiling naton gani,  gintukod ang Paris Agreement on Climate Change para obligaron ang mga katapo nga mga  pungsod nga panubuon ang GHG emission sang ila paggamit sang fossil fuel sa 45% kag ang paggamit sini  sa pag-manufacture sang biodegradable lang nga materials.
english: That said, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change was established to oblige member countries to reduce GHG emissions from their use of fossil fuels to 45% and their use in the manufacture of only biodegradable materials.

text: Sadly though, may pila ka pungsod, labi na gid ang mga fossil fuel producers kag exporters nga nagapamalibad pa.
english: Sadly though, there are some countries, especially fossil fuel producers and exporters that still refuse.

text: Ang iban gani naggwa na sa Paris Agreement.
english: Some have even pulled out of the Paris Agreement.

text: Good, though, kay ang kadamuan gapamati kag naga-obligar.
english: Good, though, because most listen and oblige.

text: Nakita man mismo sang mga indibidwal nga mga pungsod ang kaimportante sang pagpananom sang mga kahoy kag sige-sige naman ang ila pagpananom sang dugang nga kakahuyan.
english: Individual countries have also seen the importance of planting trees and are continuing to plant more trees.

text: Ang may ikasarang teknonoliya nagapatuman naman sang carbon capture paagi sa clean energy kag underground sequestration.
english: The technologically capable are implementing carbon capture through clean energy and underground sequestration.

text: Ang iban nagtukod naman sang mga renewable energy projects – solar, wind, hydropower, etc.
english: Others have built renewable energy projects – solar, wind, hydropower, etc.

text: – agud indi na mdugangan pa ang pagluntad sang GHG.
english: – to prevent further GHG emissions.

text:
***

Sa karon, na-classify na gani ang mga pungsod sa tatlo ka kategorya sunu sa status sang ila indibidwal nga kahimtangan angot sa Climate Change.
english:
***

Currently, countries have been classified into three categories according to the status of their individual situation regarding Climate Change.

text: Ining tatlo nga kategorya amo ang: Carbon-Neutral (Net-zero), Carbon-Negative, kag Carbon Positive.
english: These three categories are: Carbon-Neutral (Net-zero), Carbon-Negative, and Carbon Positive.

text: By the way, ang carbon nagatumod sa Carbon Dioxide, nga may pinakadaku nga bahin sa GHG, kag iban pa nga gaseous carbon compounds nga may kaangtanan sa Climate Change.
english: By the way, carbon refers to Carbon Dioxide, which has the largest share in GHG, and other gaseous carbon compounds associated with Climate Change.

text: Ang Carbon-Neutral (Net-Zero) nga pungsod ga-offset sang ila Carbon Dioxide emission nga ginaupdan sang carbon mitigation efforts, katulad sang pagpananom sang kahoy nga ga-absorb sang equal amount nga carbon, nga wala na naga-contribute pa sa Climate Change.
english: Carbon-Neutral (Net-Zero) countries offset their Carbon Dioxide emissions accompanied by carbon mitigation efforts, such as planting trees that absorb an equal amount of carbon, without contributing to Climate Change.

text: Ang Carbon-Negative naman goes further sa mitigation process.
english: Carbon-Negative goes further in the mitigation process.

text: Gina-sequester sini ang sobra nga carbon sangsa gina-emit sini to the end nga mapa-slow down ini tubtub ma-reverse pa sini ang epekto sang Climate Change tubtub Zero-Carbon na.
english: It sequesters more carbon than it emits to the end that it can slow down until it can reverse the effects of Climate Change until it is Zero-Carbon.

text: Samtang ang mga Carbon-Positive nga mga pungsod padayon pa nga nagapa-emit sang sobra nga carbon.
english: Meanwhile Carbon-Positive countries still continue to emit too much carbon.

text: Diri na-belong ang dalagku nga industrial countries, labi na gid ang mga fossil fuel producers kag exporters.
english: This includes the large industrial countries, especially the fossil fuel producers and exporters.

text:
***

Ang masunod amo ang mga pungsod nga na-classify na sa tatlo ka kategorya angot sa Climate Change:

Carbon-Neutral (Net-Zero) countries – Comoros, Gabon,Guyana, Madagascar, Niue.
english:
***

The following are the countries that have been classified into three categories regarding Climate Change:

Carbon-Neutral (Net-Zero) countries – Comoros, Gabon,Guyana, Madagascar, Niue.

text: Carbon-Negative countries – Bhutan, Panama, Suriname.
english: Carbon-Negative countries – Bhutan, Panama, Suriname.

text: Madugang pa diri ang “Other notable Climate-Friendly” countries (nga ma-expect sa paglab-ut sang carbon negativity sa sulod lang sang malip-ut lang nga tinuig) – Kiribati, Montserrat, Nauru, Tonga, Tuvalu, Saint Helena, kag Wallis and Futuna Islands.
english: This will include “Other notable Climate-Friendly” countries (expected to achieve carbon negativity within a few years) – Kiribati, Montserrat, Nauru, Tonga, Tuvalu, Saint Helena, and Wallis and Futuna Islands.

text: Carbon-Positive – ang nabilin pa sa 196 nga katapo sang Paris Agreement.
english: Carbon-Positive – the remainder of the 196 members of the Paris Agreement.

text: Sa sini nga classification, wala nalakip diri ang Filipinas sa una nga duha nga kategorya kag bisan sa climate-friendly countries, which means nalakip pa ini sa Carbon-Positive nga mga pungsod.
english: In this classification, the Philippines is not included in the first two categories and even in the climate-friendly countries, which means it is still included in the Carbon-Positive countries.

text: Which means man nga kinahanglan pa maghimulat pa gid ang Filipinas agud mapasanyog ang away sini sa Climate Change.
english: Which means that the Philippines will have to wait longer to improve its fight against Climate Change.

text:
***

Sa karon nga problema sang mga Carbon-Positive, lakip sa obligasyon sini nga pagpanubo sang ila GHG emission ang indi na mapalapta ini sa iban nga mga pungsod, labi na gid sa mga Climate-Friendly nga mga pungsod.
english:
***

In the current problem of Carbon-Positive, among its obligations to reduce their GHG emissions is not to spread them to other countries, especially Climate-Friendly countries.

text: In fact, may obligasyon sila, bangod sang ila mataas nga carbon footprint sang GHG emission, ang magbulig Financial kag Technological sa mga vulnerable nga mga pungsod nga nahalitan sang malawakan nga epekto sang severe weather events katulad sang bagyo, heavy rainfall, drought, kag intensive heat nga matudlo sa malawakan nga GHG emission sang mga Carbon-Positive nga mga pungsod./PN
english: In fact, they have an obligation, due to their high carbon footprint of GHG emission, to provide financial and technological assistance to vulnerable countries affected by the widespread impact of severe weather events such as typhoons, heavy rainfall, drought, and intensive heat that can be attributed to the widespread GHG emissive Carbon-Positive countries.

text: Nagapang-alang-alang ang pila sa business groups sa pag-implementar sang flexible work arrangements kag four-day workweek.
english: Some business groups are hesitant to implement flexible work arrangements and the four-day workweek.

text: Ini kasunod sang panawagan halin mismo kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: This follows a call from President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: nga buhinan ang fuel consumption bangud sang natalana nga pagtimbuok sang oil prices sa masunod nga semana bangud sang epekto sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: to reduce fuel consumption due to the expected rise in oil prices next week due to the impact of the war in the Middle East.

text: Suno sa Employers’ Confederation of the Philippines, bukas man ang private sector sa pagpatuman sang flexible work arrangements kag four-day workweek, apang indi ini mahimo iimplementar sa tanan nga industriya.
english: According to the Employers’ Confederation of the Philippines, the private sector is also open to implementing flexible work arrangements and four-day workweek, but it cannot be implemented in all industries.

text: Amo man sini ang pagpati sang Management Association of the Philippines.
english: The Management Association of the Philippines believes the same.

text: Suno naman sa Federation of Philippine Industries, dapat nga kun may adjustments gid man sa work structures, kinahanglan nga mahinalungon gid ang pagdihon agud malikawan ang disruptions sa output, delivery schedules, kag supply chain flows.
english: According to the Federation of Philippine Industries, if there are adjustments in work structures, they should be done very carefully to avoid disruptions in output, delivery schedules, and supply chain flows.

text: Pahayag naman sang Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry, kun ipatuman ang four-day workweek, dapat nga may balanse, evidenced-based, kag sector-sensitive approach.
english: The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry said that if the four-day workweek is to be implemented, there should be a balanced, evidence-based, and sector-sensitive approach.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa nauna na nga nagsabat sa panawagan sang presidente.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) was one of the first to respond to the president's call.

text: Sa Memorandum Order 26-886, iga-apply sang DTI central office ang special flexible working scheme agud makakinot sa enerhiya bangud sa pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong.
english: In Memorandum Order 26-886, the DTI central office will apply the special flexible working scheme to save energy due to the increase in fuel prices.

text: Ang ila nga job order kag contract of service workers lakip na ang involved sa frontline functions ang maga-trabaho lamang sa ila mga balay sa kada Byernes.
english: Their job order and contract of service workers including those involved in frontline functions will only work from their homes every Friday.

text: Ang tanan nga DTI transactions kada Byernes sa central office ang gin-request man nga himuon online.#
english: All DTI transactions every Friday at the central office are also requested to be done online.

text: Naghimo sang maragtas ang Spanish tennis player nga si Carlos Alcaraz bilang pinakabata nga male player nga nakakumpleto sang kampyonato sa Grand Slam matapos nga ginlutos sini si Novak Djokovic sa final sang Australian Open.
english: Spanish tennis player Carlos Alcaraz made history as the youngest male player to complete a Grand Slam championship after he defeated Novak Djokovic in the final of the Australian Open.

text: Apisar sang mahinay nga mag-umpisa sang hampang para kay Alcaraz, nakabawi ini sa masunod nga mga set kag ginbalabagan ang 38-anyos nga Serbian superstar nga makakuha sang ika-25 na nga Grand Slam title.
english: Despite a slow start to the match for Alcaraz, he recovered in the following sets and prevented the 38-year-old Serbian superstar from clinching his 25th Grand Slam title.

text: 2-6, 6-2, 6-3, 7-5 ang score sang duha sa Rod Laver Arena.
english: The score was 2-6, 6-2, 6-3, 7-5 at Rod Laver Arena.

text: Sa edad nga 22-anyos, si Alcaraz ang pinakabata sa Open Era nga nakadaog sa apat ka major tennis tournaments kasunod sang iya nauna nga mga kadalag-an sa Wimbledon kag sa French kag US Opens.
english: At 22-years-old, Alcaraz is the youngest in the Open Era to win four major tennis tournaments following his earlier triumphs at Wimbledon and the French and US Opens.

text: Nalapawan sini ang record sang legendary tennis player nga si Rafael Nadal nga halin man sa Espanya nga nakalab-ot man sang amo nga achievement sa edad sini anay nga 24-anyos.
english: He surpassed the record of legendary tennis player Rafael Nadal of Spain who also achieved the same achievement at the age of 24 years.

text: Ini naman ang una nga tion nga nalutos si Djokovic sa finals sang Australian Open.
english: This is the first time Djokovic has lost in the finals of the Australian Open.

text: Antes sini, 10 ka beses siya nga nagdaog sa Melbourne.
english: Before that, he won 10 times in Melbourne.

text: Katapusan siya nga nakadala-pauli sang Grand Slam singles trophy sang 2023 kadungan sang US Open.
english: He will be the last to take home the Grand Slam singles trophy in 2023 at the US Open.

text: Nagahanda na ang pila ka mga Pilipino sa Middle East pananglitan magtakop ang 48 ka oras nga ginhatag ni United States President Donald Trump sa Iran agud buksan ang strait of Hormuz.
english: Some Filipinos in the Middle East are preparing in case the 48 hours given by US President Donald Trump to Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz expires.

text: Suno kay Bombo international correspondent Joseph Rivera direkta sa Qatar, iya ginpahayag nga nagatipon na ang mga ini sang pila ka mga supply sang pagkaon, ilabi na ang tubig, agud makapangaman ang mga ini kun tumanon ni Trump ang iya ginbuy-an nga mga salaysay nga pag-bomba sa Iran, ilabi na sang power plant sini sa Tehran.
english: According to Bombo international correspondent Joseph Rivera directly in Qatar, he said they are already gathering some food supplies, especially water, to prepare them if Trump carries out his released narratives of bombing Iran, especially its power plant in Tehran.

text: Dugang pa ni Rivera nga dako ang posibilidad nga maapektuhan gid ang mga ini, lakip na ang kaiping nga mga pungsod sang Iran.
english: Rivera added that they are likely to be severely affected, including Iran's neighboring countries.

text: Nagakabalaka sa karun ang madamo nga mga Pilipino sa amo nga rehiyon, bangud sa posible pag-init pagid sang tensyon sa tunga sang Amerika kag Iran.
english: Many Filipinos in the region are now worried about the possible escalation of tensions between the United States and Iran.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang Qatari government nga padayon ang ila military defense, agud pangapinan ang ila pungsod, ilabi na ang ila pumuluyo.
english: The Qatari government has assured that it will continue its military defense, to defend its country, especially its people.

text: Gintay-og sang magnitude 5.4 nga linog ang Sarangani Island, Davao Occidental subong nga adlaw, Marso 28.
english: A magnitude 5.4 earthquake jolted Sarangani Island, Davao Occidental today, March 28.

text: Sa Earthquake Information 1 nga gin-release sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), ginpahayag nga tectonic in origin ang linog.
english: In Earthquake Information 1 released by the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), the quake was said to be tectonic in origin.

text: Na-record ini 11:33 sa aga.
english: It was recorded at 11:33 am.

text: Yari ang reported intensities.
english: Here are the reported intensities.

text:
Intensity III – M’lang, COTABATO; Maasim and Malungon, SARANGANIIntensity II – Tupi, SOUTH COTABATOIntensity I – City of Digos, DAVAO DEL SUR; Jose Abad Santos, DAVAO OCCIDENTAL; Kiamba, SARANGANI; T’Boli, SOUTH COTABATO

Wala sang ginaantisipar nga damage, apang posible suno sa ahensya ang aftershocks.
english:
Intensity III – M’lang, COTABATO; Maasim and Malungon, SARANGANIIntensity II – Tupi, SOUTH COTABATOIntensity I – City of Digos, DAVAO DEL SUR; Jose Abad Santos, DAVAO OCCIDENTAL; Kiamba, SARANGANI; T’Boli, SOUTH COTABATO

No damage is anticipated, but the agency said aftershocks are possible.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpahanumdom ang Office of Civil Defense sa mga pumuluyo sa lugar nga mag-aligmat kasunod sang report sang Phivolcs.#
english: The Office of Civil Defense immediately reminded residents in the area to be vigilant following the Phivolcs report.

text: Hugot nga nagpanindugan si Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga indi niya pagtugtan nga basta-basta nalang isuko sang Pilipinas ang Kalayaan Islands.
english: Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson insisted that he will not allow the Philippines to simply surrender the Kalayaan Islands.

text: Ini nga panindugan ni Lacson ang sabat sa pahayag ni Senator Rodante Marcoleta nga “isuko na lang” ang Kalayaan Islands sa China, bangud ini ang malayo na sa exclusive economic zone (EEZ) sang Pilipinas.
english: Lacson's position is in response to Senator Rodante Marcoleta's statement that the Kalayaan Islands should be “surrendered” to China, as they are far from the Philippines' exclusive economic zone (EEZ).

text: Suno kay Lacson, indi niya ini pag-tugutan kay ang Kalayaan Islands ang kabahin nga pulo sang Palawan, kag gina-istaran sang indi magnubo sa 300 ka Pilipino.
english: Lacson said he will not allow this because the Kalayaan Islands are part of Palawan, and are home to at least 300 Filipinos.

text: Base sa prinsipyo sang “res nullius” ukon “terra nullius,” ang una nga tawo nga makadiskubre kag makapuyo sa duta nga wala sang may nagapanag-iya ang ginakilala bilang lehitimong nga naga-angkun sini.
english: Based on the principle of “res nullius” or “terra nullius,” the first person to discover and occupy the land without ownership is recognized as the legitimate claimant.

text: Ginhimo ni Lacson bilang halimbawa si Tomas Cloma, nga isa ka abogado kag adventurer, nga nakadiskubre sang Spratly Islands kag gin-angkun ini antes ipasa sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas.Bangud sini, suno sa batas, ang Pilipinas ang legal nga nagapanag-iya sang Kalayaan Islands.
english: Lacson cited as an example Tomas Cloma, a lawyer and adventurer, who discovered the Spratly Islands and claimed them before handing them over to the Philippine government.

text: Dugang pa ni Lacson, ang arbitral award sa West Philippine Sea wala nagasakop sa Kalayaan Islands, lakip na ang Pag-asa Island, gani indi dapat ini isuko.
english: Lacson added that the arbitral award in the West Philippine Sea does not cover the Kalayaan Islands, including Pag-asa Island, so it should not be surrendered.

text: Depensa naman ni Senator Marcoleta, nga ang iya ginpahayag ginasala-interpret lang, kag indi niya buot isuko ang Kalayaan Islands.
english: Senator Marcoleta defended that his statement was misinterpreted, and he does not want to give up the Kalayaan Islands.

text: Ginbalik sang beterana nga singer kag actress nga si Zsa Zsa Padilla ang iya Lifetime Achievement Award nga ginpasidungog sa iya sang Aliw Awards Foundation.
english: Veteran singer and actress Zsa Zsa Padilla returned her Lifetime Achievement Award honored by the Aliw Awards Foundation.

text: Suno kay Zsa-Zsa wala sini manamian ang ginpakita nga pag-amuma sa ila kag kaangay nga wala sang respeto ang nagdumala sang awarding ceremony.
english: Zsa-Zsa said he did not like the care shown to them and it seemed that the awarding ceremony was held without respect.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nadula ang kahulugan sang pagpasidungog matapos wala sila natagaan sang opportunidad nga makahatag sang ila speech bilang pagpasalamat man sa mga tawo nga nangin parte sang ila kadalga-an.
english: He said the meaning of the honor was lost after they were not given the opportunity to give their speech as a thank you to the people who were part of their success.

text: Upod ni Padilla sa mga ginpasidunggan sanday Lani Misalucha, Jed Madela, Gary Valenciano, kag Franki Asinero nga amo man ang pagtratar sa mga ini.
english: Padilla was among those honored by Lani Misalucha, Jed Madela, Gary Valenciano, and Franki Asinero who received the same treatment.

text: Gilayon naman nga naghatag sang ila sabat ang Aliw Awards Foundation, nga suno sa tagdumalahan nga gintinguhaan gid nila nga mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga tion ang tagsa-tagsa apang ginkulang gid sa oras.
english: The Aliw Awards Foundation immediately responded, saying that they tried their best to give each person adequate time but were short of time.

text: Rason nga wala na makahatag sang ila speech ang iban nga napasidunggan kaangay na lang ni Zsa-zsa Padilla nga nakabaton sang Lifetime Achievement Award.
english: Some of the honorees, such as Zsa-zsa Padilla, who received the Lifetime Achievement Award, were unable to give their speeches.

text: Isang 55-taóng gulang na lalaki ang tumakas kasama ang 22-taóng gulang na fiancée ng kanyang menor de edad na anak, habang bitbit ang lahat ng ipon at mga alahas ng kanilang pamilya.
english: A 55-year-old man fled with his minor daughter's 22-year-old fiancée, carrying all their family's savings and jewelry.

text: Kinilala ang lalaki bilang si Shakeel, isang ama ng anim at lolo ng tatlo, na umano’y tumakas patungong Delhi upang pakasalan si Ayesha (hindi tunay na pangalan), ang nobya na inihanda sana para sa kanyang 17-taóng gulang na anak na si Aman (hindi rin tunay na pangalan).
english: The man was identified as Shakeel, a father of six and grandfather of three, who allegedly fled to Delhi to marry Ayesha (not his real name), the bride prepared for his 17-year-old son Aman (also not his real name).

text: Ayon sa kanyang asawang si Shabbana, si Shakeel mismo ang nagpumilit sa pagpapakasal nina Aman at Ayesha, kahit pa tutol sila dahil sa murang edad ng kanilang anak at kakulangan sa pera.
english: According to his wife Shabbana, Shakeel himself insisted on the marriage of Aman and Ayesha, even though they were against it because of the young age of their children and lack of money.

text: Ngunit sa hindi inaasahang pag-ikot ng pangyayari, tumawag si Shakeel mula sa Delhi upang sabihin sa kanyang pamilya na siya na mismo ang nagpakasal kay Ayesha.
english: In an unexpected turn of events, Shakeel called from Delhi to tell his family that he had married Ayesha himself.

text: “Yung babaeng dapat ay maging manugang ko, asawa na ngayon ng asawa ko,” ani Shabbana sa isang panayam sa lokal na midya.
english: “The woman who was supposed to be my daughter-in-law is now my husband's wife,” Shabbana said in an interview with local media.

text: Ikinuwento rin ni Shabbana na madalas bumisita si Shakeel kay Ayesha sa ngalan ng paghahanda sa kasal, ngunit matagal na raw niyang pinaghihinalaan ang namumuong ugnayan ng dalawa.
english: Shabbana also revealed that Shakeel often visited Ayesha in the name of wedding preparations, but she had long suspected the relationship between the two.

text: Kapag kinakausap niya ang kanyang asawa tungkol dito, siya raw ay nilalait, pinapagalitan, at minsan pa ay sinasaktan.
english: When he talks to his wife about it, she is insulted, yelled at, and sometimes even hurt.

text: Kalaunan, nakakuha siya ng ebidensiya—mga mensahe sa cellphone—na ipinakita niya kay Aman, dahilan para kanselahin nito ang kasal.
english: Eventually, she found evidence—cellphone messages—that she showed to Aman, causing him to cancel the wedding.

text: Ngunit hindi doon nagtapos ang eskandalo.
english: But the scandal did not end there.

text: Bukod sa pagtakbo ni Shakeel kasama si Ayesha, nadiskubre rin na tinangay niya ang higit 200,000 rupees (halos ₱140,000) at ang lahat ng alahas ng pamilya.
english: Besides running away with Ayesha, Shakeel was also discovered to have stolen more than 200,000 rupees (almost ₱140,000) and all the family's jewelry.

text: Sa kabila ng matinding iskandalo, wala pa raw formal na reklamo na inihain laban kay Shakeel, kaya’t hindi pa makakilos ang mga pulis, ayon sa ulat ng Times of India.
english: Despite the scandal, no formal complaint has been filed against Shakeel, so the police cannot act, according to a Times of India report.

text: Hindi ito ang unang pagkakataong may ganitong pangyayari sa India.
english: This is not the first time such an incident has occurred in India.

text: Ilang buwan lang ang nakalipas, naiulat din ang isang lalaki na tumakas at nagpakasal sa ina ng kanyang bride-to-be, siyam na araw bago ang kanilang nakatakdang kasal.
english: Just a few months ago, a man was reported to have run away and married his bride-to-be's mother, nine days before their scheduled wedding.

text: Patay ang pito ka Qatari kag Turkish citizens matapos nagtibusok ang military helicopter sa Qatar.
english: Seven Qatari and Turkish citizens were killed after a military helicopter crashed in Qatar.

text: Nasapwan naman ang lawas sang mga biktima matapos ang insidente.
english: The bodies of the victims were found after the incident.

text: Suno sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, may technical malfunction, apang ginahibalo pa ang dugang nga mga rason sa likod sang trahedya nga natabo kadungan sang training exercise.
english: According to initial investigation, there was a technical malfunction, but further reasons behind the tragedy that occurred during the training exercise are still being investigated.

text: Suno sa Turkey kag Qatar, ang mga nakasakay sa helicopter amo ang apat ka Qatari military personnel, isa ka Turkish serviceman, kag duha ka technicians halin sa Turkish defense company.
english: According to Turkey and Qatar, the occupants of the helicopter were four Qatari military personnel, a Turkish serviceman, and two technicians from a Turkish defense company.

text: Nahibaluan nga may military base ang Turkey sa Qatar kag may yara sang defense agreement sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod halin pa sang 2014.
english: Turkey has a military base in Qatar and there has been a defense agreement between the two countries since 2014.

text: Natabo ang pagtibusok sang helicopter samtang padayon man ang bombahanay sang US kag Israel sa Iran, nga ginabalusan naman sang Tehran paagi sa pag-atake naman sa mga kaalyado sang duha ka pungsod sa Gulf.
english: The helicopter crash occurred as the US and Israel continue to bomb Iran, which Tehran is retaliating by attacking the two Gulf countries' allies.

text: Huring-huring sa karun ang istorya nga posible nga pagabaklon sang former Governor kag prominente nga businessman nga si Chavit Singson ang Miss Universe Organization.
english: There are rumors that former Governor and prominent businessman Chavit Singson may buy the Miss Universe Organization.

text: Ginpahayag man nga makigkita si Singson sa nasambit nga organization sa masunod nga bulan sa posibilidad nga pagbakal sini.
english: Singson will also meet with the organization next month on the possibility of buying it.

text: Nag-ugat ang iya nga plano matapos ang isyu sang Thailand kag Mexico sa gintalikdan nga Miss Universe 2025 pageant.

text: Gin-athag sang optical professional nga ang kalabanan nga nagatubo nga ‘bump’ sa mata ang isa ka timos-timos ukon hordeolum.
english: The optical professional explained that most of the bumps that grow in the eye are a thymus or hordeolum.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Katherine Francia, Chairperson sang Department of Ophthalmology sa Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC), iya ginpahayag nga may duha ka klase sang timos-timos, ini amo ang external kag internal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Katherine Francia, Chairperson of the Department of Ophthalmology at the Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC), said there are two types of thymus, external and internal.

text: Suno kay Francia, ang external hordeolum ang isa ka hapaw nga bump nga makit-an sa mata, samtang ang internal na man amo ang may mas madalom nga bump.
english: According to Francia, the external hordeolum is a superficial bump that can be seen with the naked eye, while the internal one has a deeper bump.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang external nga timos-timos ang yara lamang sa glands sang milok, rason nga kon magbunot sang strand sang sini, gilayon ini nga nagakupos.
english: He also explained that the external thymus is only in the glands of the milok, which is why when you pull a strand of it, it immediately shrinks.

text: Bangud man nga ang nana naga-agi sa ginbunotan sang milok rason nga nagaguwa ini gilayon.
english: Because the pus passes through the throat, it comes out immediately.

text: Ginklaro man sang natungdan nga ang internal nga timos-timos ang indi magkupos bisan pa nga uboson gabot ang mga milok.
english: He also clarified that the internal timos-timos will not shrink even if the milok are exhausted.

text: Ini bangud man sa madalom nga posisyon sini sa gland sang eyelashes.

text: Sa selebrasyon sang ika-81 nga kaadlawan ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, nagpanawagan liwat si Vice President Sara Duterte nga magpabilin nga malig-on agud nga mapangapinan ang kinamatarong sang iya amay.
english: In the celebration of former President Rodrigo Duterte's 81st birthday, Vice President Sara Duterte once again called on the people to remain steadfast in order to defend the rights of her father.

text: “As we celebrate, we also stand firm.
english: “As we celebrate, we also stand firm.

text: The defense of his rights is a defense of our national sovereignty,” suno sa bise presidente sa iya ginpagwa nga video message, Marso 28.
english: The vice president said in a video message released on March 28.

text: Gintawag sini nga “unconstitutional intrusion” ang pagdala sa iya amay sa The Hague agud mag-atubang sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: He called it an “unconstitutional intrusion” to bring his father to The Hague to appear before the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: “We must remain vigilant against the weaponization of the law and the unconstitutional intrusion of foreign bodies that seek to bypass our own courts.
english: “We must remain vigilant against the weaponization of the law and the unconstitutional intrusion of foreign bodies that seek to bypass our own courts.

text: Our justice system must remain independent, serving only the mandate of the Filipino people and never the interests of foreign powers,” dugang ni Sara.
english: Our justice system must remain independent, serving only the mandate of the Filipino people and never the interests of foreign powers,” Sara added.

text: Naka-detain ang amay nga Duterte sa ICC detention facility sa Netherlands halin sang Marso 2025 kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga crimes against humanity nga nag-ugat sa iya kontrobersyal nga drug war.
english: Duterte's father has been detained in the ICC detention facility in the Netherlands since March 2025 and faces charges of crimes against humanity stemming from his controversial drug war.

text: Natapos na ang confirmation of charges hearing kag ginahulat na lang ang desisyon sang Pre-Trial Chamber 1 kun ipasaka sa trial ang amo nga kaso.

text: Sa gin-post ni VP Duterte nga video, nagpasalamat man ini sa tanan nga nagapalangga kag nagadumdom sa iya amay.

text: “To all the parallel support groups, volunteers, and the millions of Filipinos here and abroad who organized celebrations to honor him, maraming salamat sa inyong walang sawang pagmamahal at katapatan.

english: Through the storms and challenges, your resilience remains our inspiration.

text: SA NAHIBAL-AN ta na, ang Netherlands isa ka low-lying nga pungsod sa Uropa nga halos katunga sini nagatindog lang sang isa ka metro above sea level kag ang isa sa walo (1/8) ka bahin sini below sea level pa.
english: AS WE KNOW, the Netherlands is a low-lying country in Europe with almost half of it standing only one meter above sea level and one in eight (1/8) of it still below sea level.

text: In fact, tungod sini, may malawig ini nga flood history halin pa sadtong ginatos ka libu ka tuig nga nagliligad.
english: In fact, because of this, it has a long flood history dating back hundreds of thousands of years.

text: Ginatos ka libu man gani nga kabuhi sang tawo kag ila mga kahayupan ang kinuha sini.
