text: Pati na ang pangkabuhian sang mga pumuluyo nga nagpatulo gid sang ila mapait nga mga luha.
english: Even the livelihood of the people who shed their bitter tears.

text: Ang masakit pa gid kay ginsul-ob pa sang dagat ang malapad nga kadutaan sini halin sa baybayon nga nagaatubang sa North Sea tubtub sa agricultural lands sa takas, nga ang daku nga bahin sini nangin Zuiderzee Bay nga nagpabilin nga amo sina sa madugay nga panahon tubtub na-reclaim sang ulihi ang daku nga bahin sini balik sa agricultural land.
english: To make matters worse, the sea still wore away its vast lands from the coast facing the North Sea to the agricultural lands beyond, with much of it becoming the Zuiderzee Bay which remained so for a long time until much of it was later reclaimed back to agricultural land.

text: Ginpalala pa ini nga problema sang Global Warming nga nagtuga sang mahaliton nga Climate Change nga dala sang Industrial Revolution sa Uropa tubtub sa Estados Unidos sugod sadtong ika-18 tubtub ika-19 ka siglo.
english: This problem was exacerbated by Global Warming which caused the devastating Climate Change brought about by the Industrial Revolution in Europe to the United States from the 18th to the 19th century.

text: Ining Climate Change nagpataas sang surface temperature sang kalibutan, nga nagtuga sang pagtaas man sang sea level, mas frequent kag mas madamol nga pagtupa sang ulan, mas mahaliton nga mga bagyo, kag malawig nga tagtuyot (drought) kag heat wave, nga luyag tambagan sang mga siyentipiko batok sa pagdugang sang pagtaas sini sa 1.5 degrees Celsius agud mapunggan ang mas disastrous nga epekto sini.
english: This climate change has increased the world's surface temperature, which has also caused sea level rise, more frequent and heavier rainfall, more damaging storms, and prolonged droughts and heat waves, which scientists want to advise against increasing its rise to 15 degrees Celsius to prevent further disaster. its effect.

text: Angot diri, ginarekomendar nila mayormante ang pagpanubo sang greenhouse gas (CHG) emission nga tuga sang dugang nga paggamit sang fossil fuel (oil, natural gas, coal) sa halos tanan nga hulag sang mga tawo, nga, in fact, indi pa man lubos mapatuman.
english: In this regard, they mainly recommend reducing greenhouse gas (CHG) emissions caused by the increased use of fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) in almost all human activities, which, in fact, have not yet been fully implemented.

text: Tungod sini, ang ordinaryo nga pamensaron sang tawo amo nga tubtub sa karon gahikahos gihapon ang Netherlands sa wala katapusan nga problema sini sa flooding kag sang dugang nga mga problema nga dala sang Climate Change.
english: Because of this, the ordinary thinking is that the Netherlands is still struggling with its endless problem of flooding and the additional problems brought about by Climate Change.

text: Pero, nagsala kita.
english: But, we were wrong.

text: Dala sang duna nga adventurist mercantile spirit sang mga Dutch (pumuluyo sang Netherlands), nagsugod sila sa pag-explore sang nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang kalibutan kung diin pwede nila makitaan, kag nakitaan gid, sang oportunidad sa pagnegosyo.
english: Driven by the inherent adventurist mercantile spirit of the Dutch (residents of the Netherlands), they began to explore different parts of the world where they could find, and did find, business opportunities.

text: Nagpasanyog ini sang shipping trade indi lang halin sa Netherlands kag kaingod nga pungsod sa Uropa kundi pabalik man dira sa ila halin mayormante sa Asya kag Africa, nga nagtulod sang pagtukod sang mga seaport sa Neetherlands (sobra 20 tubtub sa karon).
english: This promoted shipping trade not only from the Netherlands and neighboring European countries but also back to them from mainly Asia and Africa, leading to the establishment of seaports in the Netherlands (over 20 to date).

text: Kag sa wala lang madugay gindominar na sang Netherlands ang shipping trade sang Uropa, nga naupangan lang sang mga gyera nga naglakip sang WW I kag WW II.
english: And the Netherlands soon dominated Europe's shipping trade, interrupted only by the wars that included WW I and WW II.

text: Tubtub nangin Titanic Commecial Power ang Netherlands sa pagsulod pa lang sang 17th century (Golden Age sa Netherlands).
english: Until the Netherlands became a Titanic Commercial Power at the beginning of the 17th century (Golden Age in the Netherlands).

text: Karon gani, lakip na ini sa 14 ka manggaran nga pungsod sa kalibutan.
english: Today, it is among the 14 richest countries in the world.

text: Kilala man ini sa talalupangdon nga mga hinimuan sang Dutch adventurist spirit sa arts, science, kag technology.
english: It is also known for the remarkable achievements of the Dutch adventurist spirit in the arts, science, and technology.

text: Diri man napatindog ang mga upisina sang madamo nga international organizations katulad sang International Court of Justice, International Criminal Court,  Permanent Court of Arbitration, kag mismo ang mga European Union organizations katulad sang European Medicines Agency, European Parliament liaison office in the Netherlands, European Investment  Bank, European Police Office, kag Galileo Reference Center.
english: It is also home to the offices of many international organizations such as the International Court of Justice, the International Criminal Court, the Permanent Court of Arbitration, and the European Union organizations themselves such as the European Medicines Agency, the European Parliament liaison office in the Netherlands, the European Investment Bank, the European Police Office, and the Galileo Reference Center.

text:
***

In fact, sa sige man nga pag-asenso sang ekonomiya sang Netherlands, lubos na nabayaran sini ang iya mga kautangan kag nagamit pa ang dugang nga kita sang gobyerno sa pagtukod sang mga kinahanglan nga mga proyekto batok sa daku sini nga problema sa flooding kag mga problema nga dala sang Climate Change.
english:
***

In fact, as the Netherlands' economy continues to grow, it has fully paid off its debts and used the additional government revenue to build necessary projects against its huge problem of flooding and problems brought about by Climate Change.

text: Sa pagpatindog lang sang 27-meter seawall (Afsluitdijk), naggasto diri ang Netherlands sang sobra $2.5 ka Bilyon.
english: Just to build the 27-meter seawall (Afsluitdijk), the Netherlands spent over $2.5 billion.

text: Indi man lahog-lahog ang ginasto sini sa sea dike rings (primary kag secondary) batok sa storm surges sa mga panghigaron nga wala masakop sang seawall.
english: It also spent a lot of money on sea dike rings (primary and secondary) against storm surges in areas not covered by the seawall.

text: Subong man sa pagpatuman sang Room for the River Program nga makapahagan-hagan sang pagbinaha-baha sa kapatagan paagi sa pagpatukod sang mga river branches, malapad nga water channels, kag floodplains nga magasalo sang sobra nga inundation.
english: Also in the implementation of the Room for the River Program that will mitigate flooding in the plains by building river branches, wide water channels, and floodplains that will absorb excessive inundation.

text: Kabahin ini tanan nga mga proyekto sang Delta Works/Zuiderzee Works, nga ginkilala na nga isa sa Seven Wonders of the Modern World, nga ang inisyatibo sa pag-away sa severe flooding nangin ejemplo pa sang mga pungsod nga may kasubong nga problema sa Netherlands.
english: These are all part of the projects of the Delta Works/Zuiderzee Works, which has been recognized as one of the Seven Wonders of the Modern World, whose initiative to combat severe flooding has become an example for countries with similar problems to the Netherlands.

text: Ang Vietnam ang una nga nag-adoptar sang inisyatibo sang Netherlands bilang kabahin sang Mekong Delta Plan tungod sang similaridad sang Mekong kag Dutch river deltas nga vulnerable sa flooding.
english: Vietnam was the first to adopt the Netherlands initiative as part of the Mekong Delta Plan due to the similarity of the Mekong and Dutch river deltas being vulnerable to flooding.

text: Nagsunod man ang iban pa nga mga pungsod, katulad sang North Folk (Virginia, USA), kag ang Bangladesh, nga nagkuha man sang bulig sang Netherlands sa Delta Program sini.
english: Other countries followed, such as North Folk (Virginia, USA), and Bangladesh, which also received help from the Netherlands in its Delta Program.

text: Samtang, ang Netherlands katapo man sang EU National Energy and Climate Program (2021-2030) nga nagapadayon sang away batok sa GHG.
english: Meanwhile, the Netherlands is also a member of the EU National Energy and Climate Program (2021-2030) which continues the fight against GHG.

english: Ravena added that Iloilo City is also one of the pioneers in implementing the said committee.

text: Nagpanawagan sila sang kooperasyon kag pagbinuligay sa publiko agud mas mangin epektibo ang pagpatigayon sang nasambit nga inisyatibo.
english: They called for the cooperation and cooperation of the public to make the initiative more effective.

text: Nagpaandam ang militar sang Iran nga dalayon nila nga siraduhan ang bilog nga Strait of Hormuz pananglitan bombahan sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang mga power plant sang Tehran.
english: Iran's military has warned that it will immediately close the entire Strait of Hormuz if the United States bombs Tehran's power plants.

text: Suno sa Iran, indi nila pagbuksan ang bilog nga Strait tubtub nga indi pa nila maubos tukod ang power plants nga gub-on sang Estados Unidos.
english: Iran says it will not open the entire Strait until it finishes building the power plants that the United States will destroy.

text: “If the United States’ threats regarding Iran’s power plants are carried out… the Strait of Hormuz will be completely closed, and it will not be reopened until our destroyed power plants are rebuilt,” suno sa military operational command nga Khatam Al-Anbiya sa statement nga ginpagwa paagi sa Iranian state television.
english: “If the United States’ threats regarding Iran’s power plants are carried out… the Strait of Hormuz will be completely closed, and it will not be reopened until our destroyed power plants are rebuilt,” military operational command Khatam Al-Anbiya said in a statement released via Iranian state television.

text: Nagpaandam man sila nga atakehon nila ang power plants, energy, kag information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure sang Iran kag ang mga power plants sa mga pungsod sa Middle East nga may yara sang US bases kag mga kumpaniya nga may US shareholders.
english: They also warned that they would attack Iran’s power plants, energy, and information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and power plants in Middle Eastern countries with US bases and companies with US shareholders.

text: Gindugang sang Iran nga dugangan pa nila ang ila ibalos agud nga depensahan ang ila pungsod sa interes sang ila nasyon kag mga pumuluyo.
english: Iran added that it will increase its retaliation to defend its country in the interest of its country and people.

text: Matandaan nga antes sini, nagpaandam si US President Donald Trump kahapon nga may 48 lang ka oras ang Iran agud buksan ang Strait bangud kun indi, atakehon sang US ang ila energy infrastructures lakip ang power plants.
english: Earlier, US President Donald Trump warned yesterday that Iran has only 48 hours to open the Strait because otherwise, the US will attack their energy infrastructures including power plants.

text: Ginbalabagan sang Iran ang Strait of Hormuz kag ginaalegar nga ginpangbutangan sang mga bomba halin sang nagsugod ang gyera sa Middle East sang Pebrero 28, apang may pila pa ka mga barko nga nagaagi diri nga indi iya sang Amerika kag Israel.
english: Iran has blockaded the Strait of Hormuz and allegedly bombed it since the war in the Middle East began on February 28, but there are still several non-American and Israeli ships passing through it.

text: Tuman ka importante ini nga Strait bangud diri nagaagi ang 25% sang langis nga ginagamit sang kalibutan.
english: The Strait is very important because 25% of the world's oil passes through it.

text: Nangin emoyonal ang NBA legend nga si Lebron James pagkatapos sang iya hampang batok sa Cleveland bangud sa huring-huring sa possible sini nga pagretiro.
english: NBA legend Lebron James became emotional after his game against Cleveland over rumors of his possible retirement.

text: Sa 23 sini ka tuig nga karera sa National Basketball Association, nadag-an na ni Lebron ang apat ka kampyonato kag nagpanguna man sa puwesto sa all-time scoring list.
english: In his 23-year career in the National Basketball Association, Lebron has won four championships and topped the all-time scoring list.

text: Wala pa sang desisyon ang Lakers icon kun san-o ini magaretiro apang suno sa iya nga kun indi sa subong san-o pa.
english: The Lakers icon has not yet decided when he will retire but he said that if not now when.

text: Sa subong motivated pa ini sa iya hampang kaupod si Luka Doncic kag ang iya anak nga si Brony kun sa diin naga-average ini sang 22 points sa iya kada hampang sa sini nga season.
english: He is still motivated by his game with Luka Doncic and his son Brony where he is averaging 22 points per game this season.

text: Suno sa mga analyst, possible nga magapadayon si Lebron sang isa pa ka season, apang nagapabilin ang palamangkutanon kun handa sini nga pagabatunon ang possible nga buhin sa iya sweldo sa iya team nga Lakers.
english: According to analysts, Lebron is likely to continue for another season, but the question remains whether he is willing to accept a possible salary cut for his team, the Lakers.

text: Wala pa sang nakita nga peligro ang Malacañang sang “energy lockdown” ukon kakulangan sang suplay sang kuryente kag langis sa pungsod apisar sa naga-lala nga kinagamo sa Middle East.
english: Malacañang has not yet seen any danger of an energy lockdown or shortage of electricity and oil supply in the country despite the escalating unrest in the Middle East.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro, sa subong nga tion malayo pa ang pungsod sa sitwasyon pareho sang dekada ’70 nga may fuel rationing kag wala sang mga salakyan.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said the country is currently far from a situation like the 1970s with fuel rationing and no cars.

text: Dugang pa sang opisyal, bilang kabahin sang contingency plan sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., aktibo nga nagapangita ang Department of Energy kag Department of Foreign Affairs sang alternatibo nga kuhaan sang produktong petrolyo nga wala naga-salig sa Middle East.
english: The official added that as part of the contingency plan of the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., the Department of Energy and Department of Foreign Affairs are actively looking for alternative sources of petroleum products that do not rely on the Middle East.

text: Ginmensyonar man ni Castro ang report ni Energy Secretary Sharon Garin nga sa subong naga-pakig-angot na ang Pilipinas sa mga pungsod kaangay sang India, Argentina, kag Canada agud masiguro ang padayon nga suplay sang langis sa pungsod.
english: Castro also mentioned the report of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin that the Philippines is now in contact with countries such as India, Argentina, and Canada to ensure the continuous supply of oil in the country.

text: Dugang pa ni Castro, samtang nagalaom ang gobyerno sa diplomatiko nga resolusyon sa tunga sang mga nagakinagamo nga pungsod, padayon man ang pagpanghanda sang Presidente agud malikawan ang pinakamalala nga sitwasyon nga mahimo magpabudlay sa mga Pilipino.
english: Castro added that while the government hopes for a diplomatic resolution between the conflicting countries, the President is also continuing to prepare to avoid the worst situation that could make it difficult for Filipinos.

text: Natapos na ang kampanya sang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa labing-una nga edisyon sang WTA 125 Philippine Women’s Open.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala's campaign in the first edition of the WTA 125 Philippine Women's Open has come to an end.

text: Ini matapos nalutos siya sa quarterfinals sa kamot sang Colombian nga si Camila Osorio, 4-6, 4-6, sa Rizal Memorial Tennis Center.
english: This was after she lost in the quarterfinals to Colombian Camila Osorio, 4-6, 4-6, at the Rizal Memorial Tennis Center.

text: Nanugon si Eala nga indi na siya makapadayon pa sa semifinals, apang ang mas importante suno sa iya, nadala ang WTA match diri sa Pilipinas kag mas madamo nga mga Pilipino ang nakalantaw.
english: Eala admitted that she will not be able to continue to the semifinals, but more importantly, she said, the WTA match was brought here in the Philippines and more Filipinos watched.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini ang iya nga international match nga ginhiwat sa atubang sang Filipino fans diri sa pungsod.
english: It is known that this is his international match held in front of Filipino fans here in the country.

text: “Sayang, hindi pumasa sa level pero ang importante, nandito ako sa Manila, sa Pilipinas at nandito ang WTA.
english: “Unfortunately, I didn't pass the level but the important thing is, I was in Manila, in the Philippines and the WTA was here.

text: Enjoy the rest of the week, I hope you all guys get inspired and learn to love tennis.
english: Enjoy the rest of the week, I hope you all guys get inspired and learn to love tennis.

text: I love tennis so much so I’m lucky to be able to share this experience and journey with all of you.
english: I love tennis so much so I’m lucky to be able to share this experience and journey with all of you.

text: Maraming salamat,” pahayag sang Pinay star.
english: Thank you very much,” the Filipina star said.

text: Maga-atubang naman si Osorio kay Solana Sierra sang Argentina nga amo naman ang naglutos kay Lanlana Tararudee sang Thailand, 6-3, 6-4, sa quarterfinal match.
english: Osorio will face Solana Sierra of Argentina, who defeated Lanlana Tararudee of Thailand, 6-3, 6-4, in the quarterfinal match.

text: Mangin masako naman si Eala sa WTA 500 Mubadala Abu Dhabi kun sa diin magadiretso siya sa main draw matapos napilian bilang wildcard.
english: Eala will be busy at the WTA 500 Mubadala Abu Dhabi where she will go straight to the main draw after being selected as a wildcard.

text: TUNGOD nasakop na sang polderland (reclaimed inundated areas) kag nasarhan na ang 3/5 sang Zuiderzee Bay sang shut-off/closure dam (Afsluitdijk), ano na ang matabo sa mga shipping vessels nga luyag magsulod sa seaports sang Netherlands paagi sa sadto Zuiderzee Bay?
english: WITH polderland (reclaimed inundated areas) and 3/5 of the Zuiderzee Bay closed by the shut-off/closure dam (Afsluitdijk), what will happen to shipping vessels that want to enter the seaports of the Netherlands through the former Zuiderzee Bay?

text: Manabaw ang Zuderzee Bay, apang nagamit ini sa shipping activities sa exports kag imports sang Netherlands pagkatapos nga gin-dredge ini.
english: Zuderzee Bay is shallow, but it was used for shipping activities in the exports and imports of the Netherlands after it was dredged.

text: Gani nagamit ini sa pagsulod kag paggwa sa duha ka seaport sang Netherlands sa border sang Wadden Sea, ang 2/5 nga bahin sang Zuiderzee Bay nga ginsarhan sang Afsluitdijk, samtang gina-reclaim ang 3/5 nga bahin sini sa sulod.
english: It was therefore used to enter and exit the two Dutch seaports on the border of the Wadden Sea, the 2/5 of Zuiderzee Bay enclosed by the Afsluitdijk, while reclaiming 3/5 of its interior.

text: Amo ini ang Harlingen Port sa northwest coast sang Netherlands kag ang Den Helder Port sa tabuk sini sa southern end sang Wadden Sea nga ma-access halin sa North Sea.
english: Amo ini ang Harlingen Port sa northwest coast sang Netherlands kag ang Den Helder Port sa tabuk sini sa southern end sang Wadden Sea nga ma-access halin sa North Sea.

text: Mga regional hub ini, kon diin ginabaton kag nagagwa ang mga shipping cargoes halin kag pakadto sa kon diin man nga destinasyon nila.
english: Mga regional hub ini, kon diin ginabaton kag nagagwa ang mga shipping cargoes halin kag pakadto sa kon diin man nga destinasyon nila.

text: Sang ulihi, ugaling, ginpamat-ud sang gobyerno nga ibalik sa orihinal nga kahimtangan ang Wadden Sea, upod ang freshwater Markermeer Lake nga nabilin nga wala ma-reclaim.
english: Sang ulihi, ugaling, ginpamat-ud sang gobyerno nga ibalik sa orihinal nga kahimtangan ang Wadden Sea, upod ang freshwater Markermeer Lake nga nabilin nga wala ma-reclaim.

text: Nahamtang ini sa southmost sang sadto Zuiderzee Bay malapit sa Amsterdam, nga capital city sang Netherlands.
english: Nahamtang ini sa southmost sang sadto Zuiderzee Bay malapit sa Amsterdam, nga capital city sang Netherlands.

text: Gin-deklarar ang Wadden Sea bilang National Park kag tourist site tubtub sa coastline sang Denmark, Germany kag Netherlands tungod sang ecological kag recreational asset sini.
english: The Wadden Sea has been declared a National Park and tourist site up to the coastline of Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands for its ecological and recreational assets.

text: Ginkilala pa gani ini bilang isa ka global heritage site, nga ginabuligan conserve sang tatlo ka pungsod.
english: It has even been recognized as a global heritage site, which three countries help conserve.

text: Ang Markermeer Lake ginpabilin man agud mangin freshwater reservoir kag buffer batok sa floodwaters kag drought.
english: Markermeer Lake was also retained to act as a freshwater reservoir and buffer against floodwaters and drought.

text: In fact, nagluas gani ini sa Amsterdam sang iguon ini sang drought sadtong 2003.
english: In fact, it even came out of Amsterdam when it was hit by drought in 2003.

text: Nonetheless, ang pagkilala na sa Wadden Sea bilang global heritage site wala man makatublag sang operasyon sang duha ka seaport kag sang iban pa sa mga sobra 20 pa ka seaport sa Netherlands bisan pa tungod man sa pagsara sang sadtong Zuiderzee Bay.
english: Nonetheless, the recognition of the Wadden Sea as a global heritage site has not disrupted the operation of the two seaports and others in the more than 20 other seaports in the Netherlands despite the closure of the then Zuiderzee Bay.

text: Ang iban naman nga mga seaport wala man problema sa pag-agi sa shut-off dam tungod bukas-sara man ang mga floodgates sini kon kinahanglan.
english: Other seaports have no problem passing through the shut-off dam because their floodgates are open and closed when necessary.

text: Ginasara lang ang mga ini agud tambagan ang unusual nga taas sang taob (high tide) kag storm surge.
english: They are only closed to advise against unusual high tide and storm surge.

text: Kon indi dira, makaagi man sila sa mga inlet kag waterway canal nga ma-access sa northwest side sang North Sea, katulad sang Den Helder Port, nga yara gihapon sa lokasyon sini nga pwede ma-access halin sa inlet nga gabukas direkta sa North Sea pasulod sa Wadden Sea.
english: Otherwise, they can also pass through inlets and waterway canals accessible on the northwest side of the North Sea, such as Den Helder Port, which is still in its location that can be accessed from the inlet that opens directly into the North Sea into the Wadden Sea.

text: Samtang, ang Harlingen Port isa ka importante nga industrial port sa northwest sang Netherlands nga na-locate sa Western Scheldt estuary agi sa border sang Wadden Sea halin sa North Sea.
english: Meanwhile, Harlingen Port is an important industrial port in the northwest of the Netherlands located in the Western Scheldt estuary through the border of the Wadden Sea from the North Sea.

text: Fortunately, para sa Antwerp Port sang kaingod nga Belgium, indi masolo sang Netherlands ang Scheldt River.
english: Fortunately, para sa Antwerp Port sang kaingod nga Belgium, indi masolo sang Netherlands ang Scheldt River.

text: Ang western lang nga bahin Scheldt River ang sakop sa border sang Netherlands, samtang ang Eastern side kabahin na sang Belgium nga ginagamit sini nga shipping route pakadto kag paggwa sa Antwerp Port dira sa Belgium.
english: Ang western lang nga bahin Scheldt River ang sakop sa border sang Netherlands, samtang ang Eastern side kabahin na sang Belgium nga ginagamit sini nga shipping route pakadto kag paggwa sa Antwerp Port dira sa Belgium.

text: Gani ginpabay-an na lang nga bukas ang Western Scheldt upod sa Eastern Scheldt.
english: So the Western Scheldt was left open along with the Eastern Scheldt.

text: Gin-ugyunan na lang nila ang buligan limpyuhan kag ma-proteksyunan ang Scheldt River.
english: Gin-ugyunan na lang nila ang buligan limpyuhan kag ma-proteksyunan ang Scheldt River.

text: Ginbutangan na lang sang Netherlands ang kilid sang Western Scheldt sang dike nga indi kinahanglan subong ka taas sangsa shut-off dam, nga sang ulihi napataas pa sa mga 27 ka tapak.
english: The Netherlands simply lined the side of the Western Scheldt with a dike that was not necessarily as high as the shut-off dam, which was later raised to about 27 feet.

text: Indi gid man ini problema kay ang Scheldt River isa ka estuary nga ga-free flow halin sa North Sea pasulod sa ngangaan (mouth) kag ga-discharge deretso sa likod sang southern Netherlands pagwa man sa North Sea.
english: This is not a problem because the Scheldt River is an estuary that free flows from the North Sea into the mouth and discharges straight behind the southern Netherlands out into the North Sea.

text: Ang Scheldt River may kalawigon nga 270  ka milya (435 km.).
english: The Scheldt River is 270 miles (435 km.) long.

text:
***

Bangod sa padayon nga pagka-madinalag-on sang sobra 20 ka seaports sang Netherlands, nagpadayon man ang pag-uswag sang Netherlands.
english:
***

Due to the continued competitiveness of the Netherlands’ over 20 seaports, the Netherlands has also continued to grow.

text: Ang Rotterdam Port ginakilala gani bilang pinakadaku nga seaport sa Uropa kag world’s largest seaport sa Asya sa South Holland.
english: Rotterdam Port is therefore recognized as the largest seaport in Europe and the world’s largest seaport in Asia in South Holland.

text: Ang Amsterdam Port kilala man sa pag-serve sang shipping needs indi lang sang Uropa kundi sang iban pa nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: Amsterdam Port is also known for serving the shipping needs of not only Europe but the rest of the world.

text:
***

Daku nga sabat ang shut-off dam sa problema sa flooding kag storm surge sa low-lying mainland Netherlands.
english:
***

The shut-off dam is a big answer to the flooding and storm surge problem in the low-lying mainland Netherlands.

text: Nonetheless, may problema gihapon sa flooding nga madala sang excessive rain kag leak sang pagbinaha-baha halin sa mga kaingod nga mga pungsod.
english: Nonetheless, there is still a problem of flooding caused by excessive rain and leakage of flooding from neighboring countries.

text: So, ginpatuman ang Room for River program/project agud magsalo sang excess inundation nga indi kinahanglan punggan sang mataas nga dike kay makapataas pa ini sa storm rain inundation.
english: So, the Room for River program/project was implemented to absorb the excess inundation that does not need to be stopped by a high dike because it can increase the storm rain inundation.

text: Angot diri ginapatigyon ang clearing sang winter bed nga nagasupon sa water flow sa mga suba, ang pagtuga sang mga river branches, water channels, kag flood plains agud magsalo sang wala malutsan nga baha kag inundation.
english: In this regard, clearing of winter beds that interfere with water flow in rivers, creation of river branches, water channels, and flood plains to absorb untreated floods and inundation are being carried out.

text: Samang indi man ini makasabat sing lubos sang pagtener sang pagbinaha-baha sa low-lying mainland, daku man ini nga bulig agud  mapahagan-hagan ining problema kag matapna dayon.
english: While it does not fully address the persistence of flooding on the low-lying mainland, it is also a great help to mitigate the problem and prevent it immediately.

text: (May Kasugpon)/PN
english: (Attached)/PN

text: Wala gid natabangan ang isa ka 17-anyos nga dalagita matapos ginlampusan sang tubo kag ginkastigo sang iya amay sa Brgy.
english: A 17-year-old girl was beaten with a pipe and beaten by her father in Brgy.

text: Rizal, Sagay City, Negros Occidental.
english: Rizal, Sagay City, Negros Occidental.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Michelle” samtang ang suspek naman amo si alyas “Greg”, 49-anyos.
english: The victim was identified as Michelle while the suspect was identified as Greg, 49 years old.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nagapangayo sang tabang ang biktima apang ginkandaduhan sang suspek ang pwertahan rason nga wala nakasulod ang mga kaingod-balat agud buligan ang biktima.
english: According to the investigation, the victim was calling for help but the suspect locked the door so the neighbors could not enter to help the victim.

text: Sang nagresponde ang kapulisan, wala na sang pangalibutan kag duguon ang dalagita gani gindala ini sa ospital apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: When police responded, the girl was unconscious and bleeding and was rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: Ginapatihan nga nagsuprir sang depresyon ang suspek bangud suno sa mga nakakilala sa iya, pila ka adlaw na ini nga wala nagatulog kag indi mapahamtang.
english: It is believed that the suspect suffered from depression because according to those who knew him, he had not slept for several days and could not calm down.

text: Magasapol liwat ang mga opisyal sang Department of Energy (DOE) sa oil companies subong nga adlaw, Marso 3, bangud sa ginalantaw nga pagtimbuok sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo bangud sa krisis sa Middle East.
english: Department of Energy (DOE) officials will meet again with oil companies today, March 3, to discuss the expected increase in petroleum product prices due to the crisis in the Middle East.

text: Suno kay DOE-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rino Abad, sa meeting subong nga adlaw, istoryahan ang oil price trend kag kun paano sini maapektuhan ang kada semana nga price adjustment.
english: DOE-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rino Abad said today's meeting will discuss the oil price trend and how it will affect the weekly price adjustment.

text: Posible suno kay Abad nga maistoryahan man nga indi man pagtingubon sa kada Martes ang tuman ka dako nga price hike.
english: Abad said it is possible to discuss not to combine the huge price hike every Tuesday.

text: Nagpanugyan man ang ahensya sa mga tag-iya sang salakyan nga magpangita sang pumping stations nga may pinakamanubo nga presyo sang langis, bangud may mga station man suno sa ila nga nagatanyag sang piso tubtub uno-singkwenta nga discount.
english: The agency also advised vehicle owners to look for pumping stations with the lowest price of oil, as there are stations that offer discounts of pesos to one-fifty pesos.

text: Nagapakig-angot naman subong ang DOE sa Department of Transportation (DOTr) kag sa Department of Agriculture (DA) kaangot sa possible nga pag-release sang fuel subsidies.
english: The DOE is now liaising with the Department of Transportation (DOTr) and the Department of Agriculture (DA) regarding the possible release of fuel subsidies.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang ahensya nga possible lab-ot sa P7 tubtub P10 kada litro ang isaka sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana bangud sang epekto sang gyera sang Israel kag US batok sa Iran.
english: The agency earlier warned that the price of petroleum products could rise by P7 to P10 per liter next week due to the impact of the war between Israel and the US against Iran.

text: Bangud sa amo nga gyera, gin-shutdown ang oil and gas facilities sa Middle East kag naapektuhan man ang paglabay sang mga barko sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: The war has shutdown oil and gas facilities in the Middle East and affected shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Sa bahin naman ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., ginpahayag sini nga maga-istorya siya sa congressional leaders agud nga mahatagan siya sang otoridad nga buhinan ang excise taxes sa petroleum products.
english: For his part, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. said he will talk to congressional leaders to give him the authority to reduce excise taxes on petroleum products.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga may bastante nga suplay sang langis ang Pilipinas nga makasarang maglawig sang 50 tubtob 60 ka adlaw, bisan pa sa nagalala nga tensyon sa Middle East.
english: He also assured that the Philippines has enough oil supplies to last 50 to 60 days, despite the escalating tensions in the Middle East.

text: Suno sa presidente, bisan posible nga magsaka ang presyo sang langis bangod sang mga geopolitical tensions, indi dayon maapektuhan sang kakulangan sa suplay ang pungsod bangod may yara sang stockpile sang gasolina, fuel oil, kag kerosene.
english: The president said that although oil prices are likely to rise due to geopolitical tensions, the country will not be immediately affected by supply shortages because it has a stockpile of gasoline, fuel oil, and kerosene.

text: Gindugang pa niya nga ang mga supplier sang petroleum products may yara man sang ila kaugalingon nga imbentaryo nga mahimo pa nila ma-release, nga magahatag sang dugang nga suplay para sa pungsod.
english: He added that suppliers of petroleum products also have their own inventories that they can still release, which will provide more supply for the country.

text: Magapatigayon sang half-day work-from-home ang Iloilo City Government subong nga adlaw, Miyerkules, kasunod sang gin-anunsyo sang Malacañang kahapon bilang kabahin sang pag-obserbar sang Semana Santa.
english: The Iloilo City Government will conduct a half-day work-from-home today, Wednesday, following the announcement of Malacañang yesterday as part of the observance of Easter.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga suno sa ginpagwa nga Memorandum Order, ang mga empleyado sang syudad magatrabaho halin alas-8:00 sang aga tubtob alas-12:00 sang udto paagi sa work-from-home setup.
english: Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said that according to the Memorandum Order, city employees will work from 8:00 am to 12:00 noon through a work-from-home setup.

text: Ginmandu man nga suspendido ang regular nga trabaho sang gobyerno halin alas-12:00 sang udto tubtob alas-5:00 sang hapon bilang kabahin man sang pag-obserbar sang Semana Santa.
english: Regular government work was also ordered suspended from 12:00 noon to 5:00 pm as part of the observance of Easter.

text: Samtang, ginpahamtang naman ang Blue Alert Status sa syudad agud masiguro ang seguridad sang syudad sang mga tawo.
english: Meanwhile, Blue Alert Status has been imposed in the city to ensure the security of the city's people.

text: Ila man ginapahibalo sa publiko nga wala sang onsite work, kag magaresume ang regular nga trabaho sa Lunes, Abril 6, 2026.
english: They also inform the public that there will be no onsite work, and regular work will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.

text: Gindumdum man ang publiko nga magbulig sa pagkonserbar sang enerhiya paagi sa pagpatay sang mga suga kag pag-unplug sang mga appliances kon wala ginagamit, agud malikawan ang disgrasya kag masiguro ang kaluwasan.
english: The public was also reminded to help conserve energy by turning off lights and unplugging appliances when not in use, to avoid accidents and ensure safety.

text: Sa pihak sini, ang frontline services sang syudad magapadayon sa normal nga operasyon agud maserbisyuhan gihapon ang publiko.
english: Meanwhile, the city's frontline services will continue to operate normally to serve the public.

text: Ginhatagan sang igtalupangod sang ENT (Ear, Nose, and Throat) specialist ang ‘common all-year-round’ nga kaso sang ear problems.
english: The ENT (Ear, Nose, and Throat) specialist drew attention to the ‘common all-year-round’ case of ear problems.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Joebert Villanueva, head sang ENT Care Center sa Western Visayas Medical Center, iya ginpahayag nga 80% sa outpatient sa ila talatapan ang nagapangatubang sang problema sa dulunggan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Joebert Villanueva, head of the ENT Care Center at the Western Visayas Medical Center, said that 80% of the outpatients in their office are facing ear problems.

text: Suno kay Villanueva, wala sang season nga ginapili ang balatian sa hearing ukon ear problem.
english: According to Villanueva, there is no season that chooses hearing diseases or ear problems.

text: Lakip man sa ginpunto sini ang ‘impacted cerumen’ ukon ang mga nagabagtik nga tutuli nga isa sa nagapanguna nga kaso sa idalom sang ear problems.
english: He also pointed out the impacted cerumen, which is one of the leading causes of ear problems.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga isa man sa gina-eksperyensya sang kadam-an amo ang ‘Otitis externa’ ukon ang inflammation sang ear canal nga mahimo makatuga sang pagkabungol kon indi mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: He also said that one of the most common conditions is 'Otitis externa' or inflammation of the ear canal that can cause deafness if not given proper treatment.

text: Nagmando si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered

text: nga i-recalibrate ang preparasyon sang Pilipinas para sa ASEAN 2026 agud nga makakinot kag magatutok lamang sa mas importante nga mga isyu.
english: to recalibrate the Philippines' preparation for ASEAN 2026 to save money and focus only on more important issues.

text: Suno sa presidente, bilang kabahin nga tikang, ila na lang patigayunon online ang ginabulubanta nga 650 ka preparatory meetings.
english: The president said that as part of the measure, they will conduct the estimated 650 preparatory meetings online.

text: Lakip diri ang mga meeting sang working groups, senior officials, kag ministerial level.
english: This includes meetings of working groups, senior officials, and ministerial level.

text: Ginkumpirmar man niya nga himuon nga simple ang Leaders’ Summit sa Mayo, nga maga-focus sa mga kinahanglan nga tutukan nga isyu kaangay sang energy security, mga pagkaon, kag kaayuhan sang migrant workers.
english: He also confirmed that the Leaders’ Summit in May will be kept simple, focusing on much-needed issues such as energy security, foods, and the welfare of migrant workers.

text: Nagpagwa na sang memorandum ang gobyerno agud ipatuman ini nga mga pagbag-o, lakip na ang paghiwat sang diplomatic briefings sang Department of Foreign Affairs.
english: The government has already issued a memorandum to implement these changes, including holding diplomatic briefings by the Department of Foreign Affairs.

text: Suno naman kay Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, katuyuan sini nga tikang nga mapabakod ang pagbinuligay sang Southeast Asian nations kag makahimo sang konkreto nga sabat sa mga nagakatabo nga global challenges, ilabi na subong ang ginapangatubang nga krisis sa Middle East.
english: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said the move aims to strengthen cooperation between Southeast Asian nations and develop concrete responses to ongoing global challenges, especially the current crisis in the Middle East.

text: Ginapaabot man nga magapatigayon ang gobyerno sang dugang nga pagkinot kag mahatag ang pondo sa mga programa nga magabulig sa mga pumuluyo nga apektado sang global oil crisis.
english: The government is also expected to implement further austerity and allocate funds to programs that will help the people affected by the global oil crisis.

text: Ginpabutyag sang gobyerno nga mas importante subong ang madali kag praktikal nga solusyon kag indi ang engrande nga seremonya.
english: The government has stressed that easy and practical solutions are more important now than grand ceremonies.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Senate President Pro Tempore kag Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman Ping Lacson nga ginrekomenda sang committee ang pagpasaka sang kaso nga plunder kag graft batok sa tatlo ka incumbent senators kag tatlo ka mga anay matag-as nga opisyal sang gobyerno bangud sa kahilabtanan sa anomalya sa flood control projects.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore and Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman Ping Lacson confirmed that the committee recommended the filing of plunder and graft cases against three incumbent senators and three former senior government officials for their involvement in anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Nalakip sa mga ginhingadlan amo sanday Senator Jinggoy Estrada, Senator Joel Villanueva kag Senator Chiz Escudero amo man ang mga anay mamalidha nga sanday Bong Revilla, Zaldy Co, kag Mitch Cajayon-Uy.
english: Among those named are Senator Jinggoy Estrada, Senator Joel Villanueva and Senator Chiz Escudero as well as former lawmakers Bong Revilla, Zaldy Co, and Mitch Cajayon-Uy.

text: Suno kay Lacson, nagapangatubang na sa imbestigasyon ang mga ini kag may pila man nga ginmanduan nga arestuhon bangud sa pagkaulamid sa nasambit nga anomalya.
english: Lacson said they are already facing investigation and some have been ordered to be arrested for their involvement in the anomaly.

text: Sa karun, apat (4) pa lamang ang nagpirma sa nasambit nga draft kag indi pa ini opisyal nga report sang committee.
english: At present, only four (4) have signed the draft and it is not yet an official report of the committee.

text: Ang mga nagpirma pa lamang sa karun amo sanday Lacson, senator Risa Hontiveros, senator Bam Aquino, kag senator Kiko Pangilinan, matapos nga nag-atras ang tatlo ka myembro.
english: The only ones who have signed are Lacson, Senator Risa Hontiveros, Senator Bam Aquino, and Senator Kiko Pangilinan, after three members withdrew.

text: Kinahanglan sa karun sang onse (11) ka pirma agud mapresentar ang nasambit nga report sa plenaryo sang Senado.
english: Eleven (11) signatures are currently required to present the said report to the Senate plenary.

text: Gintawag ni US President Donald Trump nga “talawit” ang mga kaalyado sa North Atlantic Treaty Organization ukon NATO bangud wala sang mga ini ginsapak ang iya panawagan para sa bulig militar kontra sa Iran agud makontrol ang Strait of Hormuz.
english: US President Donald Trump has called his allies in the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) “traitors” because they ignored his call for military help against Iran to control the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ginpahayag ni Trump nga apisar nagasaka ang presyo sang produktong petrolyo bangod sa krisis, nagapadayon sa gihapon ang iban nga pungsod nga wala nagabulig.
english: Trump said that despite the rising price of petroleum products due to the crisis, other countries continue not to help.

text: Samtang, may pila naman ka mga pungsod nga nagpahayag nga handa sila maghatag sang kontribusyon, apang wala pa sila sang pormal nga commitment.
english: Meanwhile, some countries have expressed their willingness to contribute, but they have not yet made a formal commitment.

text: May ara naman sang iban nga pungsod nga naga hulat anay nga mag-untat ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: There are other countries that are waiting for the war in the Middle East to end.

text: Sa subong, ginapahayag nga ang pagbalabag sang Iran nakaapekto sa dalagan sang mga barko nga may karga nga langis nagikan sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: So far, the Iranian blockade has reportedly affected the flow of oil-laden ships from the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ini man ang rason ukon ang ginhalinan sang pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: This is also the reason or the source of the increase in the price of petroleum products around the world.

text: SANG nagbalik na ang kalinong pagkatapos sang WW I sadtong 1918, back to business na ang Netherlands kag nagpadayon ang pag-prosper sini sa pagsanyog liwat sang iya mga land-based nga mga industriya, commercial activities, kag maritime trade.
english: WHEN peace returned after WW I in 1918, the Netherlands was back to business and continued to prosper with the revival of its land-based industries, commercial activities, and maritime trade.

text: Kag ina bisan pa nagaprolema gihapon sila sang indi kinaandan nga pagbinaha-baha (flooding) nga dala sang sobra nga pag-inulan kag storm surges nga nagadalasdas pa-takas (upstream) halin sa mabagyuhon nga North Sea nga dala sang Climate Change.
english: And that's despite the fact that they are still facing unusual flooding caused by excessive rainfall and storm surges that rush upstream from the stormy North Sea caused by Climate Change.

text:
Luas sina, ginaproblema man nila ang tagtuyot (drought)

bangod sang temperature rise nga 1.7 degrees Centigrade kag ang paglawig sini sangsa kinaandan.
english:
In addition, they are also having problems with drought

due to the temperature rise of 1.7 degrees Centigrade and its prolongation than usual.

text: Subong man ang indi na balanse nga pattern sang water cycle nga nagabutang sa alang-alang sa naandan nga scheduling sang tagtalanom kag tag-alani sang food crops sa Netherlands.
english: As well as the unbalanced pattern of the water cycle that threatens the usual scheduling of planting and harvesting of food crops in the Netherlands.

text: Ining problema sa water cycle nangin problema man gani sang Filipinas.
english: This water cycle problem has even become a problem for the Philippines.

text: Kon sa masami ang Setyembre panahon na sang hangin Amihan kag tag-ilinit, kag tag-alani man sa madamo nga lugar sa Filipinas, indi na.
english: While September is usually the time of the northerly winds and summer, and also the harvest season in many parts of the Philippines, it is not.

text: Sunu sa Pag-asa, sang Oktubre lang nagluntad ang Amihan.
english: According to Pag-asa, the Amihan only appeared in October.

text: Gani, ang malain nga panahon nga dala sang Habagat padayon nga nanghalit sang madamo nga alanihon, nga kon indi man bangod sa bagyo, bangod ato sa madamol nga pag-inulan nga nagdala sang madalom nga pagbinaha-baha.
english: Thus, the bad weather brought by the Southwest continued to damage many crops, which if not because of the typhoon, because of the heavy rains that brought deep flooding.

text: Sobra katunga sang land area sang Netherlands ginagamit sa agrikultura, mainly sa trigo (wheat) para sa ila staple food, kag animal feeds sang minilyon sini nga mga baka, baboy, kag mga manok, which makes it bilang biggest meat exporter sa Uropa.
english: More than half of the Netherlands' land area is used for agriculture, mainly wheat for its staple food, and animal feeds for its millions of cattle, pigs, and chickens, which makes it Europe's largest meat exporter.

text:
***

Sa madugay nga panahon sugod sang pagluntad sang mga tawo sa baybayon sang Netherlands ginbakasan na sang mga tawo dira kag sang gobyerno agud ma-control ang storm surges kag flooding halin sa North Sea paagi sa mga artificial barriers ukon dikes.
english:
***

For a long time since the existence of people, the coast of the Netherlands has been dredged by local people and the government to control storm surges and flooding from the North Sea through artificial barriers or dikes.

text: Kag sang na-create sang flooding ang Zuiderzee Bay ginbutangan man sang dikes ang palibut sini.
english: And when the Zuiderzee Bay was created by flooding, dikes were also placed around it.

text: Ugaling sadtong 1916 gin-igu ini sang disastrous storm surges nga nagwasak sang mga dike sini.
english: But in 1916 it was hit by disastrous storm surges that destroyed its dikes.

text: Liwat ginpatindugan ang Zuiderzee Bay sang 19-mile nga dike sa ganhaan sini agud ma-transform ang tatlo sa lima (3/5) sang area sini bilang freshwater lake (IJsselmeer) nga kinahanglan mapamala paagi sa pumps kag iban pa padugi agud mapuslan liwat bilang farmlands.
english: Zuiderzee Bay was rebuilt with a 19-mile dike at its entrance to transform three-fifths of its area into a freshwater lake (IJsselmeer) that needs to be drained by pumps and other measures to be reused as farmlands.

text: Ang nabilin sa Zuideerzee Bay nga 2/5 ginpabilin nga nasul-ob sang dagat nga sang ulihi ginhingadlan ini nga Wadden Sea.
english: The rest of the Zuideerzee Bay 2/5 was kept submerged by the sea which later renamed it the Wadden Sea.

text: May kataason na ining dikes sang mga 4.5 ka tapak ang halin sa 2.25 ka tapak sadto palibut sa Zuiderzee Bay.
english: The dikes are now about 4.5 feet high from 2.25 feet around Zuiderzee Bay.

text: Gin-establisar ang una nga reclaimed area (polder) sadtong 1930.
english: The first reclaimed area (polder) was established in the 1930s.

text: Ang ikaduha ka polder sadtong 1942 sa katung-anan sang WW 2 (1939-1945).
english: The second polder was in 1942 in the middle of WW 2 (1939-1945).

text: Wala gin-respeto sang Nazi Germany sa idalom ni Adolf Hitler ang neutrality sang Netherlands kag gin-atake gid ini sadtong Mayo 10 1940.
english: Nazi Germany under Adolf Hitler did not respect the neutrality of the Netherlands and attacked it on May 10, 1940.

text: Nag-surrender ang Dutch (Netherlands) forces sadtong Mayo 15, 1940, kag gin-control na sang Nazi Germany ang pamulitika kag maritime trade sini.
english: Dutch (Netherlands) forces surrendered on May 15, 1940, and Nazi Germany took control of its politics and maritime trade.

text: Nalagyo ang Dutch government kag ang royal family sang Netherlands kag nag-relocate sa London, ang iban sa Ottawa, Canada tubtub sa katapusan sang WW 2..
english: The Dutch government and the royal family of the Netherlands fled and relocated to London, some to Ottawa, Canada until the end of WW 2..

text: Nagdaug ang Allies.
english: The Allies won.

text: Nagsurrender ang Italy sadtong Setyembre 3, 1943.
english: Italy surrendered on September 3, 1943.

text: Ang Nazi Germany sadtong Mayo 7, 1945.
english: Nazi Germany on May 7, 1945.

text: Ang Japan sadtong Setyembre 2, 1945.
english: Japan on September 2, 1945.

text: Na-liberate ang Netherlands sadtong Mayo 5, 1945.
english: The Netherlands was liberated on May 5, 1945.

text: Kag nagbalik ang kalinong kag kahamungaya sang pangabuhi sa Netherlands.
english: And peace and prosperity returned to the Netherlands.

text: Ugaling lang kay gin-igu naman ini sang disastrous floods sadtong 1953, nga nagpatay sang 2,551 ka tawo halin sa Netherlands, Belgium kag England.
english: However, it was hit by disastrous floods in 1953, which killed 2,551 people from the Netherlands, Belgium and England.

text: Mga 1,836 sini mga taga-Netherlands.
english: About 1,836 of these are Dutch.

text: Nagdulot man ini sang devastation sa mga 800 sq.
english: It also caused devastation to about 800 sq. m.

text: miles nga land area.
english: miles of land area.

text: Ining hitabo nangin wake-up call sa mga ortoridad kag gintukod dayon ang Deltacommissie (Delta Committee) sadtong Pebrero 1953.
english: This incident was a wake-up call to the authorities and the Deltacommissie (Delta Committee) was formed in February 1953.

text: Obligasyon sini ang idihon ang plano sa protejer sang mga vulnerable nga mga areas batok sa pagbinaha-baha pa sa palaabuton.
english: It is its obligation to implement a plan to protect vulnerable areas against future flooding.

text: Ginpasar ang Delta Law sadtong 1959 nga nagpatuman sang Delta Works.
english: The Delta Law was passed in 1959 which implemented the Delta Works.

text: Ang Delta Works isa ka giant flood-control nga proyekto nga ginpatigayon sa southwestern Netherlands.
english: Delta Works is a giant flood-control project conducted in the southwestern Netherlands.

text: Nagsarado ini sang mga suba nga gaangot sa dagat (estuaries) sang Rhine, Meuse (Maas) kag Schelde.
english: It closed the estuaries of the Rhine, Meuse and Schelde.

text: Gintukuran ining mga suba sa ila baba sang mga floodgates nga nagatugot sa pagsulod sang dagat (seawater) kag taob (tidal wave) nga pwede sarhan sa tion sang severe storm.
english: These rivers are built at their mouths with floodgates that allow the entry of seawater and tidal waves that can be closed during severe storms.

text: Na-kumpleto ang pag-construct sang floodgates sa Schelde River sadtong 1986.
english: The construction of the floodgates on the Schelde River was completed in 1986.

text: Duha ka movable storm-surge barriers ang gindugang sadtong 1997.
english: Two movable storm-surge barriers were added in 1997.

text: Ining mga giant seawalls nagtaas sang 20 ka tapak agud maseguro nga indi na malapawan ang kapatagan sang mga storm surges.
english: These giant seawalls rose 20 feet to ensure that the plain would no longer be overrun by storm surges.

text: Ginkilala ining mga structures sang Delta Works bilang isa sang Seven Wonders of the Modern World sang American Society of Civil Engineers.
english: These Delta Works structures have been recognized as one of the Seven Wonders of the Modern World by the American Society of Civil Engineers.

text:
Naaresto ang apat ka mga lalaki nga Indian kag Nepalese national matapos gin-report naggamit sang curry spices powder bilang armas sa pagpangawat sa Yoshikawa, Saitama Prefecture

Suno sa otoridad sang Saitama, apat ka mga lalaki halin saIndia kag Nepal ang nagpalapit sa 52-anyos nga biktima.
english:
Four men of Indian and Nepalese nationals were arrested after they reportedly used curry spices powder as a weapon in a robbery in Yoshikawa, Saitama Prefecture

According to Saitama authorities, four men from India and Nepal approached the 52-year-old victim.

text: Sa baylo nga kutsilyo ukon pusil, gin-usar sang mga suspek ang curry spice powder kag ginsabwag ini sa nawong kag mata sang biktima agud nga temporaryo siya nga indi makakita.
english: Instead of a knife or gun, the suspects used curry spice powder and sprinkled it on the victim's face and eyes to temporarily blind him.

text: Apang, wala nagpapyerdi ang biktima kag maisog nga nagbto sa mga suspek, kag wala gid niya ginbuy-an ang iya bag.
english: However, the victim did not give up and bravely resisted the suspects, and he never let go of his bag.

text: Gindala sa ospital ang biktima para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong sa nagahabok sini nga mata.
english: The victim was taken to the hospital for proper treatment of his swollen eye.

text: Sa bulig sang mga CCTV footage, naaresto na sang Saitama Prefectural Police ang apat nga suspek sa natabo nga insidente, ginkasuhan sila sang assault attempted robbery.
english: With the help of CCTV footage, Saitama Prefectural Police have arrested four suspects in the incident and charged them with assault attempted robbery.

text: Gin-athag sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga wala pa ginapatuman ang automatic nationwide price freeze sa mga nagapanguna nga balaklon kag produkto pagkatapos sang deklarasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) clarified that the automatic nationwide price freeze on basic commodities and products has not yet been implemented following the declaration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sang national energy emergency.
english: of the national energy emergency.

text: Ini matapos nagpagwa si Marcos sang Executive Order No.
english: This comes after Marcos issued Executive Order No.

text: 110, nga nagdeklara sang state of national energy emergency kag nagmandu sang pag-adopt sang UPLIFT ukon Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport nga nag-activate sang whole-of-government response.
english: 110, which declared a state of national energy emergency and mandated the adoption of the UPLIFT or Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport that activated a whole-of-government response.

text: Suno sa Republic Act No.
english: According to Republic Act No.

text: 7581 ukon Price Act, insigida nga gina-freeze sang isa ka lugar ang presyo sang nagapanguna nga balaklon kon ini ideklara nga yara sa state of calamity, emergency, martial law, state of war, state of rebellion, kag kun ginsuspender ang writ of habeas corpus.
english: 7581 or Price Act, a place immediately freezes the price of basic commodities if it is declared in a state of calamity, emergency, martial law, state of war, state of rebellion, and if the writ of habeas corpus is suspended.

text: Ginpahayag sang DTI nga kasunod sang Executive Order 110, wala pa ginapatuman ang automatic nationwide price freeze sa idalum sang Price Act.
english: The DTI said that following Executive Order 110, the automatic nationwide price freeze under the Price Act has not yet been implemented.

text: Nagapabilin naman nga alerto ang consumer protection teams sang ahensya.
english: The agency's consumer protection teams remain alert.

text:
Ang pinakabag-o nga monitoring sang DTI nagapakita nga may ara sang nagakaigo nga inventory sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon

Sa karon, nagapabilin nga committed ang DTI sa pagbalanse sang interes sang mga consumer kag sang ekonomiya sang local manufacturers.
english:
DTI’s latest monitoring shows that there is adequate inventory of basic commodities

Currently, the DTI remains committed to balancing the interests of consumers and the economy of local manufacturers.

text: Suno naman kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, wala nila ginasarado ang posibilidad sang pagpatuman sang prize freeze.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said they are not ruling out the possibility of implementing a prize freeze.

text: Gindugang man sini nga ila pagatun-an ini sa senado kag ila pagabalansehon agud nga indi lamang ang isa ka sektor ang maapektuhan kundi balanse man para sa iban nga sector.
english: He added that they will study it in the senate and they will balance it so that not only one sector will be affected but also balance for other sectors.

text: Magahulag ang Japan kag ang lima ka dalagku nga mga pungsod sa Europa agud nga makabulig nga makalabay sang hilway sa Strait of Hormuz ang mga barko nga may karga nga langis.
english: Japan and the five major European countries will act to help oil ships pass safely through the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang kaundan sang joint statement nga gin-release sang United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, kag Japan.
english: This is part of the content of the joint statement released by the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, and Japan.

text: Sa amo nga pahayag, mabaskog nga ginkondenar sang anum ka mga pungsod ang mga pagpang-atake sang Iran sa mga commercial vessel sa Gulf kag sa civilian infrastructure lakip na sa mga oil kag gas installations.
english: In the statement, the six countries strongly condemned Iran's attacks on commercial vessels in the Gulf and on civilian infrastructure including oil and gas installations.

text: Ginpakamalaot man sang amo nga mga pungsod ang “de facto closure” sang Strait of Hormuz.
english: Those countries also condemned the “de facto closure” of the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Antes sini nga statement, gin-report sang Qatar nga daku nga halit ang ginsuprer sang Ras Laffan Industrial City bangud sang missile strikes sang Iran.
english: Prior to this statement, Qatar reported that Ras Laffan Industrial City suffered heavy damage due to Iranian missile strikes.

text: Ang Ras Laffan amo ang naga-proseso sang ginabanta one-fifth sang liquefied natural gas sang kalibutan.
english: Ras Laffan processes approximately one-fifth of the world’s liquefied natural gas.

text: Gin-atake man ang main port sang Saudi Arabia sa Red Sea nga amo ang ginagamit agud nga ma-divert ang exports agud nga makalikaw sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Saudi Arabia's main port in the Red Sea, which is used to divert exports to avoid the Strait of Hormuz, was also attacked.

text: Suno sa anum ka mga pungsod, nagakahangawa sila sa nagalala nga sitwasyon.
english: The six countries said they were concerned about the worsening situation.

text: Naghingyo sila nga untatan na sang Iran ang pagpamahog, pagtanum sang bomba, pag-atake gamit ang drones kag missiles, kag paghimo sang iban pa nga paagi agud nga ma-atake ang mga barko nga nagaagi sa Strait.
english: They demanded that Iran stop threatening, planting bombs, attacking with drones and missiles, and taking other measures to attack ships passing through the Strait.

text: Pahayag pa sang anum ka pungsod, kun ano man ang ginahimo sang Iran, maapektuhan sini ang tanan nga parte sang kalibutan, lakip na ang pinakamahuyang ukon pigado nga mga pungsod.
english: The six countries said that whatever Iran does will affect all parts of the world, including the weakest or poorest countries.

text: Pahayag pa nila, handa sila nga maghimo sang mga tikang agud nga makaagi ang langis sa Strait of Hormuz, kag gina-abi-abi man nila kun may dugang nga mga pungsod nga magabulig sa pagpreparar kag pagplano.
english: They said they are ready to take steps to allow oil to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, and welcome additional countries to help prepare and plan.

text: Nagpromisa man sila sang dugang nga mga tikang agud nga mangin estable ang energy markets lakip na ang pag-trabaho sa mga pungsod nga naga-produce sang langis agud nga mas mapadamo pa ang suplay.
english: They also promised further measures to stabilize energy markets including working with oil-producing countries to further increase supply.

text: Wala sang dugang mga detalye nga ginbutang sa statement, apang ginakabig na ini nga daku nga development sa sulod sang tatlo ka semana nga gyera sa Middle East.
english: No further details were put into the statement, but it is already being seen as a major development during the three-week war in the Middle East.

text: Wala man namensyonar sa amo nga statement ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The statement did not mention the United States of America.

text: Antes sini, may panawagan si US President Donald Trump nga magbulig ang iban nga mga pungsod nga makaagi ang mga barko sa Strait of Hormuz, apang may mga pagpang-alang-alang pati ang mga kaalyado sang Estados Unidos nga mag-intra sa gyera.#
english: Earlier, US President Donald Trump had called for other countries to help ships pass through the Strait of Hormuz, but there were reluctance even among US allies to join the war.

text: Nabulsa sang Filipino Olympic pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena ang bulawan nga medalya sa International Springer-Meeting sa Cottbus, Germany.
english: Filipino Olympic pole vaulter EJ Obiena won the gold medal at the International Springer-Meeting in Cottbus, Germany.

text: Ini man ang panibag-o nga season best ni Obiena.
english: This is also Obiena's new season best.

text: Gindeklarar siya nga gold medalist patas kay Menno Vloon sang Netherlands matapos pareho nga nakalukso sang 5.77-meters.
english: He was declared the gold medalist along with Menno Vloon of the Netherlands after both jumped 5.77-meters.

text: Sandig sa website sang meet, kinahanglan ang jump-off agud nga madesisyunan kun sin-o sa ila ang kampyon, apang sang ulihi, pareho man sila nga wala nakalampas sa 5.84m sa pareho nga attempts.
english: According to the meet's website, a jump-off was needed to decide who was the champion, but in the end, they both failed to exceed 5.84m in the same attempts.

text: Ini ang una nga tion sa maragtas sang Cottbus nga duha ka mga atleta ang gindeklarar sa una nga pwesto.
english: This is the first time in Cottbus history that two athletes have been declared in first place.

text: Nagpangatlo naman ang American pole vaulter kag defending champion nga si Sam Kendricks matapos nalukso ang 5.77m sa sulod sang tatlo ka attempts.
english: American pole vaulter and defending champion Sam Kendricks came third after jumping 5.77m in three attempts.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, nabulsa man ni Obiena ang bronze medal sa 6th ISTAF Indoor Dusseldorf sa amo man nga pungsod.
english: Last week, Obiena also won the bronze medal at the 6th ISTAF Indoor Dusseldorf in the same country.

text: Sa amo nga tournament, naangkon sini ang 5.65-meter clearance.#

Nagbulag ang Northern Netherlands sa Spanish Empire sa idalom ni King Philip II bilang de facto independent sadtong 1581 pagkatapos nga nagdaug sila sa ila pag-alsa (revolt) batok diri sa sulod sang Eight Year’s War.
english:
***

The Northern Netherlands seceded from the Spanish Empire under King Philip II as de facto independent in 1581 after winning a revolt against it during the Eight Year's War.

text: Wala ini ugaling ginkilala sang Espanya kag ginpadayon sini ang Eight Year’s War tubtub naglab-ut ini sa 12 Year Truce kag ginkilala na sini ang Northern (Calvinist) Netherlands nga isa ka sovereign power sadtong 1621 nga ginhingadlan na nga Kingdom of Netherlands.
english: However, Spain did not recognize this and continued the Eight Year's War until it reached the 12 Year Truce and recognized the Northern (Calvinist) Netherlands as a sovereign power in 1621 which was renamed the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

text: Samtang ang Southern (Catholic) Netherlands nangin Kingdom of Belgium sadtong 1830.
english: The Southern (Catholic) Netherlands became the Kingdom of Belgium in 1830.

text: Ang Netherlands nag-experyensya sugod sadtong 1585 sang pagsanyog sang ekonomiya tubtub nalab-ut sini ang malapit sa isa ka siglo (century) nga “explosive economic growth”.
english: The Netherlands experienced from 1585 economic growth until it reached nearly a century of explosive economic growth.

text: Nangin “dominant trade power” ini pag-abot sang 1670 partly bangod sang aktibidad sini sa shipbuilding.
english: It became the dominant trade power by 1670 partly because of its shipbuilding activity.

text: Sa ina nga tuig, ang merchant marine sini naglab-ut sa 568,000 ka tonelada nga shipping, nga halos katunga na sang European total.
english: That year, its merchant marine totaled 568,000 tons of shipping, almost half of the European total.

text: Napasanyog man sini ang mga industriya sa papermaking, sugar refining, printing, linen industry nga nag-spinoff sa industriya sa vegetable oils katulad sang flax kag rapeseed oil, kag mga industriya nga nagagamit sang cheap peat fuel katulad sang brewing kag ceramics (brickworks, pottery kag clay-pipe making).
english: It also promoted industries in papermaking, sugar refining, printing, linen industries that spinoff into industries in vegetable oils such as flax and rapeseed oil, and industries using cheap peat fuel such as brewing and ceramics (brickworks, pottery and clay-pipe making).

text: Napasanyog man sini ang fisheries (herring) industry.
english: It also boosted the fisheries (herring) industry.

text: Ang lubos na nga pagbulag sa Espanya kag ang panghangkat sang stiff competition sa shipping activities sa tunga sini sa mga ka-kumpetensya nga mga pungsod sa Uropa sadtong 1621 tubtub 1663 nagresulta ugaling sa Anglo-Dutch War, Dutch-Swedish War, kag Franco-Dutch War.
english: The complete isolation of Spain and the challenge of stiff competition in shipping activities between it and competing European countries from 1621 to 1663 resulted in the Anglo-Dutch War, Dutch-Swedish War, and Franco-Dutch War.

text: Expectedly, nagresulta ini sa declining prospect sang trade activities sang Netherlands, lakip na ang bag-o nga investment sa whaling industry nga naghuyang man tungod sa stiff competition sang foreign investors.
