text: Sa sina nga tinuig mga 21% sang populasyon ang nakapuyo na sa sining reclaimed land area.
english: In that year about 21% of the population already lived in this reclaimed land area.

text: Sa karon (2022), halos katunga (50%) sang populasyon sang Netherlands (mga 9 ka milyon) ang nagapuyo sa 350 ka kilometro nga baybayon (coast) kag mga rehiyon nga below sea level sang Netherlands.
english: Currently (2022), almost half (50%) of the Dutch population (about 9 million) live in the 350 kilometers of coast and below sea level regions of the Netherlands.

text: Daku ina ugaling nga problema kon matabo nga magtaas ang sea level, nga posible kon matunaw ang mga yelo halin sa cold regions sang Greenland kag Antartica nga malapit lang sa Netherlands sa Uropa, kag matabo man ang sige-sige nga pag-ulan (extreme precipitation) nga makatuga sang malapad nga pagbinaha-baha (flooding) sa kapatagan.
english: That is a big problem, however, if sea levels rise, which is possible if the ice from the cold regions of Greenland and Antarctica near the Netherlands in Europe melts, and there is also extreme precipitation that can cause widespread flooding in the plains.

text: MATABO GID MAN BALA INI SA NETHERLANDS?
english: WILL THIS EVER HAPPEN IN THE NETHERLANDS?

text: Well, wala pa sadto dapat kabalak-an ang mga pumuluyo nga nagapuyo diri sa malawak sini nga reclaimed land along the sea coast.
english: Well, the people living here on this vast reclaimed land along the sea coast didn't have to worry.

text: Ina tungod sa sulod sang 6,000 ka tuig nga nagligad, sunu sa pagtuon sang mga scientist, ang sea levels sa palibut sang Netherlands halos wala nagtaas (stable), nga naghatag sing kahigayunan sang madamo nga magtukod sang mga coastal communities diri kag iban pa nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: That's because for the past 6,000 years, according to scientists, sea levels around the Netherlands have been stable, allowing many to establish coastal communities here and elsewhere in the world.

text: Sa paghinampot ugaling sang Industrial Revolution (1760 tubtub 1820-1840) nagliwat na ang kahimtangan sang kalibutan sa amat-amat na nga pagdugang sang kainiton sa kalibutan (Global Warming).
english: However, with the approach of the Industrial Revolution (1760 to 1820-1840), the world's situation changed with global warming.

text: Upod sa mahaliton nga mga aktibidad sang katauhan batok sa palibut (environment) katulad sang sobra nga pagpanabas sang kakahuyan tubtub makalbo.
english: Including harmful human activities against the environment such as excessive deforestation.

text: nagsugod man sadto ang malawakan nga paggamit sang fossil fuel (oil, natural gas, coal) sa tanan nga pagginawi sang tawo sa kalibutan.
english: it also marked the beginning of the widespread use of fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) in all human activities in the world.

text: Nadiskubrihan sang aton mga scientist nga ang pagsunog sang fossil fuel naga-producir gali sang mga greenhouse gas (GHG), labi na gid ang carbon dioxide, nga naga-pollute sang palibut kag naga-trap sang init sa ibabaw sang kalibutan nga halos na makagwa palayo.
english: Our scientists have discovered that the burning of fossil fuels actually produces greenhouse gases (GHG), especially carbon dioxide, which pollute the environment and trap heat on the surface of the earth that is almost released.

text: Nagtuga ini sang Global Warming nga nangin kabangdanan sang global sea level rise kag sang extreme weather nga nagadala sang mabaskog nga mga bagyo, mataas nga storm surge sa baybayon, kag pagbinaha-baha sa takas.
english: This has caused Global Warming which has caused global sea level rise and extreme weather that brings strong typhoons, high storm surges along the coast, and flooding offshore.

text: Ining Global Warming, sunu sa mga siyentipiko, nagpataas sugod sadtong 1880 sang global sea levels halin 21 tubtub 24 centimeters (8-9 inches).
english: This global warming, according to scientists, has raised since 1880 global sea levels from 21 to 24 centimeters (8-9 inches).

text: (May kasugpon)/PN
english: (Attached)/PN

text: Isang 8-taong-gulang na batang lalaki mula sa Uttaradit Province sa Thailand ang natuklasang iniwan at pinabayaan ng kanyang ina na nalulong sa droga.
english: An 8-year-old boy from Uttaradit Province in Thailand was found abandoned and neglected by his drug-addicted mother.

text: Dahil dito, sa loob ng mahabang panahon, nakakasama lamang niya ang kanyang mga aso, at natutong kumahol bilang paraan ng pakikipagkomunikasyon.
english: Because of this, for a long time, he was only with his dogs, and learned to bark as a means of communication.

text: Nalaman ni Paveena Hongsakul ng Foundation for Children and Women ang tungkol sa kaso ng bata mula sa isang punong-guro sa distrito ng Lap Lae.
english: Paveena Hongsakul of the Foundation for Children and Women learned about the child's case from a headmaster in Lap Lae district.

text: Ayon sa ulat, dinala lang ng ina ang bata sa paaralan isang beses upang makatanggap ng benepisyo, ngunit hindi man lang siya inenrol.
english: According to the report, the mother only brought the child to school once to receive benefits, but he was not enrolled.

text: Hindi rin nakaranas ng kindergarten ang bata at matagal nang emosyonal na pinabayaan ng kanyang ina at nakatatandang kapatid.
english: The child also did not experience kindergarten and has long been emotionally neglected by his mother and older siblings.

text: Sa kawalan ng kalinga ng tao, mga aso ang naging kaibigan at kasama niya, at natutunan niyang kumilos at kumahol gaya nila.
english: In the absence of human care, dogs became his friends and companions, and he learned to act and bark like them.

text: Nakipag-ugnayan si Hongsakul sa lokal na pulisya upang imbestigahan ang sitwasyon.
english: Hongsakul contacted the local police to investigate the situation.

text: Sa kanilang pagsisiyasat, napatunayan nilang positibo sa droga ang 46-taong-gulang na ina at 23-taong-gulang na kuya ng bata.
english: In their investigation, they found that the 46-year-old mother and 23-year-old brother of the child tested positive for drugs.

text: Ayon sa pulisya, mas inuna ng dalawa ang kanilang bisyo kaysa sa kapakanan ng bata.
english: According to police, the two put their addiction ahead of the child's welfare.

text: Ayon sa mga kapitbahay, palagi raw humihingi ng pera at pagkain ang ina.
english: According to the neighbors, the mother was always asking for money and food.

text: Dahil sa matagal nang isyu sa droga, iniiwasan ng mga tao ang kanilang pamilya, dahilan upang walang batang gustong makipaglaro sa bunso.
english: Because of the long-standing drug issue, people avoid their families, so no child wants to play with the youngest.

text: Sa halip, sumama na lamang siya sa isang grupo ng mga aso, ginaya ang kanilang kilos, at natutong kumahol bilang pakikipag-usap.
english: Instead, he joined a group of dogs, guided their movements, and learned to bark as a form of communication.

text: Iniulat ng Thai newspaper na Khaosod na ang batang tinawag lamang bilang “A” upang maprotektahan ang kanyang pagkakakilanlan, ay inilipat na sa Uttaradit Children’s Home.
english: Thai newspaper Khaosod reported that the child, identified only as “A” to protect his identity, has been transferred to the Uttaradit Children’s Home.

text: Doon ay tutulungan siyang matutong magsalita ng wasto at matiyak na makatatanggap siya ng tamang edukasyon at pangangalaga.
english: There they will help him learn to speak correctly and make sure he receives the right education and care.

text: May ara sang nagakaigo nga pondo ang Department of Budget and Management (DBM) agud suportahan kag buligan ang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) para sa mga minimum wage earners.
english: The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) has adequate funds to support and assist the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) for minimum wage earners.

text: Ginpasiguro sang ahensya nga may nakahanda ini nga contingency funds kun magpangabay ukon magpangayo man sang bulig ang Department of Labor and Employment agud palaparon ang pinansyal sini nga bulig para sa mga minimum wage workers nga naapektuhan sang pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong.
english: The agency assured that it has contingency funds ready if the Department of Labor and Employment requests assistance to expand its financial assistance for minimum wage workers affected by the increase in fuel prices.

text: Suno kay Acting Budget Secretary Rolando Toledo nga may ara sang gin-allocate nga P21.3 bilyon para sa TUPAD program sang DOLE, apang ini para lamang sa mga displaced, under-employed, kag seasonal workers.
english: According to Acting Budget Secretary Rolando Toledo, there is an allocated P21.3 billion for the TUPAD program of the DOLE, but this is only for the displaced, under-employed, and seasonal workers.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Malacañang nga ila pagatun-an ang ginapanawagan sang publiko nga dapat mahatagan ang mga ini sang pinansyal nga bulig, indi lamang ang mga minimum wage earners kundi pati man ang middle class kag mga empleyado sang gobyerno nga naapektuhan sang oil crisis bangud sa tensyon sa Middle East.
english: Earlier, Malacañang said it would study the public's call for financial assistance, not only the minimum wage earners but also the middle class and government employees affected by the oil crisis due to tensions in the Middle East.

text: Ginapanawagan man sang pila ka labor groups sa gobyerno nga hatagan sila sang monthly subsidy para sa masobra 5 milyon nga mga minimum wage earners sa pungsod.
english: Some labor groups are also calling on the government to provide them with a monthly subsidy for the more than 5 million minimum wage earners in the country.

text: Magluwas sa contingency fund, mahimo man gamiton sang Department of Budget and Management ang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund para pondohan ang iban pa nga mga programa sang gobyerno ilabi na nga madamo sa subong ang nagakinahanglan sang bulig.
english: In addition to the contingency fund, the Department of Budget and Management can also use the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund to fund other government programs especially as many are currently in need of assistance.

text: Nakabulsa sang bulawan nga medalya ang duha ka mga Ilonggo sa nagapadayon nga 13th ASEAN PARA Games sa Thailand.
english: Two Ilonggos won gold medals at the ongoing 13th ASEAN PARA Games in Thailand.

text: Nangibabaw ang wheelchair fencer nga si Marlyn Garrucho, tumandok sang Oton, sa wheelchair Women’s saber category.
english: Wheelchair fencer Marlyn Garrucho, a native of Oton, won the wheelchair Women’s saber category.

text: Ginlutos sini ang isa pa ka Pinay nga si Marieta Hernandez sa quarterfinals, 15-6, antes ginpierde ang mga tiglawas sang Thailand nga si Duean Nakprasit sa semifinal match, 15-13, kag si Thitirat Pengprasittipong sa gold medal match, 15-11.
english: She defeated another Filipina Marieta Hernandez in the quarterfinals, 15-6, before defeating Thailand representatives Duean Nakprasit in the semifinal match, 15-13, and Thitirat Pengprasittipong in the gold medal match, 15-11.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sa athletics, duha naman ka bulawan nga medalya ang naangkon sang 46-anyos nga si Rodrigo Podiotan Jr.
english: Meanwhile, in athletics, 46-year-old Rodrigo Podiotan Jr. won two gold medals.

text: nga tumandok sang Brgy.
english: native of Brgy.

text: Bantay, Santa Barbara.
english: Guard, Santa Barbara.

text: Nakuha sini ang amo nga mga medalya sa event nga 400m kag 100m racing wheel chair T52 classification.
english: He won the medals in the 400m and 100m racing wheel chair T52 classification.

text: Ginlutos sini ang multi-titled Paralympian kag iya long-time sparring partner kag abyan nga si Jerrold Pete Mangliwan.
english: He defeated multi-titled Paralympian and his long-time sparring partner and friend Jerrold Pete Mangliwan.

text: Nag-set man si Podiotan sang bag-o nga Games record nga 1:01.06.
english: Podiotan also set a new Games record of 1:01.06.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Podiotan, iya ginpahayag nga nagalaum siya nga paagi sini nga kadalag-an, makalab-ot sa mga natungdan ang panawagan nga suportahan ang para-athletes.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Podiotan said he hopes that through this victory, the call to support the para-athletes will reach the concerned.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa iban nga mga tawo nga bisan may kasablagan sa lawas, dapat maghandum sang mataas kag magpasakop sa mga kumpetisyon kun may talento ukon abilidad nga mahimo mapakigbahin para nga sarang man mapabugal sang Pilipinas.
english: He also appealed to other people who even with disabilities, should aspire high and participate in competitions if they have talents or abilities that can be participated so that the Philippines can be proud.

text: Proud naman ang Ilonggo coach sini nga si Ernie Candelario sa nalab-ot ni Podiotan.
english: Ilonggo coach Ernie Candelario is proud of Podiotan's achievement.

text: Pahayag sang coach, sa nagligad nga edisyon sang ASEAN Para Games, fourth placer si Podiotan apang wala ini nag-untat sa paghanas tubtub nga nalab-ot sini ang gold medal kag naka-break pa sang record sa hinampang.
english: The coach said that in the last edition of the ASEAN Para Games, Podiotan was fourth placer but he did not stop training until he achieved the gold medal and broke the record in the game.

text: “Hindi rason nga bisan isa siya ka PWD person nga nadapu-an sang sakit nga polio.
english: “It is not a reason that even if he is a PWD person who has been infected with polio.

text: Umpisa sang bata pa siya kag naga wheel chair nalang siya.
english: Since he was a child and he has been in a wheel chair.

text: Pero wala siya nadulaan sang paglaum nga maka hatag sang bugal Hindi lang sa probinsiya sang ILOILO kundi sa bilog nga pungsod sang Pilipinas .
english: But he did not lose hope to give pride not only to the province of ILOILO but to the entire country of the Philippines.

text: Sa tunga sang kapigaduhon Nag bakas gid si Rodrigo nga mag practice para makasulod sa minimum standard kag mag represinta sang pungsod.,” kabahin sang post sang coach nga tumandok sang Napnapan, Tigbauan.
english: In the midst of poverty, Rodrigo struggled to practice to enter the minimum standard and represent the country.,” part of the post of the coach who is a native of Napnapan, Tigbauan.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang 13th ASEAN Para Games amo ang multi-sport event para sa mga atleta nga may disabilities.
english: The 13th ASEAN Para Games is a multi-sport event for athletes with disabilities.

text: Sanctioned ini sang ASEAN Para Sports Federation (APSF).
english: It is sanctioned by the ASEAN Para Sports Federation (APSF).

text: Nag-walk out si Miss Universe 2025 Fatima Bosch sa isa ka interview sa American Spanish-language TV network matapos siya ginpamangkot angot sa kontrobersiya nga nagapalibot sa pageant kag sa iya pagkadaog.
english: Miss Universe 2025 Fatima Bosch walked out of an interview with the American Spanish-language TV network after she was asked about the controversy surrounding the pageant and her loss.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang network sa ila Facebook page nga naghalin ini sa tunga-tunga sang taping kag gin-cancel man ang tanan niya nga naka-schedule nga pagpakita sa telebisyon.
english: The network confirmed on its Facebook page that she left midway through the taping and also canceled all of her scheduled television appearances.

text: Suno sa report, guest si Miss Mexico sa isa ka international program.
english: According to the report, Miss Mexico was a guest on an international program.

text: Lakip sa mga gin-istoryahan ang isyu angot sa pag-freeze sang account ni Miss Universe Organization (MUO) president Raul Rocha bangud sa ginaalegar nga kaangtanan sini sa iligal nga droga, kag ang kaso nga gin-file batok kay Fatima sang Miss Universe Thailand kag Miss Grand International (MGI) president Nawat Itsaragrisil.
english: Among the topics discussed were the issue of freezing the account of Miss Universe Organization (MUO) president Raul Rocha due to his alleged links to illegal drugs, and the case filed against Fatima by Miss Universe Thailand and Miss Grand International (MGI) president Nawat Itsaragrisil.

text: Sa pagsugod sang interview, nagsabat pa ang beauty queen nga wala siya sang bisan ano nga kaso kag nagpahayag nga indi na niya luyag palawigon pa ang istorya.
english: At the beginning of the interview, the beauty queen replied that she had no case and said she did not want to prolong the story.

text: Apang ginbuyagyag sang isa sa mga host nga antes pa magsugod ang airing, ginhambalan sila ni Fatima nga ang iya amay, si Bernardo Bosch Hernández, ang naga-handle sang “legal situation.”
english: But one of the hosts revealed that just before the airing began, Fatima told them that her father, Bernardo Bosch Hernández, was handling the “legal situation.”

text: Gintuad sang isa ka public health expert nga ginabanta 74,000 ka mga Pinoy ang napatay bangud sa ischemic heart disease.
english: A public health expert admitted that an estimated 74,000 Filipinos have died from ischemic heart disease.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rafael Martin Hilado, Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgeon sa Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC), iya ginpahayag nga ginatawag man ang amo nga balatian nga coronary artery disease kag coronary heart disease.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rafael Martin Hilado, Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgeon at the Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC), said the disease is also called coronary artery disease and coronary heart disease.

text: Suno kay Hilado, kon ang mga arteries nagakipot, mas magamay ang dugo kag oxygen ang nagalab-ot sa heart muscle nga mahimo magtuga sang heart attack.
english: According to Hilado, when the arteries are narrowed, less blood and oxygen reach the heart muscle which can cause a heart attack.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga mahimo malikawan ang amo nga balatian kon bag-uhon ang lifestyle changes.
english: He also explained that the disease can be prevented by changing lifestyle changes.

text: Lakip na ang paguntat sang pagpanigarilyo, pag-exercise, 7-9 hours sleep, kag pagkaon sang healthy diet.
english: That includes quitting smoking, exercising, getting 7-9 hours of sleep, and eating a healthy diet.

text: Suno naman kay Dr. Marcelino Felisarta, Adult Cardiologist sa Western Visayas Medical Center, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang pili ang cardio vascular diseases, mapa-bata man ukon tigulang.
english: According to Dr. Marcelino Felisarta, Adult Cardiologist at the Western Visayas Medical Center, said there is no discrimination against cardio vascular diseases, whether in children or the elderly.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga majority sang ila pasyente nga naga-angkon sang amo nga balatian ang naga-edad 50-60 anyos.
english: He also said that the majority of their patients who suffer from the disease are between the ages of 50-60 years old.

text: Sa isa ka indi kinaandan nga hitabo, nag-ako si King Felipe VI sa mga pagpang-abuso nga ginhimo sang Espanya sa mga lugar nga ila ginsakop sang Spanish colonial period halin sang 1492 tubtub sang 1898.
english: In an unusual move, King Felipe VI acknowledged the abuses committed by Spain in the areas they occupied during the Spanish colonial period from 1492 to 1898.

text: Suno sa hari, tuyo sang Spanish colonial laws nga makahatag sang proteksyon, apang sa pagkamatuod, naglain ang dalagan sang mga hitabo kag may natabo nga mga abuso.
english: According to the king, Spanish colonial laws were intended to provide protection, but in reality, the course of events took a turn for the worse and abuses occurred.

text: “When we study certain things under modern-day criteria, with our values, obviously we can’t feel ​proud.
english: “When we study certain things under modern-day criteria, with our values, obviously we can’t feel ​proud.

text: But we must learn from this, within its ​context, without too much moralising.
english: But we must learn from this, within its ​context, without too much moralising.

text: We must learn lessons through objective and rigorous analysis,” suno sa hari.
english: We must learn lessons through objective and rigorous analysis,” the king said.

text: Sa bilog nga maragtas, wala sang hitabo nga pormal nga nakapangayo sang pasaylo ang Espanya sa mga pungsod nga ila ginsakop lakip na ang Pilipinas nga nangin Spanish colony sa sulod sang 333 ka tuig.
english: Throughout history, Spain has never formally apologized to the countries it conquered, including the Philippines, which was a Spanish colony for 333 years.

text: Sang ika-16 tubtub ika-18 nga siglo, nanguna ang Espanya sa pinakadako nga mga imperyo sa sa maragtas sang kalibutan nga nagalakip sang lima ka kontinente lakip na ang Central and Latin America kun sa diin may mga natabo nga forced labor, land expropriation kag kalakasan batok sa Indigenous people.#
english: In the 16th to 18th centuries, Spain led one of the largest empires in world history that included five continents including Central and Latin America where forced labor, land expropriation and violence against Indigenous people occurred.

text: Nakilal-an na ang lalaki nga nasapwan nga patay sa bakante nga lote sa Zone 3, Barangay Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City sang hapon sang Marso 29.
english: The man who was found dead in a vacant lot in Zone 3, Barangay Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City on the afternoon of March 29 has been identified.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas John, 50 anyos kag residente man sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as John, 50, resident of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Mavin Laraño, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 3, iya ginpahayag nga wala gid nagsulod sa pinsar sang pamilya sang biktima nga siya ang nasapwan nga patay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Mavin Laraño, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 3, said it never occurred to the victim's family that he was found dead.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan, ang nahibaluan sang pamilya amo nga nagbalik ini sa Roxas, Capiz.
english: According to police investigation, the family knows that he returned to Roxas, Capiz.

text: Ginpahayag man nga nakita sang bata sang biktima sa social media ang tsinelas nga ginapanag-iyahan sang iya amay, nga amo ang naghatag sang ideya sa ila nga mahimo ang amay nila amo ang nasapwan.
english: The victim's son also reportedly saw the slippers belonging to his father on social media, which gave them the idea that their father might have been found.

text: Sang ila nga gin-usisa didto nahibaluan nga wala ini nakareport sa iya trabaho sa Roxas.
english: When they checked there, it was learned that he did not report to his job in Roxas.

text: Ginpahayag man sang iya asawa nga may ara sang problema ini nga ginapangatubang kag may ginasuprer man ini nga high blood pressure rason nga mahimo nagtlod sa iya nga utason ang kaugalingon nga kabuhi.
english: His wife also said that he was facing problems and suffering from high blood pressure which may have led him to take his own life.

text: Nagsaka sang masobra piso ang presyo sang mga produktong petrolyo epektibo subong nga aga, Marso 3.
english: The price of petroleum products rose by more than a peso effective this morning, March 3.

text:
Gasolina: 1.90 kada litroDiesel: 1.20 kada litroKerosene: 1.50 kada litro

Ini na ang pang-walo nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga may saka-presyo sa gasolina, kag pang-10 naman nga sunod-sunod nga semana para sa diesel kag kerosene.
english:
Petrol: 1.90 per literDiesel: 1.20 per literKerosene: 1.50 per liter

This is the eighth consecutive week of price increases for gasoline, and the 10th consecutive week for diesel and kerosene.

text: Una na nga gin-project sang Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) ang masobra piso nga saka sa presyo subong nga semana ilabi na bangud sa nag-ibwal nga tensyon sa tunga sang US kag Israel batok sa Iran nga subong naglapta na sa Middle East.
english: The Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) had earlier projected a price increase of more than a peso this week especially due to the escalating tension between the US and Israel against Iran that has now spread to the Middle East.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Senator Bam Aquino nga dapat i-suspend na sang gobyerno ang excise taxes sa fuel sa idalom sang Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law.
english: Senator Bam Aquino called on the government to suspend excise taxes on fuel under the Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law.

text: Suno kay Aquino, sa idalom sang TRAIN Law, may yara sang automatic suspension of excise taxes sa petroleum products kun ang average global oil price nagalab-ot na sa $80 per barrel para sa tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga bulan.
english: According to Aquino, under the TRAIN Law, there will be an automatic suspension of excise taxes on petroleum products when the average global oil price reaches $80 per barrel for three consecutive months.

text: Makabulig ang suspension suno sa senador agud nga mabuhinan ang bug-at nga pas-anon sang mga pumuluyo sa pagsaka sa presyo sang langis samtang mataas ang tension sa Middle East.
english: The senator said the suspension will help reduce the burden of the people on the rising oil prices while tensions in the Middle East are high.

text: Kun magsaka ang presyo sang gatong suno sa senador, ginaantisipar nga magasunod man sa pagsaka ang iban nga balaklon pati na ang pagkaon.
english: If the price of fuel increases, the senator said, it is anticipated that other commodities including food will follow suit.

text: Sabado sang gin-umpisahan sang US kag Israel ang operasyon sa Iran nga nagpatay sa ila Supreme Leader kag iban pa nga senior officials.
english: The US and Israel launched an operation in Iran on Saturday that killed their Supreme Leader and other senior officials.

text: Nagbalos ang Tehran kag ginpang-atake ang military bases sang Estados Unidos sang Middle East.#
english: Tehran retaliated by attacking US military bases in the Middle East.

text: Ginmanduan ni Senate President Vicente Sotto III ang Senate Committee on Rules nga tun-an ang posibilidad sa pagdeklarar sa pila ka Chinese Embassy officials bilang persona non grata.
english: Senate President Vicente Sotto III has directed the Senate Committee on Rules to study the possibility of declaring some Chinese Embassy officials persona non grata.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagpang-insulto sang amo nga mga opisyal sang China batok sa mga opisyal sa Pilipinas.
english: This follows the insults of the same Chinese officials against the officials in the Philippines.

text: Pananglitan matabo ini, ginalantaw magalala ang tension sa tunga sang Manila kag Beijing bangud ini nga deklarasyon amo ang isa sa pinakaseryoso nga tikang nga mahimo obrahon sang host country batok sa foreign diplomats.
english: If this happens, tensions between Manila and Beijing are expected to escalate as this declaration is one of the most serious steps that a host country can take against foreign diplomats.

text: Ang direktiba ni Sotto ang ginpaguwa kadungan sang plenary session samtang nga gina-istoryahan ang resolusyon nga nagakondena sang embahada sang China bangud sa ila mga pahayag nga naga-atake sa Philippine officials kag mga institusyon.
english: Sotto's directive was issued during the plenary session while discussing a resolution condemning the Chinese embassy for its statements attacking Philippine officials and institutions.

text: Partikular nga namunuhan amo ang social media post ni Guo Wei, ang Deputy Spokesperson sang Chinese Embassy.
english: Particularly notable was the social media post of Guo Wei, the Deputy Spokesperson of the Chinese Embassy.

text: Gin-insulto ni Guo ang mga senador nga nagpirma sang resolusyon nga nagapabakod sang kinamatarong sang Pilipinas nga depensahan ang national sini nga interes sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Guo insulted the senators who signed the resolution strengthening the Philippines' right to defend its national interests in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sandig kay Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson, ang president lamang ang may gahum nga magpalayas sa isa ka diplomat, apang mahimo naman makapaguwa ang Senado sang formal recommendation nga may yara sang daku nga bug-at.
english: According to Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson, only the president has the power to expel a diplomat, but the Senate can issue a formal recommendation that has great weight.

text: Kasunod sang direktiba ni Sotto, tun-an na sang Committee on Rules ang legal kag diplomatic implications sang amo nga tikang antes dalayon nga makahulag ang Senado.
english: Following Sotto's directive, the Committee on Rules will study the legal and diplomatic implications of the move before the Senate can act immediately.

text: ANG PAGTUON sang US-based Climate Central Study sadtong 2019 nagasiling nga mangin katulad sa isa ka “swimming pool” ang syudad sang Iloilo pag-abot sang 2050.
english: A 2019 US-based Climate Central Study says Iloilo City will be like a swimming pool by 2050.

text: Iindi buot silingon sina, ugaling, nga ang bug-os gid nga syudad ang sudlon sang tubig sa pag-abot sang ina nga panahon.
english: That does not mean, however, that the entire city will be flooded when that time comes.

text: Ang 2050 nagapa-alarma matuod sang pagsul-ob sang tubig sa padayon nga pag-usmod (subsidence) sang duta, pagtaas sang sea level rise, kag pagbaha-baha sa palibut dala sang madamol nga ulan sa syudad nga tuga sang Climate Change.
english: 2050 is indeed alarming of water consumption in the continuous subsidence of the land, rising sea level rise, and environmental flooding caused by heavy rains in the city caused by Climate Change.

text: Kon ang kabandanan man lang sini ang padayon nga sea level rise kag subsidence, ang pagpati sang mga experto amo nga mga 4 ka tapak man lang ini nga tubig ang masulod kag magtener sa syudad sa 2050, nga indi pa lubos mapa-idalom ang syudad sa underwater.
english: If the cause is continuous sea level rise and subsidence, experts believe that only about 4 feet of water will enter and remain in the city by 2050, which will not completely submerge the city.

text: Pila lang ka bahin, sunu gani sa UP-NOAH.
english: Only a few parts, according to UP-NOAH.

english: It also has a long coastline of 21.3 kilometers that is open to the threat of high and strong waves and storm surge to coastal homes.

text: Sunu man sa CLUP, ang 90% sang land mass sang syudad yara sa 2.64 meters (8.67 ka feet) above sea level samtang ang 10% yara sa mga 5.19 m. (17.02 ft.) nga elevation.
english: According to the CLUP, 90% of the city's land mass is 2.64 meters (8.67 feet) above sea level while 10% is about 5.19 m. (17.02 ft.) elevation.

text: Tungod sloping ang land mass ang syudad, masugod ang elevation sini sa 0 meters halin sa ginatabuan sang dagat kag baybay kag amat-amat masaka, sunu sa latest Elevation Map sang syudad, sa 1m.
english: Due to the sloping land mass of the city, its elevation will start at 0 meters from the confluence of the sea and the coast and gradually rise, according to the latest Elevation Map of the city, to 1m.

english: (3.28 ft.) , 2 m. (6.56 ft), 2.64 m. (8.67 ft.) according to the CLUP, and in addition to its recent measurement of up to 3 m. (9.84 ft.), 4 m. (13.12 ft.), and at 7 m. (22.97 ft.) in some parts of the city.

english: In other words by 2050 much more of the city will remain above ground from an estimated 4 ft.

english: This probably includes the tip of Mandurriao near the Iloilo Floodway, where, as we have seen, there is still much left in its depths even at high tide.

english:

The only problem we have is how to stop the high tide and storm surge in the bay and how high and how much flood water the city will experience due to the heavy rains brought about by Climate Change.

May ebidensya na kita dira sang pagbinaha-baha sa panahon sang Typhoon Frank (Hunyo 19, 2008) sa syudad, kon diin nangin-swimming pool ini sa 3/4 nga bahin sang syudad sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw.
english:
***

We already have evidence of flooding during Typhoon Frank (June 19, 2008) in the city, where it became a swimming pool in 3/4 of the city for several days.

text: Napamatud-an pa gid ini sang iguon ang pungsod sang todo maulanon nga Bagyo Igay sadtong Hulyo 27, 2023.
english: This was further proven when Typhoon Igay hit the country on July 27, 2023.

text: Nagpabaha ini sang 70 ka low-lying ka mga barangay.
english: It flooded 70 low-lying barangays.

text: In fact, ang tubig baha naglab-ut sa 45 ka pulgada (3.75 ft.) sa mga barangay sang Desamparados kag Camalig kag 38 ka pulgada (3.1 ft.) sa Dungon-B sa Mandurriao.
english: In fact, the flood water reached 45 inches (3.75 ft.) in the barangays of Desamparados and Camalig and 38 inches (3.1 ft.) in Dungon-B in Mandurriao.

text: Napamatud-an pa gid ini sadtong natabo sang Hulyo 21, 2024 sa baybayon sang syudad sang nag-evacuate ang madamo halin sa ila mga puluy-an malapit sa baybayon bangod sa tumalagsahon nga pagtaas dira sang taob (high tide) tubtub 1.99 m, ukon 6.53 ft.
english: This was further proven by the incident on July 21, 2024 on the city's coast when many people evacuated from their homes near the coast due to the unusual rise of the high tide to 1.99 m, or 6.53 ft.

english: After Typhoon Frank, 4.75 km were built.

english: Iloilo Floodway in 2020 that prevented the overflow of water at the confluence of the Tigum and Aganan Rivers in Pavia, Iloilo to Iloilo City from the province.

english: This floodway has an elevation from the surface of the sea that, in our view, is about 20 ft., which does not reach the back of Mandurriao based on an estimated 4 ft.

text: Sa bahin sang Molo, sa malab-ut sang Molo Boulevard, may dike man dira nga nagataas sing mga 19 ka tapak nga nagaaamlig sa mga pumuluyo batok sa pagtaas sang taob kag storm surge.
english: In the Molo area, near Molo Boulevard, there is also a dike that is about 19 feet high that protects the residents against the rising tide and storm surge.

text: May Sunset Boulevard (Iloilo North Bank Road) pa gid nga napatukod diri sining tuig lang, courtesy man sang pagpanikasug ni Drilon.
english: There is also a Sunset Boulevard (Iloilo North Bank Road) that was built here this year, courtesy of Drilon's efforts.

english: During the tenure of Mayor Jerry Treñas, many residents living along the coast and the Iloilo River were also forced to move to higher ground.

text:
***

Ugaling lang kay sige gihapon ining aton problema sang pagbinaha-baha sa syudad.
english:
***

However, we still have this problem of flooding in the city.

text: Makabulig seguro ang madinalag-on nga ginahimo sang The Netherlands (Holland) nga isa man ka “low-lying country”, nga daku nga bahin sini reclaimed land (2,500 square miles)./PN
english: The successful practice of The Netherlands (Holland), which is also a “low-lying country”, with a large part of it reclaimed land (2,500 square miles), will probably help./PN

text: Umani ng matinding atensyon online ang British YouTuber na si Max Fosh matapos niyang pekehin ang sarili niyang kamatayan sa pagtatangkang makuha ang $50 na refund mula sa isang airline.
english: British YouTuber Max Fosh has received a lot of attention online after he faked his own death in an attempt to get a $50 refund from an airline.

text: Ayon kay Fosh, hindi niya nagamit ang kanyang plane ticket at sinubukang i-refund ito.
english: According to Fosh, he did not use his plane ticket and tried to refund it.

text: Ngunit batay sa refund policy ng airline, kamatayan lamang ng pasahero ang tanging dahilan na kanilang tinatanggap para ibalik ang bayad.
english: However, according to the airline's refund policy, the death of a passenger is the only reason they accept for a refund.

text: Dahil dito, bumiyahe si Fosh patungong Seborga, Italy, kung saan nakumbinsi niyang maglabas ng isang pekeng death certificate ang isang lokal na opisyal.
english: Because of this, Fosh traveled to Seborga, Italy, where he convinced a local official to issue a fake death certificate.

text: Isinumite niya ito sa airline bilang “patunay” na siya ay pumanaw na.
english: He submitted it to the airline as “proof” that he had left.

text: Ngunit ayon sa kanyang abogado, ang ginawang ito ni Fosh ay mapanganib at maaaring mauwi sa kasong fraud, kahit pa ito ay bahagi lamang ng isang biro para sa kanyang YouTube channel.
english: But according to his lawyer, Fosh's actions are dangerous and could lead to fraud, even if it's just part of a joke for his YouTube channel.

text: Sa kabila ng lahat, hindi pa rin siya nakakuha ng refund.
english: Despite all this, he still did not get a refund.

text: Gayunpaman, nag-trending ang kanyang video at umani ng sari-saring reaksiyon mula sa netizens.
english: However, his video became trending and received mixed reactions from netizens.

text: Marami ang naaliw, ngunit may ilan ding nagpaalala sa kahalagahan ng pag-unawa sa refund policy ng airline bago bumili ng ticket.
english: Many were amused, but some also reminded the importance of understanding the airline's refund policy before buying a ticket.

text: “Nakakatawa pero delikado,” ayon sa isang netizen.
english: “Funny but dangerous,” one netizen agreed.

text: “Hindi dapat ginagawang biro ang mga ganitong bagay.”
english: “Such things should not be made into jokes.”

text: Padayon ang pagbantay sang Iloilo City Heath Office sang mga kaso sang dengue sa syudad.
english: The Iloilo City Health Office continues to monitor dengue cases in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Jan Reygine Ansino-Hortinela, medical officer III sang Iloilo City Heath Office, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ka importante ang pagpaninlo sa palibot bangud ini ang isa ka pamaagi agud matapna ang pagdamo sang lamok.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Jan Reygine Ansino-Hortinela, medical officer III of the Iloilo City Health Office, said that cleaning the environment is very important because it is a way to prevent the spread of mosquitoes.

text: Suno kay Hortinela, 11% nga mas manubo ang kaso subong sang dengue sa syudad sugod sang Enero tubtob Pebrero kon ikumpara sa nagligad nga tuig sa kapareho nga period.
english: According to Hortinela, the number of dengue cases in the city was 11% lower from January to February compared to the same period last year.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang CHO nga tayuyon ang ginahiwat nga pamulong-pulong sa tagsa ka mga barangay agud ma-edukar ang pumuluyo.
english: The CHO also ensured that talks are held regularly in each barangay to educate the people.

text: Santo sa data sang talatapan, sugod Enero 1 tubtob Pebrero 24, 2025, isa na ang napatay, samtang may tatlo ka aktibo nga kaso 3, kag 104 ang nakarecover.
english: According to the office's data, from January 1 to February 24, 2025, one person has died, while there are three active cases 3, and 104 have recovered.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga himuon ang 5S kontra Dengue – Search and Destroy breeding sites, self-protective measures, seek early consultation, support fogging, kag sustain hydration.
english: He also advised the public to practice 5S against Dengue – Search and Destroy breeding sites, self-protective measures, seek early consultation, support fogging, and sustain hydration.

text: Gina-engganyo sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang mga Ilonggo nga mag-upod sa obserbasyon sang Earth Hour 2026 kun sa diin ilabi nga pabaloran ang pagkinot sang kuryente.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government encourages Ilonggos to join the observance of Earth Hour 2026 where electricity saving will be especially valued.

text: Ginapangabay ang pagpatay sang non-essential lights ukon indi man kinahanglanon nga mga suga sa sulod sang isa ka oras halin 8:30 p.m. tubtub 9:30 p.m. bwas, Marso 28.
english: Non-essential lights or unnecessary lights are requested to be turned off for one hour from 8:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m. tomorrow, March 28.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mitzi Peñaflorida, head sang Environmental Programs and Management Services Division sang Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO), iya ginpahayag nga ginpalab-ot na nila ini nga panawagan tubtub sa kabanwahanan, kabarangayan, kag mangin sa mga balay kag establisyemento.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mitzi Peñaflorida, head of the Environmental Programs and Management Services Division of the Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO), said they have already extended the appeal to the towns, barangays, and even to houses and establishments.

text: Magluwas sa pagpatay sa mga suga, may ginpreparar man nga programa kag nagkalain-lain nga mga aktibidad sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol nga magasugod naman alas singko sa hapon.
english: Besides the lights out, there are also programs and various activities prepared at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol which will start at 5 pm.

text: Paga-updan ini sang health office, Sangguniang Kabataan, Red Cross, water districts, kag iban pa.
english: It will be accompanied by the health office, Sangguniang Kabataan, Red Cross, water districts, and others.

text: Sa mga magatambong sa event sa Kapitolyo, mahimo makapa-rehistro alas kuatro sa hapon.
english: For those who will attend the event at the Capitol, you can register at 4 pm.

text: Ang kada participant gina-require nga magdala sang liso ukon seedling sang native ukon fruit-bearing tree bilang suporta naman sa “Tanum Iloilo” program sang probinsya.
english: Each participant is required to bring a seedling of a native or fruit-bearing tree in support of the province's “Tanum Iloilo” program.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang pang-apat nga tuig sang “Ligum-Dulom” celebration sa Iloilo.
english: This is the fourth year of the “Ligum-Dulom” celebration in Iloilo.

text: Ang dululungan nga pagpatay sang non-essential electricity kag equipment amo ang pagpakita sang simboliko kag importante nga akto sang pagkinot kag pagbulig sa kalibutan.
english: The simultaneous shutdown of non-essential electricity and equipment is a symbolic and important act of saving and helping the world.

text: Ginsuguran sang World Wide Fund for Nature ang obserbasyon sang Earth Hour sang 2007 tubtub nga nangin isa ini ka global environmental campaign nga gina-updan sang minilyon ka mga tawo nga nagapatay sang ila mga suga sa sulod sang isa ka oras agud nga mapasangkad pa ang ihibalo natuhoy sa climate change.
english: The World Wide Fund for Nature began observing Earth Hour in 2007 until it became a global environmental campaign with millions of people turning off their lights for an hour to raise awareness about climate change.

text: Ginalantaw man sang kadam-an nga labi pa nga importante ang partisipasyon sa Earth Hour subong nga tuig ilabi na bangud sang nagakatabo nga energy crisis sa madamo nga mga pungsod.
english: Many also see participation in Earth Hour as even more important this year especially due to the ongoing energy crisis in many countries.

text: “More than an hour of darkness, it is a powerful reminder that small actions, when done together, create lasting impact for our communities and future generations.
english: “More than an hour of darkness, it is a powerful reminder that small actions, when done together, create lasting impact for our communities and future generations.

text: Take part in it!
english: Take part in it!

text: Turn off your lights, gather your family, and stand with Iloilo in making a difference,” kabahin pa sang pagpangagda sang Iloilo Provincial Government.#
english: Turn off your lights, gather your family, and stand with Iloilo in making a difference,” as part of the invitation of the Iloilo Provincial Government.#

text: Ilisipon na lang suno sa City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) ang mga opisyal sang Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City ang naga-kooperar sa mga pulis kaangot sa mga ginapatigayon nga drug buy bust operation.
english: The City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) said it will count the officials of Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City who are cooperating with the police in connection with the ongoing drug buy bust operation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, officer-in-charge sang CDEU, iya ginpahayag nga wala siya nakahibalo kun nahuya ukon nahadlok ang barangay officials, apang nagapang-alang-alang ang mga ini nga magbulig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, officer-in-charge of the CDEU, said he does not know if the barangay officials are ashamed or afraid, but they are reluctant to help.

text: Pahayag ni Gimeno, mabudlay sudlon ang amo nga barangay, apang daku nga suporta sa ila bahin ang civilian informants.
english: Gimeno said it is difficult to enter the barangay, but the civilian informants are a big support on their part.

text: Indi na bag-o ang Bakhaw sa pamatin-an sang taga-syudad kun buy bust ang hambalan suno kay Roque, ilabi na nga ang nadakpan sa iban nga operasyon, nagatudlo man sa amo nga barangay nga amo ang ila source.
english: Bakhaw is not new to the city's audience when it comes to buy bust, Roque said, especially since those arrested in other operations also point to the barangay as their source.

text: Lakip sa latest operations sang pulis sa Barangay Bakhaw amo ang natabo subong nga Marso nga pagdakop sa anum ka mga suspek nga yara sa balay sang main target sang drug buy bust.
english: Among the latest operations of the police in Barangay Bakhaw is the March arrest of six suspects who were in the house of the main target of the drug buy bust.

text: Nakuha sa ila ang suspected shabu nga may balor P952,000.
english: They were recovered with suspected shabu worth P952,000.

text:
Sang hingapusan sang Pebrero, may mag-utod man nga construction worker kag passenger assistant officer nga nadakpan sa amo nga barangay kun sa diin nakumpiskar ang P1.9-million nga balor sang ginapasuni shabu.#

Naaresto ang duha sa joint operation sang CDEU, Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) Team, Revitalized Pulis sa Barangay (RPSB) Team Bakhaw, kag Iloilo City Police Station 10 – Station Drug Enforcement Team.
english:
In late February, two brothers, a construction worker and a passenger assistant officer, were also arrested in the same barangay where P1.9-million worth of suspected shabu was seized.

The two were arrested in a joint operation by the CDEU, Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) Team, Revitalized Police in Barangay (RPSB) Team Bakhaw, and Iloilo City Police Station 10 – Station Drug Enforcement Team.

text:
Sinemana ang intense surveillance nga ginhimo kasunod sang community tips kag bulig man sang RPSB Bakhaw.#

Photo from ICPO
english:
The intense surveillance was conducted weekly following community tips and the help of RPSB Bakhaw.

Photo from ICPO

text: Magataas sang halos piso ang presyo sang mga produktong petrolyo sa subong nga semana.
english: The price of petroleum products will rise by nearly a peso this week.

text: Ini matapos gin-anunsyo sang mga retailer subong nga adlaw ang pagtaas sang presyo, kasunod sang tensyon sa tunga sang Estados Unidos kag Iran.
english: This comes after retailers today announced a price increase, following tensions between the United States and Iran.

text:
Gasolina: Posible nga magsaka sang ₱1.90 kada litroDiesel: Posible nga magsaka sang ₱1.20 kada litroKerosene: Posible nga magsaka sang ₱1.50 kada litro

Ipatuman ang amo nga mga pagtaas sang presyo sa Martes sang aga.
english:
Gasoline: Likely to rise by ₱1.90 per literDiesel: Likely to rise by ₱1.20 per literKerosene: Likely to rise by ₱1.50 per liter

Those price increases will be implemented on Tuesday morning.

text: Posible nga magpasaka sang presyo sang ila ginabaligya nga pagkaon ang mga nagapanag-iya sang karinderya sa Iloilo City bangud sa posible nga pagsaka man sa presyo sang Liquified Petroleum Gas (LPG) sa masunod nga bulan.
english: Cafeteria owners in Iloilo City are likely to raise the price of their food due to the possible increase in the price of Liquified Petroleum Gas (LPG) next month.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Frozzy Magbanua, nagapanag-iya sang karinderya sa City Proper, iya ginpahayag nga magadugang sila sang P2 tubtob P5 kun matigayon nga mapasaka ang presyo sang LPG.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Frozzy Magbanua, owner of a cafeteria in City Proper, said they will add P2 to P5 if the price of LPG is increased.

text: Suno sa iya, ila man ginakonsiderar nga buhinan nalang ang serving sang ila ginabaligya nga sud-an kag ipabilin ang ila presyo agud indi man matam-an ang mga estudyante nga masami nga nagabakal sa ila.
english: He said they are also considering reducing the serving of their food and maintaining their price so that there are not too many students who often buy from them.

text: Dugang pa ni Magbanua, indi lang ang presyo sang LPG ang ila ginaproblema bangud nagmahal man ang bugas, mantika kag iban pa nga ila gid ginagamit sa ila nga negosyo.
english: Magbanua added that the price of LPG is not the only problem they are facing because the price of rice, oil and other items that they use in their business have also increased.

text: Nakonsensya gani nga nag-resign ang pinakamataas nga counterterrorism official sang administrasyon ni United States President Donald Trump.
english: The top counterterrorism official of the administration of United States President Donald Trump has resigned.

text: Ginbutang man mismo ni Joseph Kent, director sang National Counterterrorism Center (NCTC), sa iya resignation letter kay Trump nga indi na masarangan sang konsensya sini nga magsuporta sa gyera batok sa Iran.
english: Joseph Kent, director of the National Counterterrorism Center (NCTC), also put it in his resignation letter to Trump that he could no longer conscientiously support the war against Iran.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga wala man sang pagpamahog nga dala ang Iran sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: He also said that Iran does not pose any threat to the United States of America.

text:
Suno pa sa iya, klaro nga ang Estados Unidos ang nagsugod sang gyera bangud sang pressure halin sa Israel kag sa iya sini nga “powerful American lobby.”

Bangud sa iya pagbiya sa posisyon, siya ang pinaka-high profile figure halin sa Trump administration nga naghalin agud nga magprotesta batok sa gyera sa Middle East.
english:
He said it is clear that the United States started the war because of pressure from Israel and its “powerful American lobby.”

With his resignation, he is the most high profile figure from the Trump administration to leave to protest against the war in the Middle East.

text: Kilala si Kent nga anay myembro sang Green Beret special forces.
english: Kent is known to be a former member of the Green Beret special forces.

text: Napadala siya sa 11 ka beses sa overseas operations kaupod ang militar sang Estados Unidos lakip na ang US Army special forces sa Iraq.
english: He was deployed 11 times in overseas operations with the US military including US Army special forces in Iraq.

text: Sang ulihi, nangin paramilitary officer siya sa Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) apang sang ulihi nagbiya na ini sa serbisyo sa gobyerno matapos napatay ang iya asawa nga isa man ka US military officer sa suicide bombing sa Syria sang 2019.
english: Later, he became a paramilitary officer in the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) but later left government service after his wife, also a US military officer, was killed in a suicide bombing in Syria in 2019.

text: Sa iya post matapos nag-resign, namensyonar man sini ang iya asawa.
english: In his post after resigning, he also mentioned his wife.

text: “As a Gold Star husband who lost my beloved wife Shannon in a war manufactured by Israel, I cannot support sending the next generation off to fight and die in a war that serves no benefit to the American people nor justifies the cost of American lives,” suno kay Kent.
english: “As a Gold Star husband who lost my beloved wife Shannon in a war manufactured by Israel, I cannot support sending the next generation off to fight and die in a war that serves no benefit to the American people nor justifies the cost of American lives,” according to Kent.

text: Matandaan nga gin-appoint ni Trump si Kent sa NCTC kun sa diin nagatrabaho siya sa idalom sang director sang national intelligence.
english: Trump appointed Kent to the NCTC where he works under the director of national intelligence.

text: Sila ang naga-analisa kag naga-coordinate sang US response pananglitan may yara sang terrorist threats.
english: They analyze and coordinate the US response in case there are terrorist threats.

text: Nagpahayag naman si Trump nga mahina nga tawo si Kent kag maayo man gani nga wala na ini sa serbisyo bangud wala man siya nagaugyon suno sa iya sa assessment sini sa Iranian threat.
english: Trump said Kent is a weak man and it is good that he is no longer in service because he does not agree with his assessment of the Iranian threat.

text: Ginbali naman sang White House ang kaundan sang sulat ni Kent kag nagpanindugan nga may mapag-on nga ebidensya si Trump nga may plano ang Iran nga mag-atake sa US gani nga gin-unahan na lang nila ini.
english: The White House, however, rejected the contents of Kent's letter and insisted that Trump had strong evidence that Iran had plans to attack the US and that they had gone ahead with it.

text: Pormal na nga ginlunsar sang veteran singer nga si Imelda Papin ang “Pilipino Tayo,” isa ka bag-o nga Filipino song nga nagadala sang mensahe sang pag-isa kag kabakod sa tunga sang ginapangatubang nga pagpanghangkat sang Pilipinas.
english: Veteran singer Imelda Papin has formally launched “Pilipino Tayo,” a new Filipino song that carries a message of unity and strength in the midst of the challenges facing the Philippines.

text: Ang kanta nahimo kasunod sang nagapadayon nga mga isyu sa pungsod, lakip na ang mga ginapangatubang nga problema sa politika kag korapsyon.
english: The song was created following the ongoing issues in the country, including the political problems and corruption.

text: Ginkumpirma man nga magapatigayon sang “Pilipino Tayo” caravan si Papin sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang Pilipinas agud mapalapnag ang mensahe sang kanta.
english: It was also confirmed that Papin will conduct a “Pilipino Tayo” caravan in various parts of the Philippines to spread the message of the song.

text: Target sini nga maghatag inspirasyon sa paghiliusa sa tunga sang nagkalain-lain nga panindugan sa politika sa pungsod.
english: It targets to inspire unity among the various political positions in the country.

text: Gin-anunsyo man nga magahiwat si Papin sang selebrasyon para sa iya ika-50 anibersaryo sa showbiz sa Mayo 2026.
english: It was also announced that Papin will hold a celebration for his 50th anniversary in showbiz in May 2026.

text: Nagpanugyan sa publiko ang isa ka dental health expert nga indi magkahadlok nga magpadulong sa dentist kon nagabatyag na sang mga sintomas sang tooth decay.
english: A dental health expert advised the public not to be afraid to see a dentist if they are experiencing symptoms of tooth decay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rizjan Java Fantillan, isa ka dentista, iya ginpahayag nga isa sa mga ‘early signs’ sang tooth decay ang pagbatyag sang ngilo ukon nagabusog ang ngipon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rizjan Java Fantillan, a dentist, said one of the early signs of tooth decay is the feeling of tooth pain.

text: Suno kay Fantillan, mas makapaamayo kon mas temprano nga mapa-check ang ngipon agud nga matatapan kag mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: According to Fantillan, it is better to have the teeth checked earlier so that they can be treated and treated properly.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga kon ulihi na ang tanan kag wala na gid sang tsansa nga makay-o ang ngipon, mahimo ini ipaidalom sa root canal ukon gaboton na lang gid.
english: He also admitted that if it is too late and there is no chance of repairing the tooth, it can be subjected to a root canal or removed.

text: Kalabanan naman sang mga nagaka-eksperyensya sang tooth decay ukon dental caries amo ang naga-edad 5 ka tuig tubtob 12 ka tuig.
english: Most of those who experience tooth decay or dental caries are between the ages of 5 and 12 years.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa data sang Philippine Dental Association, yara sa 72% sang mga Filipino ang apektado sang tooth decay.
english: According to the Philippine Dental Association, 72% of Filipinos are affected by tooth decay.

text: Gintawag sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) nga isolated cases lamang ang sunod-sunod nga mga barangay officials sa probinsya nga nagkaladakpan sa mga drug buy bust operation.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) called the successive barangay officials in the province who were arrested in drug buy bust operations as isolated cases.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Colonel Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang IPPO, iya ginpahayag nga bisan may mga naaresto, nagapabilin naman ang mayorya nga barangay officials nga aktibo sa ila trabaho kag nagakooperar sa mga pulis.
english: Colonel Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the IPPO, said that although some have been arrested, the majority of barangay officials remain active in their work and cooperate with the police.

text: Suno pa kay Araño, indi man makaalarma ang kadamuon sang iligal nga droga nga nakumpiskar apisar nga minilyon ka pesos ang balor sini.
english: Araño said the number of illegal drugs seized is not alarming despite the value of millions of pesos.

text: Pahayag sini, pamatuod lang ini nga aktibo sa pag-report sa pulis ang mga pumuluyo, gani nga nadakpan, kag napunggan nga madala ang droga sa target market ukon mga drug users.
english: He said this is proof that the residents are active in reporting to the police, so that they are arrested, and prevented from bringing drugs to the target market or drug users.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sa naaresto sa drug buy bust sa Iloilo sang damlag lang amo ang tatlo ka mga punong barangay lakip ang isa halin sa Janiuay kag duha ang halin sa San Dionisio.
english: Among those arrested in a drug buy bust in Iloilo recently were three barangay captains including one from Janiuay and two from San Dionisio.

text: May yara man sang incumbent barangay kagawad, kag ang latest amo ang isa ka Sangguniang Kabataan Chairman nga nadakpan sang Pebrero.
english: There is also an incumbent barangay kagawad, and the latest is a Sangguniang Kabataan Chairman who was arrested in February.

text: Padayon naman ang kapulisan suno kay Araño sa ila nga monitoring kag pagpatigayon sang mga operasyon batok sa mga durugista.
english: Araño said the police continue to monitor and conduct operations against drug pushers.

text: May ginahanas man sila nga mga ido agud nga magamit nila sa mga drug buy bust, amo man sa checkpoint kag sa iban pa nga strategic locations.#
english: They are also training dogs to be used in drug buy busts, as well as at checkpoints and other strategic locations.

text: Magapabilin sa heightened alert status ang Philippine Coast Guard Station Iloilo tubtob Abril 5.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard Station Iloilo will remain in heightened alert status until April 5.

text: Ini kadungan sang pag-obserbar sang Semana Santa kun sa diin madamo ang mga nagabyahe nga mga tumuluo kag mga tawo nga magpaliwa-liwa kadungan sang holidays.
english: This is in conjunction with the observance of Easter where many believers travel and people to have fun during the holidays.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ensign.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ensign.

text: El John Ga, spokesperson sang nasambit nga ahensya, iya ginpahayag nga nag-deploy na sila sang 200 personnel agud nga magbantay sa nagkalain-lain nga mga ports kag terminal sa siudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: El John Ga, spokesperson of the agency, said they have already deployed 200 personnel to guard various ports and terminals in Iloilo City and province.

text: Suno kay Ga, may ara man sila sang passenger assistance center para mag-akomodar sang mga pamangkot sang mga pasahero.
english: Ga said they also have a passenger assistance center to accommodate passengers' questions.

text: Nag-deploy man sila sang ila personnel sa mga sakayang pandagat agud mag-monitor.
english: They also deployed their personnel on vessels to monitor.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa publiko nga likawan gid ang pagdala sang mga delikado kag ginadumilian nga mga bagay ilabi na ang makahulubog nga mga ilimnon agud nga mangin tayuyon ang ila nga mga pagbyahe.
english: He also reminded the public to avoid carrying dangerous and prohibited items especially alcoholic beverages in order to make their trips smooth.

text: Nagpaandam ang grupo sang Philippine exporters nga magatimbuok ang presyo sang gatong amo man ang balayran sa shipping pananglitan magdaku pa ang tension sa Middle East.
english: A group of Philippine exporters has warned that fuel prices and shipping charges will rise if tensions in the Middle East escalate.

text: Suno sa Philippine Exporters Confederation Inc.
english: According to the Philippine Exporters Confederation Inc.

text: (Philexport), ang pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo kag ang disruptions sa ruta sang aircraft kag barko nga nagakarga sang exports amo ang duha sa nagapangina nga risgo dala sini nga tension sa tunga sang US, Israel, kag Iran.
english: (Philexport), rising petroleum product prices and disruptions in aircraft and ship routes carrying exports are two of the growing risks posed by tensions between the US, Israel, and Iran.

text: Vulnerable ang Pilipinas sa fuel price hikes suno sa grupo, kag nagakahulugan ini nga magasaka man ang balayran sang exporters para sa produksyon, pagbyahe, kag logistics.
english: The Philippines is vulnerable to fuel price hikes, the group said, and this means that exporters' fees for production, travel, and logistics will also increase.

text: “Past tensions in the region have already led to higher freight and security surcharges and could again constrain trade flows and tourism, further dampening demand in major export destinations,” suno pa sa grupo.
english: “Past tensions in the region have already led to higher freight and security surcharges and could again constrain trade flows and tourism, further dampening demand in major export destinations,” the group said.

text: Gindugang man sang grupo nga ang posible nga kinahanglan magpasaka sang shipping rates amo ang export sectors kaangay sang electronics, garments, processed food, kag furniture.
english: The group also added that the most likely to increase shipping rates are export sectors such as electronics, garments, processed food, and furniture.

text: Magluwas diri, may posible nga saka man sa insurance premiums kag mas malawig nga transit times bangud lainon na naman ang alagyan ukon ruta sang mga barko.
english: In addition, there is a possible increase in insurance premiums and longer transit times due to the change of route of ships.

text: Nagpangabay naman ang Philexport sa gobyerno nga i-monitor gid ang developments kag maghimo dayon sang mga tikang nga maproteksyunan ang exporters sa possible nga disruptions.
english: Philexport urged the government to closely monitor the developments and take immediate measures to protect exporters from possible disruptions.

text: “The organization likewise calls on exporters to review supply chains, hedge against cost volatility where possible, and explore alternative routes and markets,” dugang sa ila nga statement.
english: “The organization likewise calls on exporters to review supply chains, hedge against cost volatility where possible, and explore alternative routes and markets,” their statement added.

text: Matandaan nga nagtingob-pwersa ang US kag Israel sa pagbomba sa Iran nga nagpatay sa ila Supreme Leader.
english: The US and Israel joined forces to bomb Iran, which killed their Supreme Leader.

text: Nagbalos ang Tehran kag ginbombahan ang US bases sa Middle East.#
english: Tehran retaliated by bombing US bases in the Middle East.

text: Isang 33-anyos na lalaki mula Hunan, China ang dinala sa emergency room ng First Affiliated Hospital ng Hunan Medical University dahil sa matinding pananakit ng tiyan at pagkahilo.
english: A 33-year-old man from Hunan, China was brought to the emergency room of the First Affiliated Hospital of Hunan Medical University due to severe abdominal pain and dizziness.

text: Namumutla at pawis na pawis ang pasyente nang dumating sa ospital.
english: The patient was pale and sweaty when he arrived at the hospital.

text: Ayon sa ulat ng Huaihua Daily, matapos isailalim sa CT scan, nadiskubre ng mga doktor ang kakaibang bagay sa loob ng tiyan ng lalaki.
english: According to the Huaihua Daily, after undergoing a CT scan, doctors discovered a strange object inside the man's stomach.

text: Lumalabas na may 12-inch na buhay na igat na tumagos mula sa bituka at lumalangoy sa abdominal cavity.
english: It comes out with a 12-inch live worm that penetrates from the intestine and swims into the abdominal cavity.

text: Dahil sa matinding sakit at panganib na dulot ng impeksiyon, agad na isinailalim ang pasyente sa laparoscopic surgery.
english: Due to the severe pain and risk of infection, the patient was immediately submitted to laparoscopic surgery.

text: Sa operasyon, nagulat ang mga surgeon nang makita ang gumagalaw na igat sa loob ng tiyan.
english: During the operation, the surgeons were surprised to see a moving worm inside the stomach.

text: Napag-alaman na may butas sa bahagi ng bituka ng lalaki na siyang daan ng pagpasok ng igat.
english: It was learned that the man had a hole in his intestine that was the route of the worm's entry.

text: Ginamit ng mga doktor ang espesyal na clamp upang tanggalin ang igat, at nilinis nila nang maigi ang apektadong bahagi.
english: Doctors used a special clamp to remove the tick, and they cleaned the affected area thoroughly.

text: Tinahi rin nila ang butas sa bituka upang maiwasan ang posibleng impeksiyon.
english: They also sutured the hole in the intestine to prevent possible infection.

text: Matagumpay na nakarekober ang pasyente at nakalabas ng ospital ilang araw matapos ang operasyon.
english: The patient successfully recovered and was discharged from the hospital a few days after the operation.

text: Sa ngayon, hindi pa matukoy kung paano nakapasok ang igat sa loob ng kanyang katawan, at patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad.
english: At present, it is not yet clear how the igat entered his body, and the investigation of the authorities is ongoing.

text: Ang insidenteng ito ay nagbigay babala sa publiko tungkol sa posibleng panganib ng mga kakaibang impeksiyon at ang kahalagahan ng agarang medikal na atensyon kapag nakararanas ng matinding pananakit ng tiyan.
english: This incident warns the public about the possible danger of strange infections and the importance of immediate medical attention when experiencing severe abdominal pain.

text: SANG sini lang, nakabaton si Mayor Jerry Treñas sang August 25, 2024 report sang UP-National Operational Assessment of Hazards (UP-NOAH) Center angot sa kahimtangan sang palibut (environment) sang syudad.
english: Mayor Jerry Treñas recently received the August 25, 2024 report of the UP-National Operational Assessment of Hazards (UP-NOAH) Center on the state of the city's environment.

text: Sunu sa resulta sang pagtuon (2014-2020) nga dala sining report, pila ka bahin sang syudad sa Molo, La Paz, kag Mandurriao ang naga-usmod (sinking) sing 8-9 ka millimeter (mm) kada tuig.
english: According to the results of the study (2014-2020) brought by this report, some parts of the city in Molo, La Paz, and Mandurriao are sinking by 8-9 millimeters (mm) per year.

text: Gintudlo ang tatlo ka kabangdanan: sobra-sobra nga pagkuha sang ground water; urban development (labi na gid seguro ang pagtukod sang dalagku kag mabug-at nga mga infrastructura); kag amat-amat nga pagtipon sang mahumok nga deltaic sediments nga dala sang agos sang tubig halin kag pakadto sa iban nga lugar nga sang ulihi masayuhan na sang mga tawo.
english: Three causes were pointed out: excessive groundwater extraction; urban development (especially the construction of large and heavy infrastructure); and gradual accumulation of soft deltaic sediments carried by the flow of water to and from other areas that were eventually accessible to humans.

text: Ang pagtuon sang US-based Climate Central Study sadtong 2019 nagasiling pa gani nga mangin katulad sa isa ka “swimming pool” ang syudad sang Iloilo pag-abot sang 2050.
english: A study by the US-based Climate Central Study in 2019 even said that the city of Iloilo will be like a “swimming pool” by 2050.

text: Natural lang nga mahangawa sa sining UP-NOAH report si meyor.
english: Naturally, the mayor is concerned about this UP-NOAH report.

text: Kag kita man nga indi kakosa ni Aquaman!
english: And those of us who are not Aquaman's friends!

text: Luyag pa gani ni meyor ipa-verify kag ma-review ang findings sini sang CENRO.
english: The mayor even wants the CENRO to verify and review its findings.

text:
***

“Ti, ano gid kon gausmod ang syudad?
english:
***

“Well, what if the city is destroyed?

text: Pwede man ini seguro matampukan,” pamangkot kag tugda ni Pedro.
english: I guess it can be piled up,” Pedro asked and suggested.

text: Indi kasubong kasimple ining problema, siling ko kay Pedro.
english: This problem is not that simple, I told Pedro.

text:
‘Balo ka,” siling ko, “ang syudad sang Iloilo nagatungtong sa manubo (low), patag (flat) kag mahuyang (loose) nga duta tungod sang kakulang sang kahugot (compactness) sang mabato (rocky) nga duta.”

Tubtub pa gani sa kaidadalman sini!
english:
'You know,' I said, 'the city of Iloilo rests on low, flat and loose soil because of the lack of compactness of the rocky soil.'

Even to its depths!

text: Ebidensya dira ang pag-usmod sang Ungka Flyover, kag sang isa pa ka flyover sa unhan sini, bisan pa ang mga haligi sini nakalab-ut na sa 30-50 ka tapak sa idalom samtang ginaagihan ini sang indi man mabug-at gid nga mga salakyan.
english: Evidence of this is the collapse of the Ungka Flyover, and another flyover ahead of it, although its pillars have reached 30-50 feet below the surface as they are passed by light vehicles.

text: May manubo man nga coastal elevation ang syudad nga pwede masul-ob sang dagat ang libre pa nga bahin sang duta patakas kon mataas ang taob (high tide), labi na gid sa panahon nga masanag ang bulan (full moon).
english: The city also has a low coastal elevation where the sea can wash away the free part of the land when the tide is high, especially during the full moon.

text: Sa subong pa lang gani, ginabahaan na ang syudad kon magtupa ang bisan pila lang ka minuto nga ulan sa madamo nga dalanon kag mga kabalayan dira mismo sa tunga sang syudad bisan pa malayo ang mga ini sa baybayon.
english: Even now, the city is flooded when even a few minutes of rain falls on many streets and houses right in the middle of the city even though they are far from the coast.

text: Ano pa gid ayhan kon mag-usmod ang pila ka bahin sang duta diri tungod sa pagpugday (subsidence) upod sa mas mabonok nga ulan nga dala sang Global Warming nga tuga sang Climate Change, kag sang sea level rise nga tuga man sang Climate Change!
english: What if some parts of the land here subside due to subsidence along with heavier rains caused by Global Warming caused by Climate Change, and sea level rise caused by Climate Change!

text:
***

“Ngaa problema ang pagkuha sang tubig halin sa bubon, haw?
english:
***

“Why is it a problem to get water from the well?

text: Ang pensar ko nga ang pagtener sang tubig amo ang makapahuyang sang palibut nga duta, kag indi kon mahubsan sang tubig,” pangutana kag tugda liwat ni Pedro.
english: I think it is the retention of water that weakens the surrounding soil, and not when the water runs out,” Pedro asked and suggested again.

text: Amo man gani ang pagpati ko sadto, gali, sunu sa mga experto sa siyensya, kon mahubsan ang ground water amo pa gani ang makapa-collapse (subsidence) sang palibut nga duta kay wala na ang tubig nga nagatukod sini.
english: I used to believe that, according to scientific experts, if the groundwater runs out, it will cause the collapse (subsidence) of the surrounding land because there is no water to build it.

text: Ebidensya dira seguro ang paglutaw sa dagat sang mga salakyan nga himo sa salsalon.
english: Evidence of this is probably the floating in the sea of ​​cars made of iron.

text: Ang parti naman sa sea level rise, sa nahibal-an na sang madamo sa aton, tuga ini sang wala untat nga pagboga sang greenhouse gases (GHG), labi na gid sang carbon dioxide, nga gapainit pa sang kalibutan sing labi.
english: As for sea level rise, as many of us already know, it is caused by the continuous emission of greenhouse gases (GHG), especially carbon dioxide, which is still warming the world.

text: Halin ini sila sa ginaluto nga fossil fuel (oil, natural gas, coal) nga ginagamit sang mga industriya.
english: They are derived from cooking fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) used by industries.

text: Amo gani nga padayon ang pagpanikasug sang tanan nga maibanan ang presensya sini sa palibut.
english: That is why everyone is constantly trying to reduce its presence in the environment.

text: Sa subong, ugaling, mabudlay pa gihapon mapatuman ini sing lubos sang mga pungsod.
english: At present, however, it is still difficult for countries to fully implement it.

text:
***

“Ti, ano gid kadalom ang pagsul-ob sang dagat sa kapatagan sang syudad pag-abot sang 2050, haw?” pangutana liwat ni Pedro.
english:
***

“Well, how deep will the sea erode the city’s plains by 2050, huh?” Peter asked again.

text: Well, ang diutay naton nga Aritmetik makapaathag sina.
english: Well, our little Arithmetic can explain that.

text: Sa pag-usmod sing 9 ka millimeter (mm) nga duta sa bibi sang baybayon, buslan na ini pasaka sang tubig dagat sang amo man nga kadalumon.
english: With the erosion of 9 millimeters (mm) of soil at the edge of the beach, it will be replaced upwards by seawater of the same depth.

text: Sa pulgada (inches) ang 9 mm nga pagsaka sang tubig dagat bale 0.354332 ka pulgada (inches) ini.
english: In inches, a 9 mm sea level rise is equal to 0.354332 inches.

text: Sa 10 anyos sa 2034, 3.54332 ka pulgada na ina.
english: At 10 years old in 2034, that’s 3.54332 inches.

text: Sa dugang nga 10 anyos pa gid sa 2044, mga 35.4332 ka pulgada na ina, ukon 2.95 na ka tapak (feet), kag sa dugang nga 6 ka tuig sa 2050 dugang pa ina nga 0.236 ka pulgada agud mangin 35.669 ka pulgada, ukon 2.9749 ka tapak (feet) sa pag-abot sang 2050.
english: In another 10 years to 2044, that will be about 35.4332 inches, or 2.95 feet, and in another 6 years in 2050 that will increase by 0.236 inches to be 35.669 inches, or 2.9749 feet (feet) to reach 2050 feet.

text: Tagatuhod na ina!
english: That's a knee-jerk!

text: Madugang pa naton dira ang sea level rise.
english: We can add sea level rise to that.

text: Sining Abril 2024 lang, sunu kay Pag-asa scientist Dr. Marcelino Villafuerte, ang sea level sa Philippine Sea naglab-ut sa 12 centimeters, ukon 5 ka pulgada sa sulod sang nagligad nga duha ka dekada, ukon 20 ka tuig.
english: Only this April 2024, according to Pag-asa scientist Dr. Marcelino Villafuerte, the sea level in the Philippine Sea has risen by 12 centimeters, or 5 inches, over the past two decades, or 20 years.

text: Sa 26 anyos pag-abot sang 2050 mga 6.50 ka pulgada na ina.
english: At 26 years old by 2050 that’s about 6.50 inches.

text: Kon updon ang subsidence nga 35.669 ka pulgada kag sea level rise nga 6.50 ka pulgada lab-ut na ina sa 42.169 ka pulgada, ukon mga 3.51 ka tapak (feet) sa 2050.
english: Combined with subsidence of 35.669 inches and sea level rise of 6.50 inches, that would reach 42.169 inches, or about 3.51 feet by 2050.

text: Hamak mo ran!
english: Hammock and blood!

text: Dugangan pa ina sang mabonok nga ulan sang Climate Change nga indi mapagwa sa lawod, susmariosep!
english: Add to that the heavy rains of Climate Change that can't be taken out of the sea, susmariosep!

text: malangoy gid kita sa baha.
english: we will swim in the flood.

text: Tubtub san-o?
english: How long?

text: Basi forever na!
english: Maybe forever!

text: Ti, ano ang mahimo naton dira – sang gobyerno kag naton nga mga pumuluyo?
english: So, what can we do there – the government and our citizens?

text: Dapat lang nga mabululigan naton ma-solve ining problema sa tanan nga paagi nga masarangan naton.
english: We should just help solve this problem in every way we can.

text: Subong na nga daan!
english: It's already old!

text: Pronto!/PN
english: Coming soon!/PN

text: Posible nga indi na makabalik sa nabilin nga bahin sang NBA season ang Golden State Warriors star nga si Jimmy Butler kasunod sang ginsuprer nga seryoso nga right knee injury.
english: Golden State Warriors star Jimmy Butler is likely to miss the rest of the NBA season following suffering a serious right knee injury.

text: Ginbuligan lamang nga makaguwa sa court ang 36-anyos nga player matapos nakabunggo kay Davion Mitchell sang Miami Heat.
english: The 36-year-old was only helped off the court after colliding with Davion Mitchell of the Miami Heat.

text: Sa amo nga hampang sa Chase Center, daog ang Golden State, 135-112.
english: In that game at the Chase Center, Golden State won, 135-112.

text: Ang Miami Heat amo man anay ang team kun sa diin nagahampang si Butler antes siya nagsaylo sa Warriors.
english: The Miami Heat were the same team Butler played for before he joined the Warriors.

text: Natalana pa nga magpaguwa ang Warriors sang official statement sang resulta kasunod sang overnight MRI scan.
english: The Warriors are scheduled to release an official statement on the results following an overnight MRI scan.

text: Apang antes pa sini, nagalapta na ang reports nga indi na makahampang pa subong nga season ang six-time NBA All-Star kasunod sang torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).
english: But before that, reports were circulating that the six-time NBA All-Star would miss this season following a torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).

text: May average si Butler nga 20.1 points kada game sa iya nga full season sa Golden State.

text: Antes sang insidente subong nga semana, may history na nga daan si Butler sang injuries sa iya tuo nga tiil lakip na ang torn meniscus sang Pebrero 2018 kag sprained medial collateral ligament sang Abril 2024.
english: Prior to this week’s incident, Butler already had a history of injuries to his right foot including a torn meniscus in February 2018 and a sprained medial collateral ligament in April 2024.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang American singer songwriter kag pop superstar nga si Taylor Swift kag sang iya partner nga si Travis Kelce nga kaslon na ini sa Hunyo 13, sa masunod nga tuig sa Ocean House sa Watch Hill, Rhode island.
