english: According to reports, Taylor is in a hurry to get married because she wants to have a child.

text: Ginpasapubliko man ang ila engagement sang Agosto subong nga tuig kag gin-anunsyo ini paagi sa isa ka joint Instagram post.

english: The Iloilo City Police Office has deployed 450 police personnel in various parts of the city to patrol this Easter Season.

text: Nag-post si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sang video sini nga naga-inom siya sang kape samtang yara ini sa Jerusalem.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu posted a video of him drinking coffee while in Jerusalem.

text: Ginpakita ini sa Telegram matapos ginpaguwa sang Iranian state media kag ginpalapnag sa Tehran nga napatay na ukon napilasan si Netanyahu bangud sa ila nga pag-atake.
english: This was shown on Telegram after Iranian state media released and spread in Tehran that Netanyahu had been killed or wounded in their attack.

text: “I’m crazy about coffee.
english: “I’m crazy about coffee.

text: You know ​what?
english: You know ​what?

english: I’m crazy about my people,” Netanyahu told his aide.

text: Una na nga ginsiling sang Iran Revolutionary Guards nga puntariyahon nila ang amo nga Israeli Prime Minister samtang nagapadayon ang gyera.
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guards have previously said they will target the Israeli Prime Minister as the war continues.

text: Napasaka ang emergency safety restrictions sa bilog nga Israel halin sang nag-umpisa ang gyera sang Pebrero 28.
english: Emergency safety restrictions have been lifted across Israel since the war began on February 28.

text: Halin sang nagsugod ang gyera, nakabisita si Netanyahu sa duha ka mga lugar nga gin-igu sang Iranian missiles kag nakakadto man siya sa ospital kag port kag military bases, apang limitado lamang ang media access.
english: Since the war began, Netanyahu has visited two areas hit by Iranian missiles and has also been to hospitals and ports and military bases, but media access has been limited.

text: Ang iya lamang opisina ang direkta nga nagapaguwa sang videos ilabi na ang mga statement sini kaangot sa development sang tensyon sa rehiyon kag ang mga bagay nga naga-involve sang interes sang Israel.#
english: Only his office directly releases videos especially its statements on the development of tensions in the region and matters involving Israel's interests.

text: KON ngaa ginbalewala sang Hague Tribunal ang claim sang China sa halos 80 porsyento sang South China Sea (SCS), ina tungod ang pag-okupar sini dira “illegal”.
english: WHY the Hague Tribunal ignored China's claim to nearly 80 percent of the South China Sea (SCS) is because its occupation there is “illegal”.

text:
Ang paathag dira sang Hague Tribunal amo ini: “There was no evidence that China had historically exercised exclusive control over these waters or their resources.”

In fact, sa bahin sang Filipinas, madugay na nga panahon nga gina-okupar kag sa idalom sang control sang Filipinas ang walo (8) ka isla kag tatlo (3) ka reefs sa Spratly Islands sa SCS malapit sa Palawan Island.
english:
The Hague Tribunal explained: “There was no evidence that China had historically exercised exclusive control over these waters or their resources.”

In fact, on the Philippine side, eight (8) islands and three (3) reefs in the Spratly Islands in the SCS near Palawan Island have long been occupied and under the control of the Philippines.

text: Lakip na ang Scarborough Shoal sa nakatungdan sang Luzon, nga gin-agaw sang China sadtong 2012.
english: This includes the Scarborough Shoal in eastern Luzon, which China seized in 2012.

text: Ebidensya ini nga wala makapakita ang China sang ‘exclusive control” dira sa mga lugar nga ini sa SCS.
english: This is evidence that China has not shown exclusive control over these areas in the SCS.

text: Lapaw man ini sa full sovereignty sang China sa natugot sang United Nations nga 12 nautical miles nga Territorial Sea halin sa baybayon sini, luas lang ang matugot pa sang UN nga ma-extend sa continental shelf sini.
english: It also exceeds China's full sovereignty over the United Nations' allowed 12 nautical miles of Territorial Sea from its coast, except for what the UN allows to be extended to its continental shelf.

text: Ining extent sang SCS halin sa baybayon sang China malapit sa 600 nautical miles tubtub sa Scarborough Shoal, nga lapaw na sa matugot nga 200-nautical mile nga mahatag nga EEZ sa China.
english: This extent of the SCS from the Chinese coast is close to 600 nautical miles to the Scarborough Shoal, which is beyond the allowable 200-nautical mile EEZ allowable to China.

text: In fact, wala man gani sing reklamo ang China sa kadugayon sang panahon sang pag-okupar dira sang pila ka nasyon, luwas sa sining ulihi lang sang agawon sini ang Scarborough Shoal sadtong 2012, nga mga 120 nautical miles lang halin sa Filipinas.
english: In fact, China has not even complained about the length of the occupation period by some countries, except recently when it seized the Scarborough Shoal in 2012, which is only about 120 nautical miles from the Philippines.

text:
***

By the way, ang Territorial Sea naga-refer sa lawak sang kadagatan kon diin may lubos nga sovereignty ang isa ka pungsod halin sa kaidadalman sang kadagatan tubtub sa Sea Surface sini.
english:
***

By the way, the Territorial Sea refers to the space of the sea where a country has full sovereignty from the depths of the ocean to its sea surface.

text: Ang EEZ nagatumod lang sa mapuslanon sini nga economic resources sa idalom sang kadagatan, samtang ang Sea Surface gapabilin nga sakop na sang International Waters kon diin ang Innocent Passage mahimo, although madamo nga mga pungsod ang luyag mag-obligar nga mangayo permiso ang nagaagi dira para maseguro nga indi mahalitan ang economic resources sa idalom sini.
english: The EEZ refers only to its valuable economic resources under the sea, while the Sea Surface remains part of the International Waters where Innocent Passage can take place, although many countries want to oblige those passing through to seek permission to ensure that the economic resources under it are not damaged.

text: Ang High Seas naman kabahin sang International Waters nga wala galakip sang EEZ, Territorial Sea kag Internal Waters sang isa ka pungsod, ukon sang Archipelagic Waters sang archipelagic state.
english: The High Seas are part of the International Waters that do not include the EEZ, Territorial Sea and Internal Waters of a country, or the Archipelagic Waters of an archipelagic state.

text:
***

Ang 1946 nga U-shaped nga mapa sang China nga nasulod sa 11-dash line, nga gina-claim sini nga sakop na sang iya Territorial Sea, una nga gin-publish sang gobyerno sang Republic of China (Taiwan) sadtong Disyembre 1, 1947.
english:
***

A 1946 U-shaped map of China enclosed in an 11-dash line, which it claims to now belong to its Territorial Sea, was first published by the government of the Republic of China (Taiwan) on December 1, 1947.

text: Gin-abandonar ini sang ROC sang malutos ini sa gyera kontra sa Communist China (People’s Republic of China – PROC), nga ginsalo dayon sang PROC.
english: The ROC abandoned it when it was defeated in the war against Communist China (People's Republic of China – PROC), which was then annexed by the PROC.

text: Sadtong 1952 ginbuhinan ini sang PROC sing duha ka dash line sa Gulf of Tonkin bilang pakig-ugyon sa North Vietnam nga kapareho sini nga Communist nation.
english: In 1952 PROC reduced it to two dash lines in the Gulf of Tonkin in agreement with North Vietnam, a fellow Communist nation.

text: Ginbalik ugaling sang PROC ang 11-dash line sang sini lang, probably tungod indi na sila magsahuay na sang Vietnam tungod sa claim man sini sa SCS.
english: However, PROC recently restored the 11-dash line, probably because they no longer want to fight Vietnam over its claim to the SCS.

text:
***

Nagpasaka kaso ang Filipinas sa Permanent Court of Arbitration (Hague Tribunal) batok sa pag-agaw sang China sa Scarborough Shoal sadtong 2012 mismo.
english:
***

The Philippines filed a case with the Permanent Court of Arbitration (Hague Tribunal) against China's seizure of the Scarborough Shoal in 2012 itself.

text: Gindaug sang Filipinas ang kaso sadtong 2016, apang wala ini ginkilala sang China.
english: The Philippines won the case in 2016, but China did not recognize it.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Sunu sa isa ka political observer, ina tungod kay ginapilit gid sang China ang pagpati nga bisan “illegal” ang pag-okupar sini sa SCS wala man gakahulugan nga wala na ini sing sovereignty dira.
english: According to one political observer, this is because China insists on the belief that even its “illegal” occupation of the SCS does not mean that it no longer has sovereignty there.

text: Katulad bala ina sa isa ka malalison nga anak nga ginsikway na sang amay apang gapati gihapon nga may bahin pa siya sa panublion halin sa amay, kag pwede pa nya malubad ang problema parti dira.
english: Is it like a rebellious son who has been rejected by his father but still believes that he still has a share in the inheritance from his father, and he can still solve the problem about it.

text: Tungod sini nagpatukod ang China sang mga “illegal” nga artificial islands kag outposts sa pila ka isla, kag ginapilit nga matabog sa pila ka isla kag outposts ang mga pungsod nga may control na dira, katulad sang ginahimo sini sa mga isla kon diin madugay na sa control sang Filipinas, katulad sang Pag-asa Island kag Ayungin Shoal kon diin na-stranded ang daan nga WW2 nga barko pang-gyera nga BRP Madre Sierra.
english: As a result, China has built illegal artificial islands and outposts on some islands, and is forcing countries that already have control over some islands and outposts to be expelled, as it does to islands that have long been under Philippine control, such as Pag-asa Island and Ayungin Shoal where the old WRP-2 warship was stranded. Mother Sierra.

text:
***

Pero may sabat dira ang Filipinas agud mapabakod pa gid ang kinamatarong sang Filipinas sa EEZ sini.
english:
***

But the Philippines has a response to further strengthen the Philippines' rights to its EEZ.

text: Sang sini lang, ginpakita sa publiko sang Filipinas ni retired SC justice Antonio Carpio ang 1734 Mother Map sang Filipinas kag ang mga mapa sadtong 1808 kag 1875 nga nagapaathag pa gid sang kaundan sang 1734 nga mapa.
english: Recently, retired SC justice Antonio Carpio showed the Philippine public the 1734 Mother Map of the Philippines and the maps of 1808 and 1875 that further explain the contents of the 1734 map.

text: Ang 1875 nga mapa gin-publish sa Madrid, Spain, nga sadto nag-colonize sang Filipinas, sa direksyon ni Capt.
english: The 1875 map was published in Madrid, Spain, which then colonized the Philippines, under the direction of Capt.

text: Claudio Montero, ang una nga Head sang Philippine Hydrographic Commission sa panahon sang Spanish regime.
english: Claudio Montero, the first Head of the Philippine Hydrographic Commission during the Spanish regime.

text:
Gin-describe ang 1875 nga mapa nga “the most complete and detailed official map of the Philippine territory during the Spanish regime.”

Ining 1875 nga mapa nagatudlo sa Scarborough Shoal kag Spratly Islands bilang kabahin gid gani sang Territorial Sea sang Filipinas.
english:
The 1875 map was described as “the most complete and detailed official map of the Philippine territory during the Spanish regime.”

This 1875 map identifies the Scarborough Shoal and Spratly Islands as part of the Philippine Territorial Sea.

text: Ining 1875 nga mapa sang Filipinas gin-adopt kag re-issued sang United States sing apat (4) ka beses bilang official map sang Philippine territory.
english: This 1875 map of the Philippines was adopted and re-issued by the United States four (4) times as the official map of the Philippine territory.

text:
***

Wala kita sang away sa China.
english:
***

We have no quarrel with China.

text: Abyan gihapon ang aton pagtan-aw naton sa China, ugaling lang kay kaaway ang panan-aw sini sa aton sa ginapakita na sini sa mga hitabo sa aton EEZ, samtang luyag ta lang kilalahon sang China ang aton legal nga kinamatarong sa EEZ naton.
english: We still see China as a friend, but it sees us as an enemy in what it is showing in the events in our EEZ, while we just want China to recognize our legal rights in our EEZ.

text: Tani makilala na sang China ini nga kamatuoran kag i-drop ang claim sang China sa Filipinas katulad sang ginhimo sini sa Gulf of Tonkin pabor sa North Vietnam./PN
english: Hopefully China will recognize this fact and drop China's claim to the Philippines as it did in the Gulf of Tonkin in favor of North Vietnam./PN

text: Ginpaidalum sa medical treatment si President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr. underwent medical treatment.

text: kagab-i matapos ini ginpahayag nga nakabatyag sang “discomfort” ukon paglain sang pamatyag.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, iya ginpahayag nga ang “discomfort” nga nabatyagan ni Marcos ang possible bangud sa tuman sini nga kakapoy sa pag-obra sang iya katungdanan bilang presidente.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, she said that the “discomfort” that Marcos felt was possible due to his exhaustion in performing his duties as president.

text: Dugang pa sini nga, gin-abisuhan sang iya doctor si President Marcos nga magpahuway kag ipaidalom sa monitoring.
english: He added that his doctor advised President Marcos to rest and undergo monitoring.

text: Sa karun, yara na sa estable nga kondisyon ang president kag nagpasalig naman si Castro nga magapadayon ang serbisyo ni President Marcos samtang padayon ini nga nagapaayo.
english: The president is now in stable condition and Castro assured that President Marcos will continue to serve while he continues to recover.

text: Balantayan alas nueve subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas) ang labing-una nga hampang sang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa main draw sang Australian Open.
english: Watch the first match of Filipino tennis star Alex Eala in the main draw of the Australian Open at 9 am this morning (Philippine time).

english: Eala will face 25-year-old American player Alycia Parks.

english: She is currently ranked 99th in the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) rankings while Eala is ranked 49th.

english: In addition to singles, Eala will also play doubles in the main draw of the Australian Open.

english: Words by: Bombo Jissa Padios

text: Nagtaas ang produksyon sang baboy kag manok sa Western Visayas sang 2025, suno sa datos sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english: Pork and poultry production in Western Visayas increased by 2025, according to Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) data.

text: Nagsaka sang 2% ang produksyon sang baboy kag 8.6% naman ang manok.
english: Pork production increased by 2% and chicken by 8.6%.

text: May pagsaka man sa produksyon sang Pato kag itlog sang manok.
english: There is also a rise in the production of Ducks and chicken eggs.

text: Nagnubo naman ang produksyon sang karbaw, baka, kag kanding kumparar sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The production of cattle, cows, and goats decreased compared to the previous year.

text: Naka-record man sang pagnubo sa numero sang mga kasapatan sa mga slaughterhouse sa rehiyon.
english: There has also been a recorded decline in the number of animals in slaughterhouses in the region.

text: Ginsabat sang actor nga si Zanjoe Marudo ang nagalapta nga tsismis nga bulagay na sila sang iya asawa nga si Ria Atayde.
english: Actor Zanjoe Marudo has addressed rumors that he and his wife Ria Atayde are separated.

text: Nagpabutyag ini sang iya pagkadismaya sa pagpalapta sang “fake news” sa social media, kag ginkumpirmar sini nga wala sang kamatuoran ang amo nga huring-huring.
english: He expressed his disappointment over the spread of “fake news” on social media, and confirmed that there was no truth to the rumor.

text: Nag-atubang ang actor sa isyu nga bulaganay sa media conference sang 2025 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) entry nga “UnMarry,” kun sa diin isa siya sa mga cast.
english: The actor faced the issue of separation during the media conference of the 2025 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) entry “UnMarry,” where he is one of the cast.

text: Suno kay Zanjoe, apisar ang mga yara sa iban nga pungsod naga-messge sa iya agud hibaluon kun matuod ang balita sang bulaganay na sila sang iya asawa.
english: According to Zanjoe, although those in other countries message him to find out if the news is true when he and his wife separated.

text: Ginkasal sanday Zanjoe Marudo kag Ria Atayde sa isa ka civil wedding sang Marso 2024, kag sang Setyembre ginbun-ag ang ila subang nga bata nga si Sabino.
english: Zanjoe Marudo and Ria Atayde were married in a civil wedding in March 2024, and in September their eldest son Sabino was born.

text: Gina-verify sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas ang reports nga may mga Pinoy nga gin-aresto sa Dubai bangud sa pag-share sang online content nga naangot sa atake kag air defense interceptions sa United Arab Emirates.
english: The Philippine government is verifying reports that Filipinos have been arrested in Dubai for sharing online content related to attacks and air defense interceptions in the United Arab Emirates.

text: Suno sa Philippine Embassy sa Abu Dhabi kag Consulate General sa Dubai, ginakuha pa ang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon halin sa lokal nga awtoridad kaangot sa identity, status, kag legal circumstances sang mga involved nga duha ka Pinoy.
english: According to the Philippine Embassy in Abu Dhabi and the Consulate General in Dubai, official confirmation from local authorities regarding the identity, status, and legal circumstances of the two Filipinos involved is still being sought.

text: Sa statement sang embahada kag consulate, ginsiling nga gina-respeto sini ang soberanya sang UAE kag ang ila kinamatarong nga ipatuman ang ila layi nga naangot sa national security, cybercrime, kag public order.
english: In a statement, the embassy and consulate said it respects the UAE's sovereignty and its right to enforce its laws related to national security, cybercrime, and public order.

text: Ginapahanumdom man sa overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) nga magtuman gid sa layi sang pungsod kun sa diin sila naga-trabaho kag mangin mahinalungon sa paggamit sang social media kag messaging platforms.
english: Overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) are also reminded to strictly observe the laws of the country where they work and be careful in using social media and messaging platforms.

text: Gina-abisuhan man sang embahada ang mga Pilipino nga likawan ang pag-rekord, pag-post, pag-forward, kag pag-komento sa indi beripikado ukon sa mga sensitibo nga security-related content agud malikawan ang paglapta sang rumor sa mga impormasyon nga indi pa man sigurado.
english: The embassy also advises Filipinos to refrain from recording, posting, forwarding, and commenting on unverified or sensitive security-related content to avoid spreading rumors on information that is not yet certain.

text: Istrikto nga ginadumilian sang UAE ang pag-share sang misleading ukon fabricated security-related content lakip na ang videos sang air defense interceptions, mga pagpang-atake sa ila landmarks, kag AI-generated false footage.
english: The UAE strictly prohibits the sharing of misleading or fabricated security-related content including videos of air defense interceptions, attacks on its landmarks, and AI-generated false footage.

text: Ginakabig ini nga criminal offense nga mahimo silutan sang pagka-preso kag substantial fines.
english: It is considered a criminal offense punishable by imprisonment and substantial fines.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaguwa subong sa reports nga sa 25 nga naaresto bangud sa pag-share sang content sang pagpang-atake sa ila pungsod, duha ang Pinoy samtang may iban man nga nationalities kaangay sang Indians, Pakistanis, kag Bangladeshis.
english: It is known that reports are now coming out that of the 25 arrested for sharing the content of the attack on their country, two are Filipinos while there are other nationalities such as Indians, Pakistanis, and Bangladeshis.

text: Isa ang UAE sa naka-eksperyensya sang missile kag drone attacks halin sa Iran halin sang nagsugod ang gyera sang Pebrero 28.
english: The UAE is one of the countries that has experienced missile and drone attacks from Iran since the war began on 28 February.

text: Ginkumpira ni Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Juanito Victor ‘Jonvic’ Remulla nga ini ang nakabaton sang impormasyon nga possible yara sa Cambodia ang most wanted kag pugante nga business tycoon nga si Charlie Atong Ang.
english: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor 'Jonvic' Remulla confirmed that he received information that the most wanted and fugitive business tycoon Charlie Atong Ang may be in Cambodia.

text: Suno kay Remulla nga ang nasambit nga pungsod ang nahibaluan nga may yara sang mga operasyon sang online sabong, rason nga ila gid ginapanan-aw ang posibilidad sang presensya ni Ang sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Remulla said the country is known to have online sabong operations, which is why they are closely monitoring the possibility of Ang's presence in the country.

text: Apisar sini, kumpyansa sa gihapon si Remulla nga yari pa sa pungsod si Ang kag magapadayon ang ila mga lihok sa pagdakop sa iya, lakip na ang pagkanselar sang pasapote ni Ang.
english: Despite this, Remulla is still confident that Ang is still in the country and they will continue their efforts to arrest him, including the cancellation of Ang's passport.

text: Matandaan nga gindagdagan sang warrant of arrest si Ang kag nagapangatubang sang nanari-sari nga kaso bangud sa ginapahayag kahilabtanan sini sa kaso sang “Missing Sbungeros”.
english: Ang was issued a warrant of arrest and is facing various charges for his alleged involvement in the Missing Sbungeros case.

text:
Ginpasidunggan ang aktor nga si Dennis Trillo bilang Asia’s Best Actor in a Leading Role sa Asian Academy Creative Awards bangud sa tumalagsahon sini nga ginpakita sa pag-arte sa papel nga Domingo Zamora sa pelikula nga “Green Bones.”

Nalapawan sini ang pila ka bantug nga aktor sa Asia nga sanday Jacob Elordi para sa “The Narrow Road to the Deep Road” kag Park Bo Gum sang Soth Korea.
english:
Actor Dennis Trillo was honored as Asia’s Best Actor in a Leading Role at the Asian Academy Creative Awards for his outstanding performance as Domingo Zamora in the film “Green Bones.”

It surpassed some famous Asian actors Jacob Elordi for “The Narrow Road to the Deep Road” and Park Bo Gum of Soth Korea.

text: Ang “Green Bones” amo ang opisyal nga entry sa Metro Manila Film Festival 2024, kun sa diin nagdaug man ini sang madamo nga awards, upod ang Best Actor para kay Trillo, Best Supporting Actor para kay Ruru Madrid, kag Best Picture.
english: “Green Bones” is the official entry in the Metro Manila Film Festival 2024, where it also won multiple awards, including Best Actor for Trillo, Best Supporting Actor for Ruru Madrid, and Best Picture.

text: Nagdaug man si Trillo sang Gawad Urian sang Oktubre subong nga tuig para sa amo man nga papel sa nasambit nga pelikula.
english: Trillo also won the Gawad Urian in October this year for the same role in the film.

text: Igarepresentar sang duwa ka mga bataon nga Pilipino ang Pilipinas sa 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics sa Pebrero.
english: The two young Filipinos will represent the Philippines at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics in February.

text: Ini amo sanday Francis Ceccarelli kag Tallulah Proulx nga kwalipikado para sa giant slalom kag slalom events.
english: These are Francis Ceccarelli and Tallulah Proulx who are eligible for the giant slalom and slalom events.

text: Ang 22-anyos nga Ceccarelli ang labing una nga Pilipino nga nangin kwalipikado para sa Winter Olympics kag ang mangin ikalima nga Olympic alpine skier sang Pilipinas.
english: The 22-year-old Ceccarelli is the first Filipino to qualify for the Winter Olympics and will be the Philippines' fifth Olympic alpine skier.

text: Ang 17-anyos naman nga si Proulx ang labing una nga Filipina nga makasulod sa regular Winter Games kag siya ang pinakabata nga Filipino Winter Olympian.
english: The 17-year-old Proulx is the first Filipina to qualify for the regular Winter Games and is the youngest Filipino Winter Olympian.

text: Pareho man sang mga ini nga ginrepresentar ang Pilipinas sa Asian Winter Games sa Harbin, China sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Both of them represented the Philippines at the Asian Winter Games in Harbin, China last year.

text: Suno kay Jim Apelar, presidente sang Philippine Ski and Snowboard Federation, bisan indi sila sigurado nga magadaog sila sang medalya, nagbukas naman ini sang dalan agud matagaan sang tyansa ang Pilipino nga mapakita ang ila nga kinaiya sa nasambit nga sports.
english: According to Jim Apelar, president of the Philippine Ski and Snowboard Federation, although they are not sure that they will win medals, it has opened the way to give Filipinos a chance to show their character in the said sports.

text: Ang 2026 Winter Olympics pagahiwaton halin Pebrero 6 tubtob 22 sa Milan kag Cortina d’Ampezzo sa Italy.
english: The 2026 Winter Olympics will be held from February 6 to 22 in Milan and Cortina d’Ampezzo in Italy.

text: Nagbalik na sa ila nga mga pwesto ang pila ka mga street vendors sa Plazoleta Gay matapos ang mga ini ang ginpangabay sang city government nga indi anay magplastar bangud sa ginhiwat nga ASEAN meeting sa syudad suno sa mga vendor.
english: Some street vendors in Plazoleta Gay have returned to their seats after they were asked by the city government not to set up due to the ASEAN meeting held in the city, according to the vendors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rosalyn, isa sa mga street vendor, iya ginpahayag nga may ara sang nagpalapit sa ila sang nagligad nga semanakag naghingyo ini nga indi anay sila magbaligya sa adlaw sang Huwebes, Pebrero 26, bangud may ara sang maga-abot nga mga bisita.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rosalyn, one of the street vendors, said that someone approached them last week and asked them not to sell on Thursday, February 26, because there are visitors coming.

text: Suno man sa iya, wala man naglain ang iya buot bangud naintindihan niya ang sitwasyon kag ang ila kahimtangan nga mga sidewalk vendors.
english: He said he was not upset because he understood the situation and their situation as sidewalk vendors.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Rosalyn nga ini ang una nga beses nga nagpalapit ang city government sa ila agud nga indi anay magbaligya.
english: Rosalyn also shared that this is the first time the city government approached them to stop selling.

text: Madumduman nga ang Iloilo City amo ang host sang 49th meeting sang High-Level Task Force on ASEAN Economic Integration sa idalom sang Association of Southeast Asian Nations, nga ginhiwat halin Pebrero 25 tubtob 27.
english: It can be recalled that Iloilo City hosted the 49th meeting of the High-Level Task Force on ASEAN Economic Integration under the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, which was held from February 25 to 27.

text: ANG PAGPASAKOP sang mga pungsod sa United Nations pagkilala man nila ini sang ila relasyon bilang mga myembro nga ginagamhan na sang mga pagsulundan kag kasuguan sang UN.
english: THE MEMBERSHIP of countries to the United Nations is also a recognition of their relationship as members already governed by the rules and laws of the UN.

text: Ang UN gintukod agud malikawan na ang makasiligni nga gyera sang WW1 kag WW2 kag ipatigayon lang sing may kahimpit ang “mutual good and peace” sa tunga nila.
english: The UN was established to avoid the horrible wars of WW1 and WW2 and to promote mutual good and peace between them.

text: Gani, kon may indi pag-intiendihanay sa ila tunga nga indi nila maareglo dapat idangop na ini sa International Court of Justice (ICJ), Permanent Court of Arbitration (Hague Tribunal), kag kon diin man nga bagay nga ahensya sang UN agud mahusayan ini sing “equitable and fair”.
english: Therefore, if there is a disagreement between them that they cannot resolve, it should be referred to the International Court of Justice (ICJ), the Permanent Court of Arbitration (Hague Tribunal), and any other UN agency to resolve it “equitable and fair”.

text: Ginhimo ini sang Filipinas paagi sa pagdangop sa Hague Tribunal sang kaso sini batok sa China sa pag-agaw sini sang Scarborough Shoal sadtong 2012.
english: The Philippines did this by appealing to the Hague Tribunal in its case against China for its seizure of the Scarborough Shoal in 2012.

text: Sa desisyon sang Hague Tribunal sadtong 2016 nagdaug ang Filipinas.
english: In the Hague Tribunal's decision in 2016, the Philippines won.

text: Ginsiling sini nga illegal kag wala sing kinamatarong ang China sa pag-okupar sang Scarborough Shoal kag iban pa nga mga lugar sa UNCLOS-authorized 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) sang Filipinas agud ma-enjoy sing lubos ang maritime resources sini.
english: He said China is illegal and has no right to occupy the Scarborough Shoal and other areas in the UNCLOS-authorized 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) of the Philippines in order to fully enjoy its maritime resources.

text: In fact, ang pag-claim sang China sang sovereignty rights sa malapit isa ka libo ka nautical miles (sobra 80%) sang South China Sea halin sa iya baybayon ga-violar na sang international law.
english: In fact, China's claim of sovereignty rights over nearly a thousand nautical miles (more than 80%) of the South China Sea from its coast already violates international law.

text: Nga bisan tagaan pa ini sang UNCLOS sang 200-nautical miles nga EEZ halin sa iya baybayon, indi gihapon makalab-ut ukon maka-overlap man lang ang legal maritime sovereign rights sang China sa EEZ sang Filipinas.
english: That even if UNCLOS grants it a 200-nautical mile EEZ from its coast, China's legal maritime sovereign rights will not reach or overlap with the Philippines' EEZ.

text: Kag sa tunga nila nahamtang na ang international waters kon diin pasa libre na ang tanan nga mga salakyan mag-agi.
english: And between them is the international waters where all vehicles are free to pass.

text: In other words, lubos diri ang sovereignty rights sang Filipinas sa pag-enjoy sang ano man nga maritime resources sa EEZ sini nga indi dapat pahilabtan sang China kag sang iban pa nga pungsod.
english: In other words, the Philippines has full sovereignty rights to enjoy any maritime resources in its EEZ that should not be interfered with by China and other countries.

text: Continental man nga pungsod ang China kag indi archipelagic agud makatudlo nga kabahin sang sovereignty rights sini ang ano man nga natural formation sa EEZ sang Filipinas.
english: China is also a continental country and not an archipelagic country so that any natural formation in the Philippine EEZ is part of its sovereignty rights.

text: In fact, wala man gani ginakilala mismo sang China nga archipelagic ini kay wala gani ini ginpalista ang China as such sa record sang UN.
english: In fact, China itself does not even recognize it as archipelagic because China has not even registered it as such in the UN record.

text:
***

Kon may reklamo ang China dapat tani ipasaka niya ini sa Hague Tribunal kag indi gamiton ang iya poder sa idalom sang “Might is Right” principle bilang nuclear power batok sa Filipinas nga isa lang ka mahuyang nga pungsod.
english:
***

If China has a complaint, it should file it with the Hague Tribunal and not use its power under the “Might is Right” principle as a nuclear power against the Philippines which is a weak country.

text: Pwede gani pasugtan na gid lang sang China ining EEZ sang Filipinas, labi na gid kay ginhatag ini sang UNCLOS sa kada myembro sini kag gindaug pa sa Hague Tribunal.
english: China can even allow the Philippines' EEZ, especially since it was given by UNCLOS to each of its members and won in the Hague Tribunal.

text: Pero kaaway ugaling ang pagtan-aw sang China sa Filipinas.
english: But China sees the Philippines as an enemy.

text: Proof?
english: Proof?

text: Gin-abandonar sang China ang maritime claim batok sa North Korea tungod abyan niya ini sa Communist Bloc, samtang abyan ang pagtan-aw naton sa China (kag iban pa nga pungsod) nga luyag lang ipatuman ang legal naton nga kinamatarong sa West Philippine Sea.
english: China abandoned its maritime claim against North Korea because it is a friend of the Communist Bloc, while we see China (and other countries) as friends who only want to enforce our legal rights in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sadly, nagapabilin gihapon sa China ang Era of Conquest mentality sang ancient times kon diin ginadaug ang luyag sang isa ka pungsod paagi sa palugos nga paagi, pamahog, paniplang, kag gyera.
english: Sadly, China still retains the Era of Conquest mentality of ancient times where the will of a nation was won by force, threats, intimidation, and war.

text: Sa padayon nga pang-bully sini paagi sa “harassment” sa aton pagpangisda sa sulod sang EEZ, pagbomba sang tubig, kag pagbarikada kag “dangerous maneuvering” batok sa aton resupply ships diri na gani kita karon sa sining magamo nga sitwasyon.
english: With its continued bullying through harassment of our fishing inside the EEZ, water pumping, and barricading and dangerous maneuvering against our resupply ships, we are now in this chaotic situation.

text: Tubtub nga naglala na gid ang padayon nga pang-bully sang China mismo sa sulod sang aton EEZ.
english: Until the continued bullying of China itself inside our EEZ has worsened.

text: Sang sining ulihi lang gani, ginhungod nga banggan sang Chinese coastguard ang aton resupply mission ship nga BRP Teresa Magbanua malapit sa Escoda Shoal nga sa sulod man sang aton EEZ.
english: Recently, the Chinese coastguard tried to collide with our resupply mission ship BRP Teresa Magbanua near Escoda Shoal which is also within our EEZ.

text: Indi lang kis-a kundi tatlo gid ka beses!
english: Not just once but three times!

text: Aba, gin-akusar pa sang Chinese coastguard ang Filipinas nga amo ang nagbunggo sa ila.
english: Well, the Chinese coastguard even accused the Philippines of hitting them.

text: Kitang-kita gid sang PH Coastguard drone ang ginhimo nila apang gin-akusahan pa ang Filipinas nga amo ang naghimo sini.
english: The PH Coastguard drone could see what they did but the Philippines was accused of doing it.

text: Butigon!
english: Liar!

text: Indi na makabatas ang US nga magtan-aw lang sa idalom sang mutual defense treaty sini sa “dangerous bullying” sang China sa Filipinas.
english: The US can no longer stand to look under its mutual defense treaty at China's “dangerous bullying” in the Philippines.

text: Nagpahibalo na ini nga mahatag sing escort vessel sa mga salakyan pangdagat sang Filipinas agud punggan ang padayon nga pang-harass sang Chinese coastguard.
english: It has already announced that it will provide escort vessels to Philippine vessels to curb the continued harassment of the Chinese coastguard.

text:
***

Dapat bala batunon na naton ang tanyag nga bulig sang United States?
english:
***

Should we accept the United States' offer of help?

text: For now, siling ugaling ni AFP Chief Brawner, nga panindugan man ni Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: For now, however, AFP Chief Brawner said that President Marcos Jr.

text:
“The Philippines has not exhausted its options and it would continue to conduct resupplies ‘unilaterally’ (wala bulig sang US).”

“If nothing works then that’s the time we can ask for help,” pamat-ud ni General Brawner.
english:
“The Philippines has not exhausted its options and it would continue to conduct resupplies ‘unilaterally’ (without US assistance).”

“If nothing works then that’s the time we can ask for help,” General Brawner concluded.

text: Tubtub ayhan may mapatyan na sa aton mga mangingisda, mga soldado kag mga tripulante sang resupply ships?/PN
english: How long will some of our fishermen, soldiers and crews of resupply ships die?/PN

text: Ginpasidunggan si Alex Eala kag Carlos Yulo bilang Male kag Female Athletes of the Year para sa Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) 2025.
english: Alex Eala and Carlos Yulo were honored as Male and Female Athletes of the Year for the Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) 2025.

text: Nagdaog si Yulo sang iya nga ikatlo nga gold medal sa vault sa World Gymnastics Championships kag nakakuha pa ini sang iban pa nga medalya sa Asian Championships.
english: Yulo won her third gold medal in the vault at the World Gymnastics Championships and won other medals at the Asian Championships.

text: Samtang, naka-angkon man si Eala sang isa ka maragtason nga tuig sang nakasulod ini sa WTA Top 100 kag nakadaog man ini sang una sini nga WTA 125 title sa Guadalajara sa Mexico.
english: Meanwhile, Eala also had a historic year when she entered the WTA Top 100 and also won her first WTA 125 title in Guadalajara in Mexico.

text: Nangin una man ini nga Pilipina sa Open Era nga nagdaog sang isa ka singles match sa US Open kag nadala sini pauli ang bulawan nga medalya sa SEA Games sa women’s tennis.
english: She also became the first Filipina in the Open Era to win a singles match at the US Open and took home the gold medal at the SEA Games in women’s tennis.

text: Pagahiwaton ang Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) 2025 Annual Awards Night sa Pebrero 16 sa Diamond Hotel sa Manila.
english: The Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) 2025 Annual Awards Night will be held on February 16 at the Diamond Hotel in Manila.

text: Ginpanginwala ni anay Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief General Nicolas Torre III ang aplikasyon sini para sa optional retirement.
english: Former Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief General Nicolas Torre III denied his application for optional retirement.

text: Suno kay Torre nga nakatalana pa ini nga makig-istorya kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Torre said he is scheduled to meet with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: natuhoy sa nasambit nga butang.
english: regarding the said matter.

text: Sa matandaan nga kahapon nga adlaw nagua ang impormasyon nga gin-aprubahan na ang nasambit nga optional retirement ni Torre, nga sa karun ang General Manager sang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA).
english: It can be recalled that information came out yesterday that the optional retirement of Torre, who is currently the General Manager of the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), has been approved.

text: Ini nga impormasyon ang naghatag sang antisipasyon sang opisyal nga pagpungko ni chief Lt.
english: This information gave anticipation of the official inauguration of chief Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
english: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.

text: bilang masunod nga PNP chief kag ang pagpromote sa iya bilang four-star general.
english: as the next PNP chief and his promotion to four-star general.

text: MAHUYOG kita sa sport apang daw wala sing huyog ang sport sa aton kon ang pang-kalibutanon nga sport na ang paga-istoryahan.
english: WE LOVE sports but sports seem to have no interest in us when it comes to global sport.

text: Una, tungod “small Malay man” lang kita nga arisgado lang makig-compete sa “big man” katulad sang Amerikano kag Europeano, nga kon makadaug man kita sa ila daw na-milagrohan lang.
english: First, because we are “small Malay men” who are risky to compete with “big men” like Americans and Europeans, that if we win them it seems like a miracle.

text: Ikaduha, kon makaupod man kita sa pareho nga categoriya sang ikasarang, indi man kita makatupong sa manggad nila agud maghanas sing husto sang mga atleta.
english: Second, if we are in the same category of ability, we cannot match their wealth to train athletes properly.

text: Gani, ang pagsulod sang Filipinas sa prestigioso nga Summer Olympics, nga nagsugod pa sa ancient games sa Olympia, Greece, indi agud magdaug gid sang Olympic medal.
english: Therefore, the Philippines’ entry into the prestigious Summer Olympics, which dates back to the ancient games in Olympia, Greece, was not to actually win an Olympic medal.

text: Agud lang maka-partisipar!
english: So they can participate!

text: Para sa aton, ang ma-qualify lang sa Olympic (Summer) Games isa na ka daku nga kadalag-an.
english: For us, just to qualify for the Olympic (Summer) Games is already a great achievement.

text: Nonetheless, wala kita nagkataka agud magpartisipar sa Olympic Games sugod sadtong 1924, luas lang sang kanselado ini sadtong WW1 (1940) kag WW2 (1944) kag sang gin-postpone ini tungod sa Covid-19.
english: Nonetheless, we have not been able to participate in the Olympic Games since 1924, except when they were canceled during WW1 (1940) and WW2 (1944) and when they were postponed due to Covid-19.

text: Believe you me, pero nagdaug pa kita sang pila ka Olympic medals nga naglab-ut sa 14 ka medalya tubtub sa pagdaug ni Hidilyn Diaz sang una nga gold para sa Filipinas sadtong 2020 Tokyo Olympics, nga nagduso na sa aton nga ambisyonon na sing tuod-tuod ang “Quest for Gold” sa Olympics.
english: Believe you me, but we have won several Olympic medals that reached 14 medals until Hidilyn Diaz won the first gold for the Philippines in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, which has pushed us to really ambitious "Quest for Gold" in the Olympics.

text: Natuman ini sa pagdaug ni Carlos Yulo sang 2 ka gold sa 2024 ParisOlympics.
english: This was fulfilled with Carlos Yulo winning 2 golds at the 2024 ParisOlympics.

text: Upod sa gindaug nga bronze medals nanday Neshty Petecio kag Aira Villegas naangkon na naton, sa kabug-usan, ang 18 ka Olympic medals.
english: With the bronze medals won by Neshty Petecio and Aira Villegas we have, in total, 18 Olympic medals.

text: Basi indi kamo magpati, pero diutayan lang kita namilagrohan nga makadaug sang gold sadtong 1948 London Olympics pa.
english: You may not believe it, but we were almost miraculously able to win gold in the 1948 London Olympics.

text: Gindaug tani ini para sa Filipinas ni Victoria Manalo kon nabaton dayon ang iya petition for dual citizenship bilang Filipino sa bahin sang iya Filipino nga amay kag English nga iloy kag sang iya pagminyo na sa Amerikano nga bana.
english: Victoria Manalo would have won it for the Philippines if her petition for dual citizenship as a Filipino had been accepted immediately on the part of her Filipino father and English mother and her marriage to an American husband.

text: So, ginrepresentaran na gid lang niya ang United States kon diin nagdaug siya sa 1948 London Olympics sang duha ka gold – isa sa Springboard Diving kag isa man sa Platform Diving.
english: So, he represented the United States where he won two golds at the 1948 London Olympics – one in Springboard Diving and one in Platform Diving.

text:
***

Una nanikad para sa Olympic medal si Teofilo Yldefonso sa swimming (breastroke) sa Amsterdam (1928) kag Los Angeles (1932).
english:
***

Teofilo Yldefonso first competed for Olympic medals in swimming (breastroke) in Amsterdam (1928) and Los Angeles (1932).

text: Sa iya pagdaug sang bronze nangin una pa gani ini nga Southeast Asian sa pagdaug sang Olympic medal.
english: With her bronze she even became the first Southeast Asian to win an Olympic medal.

text: Si Simeon Toribio, bronze naman sa high jump sa Los Angeles (1932) nga nangin flag bearer pa sang Filipinas.
english: Simeon Toribio, bronze in the high jump in Los Angeles (1932) who became the flag bearer of the Philippines.

text: Si Jose Villanueva bronze man sa boxing (bantamweight) sa Los Angeles (1932).
english: Jose Villanueva also won bronze in boxing (bantamweight) in Los Angeles (1932).

text: Nagdaug man sing bronze si Miguel White sa 400m hurdles sa Berlin (1936).
english: Miguel White also won bronze in the 400m hurdles in Berlin (1936).

text: Nagsunod naman ang iban naton nga mga atleta sa pagdaug sang bronze kag silver bag-o pa magdaug si Diaz sa weightlifting sang gold sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: Other athletes followed suit by winning bronze and silver before Diaz won gold in weightlifting at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text:
***

Historic kag daku gid matuod ang nahimo nga kadalag-an sang aton mga atleta sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english:
***

The achievements of our athletes at the 2024 Paris Olympics are historic and enormous.

text: Nagpadala kita diri sang 22 ka mga atleta sa 9 ka different disciplines nga nagalakip sang rowing, boxing, weightlifting, gymnastics, athletics, fencing, golf, swimming, kag judo.
english: Nagpadala kita diri sang 22 ka mga atleta sa 9 ka different disciplines nga nagalakip sang rowing, boxing, weightlifting, gymnastics, athletics, fencing, golf, swimming, kag judo.

text: Ginpangunahan ini nanday silver medalists Neshty Petecio kag Carlo Paalam sang 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: It was led by silver medalists Neshty Petecio and Carlo Paalam of the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Nagdaug kita diri (2024 Paris Olympics), sa nasiling ta na, sang 2 ka gold kag 2 ka bronze, kag nag-angkon sang dalagku nga benefits kag incentives ang aton mga atleta diri.
english: We won here (2024 Paris Olympics), as we have already said, 2 gold and 2 bronze, and our athletes here have received great benefits and incentives.

text: Nagbaton sing minilyon ka pesos si Carlos Yulo, Petecio kagVillegas sa idalom sang Republic Act No.
english: Carlos Yulo, Petecio and Villegas received millions of pesos under Republic Act No.

text: 10699, ukon ang National Athletes and Coaches Benefits and Incentives Act.
english: 10699, or the National Athletes and Coaches Benefits and Incentives Act.

text: Ang Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) nagpasalig man sa paghatag sang House –and-Lot sa magadaug sang gold sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: The Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) has also pledged to award a House –and-Lot to the gold winner at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Si Yulo nagbaton sa idalom sang RA 10699 sing premyo nga PhP20M sa 2 ka gold medal nga gindaug niya, samtang tag-PhP2M man ang nabaton sang duha ka bronze medalists.
english: Yulo received under RA 10699 a prize of PhP20M for the two gold medals he won, while the two bronze medalists also received PhP2M each.

text: Nagdugang pa sing pabuya ang Kamara (House of Repesentatives) kay Yulo sang PhP14M.
english: The House of Representatives added a reward of PhP14M to Yulo.

text: Ang nabilin sa mga 22 ka atleta sa delegasyon sang pungsod gintagaan man ni PBBM sang tag-isa ka milyon ka pesos (PhP1M); PhP500,000 naman ang kada coach.
english: The remaining 22 athletes in the national delegation were also given one million pesos (PhP1M) each by PBBM; PhP500,000 per coach.

text: Ini tanan agud, sunu sa kay PBBM, mas maenggayo ang aton mga atleta nga handumon pa gid nga magdaug sing medalya sa masunod nga mga Olympic Games.
english: All this is to, according to PBBM, encourage our athletes to aspire to win medals in the next Olympic Games.

text: Wala man nagpabaya ang mga dalagko nga mga kompaniya sa private sector sa pagpabatyag sang ila kalipay kag pagdayaw sa kadalag-an sang aton mga atleta upod sa paghinugyaw sang ila sobra 100 ka milyon nga mga kasimanwa.
english: The big companies in the private sector did not neglect to express their joy and admiration for the victory of our athletes along with the cheers of their more than 100 million fellow citizens.

text: Gintagaan nila si Yulo sang daku nga cash nga pabuya kag mga non-cash incentives (condo, free flight, matahum nga salakyan, etc.) nga naghatag na sa iya, sa kabug-usan, sang indi magkubos sa PhP35M nga balor sang cash kag non-cash incentives.
english: They gave Yulo a huge cash reward and non-cash incentives (condo, free flight, nice car, etc.) that have already given him, in total, at least PhP35M worth of cash and non-cash incentives.

text: Ang masunod nga Olympic Games natalana hiwaton sa 2028 sa Los Angeles, USA./PN
english: The next Olympic Games are scheduled to be held in 2028 in Los Angeles, USA./PN

text: Posible nga maga-dangat sa 2.3 tubtob 3.1 % ang inflation rate sa bulan sang Pebrero suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
english: The inflation rate is likely to reach 2.3 to 3.1% in February, according to the Central Bank of the Philippines.

text: Suno sa BSP, pwede nga magapataas sa inflation ang pagmahal sang presyo sang bugas, isda kag produktong petrolyo.
english: According to the BSP, the increase in the price of rice, fish and petroleum products could increase inflation.

text: Samtang, makabulig naman nga mapanubo ang inflation sa pagnubo sang presyo sang utanon, prutas kag karne.
english: Meanwhile, the price of vegetables, fruits and meat will help reduce inflation.

text: Sang Enero, naglab-ot sa 2% ang inflation.
english: In January, inflation hit 2%.

text: Suno pa sa ekonomista, posible nga magadasig ang pagtaas sang inflation subong nga tuig bangud sa ginatawag nga base effects nga halin pa sang nagligad nga tuig nagsugod.
english: According to the economist, inflation is likely to rise faster this year due to the so-called base effects that began last year.

text: Indi magnubo sa P3 bilyon ang ginakita sang mga oil companies kada adlaw humalin sang naglupok ang krisis sa Middle East.
english: Oil companies have been making at least P3 billion a day since the crisis in the Middle East erupted.

text: Ini suno kay Sen.
english: This, according to Sen.

text: Rodante Marcoleta may kaangtanan sa pagtimbuok sang presyo sang langis.
english: Rodante Marcoleta regarding the rise in oil prices.

text: Suno kay Marcoleta, sa sulod lang sang duwa ka semana, lapaw na sa 120 porsiyento ang ginsaka sang litro sang diesel kag gasolina.
english: According to Marcoleta, in just two weeks, the price of diesel and gasoline has increased by more than 120 percent.

text: Base naman sa report sang Department of Energy, 32.5 milyon litro sang diesel kag 23.3 milyon litro sang gasolina ang daily consumption sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Department of Energy, the Philippines consumes 32.5 million liters of diesel and 23.3 million liters of gasoline.

text: Pahayag ni Marcoleta, kun sumahon, yara sa P2.32 bilyon kada adlaw ang gross income sang oil companies.
english: Marcoleta said the gross income of oil companies is P2.32 billion per day.

text: Ginabanta nga 4,521,000 barrel sang gasoline ang makonsumo sang pungsod kada bulan.
english: The country consumes an estimated 4,521,000 barrels of gasoline per month.

text: Dugang ni Marcoleta nga kun tingubon ang diesel kag gasolina, nagalab-ot sa P3 bilyon ang gross income sa isa ka adlaw sang mga oil companies.
english: Marcoleta added that if diesel and gasoline are combined, the gross income of oil companies reaches P3 billion a day.

text: Isa ka buwaya ang ginpakaslan sang alkalde sa banwa sang San Pedro Huamelula sa Oaxaca, Mexico bilang kabahin sang isa ka masobra 200 ka tuig na nga tradisyon nga nagasimbolo sang koneksyon sang tawo kag palibot sini.
english: A crocodile was married by the mayor in the town of San Pedro Huamelula in Oaxaca, Mexico as part of a more than 200-year-old tradition that symbolizes the connection between man and his environment.

text: Makita sa seremonya ang buwaya nga nagsuksok sang puti nga bayo pangkasal samtang ginhalukan ini ni Mayor Daniel Gutierrez sa atubang sang mga pumuluyo.
english: The ceremony showed the crocodile wearing a white wedding dress as Mayor Daniel Gutierrez kissed it in front of the residents.

text: Sa ritwal, ginakilala ang mayor bilang hari sang tribo nga Chontal, samtang ang buwaya naman ang ginakabig nga prinsesa sang mga Huave.
english: Ritually, the mayor is recognized as the king of the Chontal tribe, while the crocodile is considered the princess of the Huave.

text: Antes sang kasal, ang buwaya ang ginparada pa palibot sa banwa kag ginpakilala sa kada panimalay.
english: Before the wedding, the crocodile was paraded around the town and introduced to each household.

text: Ginasugata siya sang mga pumuluyo nga may hakos, nagsaot sila, kag nagkinalipay.
english: The villagers greet him with hugs, they dance, and rejoice.

text: Para sa safety sang tanan, ginhigtan ang baba sang buwaya.
english: For everyone's safety, the crocodile's mouth was tied.

text: Ginpasuksok ini sang puti nga bayo pangkasal antes dal-on sa town hall para sa opisyal nga seremonya.
english: She was dressed in a white wedding dress before being taken to the town hall for the official ceremony.

text: Gintapos ang kasal sa paghalok sang mayor sa baba sang buwaya.
english: The marriage was consummated with the major kissing the crocodile in the mouth.

text: Pagkatapos sang seremonya, nagsaot ang mayor kag ang buwaya sa tono sang tradisyunal nga musika.
english: After the ceremony, the mayor and the crocodile danced to the tune of traditional music.

text: Suno sa mga local nga mga pumuluyo, ang ini nga sahi sang kasal nagadala sang maayo nga ani kag madamo nga mga hulik halin sa kadagatan.#
english: According to local people, this type of marriage brings good harvest and many kisses from the sea.#

text: Magapatigayon ang Miss Grand International (MGI) sang bag-o nga “All Star” edition nga maga-welcome sang mga beauty queens halin sa nagakalain-lain nga international pageants.
english: Miss Grand International (MGI) will hold a new “All Star” edition that will welcome beauty queens from various international pageants.

text: Ginpaguwa sang MGI ang teaser para sa pinakauna nga “MGI All Stars,” nga naga-invite sa mga anay kandidata ukon former queens nga luyag liwat magbalik sa spotlight.
english: MGI released the teaser for the very first “MGI All Stars,” inviting former contestants or former queens who want to return to the spotlight again.

text: Wala pa sang gindetalye sang pageant organizers ang eksakto nga mechanics, criteria, ukon schedule sang kompetisyon.
english: The pageant organizers have not yet detailed the exact mechanics, criteria, or schedule of the competition.

text: Apang sa social media, nagasugod na pagpang-mention ang madamo nga Filipino beauty pageant fans sang mga ngalan nga luyag nila nga mangin kabahin sang espesyal nga edition.
english: But on social media, many Filipino beauty pageant fans are starting to mention the names they want to be part of the special edition.

text: Lakip sa mga ginaennganyo sang Pinoy fans amo ang anay MGI representatives nga sanday Samantha Bernardo, Roberta Tamondong, kag Nikki de Moura, kag Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray.
english: Among the Filipino fans are former MGI representatives Samantha Bernardo, Roberta Tamondong, and Nikki de Moura, and Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray.

text: Sa subong, indi pa maathag kun buslan sang magadaog sa “MGI All Stars” ang reigning queen nga si Emma Tiglao sang Pilipinas ukon mangin separado ini sa orihinal nga pageant.
english: At present, it is not clear whether the winner of the “MGI All Stars” will replace the reigning queen Emma Tiglao of the Philippines or it will be separate from the original pageant.

text: Nagahulat subong ang fans sa dugang nga anunsyo gikan sa Miss Grand International.
english: Fans are now waiting for a further announcement from Miss Grand International.

text: Nagapanukot na ang pila ka mga drivers kag operators sang fuel subsidy nga ginpasalig sang gobyerno sa pagpanguna sang Department of Transportation and Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board.
english: Some drivers and operators are already collecting the fuel subsidy promised by the government led by the Department of Transportation and Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, iya ginpahayag nga madugay na nga preparado ang mga e-wallet sang mga drivers kag operators nga ginpahayag mangin platform agud nga mas mapadasig ang pagrelease sang subsidiya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said the e-wallets of drivers and operators have been ready for a long time.

text: Suno kay Parcon, ginatinguhaan man sang ila opisina nga magpakig-angot sa LTFRB 6 nahanungod sa fuel subsidy bangud ini amo ang nagpahayag nga tinguhaan sang ila opisina nga mapalab-ot gilayon sa mga natungdan ang subsidiya antes magtakop ang bulan sang Marso.
english: According to Parcon, their office is also trying to contact LTFRB 6 regarding the fuel subsidy because it said that their office will try to immediately deliver the subsidy to the concerned before the end of March.

text: Dugang pa niya, kinahanglanun na gid sang transport sectors ang bulig sang gobyerno ilabi na nga wala man natigayon nga mapatuman ang fare hike sa mga Public Utility Vehicles.
english: He added that the transport sectors need the help of the government especially since the fare hike in Public Utility Vehicles has not been implemented.

text: Gin-apelar sang lider sang Simbahan Katolika nga magpatigayon sang ceasefire sa Middle East sa labing-madali nga tion.
english: The leader of the Catholic Church appealed for a ceasefire in the Middle East as soon as possible.

text: Ginhinambit ini ni Pope Leo XIV pagkatapos sang weekly Angelus prayer sa St.
english: Pope Leo XIV said this after the weekly Angelus prayer at St.

text: Peter’s Square.
english: Peter’s Square.

text: Suno sa Santo Papa, ini nga mga kalakasan indi gid sarang makadala sang hustisya kag kalinong nga amo kuntani ang kinahanglanon sang mga tawo sa rehiyon.
english: According to the Pope, these violences can never bring the justice and peace that the people of the region would have needed.

text: Ginlaragway sang Pope nga masingki nga gyera ang naagyan sang katawhan sa nagligad nga duha ka semana.
english: The Pope described the past two weeks as a violent war.

text: Diri na kag ginpanawagan sini nga sa ngalan sang mga Kristyano sa Middle East kag sa tanan nga katawhan nga dapat nga may ceasefire na sa tunga sang mga pungsod nga amo ang nagsugod sang kinagamo.
english: He called on behalf of Christians in the Middle East and all peoples that there should be a ceasefire between the countries that started the conflict.

text: Linibo suno kay Pope Leo XIV nga mga inosente nga mga kabuhi ang nadula, kag madamo man ang napilitan nga magbiya anay sa ila nga balay.
english: Pope Leo XIV said thousands of innocent lives were lost, and many were forced to leave their homes.

text: “Thousands of innocent people have been killed, and many others have been forced to abandon their homes.
english: “Thousands of innocent people have been killed, and many others have been forced to abandon their homes.

text: I renew my prayerful closeness to all those who have lost their loved ones in the attacks that have struck schools, hospitals, and residential areas,” suno kay Pope Leo.
english: I renew my prayerful closeness to all those who have lost their loved ones in the attacks that have struck schools, hospitals, and residential areas,” according to Pope Leo.

text: “I hope for paths of dialogue that can support the country’s authorities in implementing lasting solutions to the serious crisis underway, for the common good of all the Lebanese people,” dugang sini.
english: “I hope for paths of dialogue that can support the country’s authorities in implementing lasting solutions to the serious crisis underway, for the common good of all the Lebanese people,” it added.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga semana sang regional tension nga nagsugod halin sang nag-atake ang US kag Israel sa Tehran nga ginbalusan naman sang Tehran.
english: This is the third week of regional tension that began since the US and Israel attacked Tehran, which Tehran retaliated against.

text: Wala pa sang anuman nga negosasyon nga ginapatigayon as of press time.#
english: No negotiations are underway as of press time.#

text: Gin-appoint ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. appointed

text: bilang bag-o nga President kag Chief Executive Officer (CEO) sang Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) ang orthopedic surgeon nga Dr. Edwin Mercado.
english: as the new President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) orthopedic surgeon Dr. Edwin Mercado.

text: Si Mercado ang nagtal-os kay Emmanuel Ledesma Jr.
english: Mercado succeeds Emmanuel Ledesma Jr.

text: kag opisyal nga nagpanumpa subong nga adlaw.
english: and officially sworn in today.

text: Ang appointment ni Mercado ang natabo matapos gintawag sang pila ka mga health advocates ang pagsaylo sang P60 billion nga pondo sang state insurer sa national treasury bilang “murder” sang Universal Healthcare.
english: Mercado's appointment came after some health advocates called the transfer of the state insurer's P60 billion fund to the national treasury as a “murder” of Universal Healthcare.

text: Si Mercado nagserbe bilang vice chairman sang Mercado General Hospital/Qualimed Health Network halin sang Marso 2021 sa diin ginpakita niya ang leadership subong man ang executive kag strategic planning expertise.
english: Mercado has served as vice chairman of Mercado General Hospital/Qualimed Health Network since March 2021 where he has demonstrated leadership as well as executive and strategic planning expertise.

text: Ang natungdan ang isa ka Doctor of Medicine graduate sang University of the Philippines sang 1987 kag nakatapos sang iya Master of Medical Sciences sa Global Health Delivery gikan sa Harvard Medical School sang 2023.
english: He is a Doctor of Medicine graduate of the University of the Philippines in 1987 and completed his Master of Medical Sciences in Global Health Delivery from Harvard Medical School in 2023.

text: Sa masami, indi gid malikawan nga nagausang ikaw sang ‘chewing gum’ para fresh ang imo ginhawa.
english: Often, it is inevitable that you chew gum to freshen your breath.

text: Apang siguraduha nga indi ka na mag-usang sini pag-abot sa inyo nga kwarto para magloving-loving sang imo nga bana ukon asawa.
english: But make sure you don't chew it when you get to your bedroom to make love to your husband or wife.

text: Ang ‘chewing without swallowing’ ang mahimo nga magresulta sa bloating bangud hangin lang ang imo ginatulon.
english: ‘Chewing without swallowing’ can lead to bloating as you are only swallowing air.

text: Ang imo tiyan kaangay nga nagahulat nga may magasulod nga pagkaon gani maga-release ini sang enzymes agud magtunaw sang pagkaon nga mahimo magresulta sa gastric problems.
english: Your stomach is like waiting for food to come in so it will release enzymes to digest the food which can cause gastric problems.

text: Gani samtang mahamot ang imo baba, ikaw naman ang prone sa pag-emit sang iban nga baho samtang kamo ang nagapakighilawas.
english: So while your mouth smells good, you’re prone to emitting other odors while you’re having sex.

text: Santo sa New England Journal of Medicine, ang peppermint kilala man nga naga- repress sang testosterone nga nagaresulta sa manubo nga libido ukon gana sa sex.
english: According to the New England Journal of Medicine, peppermint is also known to repress testosterone resulting in low libido or sex drive.

text: Nagpaandam ang Iranian Armed Forces nga sarang gid nila nga bombahun ang mga energy facilities sang mga kumpanya nga kaalyado sang Estados Unidos bilang sabat sa pag-atake sa Kharg Island.
english: The Iranian Armed Forces have warned that they are very capable of bombing the energy facilities of companies allied to the United States in response to the attack on Kharg Island.

text: Suno sa Al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, gilayun nila nga wasakun ang mga kumpanya nga may kahilabtanan sa operasyon sang langis sa rehiyon.
english: According to Al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, they will immediately dissolve companies involved in oil operations in the region.

text: Gintuad naman sang isang Iranian official nga normal gihapon ang operasyon sa Kharg Island, kag wala naapektuhan ang pagsinalayo sang mga residente ukon ang mga empleyado sa isla.
english: An Iranian official acknowledged that operations on Kharg Island are still normal, and that the movement of residents or employees on the island has not been affected.

text: Ang Kharg, nga nagapanguna nga terminal para sa langis sang Iran, ang may mga storage tanks kag housing program para sa linibo sini ka mga laborers, rason kun ngaa kritikal ini sa ekonomiya sang amo nga pungsod.
english: Kharg, the main terminal for Iranian oil, has storage tanks and a housing program for thousands of its laborers, making it critical to the country's economy.

text: Suno kay JPMorgan, ang bisan ano nga direkta nga atake sa isla ang sarang gid magpauntat sang madamo nga crude exports sang Iran kag magdulot sang seryoso nga retaliation sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: According to JPMorgan, any direct attack on the island could halt many of Iran's crude exports and cause serious retaliation in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Pwede na makakuha ang mga Pilipino sang mga importante nga dokumento sang civil registry sa digital nga pamaagi matapos gin-lunsyar sang Philippine Statistics Authority ang e-certificate kahapon nga adlaw.
english: Filipinos can now obtain important civil registry documents digitally after the Philippine Statistics Authority launched the e-certificate yesterday.

text: Paagi sa PSAHelpline.ph, pahanugutan na ang digital service kag pwede na makapangayo sang e-certificates nga may pareho nga legal authority kaangay sang tradisyonal nga PSA-issued certificates.
english: Through PSAHelpline.ph, the digital service will be enabled and e-certificates can be requested with the same legal authority as traditional PSA-issued certificates.

text: Dala sa mga digital nga dokumento nga pwede i-request kag ma-verify amo ang birth certificate, marriage certificate kag death certificate, amo man ang Certificate of No Marriage ukon CENOMAR.
english: Among the digital documents that can be requested and verified are birth certificate, marriage certificate and death certificate, as well as Certificate of No Marriage or CENOMAR.

text: Suno sa PSA, ang ini nga serbisyo isa ka “cryptographically secure,” nga nagakahulugan nga ini may ara sang hugot nga seguridad kag gindisenyo para sa real-time nga beripikasyon.
english: According to the PSA, this service is “cryptographically secure,” which means it’s highly secure and designed for real-time verification.

text: Sang 2023 ang kaangay sini nga serbisyo gintestingan man sa bulig sang Armed Forces of the Philippines Pension kag Gratitude Management Center kag sang Department of Foreign Affairs.
english: In 2023 a similar service was also tested with the help of the Armed Forces of the Philippines Pension and Gratitude Management Center and the Department of Foreign Affairs.

text: Nalab-ot ang masobra 200, 000 ka mga transaction ang na-proseso sang amo nga pilot-run nga naghatag sang kumpiyansa sa PSA nga handa na ini nga i-lunsyar publiko.
english: More than 200,000 transactions were processed during the pilot-run, which gave PSA confidence that it was ready to be launched publicly.

text: Ginpasakaan sang kaso kriminal ni Miss Grand International (MGI) president Nawat Itsaragrisil si newly crowned Miss Universe 2025 Fatima Bosch sang Mexico angot sa “repeated defamatory statements” sini batok sa iya.
english: Miss Grand International (MGI) president Nawat Itsaragrisil has filed a criminal case against newly crowned Miss Universe 2025 Fatima Bosch of Mexico over her “repeated defamatory statements” against him.

text: Nagpasaka sang kaso kriminal si Miss Grand International (MGI) President Nawat Itsaragrisil batok kay Miss Universe 2025 Fatima Bosch sang Mexico matapos gin-akusar ang kandidata sang “repeated defamatory statements” nga nakaguba sa iya reputasyon.
english: Miss Grand International (MGI) President Nawat Itsaragrisil has filed criminal charges against Miss Universe 2025 Fatima Bosch of Mexico after accusing the contestant of “repeated defamatory statements” that damaged her reputation.

text: Suno sa apat ka panid nga police incident report nga ginpabutyag sang MGI sa social media, personal nga nagpadulong si Nawat sa Wat Phraya Krai Police Station sa Bangkok sang Nobyembre 12 agud ireklamo si Bosch.
english: According to a four-page police incident report released by MGI on social media, Nawat personally went to the Wat Phraya Krai Police Station in Bangkok on November 12 to complain about Bosch.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ang mga ginhambal sang Miss Universe winner wala sang kamatuoran kag nakatuga sang halit sa iya pangalan sa Thailand kag apisar pa sa iban nga pungsod.
english: He said the Miss Universe winner's statements were untrue and caused damage to her reputation in Thailand and even abroad.

text: Nadiskubrehan nga ang reklamo nag-ugat sa insidente nga natabo sa ikaduha nga adlaw sang Miss Universe 2025 pageant.
english: It was discovered that the complaint stemmed from an incident that took place on the second day of the Miss Universe 2025 pageant.

text: Matandaan nga nagsabtanay sanday Nawat kag Bosch matapos ginpahayag ni Miss Mexico nga indi siya luyag magpasakop sa isa ka sponsored shoot.
english: Nawat and Bosch had an argument after Miss Mexico said she did not want to participate in a sponsored shoot.

text: Suno sa report, natabo ang inaway sa atubang sang iban pa nga mga kandidata.
english: The fight reportedly took place in front of other contestants.

text:
Ginkumpirmar man sang MGI nga indi matuod ang akusasyon ni Fatima Bosch nga gintawag siya ni Nawat nga “dumbhead.”

Suno sa organisasyon, wala ini nahambal sang MGI President kag indi husto ang ginalantaw nga rason sang pag-walk out sang kandidata pagkatapos sang insidente.
english:
MGI also confirmed that Fatima Bosch’s accusation that Nawat called her a “dumbhead” is false.

According to the organization, the MGI President did not say this and the reason for the candidate's walk out after the incident was not correct.

text: Si Nawat Itsaragrisil ang nagauyat sang local Miss Universe franchise sa sulod sang lima ka tuig kag sa subong nagaserbe siya bilang Vice President for Asiana sa Miss Universe Organization.
english: Nawat Itsaragrisil has held the local Miss Universe franchise for the past five years and currently serves as the Vice President for Asiana in the Miss Universe Organization.

text: SAMTANG nagahilapit ang midterm election sa 2025, sige na ang hulag sang mga political parties sa national kag regional level sa pagpabakod sang ila grupo kag pagpakig-alyado sa iban nga grupo agud dag-on ining eleksyon.
english: AS THE midterm elections in 2025 approach, political parties at the national and regional levels are already moving to strengthen their groups and form alliances with other groups to win the elections.

text: Indi subong sina ang matabo sa kaso sang mga partylist kay ang botohan lang amo ang sector-party sang mga katapo sa sector, kag ang mga nominee lang sang sector ang pwede makapungko sa kongreso depende sa kon pila lang ang ma-qualify sang Comelec.
english: This is not the case with partylists because the only vote is for the sector-party of the members in the sector, and only the nominees of the sector can sit in congress depending on how many the Comelec qualifies.

text: Sa bahin sang national kag regional parties, wala kita ga-expect nga magapabilin solido ini kon makapungko na sa pwesto.
english: As for the national and regional parties, we do not expect them to remain solid when they take office.

text: Ina tungod sa masami experimental man lang ang panindugan sang aton mga national kag regional parties, kag ang na-deklarar nga party principles indi na nila masunod kag magpaanod na lang sa daluyong sang power play nga makahatag bentaha sa ila (fuera los buenos) nga selfish political kag personal/family interests.
english: This is because often the position of our national and regional parties is experimental, and the declared party principles they no longer follow and just drift in the current of power play that gives advantage to their (fuera los buenos) selfish political and personal/family interests.

text: In fact, nakita na naton ang malaw-ay nga dagway sang ila pag-inupod halos sa pagsugod pungko pa lang sa pwesto sang PBBM administration.
english: In fact, we have already seen the ugly face of their relationship almost from the beginning of the PBBM administration.

text: Naglainay na sing buot ang grupo ni PBBM sang Federal Party of the Philippines kag sang mga Duterte sang Laban kag Lakas.
english: The PBBM group of the Federal Party of the Philippines and the Dutertes of Laban and Lakas have become angry.

text: Nag-resign na si VP Sara Duterte bilang Secretary of Education kag nagbugrasanay sang relasyon ang ila coalition.
english: VP Sara Duterte has resigned as Secretary of Education and their coalition has broken relations.

text: Madamo na gani sang mga ka-partido ang nagbulag sa grupo sang mga Duterte, samtang nadugangan ang myembo sang FPP.
english: Many party members have even split from the Duterte group, while the FPP's myembo has increased.

text: Nonetheless, gapasalamat kita upod sa mga pumuluyo sa concept sang partylist representation nga nagaamlig sang mga sectoral interest, nga nasaad sa President Cory-inspired 1987 Constitution.
english: Nonetheless, we are grateful along with the people for the concept of partylist representation that protects sectoral interests, enshrined in the President Cory-inspired 1987 Constitution.

text: Beynta (20) porsyento sa ila, ukon mga 50 sa kadamuon, ang yara karon sa House of Representatives nga may kabug-usan nga sobra 300 ka myembro.
english: Twenty (20) percent of them, or about 50 in number, are now in the House of Representatives with a total of over 300 members.

text: Daku ini nga kadamuon nga makaduso sang importante nga mga hagna kon gamiton nila.
english: This is a large enough number to push through important bills if they used it.

text: Ugaling nanotaran naton nga gaiya-iya lang ang ila panindugan kag daw wala lang sila labot sa iban nga sectoral interest kag bisan sa national interest.
english: However, we have noticed that their position is arbitrary and they seem to have nothing to do with other sectoral interests and even national interests.

text: Kinahanglan tani nga maghugpng (coalesce) man sila sa mga isyu nga nagadala sang kaayuhan sang kadam-an batok sa random kag often divisive nga interests sang mga tradisyonal nga mga pulitiko sa national kag regional parties agud mabuligan duso ini.
english: They should also coalesce on issues that bring the good of the masses against the random and often divisive interests of traditional politicians in national and regional parties to help push it.

text: Katulad abe sang isyu batok sa Rice Tarrification Law nga nagatugyan sing lubos sang importasyon sang bugas sa pribado nga mga negosyante, nga ang epekto pangkabug-usan.
english: Similar to the issue against the Rice Tarrification Law that completely hands over the importation of rice to private traders, with a global impact.

text: Daw mga mangunguma gid lang ang nagaduso sini.
english: It seems that only farmers are pushing it.

text: Katulad man sa isyu nga  dapat ipatuman gid ang rice sufficiency program nga makapasalig nga indi magutman ang aton mga pumuluyo, nga daw ang mga mangunnguma man ang gaaway sini.
english: Similarly, the issue that the rice sufficiency program should be implemented to ensure that our people will not go hungry, as if the farmers are fighting for it.

text: Basi lang ugaling nga gapati ang kadamuan sa ila nga mas maayo ining pakawala nga importasyon sang bugas.
english: However, many of them may believe that this rice import is better.

text: Nga wala si Pedro nagapati.
english: Which Peter did not believe.

text: Indi kita, siling ni Pedro, magsalig nga padayon lang nga makabakal sang bugas sa luas.
english: We cannot, Pedro said, rely on continuing to buy rice from abroad.

text: Mas maayo gid kuno nga aton gid produkto nga bugas ang aton saligan para segurado.
english: It is better to trust our own rice products for safety.

text: Tuod ina!
english: That's true!

text:
***

Sa United States, kasubong man sa Canada, UK, kag Japan, ang mga kandidato limitado sang kasuguan sa ila magasto sa kampanya halin sa mga campaign donations.
english:
***

In the United States, as well as in Canada, the UK, and Japan, candidates are limited by law in what they can spend on campaigns from campaign donations.

text: Ilegal diri nga gamiton sa personal nga kinahanglanon ang ano man nga nabilin (leftover) nga campaign donations sang kandidato.
english: It is illegal to use any leftover campaign donations of a candidate for personal purposes.

text: Pwede lang ihatag ini sa charity kag gamiton sa political expenses kag sa mga election-related nga mga kaso katulad sang pag-recount kon may problema kag indi gid man significante ang abanse sang pangontra.
english: It can only be given to charity and used for political expenses and election-related cases such as recounts if there is a problem and the opposition's lead is not significant.

text: Sa Filipinas ugaling pwede ilakip ang “leftover fund” sa personal income, nga indi ma-violar ang election kag tax laws.
english: In the Philippines, however, the leftover fund can be included in personal income, without violating election and tax laws.

text: Pamangkuta bala ninyo si anay Manila Mayor Isko Moreno parti sina.
english: Ask former Manila Mayor Isko Moreno about that.

text: Sa isa ka interbyu sa TV gin-aku niya nga ginlakip na niya sa iya personal income ang ining “leftover fund” nga nabaton niya halin sa mga campaign donations.
english: In a TV interview, he admitted that he had already included in his personal income the leftover fund he received from campaign donations.

text: Wala kuno problema dira basta mabayaran mo lang ang buhis.
english: They say there's no problem as long as you pay the taxes.

text: Ginbayaran niya kuno ang buhis nga PhP9.7 ka Milyon  sa iya income nga worth PhP50.55 ka Milyon nga lakip dira ang “leftover funds”.
english: He allegedly paid taxes of PhP9.7 million on his income worth PhP50.55 million including leftover funds.

text: Ang manggad ni Moreno, suno sa report sang Rappler, nagsaka sing tuman sa sulod sang 23 ka tuig niya nga pagpungko sa pwesto sa gobyerno.
english: Moreno’s net worth, according to a Rappler report, skyrocketed during his 23 years in government office.

text: Sang 2007, ang iya SALN nagpakita nga ang iya networth lab-ut lang sa P7.5 Million.
english: In 2007, his SALN showed that his networth was only P7.5 million.

text: Sadtong 2021 naglab-ut na ini sa PhP70 ka Milyon.
english: In 2021 it reached PhP70 million.

text: Ano naman ang masiling sang Comelec?
english: What about the Comelec?

text: Siling sang Comelec nga ang aton kasuguan naga-limite lang sang dapat gastuhon sang kada botante kag sang partido, kag wala nagasiling parti kon ayhon sang kandidato ang “leftover funds”.
english: The Comelec says that our law only limits what each voter and the party can spend, and does not say whether the candidate will use the leftover funds.
