text: “Really!” tugda ni Pedro, “Makandidato man ako, a agud makakwarta daku halin sa campaign donations.” Talaga?
english: “Really!” Pedro suggested, “I'm going to run for office, too, so I can make a lot of money from campaign donations.” Really?

text: Upod kamo ni Mel?/PN
english: Are you with Mel?/PN

text: Wala ginlauman sang isa ka babaye sa Thailand nga mabutang sa peligro ang iya kabuhi bangud gid lang sa isda nga iya ginkaon.
english: A woman in Thailand did not expect to risk her life just because of the fish she ate.

text: Suno sa report, duha ka semana na sang natulon sang babaye ang bukog sang isda.
english: According to the report, the woman swallowed the fish bone two weeks ago.

text: Gintuyo nila nga kuhaon ini sa tanan nga paagi pareho sang pagkaon sang saging apang wala sang may natabo.
english: They tried to remove it in every way like eating a banana but nothing happened.

text: Nagkadto sila sa ospital kag nagpa-X-ray, apang wala sang nakita nga tunok ang doktor.
english: They went to the hospital and got X-rays, but the doctor couldn't find any thorns.

text: Samtang nagadugay, nagbanog kag nagsakit ang iya liog.
english: As time went on, his neck became swollen and painful.

text: Sang ulihi, may nakit-an ini nga matig-a kag taliwis nga butang nga amat-amat nga nagagwa sa iya liog.
english: Finally, he noticed a hard, twisted object slowly coming out of his neck.

text: Sang nagtuhaw na ang punta sang bukog, nagbalik sila sa doctor kag didto na nakuha ang bukog sang isda.
english: When the tip of the bone appeared, they went back to the doctor and got the fish bone.

text: Suno sa mga doktor, tumalagsahon ang ini nga kaso kun sa diin ang sikag mismo ang nagmato-mato pagwa sa lawas sang tawo.
english: According to doctors, this is a rare case where the sikag itself came out of the human body.

text: Nagluntad ang isa ka tension sa tunga nanday Vice Gov.
english: There was a tension between Vice Gov.

text: Debuque kag Board Member Mondejar sa ginhiwat nga session kahapon, Enero 21.
english: Debuque and Board Member Mondejar in the session held yesterday, January 21.

text: Ini matapos nga luyag kuntani ni Mondejar nga magpasar sang isa ka resolution sa committee report ni Board Member Rolando Distura.
english: This is after Mondejar wanted to pass a resolution on the committee report of Board Member Rolando Distura.

text: Dayun man nga nagpanugyan si Debuque nga igabutang lamang sa unassigned business ang luyag sini nga idugang nga resolusyon bangod nga indi madali ukon mahapos ang magsal-ot sang isa ka resolusyon ilabi na kun wala ini nakaagi sa committee hearing.
english: Debuque also suggested that the unassigned business should only be added to the resolution because it is not easy to introduce a resolution especially if it has not passed the committee hearing.

text: Nag-anunsyar man sang isa ka recess si Debuque apang nagpamilit gid si Mondejar, rason nga ginhambalan sya sang Bise Gobernador nga magpungko.
english: Debuque also announced a recess but Mondejar insisted, so the Vice Governor told him to sit down.

text: Ginsunod man ini ni Mondejar kag nagpasugot na lamang nga ibutang ini sa unassigned business.
english: Mondejar followed suit and agreed to put it in the unassigned business.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuque, iya ginpahayag nga wala sini ginadumilian si Baord Member Mondejar nga mag-propose sang resolusyon, apang suno sa iya, dapat ini una nga ma-hitso sa lebel sang Committee on Infrastructure antes pa man i-deliver ang committee report sa plenary.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuque said she does not prohibit Baord Member Mondejar from proposing a resolution, but she said it should first be resolved at the level of the Committee on Infrastructure before the committee report is delivered to the plenary.

text: Suno naman kay 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar, wala man nagalain ang iya nga buot kay Debuque bangud iya man nga naintindihan nga may ara gid sang tyempo nga lain-lain ang panan-aw sang kada isa.
english: 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar said she is not angry with Debuque because she understands that there are times when everyone has different views.

text: GIN-SELEBRAR naton sadtong Hulyo 12 ang 8th Anniversary sang West Philippine Sea arbitral award sa pagdaug dira sang Filipinas sa sovereignty rights case batok sa China nga ginhulog sang Hague-based Permanent Court of Arbitration sa amo man nga adlaw sang 2016.
english: WE CELEBRATED on July 12 the 8th Anniversary of the West Philippine Sea arbitral award for the Philippines' victory in the sovereignty rights case against China thrown out by the Hague-based Permanent Court of Arbitration on the same day in 2016.

text: Sa pagkilala sining hitabo, ginpasar ni Senator Riza Hontiveros sang nagligad nga tuig ang Senate Resolution nga gapatuman sang National West Philippine Sea Day kada tuig bilang matigdas na nga pabutyag sang aton legal nga kinamatarong sa WPS.
english: In recognition of this event, Senator Riza Hontiveros last year passed a Senate Resolution implementing the National West Philippine Sea Day every year as a strong expression of our legal right to the WPS.

text: Sa Kamara (House of Representatives), ang Makabayan bloc nagpasar pa gid sang House Bill 8583 nga nagadesignar man sa Hulyo 12 bilang West Philippine Sea Day.
english: In the House of Representatives, the Makabayan bloc further passed House Bill 8583 which also designates July 12 as West Philippine Sea Day.

text: Rason nga gina-selebrar na ini sing may bug-os nga kahulugan sang aton mga pumuluyo bilang Victory Day sa WPS, nga karon sakop na sang mapa sang Filipinas.
english: That is why it is celebrated with full meaning by our people as Victory Day in WPS, which is now part of the map of the Philippines.

text: Ang Hague Tribunal nagkilala sang 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) sa WPS nga gintalana sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea para sa Filipinas kag iban pa sa mga 100 ka member-countries sini.
english: The Hague Tribunal recognized the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) in the WPS set by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea for the Philippines and others among its approximately 100 member-countries.

text: Nag-outlaw man ini sang Chinese aggression sa fishing ground areas sa aton mismo EEZ, kag nag-reject sang 9-dash-line nga claim sang China dira sa WPS.
english: It also outlawed Chinese aggression in fishing ground areas in our own EEZ, and rejected China's 9-dash-line claim to the WPS.

text: Sa pag-selebrar sang Hulyo 12, ginhiwat man ang isa ka forum sa Strattbase ADR Institute sponsored sang Australian kag US embassies sa Manila.
english: To celebrate July 12, a forum was also held at the Strattbase ADR Institute sponsored by the Australian and US embassies in Manila.

text: Gintambungan ini sang diplomatic community sang mga pungsod nga gapanindugan sa Rule of Law.
english: It was attended by the diplomatic community of countries that stand for the Rule of Law.

text: Ginpangunahan ini sang United States, Japan, European Union kag Canada, upod sa national security officials sang aton gobyerno, mga scholar kag policy experts sa national  security.
english: It was led by the United States, Japan, the European Union and Canada, along with our government’s national security officials, scholars and policy experts on national  security.

text: Nagpahayag sila diri sang ila lubos nga pag-ugyon sa Hague Tribunal ruling kag nanawagan sa China agud kilalahon ining arbitral award sa Filipinas labi na gid kay  katapo man ang China sang UNCLOS kag Permanent Court of Arbitration.
english: They expressed their full agreement with the Hague Tribunal ruling and called on China to recognize this arbitral award in the Philippines especially since China is also a member of UNCLOS and the Permanent Court of Arbitration.

text: Dapat respetuhon man sini ang kinamatarong sa Freedom of Navigation sa kadagatan kag kahanginan sa idalom sang international law.
english: It must also respect the right to Freedom of Navigation in the seas and air under international law.

text: In fact, ginpakamalaut nila ang padayon nga pagsikway sang China sang ruling sang Hague Tribunal kag ang padayon nga illegal acts kag pang-harass sini sa WPS.
english: In fact, they condemned China's continued rejection of the Hague Tribunal's ruling and its continued illegal acts and harassment of the WPS.

text: Panggarit-garit ini nga makapaibwal sang gyera nga indi luyag matabo pa sang United Nations sa ginsumpaan nga panindugan sini sa Rule of Law agud mapaiway na sing dayon ang gyera sa tunga sang mga pungsod.
english: It is a threat to provoke a war that the United Nations does not want to happen in its sworn position on the Rule of Law in order to prevent war between nations forever.

text: May mga rally man nga ginhiwat sa pagduso sang WPS Victory Day.
english: Rallies were also held to promote WPS Victory Day.

text: Mabuhay ang West Philippine Sea Day!
english: Long live West Philippine Sea Day!

text: Aton ini!
english: It’s ours!

text: Get out China!
english: Get out China!

text:
***

Hiwaton ang Ikatlo nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdnand Marcos Jr.
english:
***

President Ferdnand Marcos Jr. will deliver his third State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: sa Lunes, Hulyo  22.
english: on Monday, July  22.

text: Expected sa pag-attend amo ang mga nagapanguna nga  mga opisyal sang gobyerno halin sa Bise Presidente, Senate President, kag  House Speaker tubtub sa mga myembro sang gabinete.
english: Expected to attend are top government officials from the Vice President, Senate President, and House Speaker to cabinet members.

text: Subong man ang mga imbitado nga mga local officials, nagapanguna nga mga personalidad sa nagakalain –lain nga sector sang pungsod, kag ang diplomatic community.
english: As well as the invited local officials, leading personalities in various sectors of the country, and the diplomatic community.

text: Surprisingly, lakip si VP Sara Duterte sa indi magtambong sa SONA.
english: Surprisingly, VP Sara Duterte was among those who did not attend the SONA.

text: Luyag lang niya kuno mangin “designated survivor”.
english: He said he just wanted to be a “designated survivor”.

text: Wala sa aton kasuguan ang pag-designar sang “designated survivor”.
english: There is no designation of “designated survivor” in our law.

text: Ang Bise Presidente automatic nga successor sang Presidente sa aton Constitution, basi lipat siya.
english: The Vice President is automatically the successor of the President in our Constitution, maybe he will move.

text: Ukon gingamit lang niya ini sa lain nga kahulugan kay indi man kita makapati nga wala siya kahibalo nga wala sina nga tinaga sa aton kasuguan.
english: Or did he just use it in a different sense because we can't believe that he didn't know that word wasn't in our law.

text: Ukon galahog lang siya katulad sang masami ginahimo sang iya anay presidente nga amay nga si Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Or is he just a fool like his former president father Rodrigo Duterte often does.

text: Sa idalom sang US law, ang “designated survivor (successor)” isa ka opisyal sa presidential line of succession nga ginapalayo sa isa ka “undisclosed location” kon tion sang importante nga okasyon katulad sang State of the Nation kag Presidential Inauguration.
english: Under US law, a “designated survivor (successor)” is an official in the presidential line of succession who is removed to an “undisclosed location” during important occasions such as the State of the Nation and Presidential Inauguration.

text: Paniguro ini agud may maka-take over dayon sang duties sang Presidente in case sang isa ka mass-casualty  event tubtub may ma-elejer na nga bag-o nga presidente.
english: This is to ensure that someone can immediately take over the duties of the President in case of a mass-casualty event until a new president is elected.

text: Luyag man lang seguro ni VP Sara makalikaw nga makaupod si PBBM sa ina nga okasyon tungod sa indi na maayo nga pagtamdanay sang mga Duterte kag ni PBBM kag sang First Lady.
english: VP Sara probably wanted to avoid being with PBBM on that occasion because of the bad relationship between the Dutertes and PBBM and the First Lady.

text: Ukon, sunu sa mga malisyoso, kay may bati-bati nga may assassination attempt batok kay PBBM kag indi siya luyag maupod sa disgrasya kon matabo, kag mahapos makabulos dayon sa pagka-Presidente kag malibre man sa daku nga problema ang ila pamilya.
english: Or, according to the malicious, because there is a rumor that there is an assassination attempt against PBBM and he does not want to be involved in the accident if it happens, and easily succeed immediately as President and free their family from big problems.

text: Masakit ini nga suspetso.
english: This is a sick suspicion.

text: Dapat mahibal-n ni VP Sara nga mangin prime suspect man siya kon matabo ini.
english: VP Sara should know that she will be a prime suspect if this happens.

text: Gani, dapat magtambong gid si VP Sara sa SONA ni PBBM kag magpungko gid malapit sa Presidente para iwas sa malain nga suspetso.
english: Therefore, VP Sara should attend PBBM's SONA and sit near the President to avoid bad suspicion.

text: Indi bala, Pedro?/PN
english: Isn't it, Pedro?/PN

text: Naghatag sang libre nga konsultasyon ang dermatologist nga si Dr. Rema Cejar natuhoy sa dandruff ukon kaspa, bilang kabahin sang “Health Talk” segment sa Good Morning Philippines.
english: Dermatologist Dr. Dr. Stanley provided a free consultation. Rema Cejar on dandruff or dandruff, as part of the “Health Talk” segment on Good Morning Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo radio kay Dr. Cejar, iya ginpahayag nga ang dandruff isa ka common nga skin condition nga nagadala sang kakatol sa anit, apang indi ini makalalaton.
english: In an interview with Bombo radio, Dr. Cejar, he said that dandruff is a common skin condition that causes itching on the scalp, but it is not contagious.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga posible ini magtinir sa ulo sang isa ka tawo kon indi mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pag-atipan.
english: He also stated that it is possible for it to stay in a person's head if not given proper care.

text: Suno sa iya ang indi regular nga paghugas sang buhok nagadala sang build-up sang oil kag higko nga mahimo magpalala sang kondisyon.
english: She says irregular hair washing brings a build-up of oil and dirt which can aggravate the condition.

text: Gintudlo man niya nga ang stress isa man sa mga factor nga naga-increase sang oil production sa scalp, nga nagaresulta sa pagdamo sang kaspa.
english: She also pointed out that stress is also one of the factors that increase oil production in the scalp, resulting in an increase in dandruff.

text: Nagbilin man ini sang pahanumdom sa publiko nga importante ang husto nga hygiene kag pag-atipan sang buhok agud malikawan ang paglala sang dandruff kag iban pa nga scalp conditions.
english: He also left a reminder to the public that proper hygiene and hair care is important to prevent dandruff and other scalp conditions from getting worse.

text: Dismayado gid si Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vince Dizon matapos niya personal nga ginbisita ang kontrobersyal nga Aganan Flyover sa banwa sang Pavia kaina sang aga.
english: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon was disappointed after he personally visited the controversial Aganan Flyover in Pavia town this morning.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Dizon nga makaulugot ang sitwasyon sang proyekto bangud halos lima ka tuig na ini nga nakatiwang-wang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dizon said the situation of the project is sad because it has been abandoned for almost five years.

text: Imbes nga mangin solusyon sa trapiko, nangin isa pa gid ini ka daku nga rason sang padayon nga pagpugok sang dalagan sang trapiko sa amo nga area.
english: Instead of being a traffic solution, it has become another major reason for the continued congestion in the area.

text: Ang Aganan Flyover ang may kabug-osan nga pondo nga ₱802 million nga ginlunsar sang Hulyo 2020, kag ginlauman nga matapos sa sulod sang 24 ka bulan ukon duha ka tuig, apang tubtob subong wala ini nahuman.
english: The Aganan Flyover with a total fund of ₱802 million was launched in July 2020, and was expected to be completed within 24 months or two years, but so far it has not been completed.

text: Dugang pa ni Dizon, may yara na sang bag-o nga tikang ang DPWH agud mapadayon ang konstruksyon sang ginhingadlan man sini nga “palpak” nga flyover.
english: Dizon added that the DPWH has already taken a new step to continue the construction of what he called the “failed” flyover.

text: May gin-allocate na nga halos ₱229 million nga pondo agud matapos ang proyekto sa tuig 2026, nga ginlaragway niya bilang “Christmas gift” ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Nearly ₱229 million has been allocated to complete the project by 2026, which he described as a “Christmas gift” from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: para sa mga Ilonggo.
english: for the Ilonggos.

text: Antes magsugod liwat ang konstruksyon, magapatigayon anay ang DPWH sang konsultasyon sa mga foreign consultant nga magalawig sang halos isa ka bulan agud masiguro ang insakto kag husto nga pagpatuman sang proyekto.
english: Before resuming construction, the DPWH will conduct consultations with foreign consultants that will last nearly a month to ensure the proper and correct implementation of the project.

text: Nagpasalig man si Dizon nga pasabton ang mga indibidwal nga yara sa likod sang “palpak” nga Aganan Flyover agud mahatagan sang hustisya ang kabudlay kag perwisyo nga ginaantos sang mga taxpayers bangud sang amo nga proyekto.
english: Dizon also promised to hold the individuals behind the “failed” Aganan Flyover accountable in order to give justice to the hardships and losses suffered by taxpayers due to the project.

text: Nakuha sa CCTV footage ang isa ka pribado nga salakyan nga nagpalagyo matapos nga nagpatughong sang krudo sa isa ka gasoline station sa Quezon City.
english: CCTV footage captured a private vehicle fleeing after filling up at a gasoline station in Quezon City.

text: Suno sa pump attendant, namangkot anay ang driver sang nasambit nga salakyan kun may ara pa sang diesel ang gasolinahan antes nga ini nga nagpatughong kag nagpalagyo.
english: According to the pump attendant, the driver of the vehicle asked if the gas station had any diesel before he turned around and fled.

text: Gintinguhaan pa nga lagson sang attendant ang driver paagi sa pagsakay sang motor, apang wala na sini makit-an ang naglagyo nga indibidwal.
english: The attendant tried to chase the driver by riding a motorcycle, but he could not find the fleeing individual.

text: Nahibaluan nga naglab-ot sa P5,196.45 ang balor sang diesel ang wala ginbayran sang driver.
english: It was learned that the driver did not pay P5,196.45 worth of diesel.

text: Sa subong, gina-imbestigaran pa sang mga awtoridad ang nagluntad nga insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Bangud sa padayon nga pag-evolve kag pag-innovate sang Queen City Development Bank, natungdan sini ang papel bilang partner sa pagpaumwad pa sang komunidad.
english: Due to the continuous evolution and innovation of the Queen City Development Bank, it has taken on the role of a partner in the further development of the community.

text: Sa pagbukas kahapon, Pebrero 23, sang tatlo ka adlaw nga Top Level Management Conference nga ginhiwat sa Dr. Rogelio M. Florete Leadership Center sa Queenbank Building sa Valeria Street, Iloilo City, ginpahayag ni Miss Margaret Ruth Florete, President kag CEO sang Queen City Development Bank, nga padayon ang pag-evolve sang Queenbank agud makadungan sa madasig nga pag-uswag sang teknolohiya kag sa nagabag-o nga dynamics sang merkado.
english: At the opening yesterday, February 23, of the three-day Top Level Management Conference held at Dr. Rogelio M. Florete Leadership Center at the Queenbank Building on Valeria Street, Iloilo City, Miss Margaret Ruth Florete, President and CEO of the Queen City Development Bank, said Queenbank is continuously evolving to keep pace with the rapid development of technology and the changing market dynamics.

text: Suno kay Miss Margaret Ruth Florete, mabatyagan sang mga komunidad ang presensya sang bangko kag nagapabilin ini nga importante nga partner sang mga kliyente, labi na sa tion sang mga pagbag-o kag kakulang sang kasiguruhan.
english: Miss Margaret Ruth Florete said communities can feel the presence of the bank and it remains an important partner of clients, especially in times of change and uncertainty.

text: Nakita sang Queenbank ang madamo nga oportunidad nga ginadala sang inobasyon, entrepreneurship kag resilience.
english: Queenbank sees the many opportunities that innovation, entrepreneurship and resilience bring.
